タイトル: Powerful ecosystem, but some frustrating design choices
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー アパレル、ファッション, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Powerful ecosystem, but some frustrating design choices"
良い点: Google Workspace offers a lot of tools under one ecosystem and the integration between Gmail, Drive, Docs, Calendar, and Meet is convenient. It’s easy to access from anywhere and collaboration is straightforward. Sharing files and working with others in real time is one of its strongest points. For small businesses, having everything in one place is useful. Customer support has been shockingly good when needed. Value is actually quite good as well.
改善点: The biggest issue for me is Gmail search. It’s strange that Google, known for search, can struggle so much with finding emails. I’ve had emails seem to disappear or be difficult to locate even when I know they exist. The inline email/reply system can become messy and confusing with longer conversations. Some features feel different simply for the sake of being different rather than better, and parts of the experience feel less efficient and polished than Outlook.

タイトル: Best low-cost collaboration & sharing, but very basic functionality
投稿者: Arsiyanti アメリカのDirector 認証済みLinkedInユーザー スポーツ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Best low-cost collaboration & sharing, but very basic functionality"
良い点: Google Workspace makes real‑time collaboration effortless. Sharing is fast, simultaneous editing is smooth, and the core apps (Docs, Sheets, Slides) are accessible from anywhere. It's not even bad accessing and making minor changes or reviews from handheld devices like smartphones. It's also great if many people need access to files (for example, posting thousands of photographs I took for an event so that all the participants could look through for their own in organized files). It’s one of the most reliable ways to pull text out of PDFs while preserving basic formatting, especially when the source layout is fairly simple. They also save into PDF format without producing a giant file size, unlike comparable MS Office apps. Google Classroom can be an indispensable management tool for instructors, especially if students are doing or creating work through Workspace apps. And you can't beat the price--FREE! You get a surprising amount of functionality and storage for nothing.
改善点: Version recovery is practically nonexistent unless you manually download drafts. If you accidentally delete a section, overwrite a major or important idea, or lose phrasing you wanted to keep, you’re out of luck — the live document is all you have. The overall workflow feels fragile because there’s no dependable way to preserve your work history. Notifications for sharing or access changes are inconsistent, and it's inefficient to manually notify, clarify, or even attach files to email. It requires great vigilance to stay on top of sharing and settings, whether it's just a few or a few hundred who can access the files. Formatting tools are limited and cumbersome, taking a lot of time to click through and apply. With the exception of PDFs, Workspace apps don't play nicely with many external apps.

タイトル: Simple, Visual and Flexible Project Management for Teams

良い点: One of Trello's biggest strengths is its simple and visual approach to project management. The board, list, and card structure makes it easy to organize tasks, track progress, and understand priorities at a glance. Features such as labels, checklists, due dates, and task assignments provide a flexible way to manage different types of projects. Trello also offers useful automation capabilities through Butler, helping reduce repetitive actions and keep workflows organized. Its intuitive interface and collaboration features make it an appealing option for teams looking for a straightforward productivity tool.
改善点: One potential limitation is that Trello's simplicity can become restrictive when managing highly complex projects with multiple dependencies. Some advanced reporting, customization, and workflow features require paid plans or additional integrations. Boards with a large number of cards may also become harder to navigate without a consistent organizational structure. More built-in analytics and advanced project planning capabilities would make the platform even more versatile.

タイトル: Dropbox Review: Flawless File Syncing Powered by Premium Pricing
投稿者: Samantha アメリカのController 不動産, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Dropbox Review: Flawless File Syncing Powered by Premium Pricing"
良い点: What I like most about Dropbox is its unmatched cross-platform file syncing speed and reliability, ensuring edits update seamlessly across all connected devices in real time. Its clean, intuitive interface makes organizing massive file hierarchies effortless without clogging local hard drive space thanks to smart offline/online storage controls. Sharing large files or folders via instant link permissions is incredibly smooth for both internal team members and external clients. Additionally, robust version history and file recovery features provide ultimate peace of mind against accidental deletions or lost edits.
改善点: What I like least about Dropbox is its restrictive pricing structure and poor free tier value compared to main competitors. The free plan offers a meager 2 GB of storage with severe device-linking limits, making paid upgrades almost mandatory very quickly. Furthermore, there are no flexible, lower-cost intermediate tiers (like 100 GB or 200 GB), forcing users to jump directly to an expensive multi-terabyte subscription they may not fully need. Advanced zero-knowledge end-to-end encryption is also locked behind top-tier business plans, leaving standard consumer tiers relying heavily on server-side security.

タイトル: Do Not Buy Quickbooks
投稿者: Clara アメリカのDirector of Operations コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Do Not Buy Quickbooks"
良い点: I have used QuickBooks for years, but my recent experience has been extremely disappointing. The biggest issue is that payments are not posting correctly, creating unnecessary accounting headaches and forcing us to spend valuable time researching discrepancies that should never occur in financial software. When you rely on an accounting platform to provide accurate financial data, payment processing errors are simply unacceptable. What makes the situation even worse is the lack of customer support. Multiple attempts to resolve these issues through customer service resulted in little to no meaningful assistance. Escalations went nowhere, and even emails sent to the Office of the [sensitive content hidden] have gone unanswered. Imagine using financial software and being unable to confidently run financial reports because the underlying payment data cannot be trusted. The entire purpose of accounting software is to provide accurate financial information, yet that becomes impossible when transactions are not recorded properly. For a company that markets itself as a leader in accounting solutions, the lack of accountability and responsiveness is incredibly frustrating. Until these issues are addressed and customer support improves significantly, I cannot recommend QuickBooks to other businesses.
改善点: What I liked least about QuickBooks Enterprise was the reliability of its payment processing and the lack of effective customer support when issues arose. Payments were not consistently posting correctly, which created discrepancies in our financial records and made it difficult to trust the accuracy of financial reports. For accounting software, accurate financial data is essential, and these issues significantly impacted our operations. When we sought assistance, customer support was unable to provide a satisfactory resolution. Escalations were slow or nonexistent, and even emails sent to higher levels of management went unanswered. The combination of software issues and poor support made what should have been straightforward accounting tasks unnecessarily time-consuming and frustrating.

タイトル: The Ultimate Accounting Solution for Growing Mid-Sized Businesses
投稿者: Marquita アメリカのSALES MANAGER 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 航空宇宙産業, 5,001～10,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "The Ultimate Accounting Solution for Growing Mid-Sized Businesses"
良い点: QuickBooks Enterprise is the perfect solution for our mid-sized business, as it effortlessly handles our massive transactional volume. The advanced inventory tracking, multi-warehousing capabilities, and customizable user permissions are exactly what we needed to scale. It bridges the gap perfectly between basic small-business bookkeeping software and overly complex, multi-million dollar ERP systems.
改善点: The pricing model for QuickBooks Enterprise has reached an unsustainable level. Intuit is effectively compelling legacy users to transition to costly annual subscriptions while simultaneously removing essential localized features. Furthermore, the customer support experience is consistently frustrating, as the automated systems and representatives often lack the technical expertise required to assist with advanced accounting configurations.

タイトル: Easy-to-use and flexible spreadsheet tool for data management
投稿者: Nikitha アメリカのAI Proposal Intern 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Easy-to-use and flexible spreadsheet tool for data management"
良い点: Microsoft Excel is easy to use and provides good value for money for organizing, analyzing, and managing data. The Templates are useful for getting started quickly with common tasks, while the straightforward Navigation makes it easy to find tools and work with spreadsheets. Excel also provides a wide range of features for calculations, data organization, reporting, and day-to-day productivity. Mobile Device Compatibility is useful when I need to access or review spreadsheets away from my computer. Overall, Excel is a flexible and practical tool for both professional and academic work.
改善点: Large and complex spreadsheets can sometimes become difficult to manage, especially when there are many formulas, sheets, and data points. I have occasionally experienced minor Bugs and Issues, such as files taking longer to load or formulas requiring troubleshooting. Some advanced features can also take time to learn for new users. I have limited direct experience with Customer Support, so I cannot strongly evaluate that aspect.

タイトル: Very easy and simple!
投稿者: Monica アメリカのGraduate Assistant 教育管理, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Very easy and simple!"
良い点: What I like most about excel is that there is a built in function to create graphs from the data you enter. I also like how easy it is to add style/coloring/different fonts to the data.
改善点: What I like least about excel is that there is not a lot of help or clarity for using different functions. For example, I had to search in google for a long time to figure out which function/equation to use to count words.

タイトル: MSExcel_review
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 人材, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "MSExcel_review"
良い点: I particularly valued Microsoft Excel's versatility, advanced analytical tools, and ability to handle complex datasets. Features such as pivot tables, formulas, charts, and automation helped improve productivity and support data-driven decision-making.
改善点: What I liked least about Microsoft Excel was that large or highly complex spreadsheets can become difficult to maintain, troubleshoot, and audit over time. As workbooks grow in size, performance can sometimes slow down, and managing complex formulas across multiple sheets increases the risk of errors. Collaboration has improved significantly, but version control and ensuring data consistency can still be challenging when multiple users are involved.

タイトル: Excel - not perfect, but still better than Numbers
投稿者: Matthew オーストラリアのCEO 不動産, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Excel - not perfect, but still better than Numbers"
良い点: Excel is really powerful. It's my go to for anything involving numbers or data analysis. Formulas and pivot tables are killer for slicing and dicing data. Conditional formatting and charts make it easy to spot trends at a glance. And you can automate practically anything.
改善点: Excel is definitely not winning any usability awards in 2026 and if you're not a total spreadsheet geek like me, the UI is straight out of the stone age, and some of the more advanced features are buried in the clunky menus. Collabing on complex sheets can be a major headache too if you're not careful with the sharing settings, plus it's often overkill for simple stuff like basic lists or tables.

タイトル: Excell is the best option
投稿者: Fewry アメリカのGraphic Designer グラフィックデザイン, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Excell is the best option"
良い点: Excel saves a lot of time as it has many amazing features and shortcut like getting the total amout of figures being typed [ Auto-sum]. I like the fact that Microsoft excel doesn't give me bugs and related issues. Its customer support is indeed great. Its templates are very comprehensive.
改善点: The only con I have for Microsoft Excel is that it has some complex formula which might be tough to get use of it.

タイトル: Strong CRM Capabilities, But Cost Became the Breaking Point
投稿者: Bill カナダのVice President of Sales and Operations 教育管理, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Strong CRM Capabilities, But Cost Became the Breaking Point"
良い点: What stands out most about Salesforce Sales Cloud is how well it centralizes customer and sales information in one system. Everything from leads and opportunities to account history and activity tracking is connected, which makes it easier for sales teams to stay organized and follow up at the right time. The automation features also help reduce manual work, especially around lead routing, reminders, and pipeline updates. For managers, the reporting and dashboards provide strong visibility into sales performance, forecasts, and team activity, which helps with better decision-making and planning.
改善点: The biggest downside is cost. Salesforce Sales Cloud can get expensive quickly, especially once you start adding extra features, users, or third-party integrations. Even basic functionality often requires higher-tier licenses or add-ons, which increases the total cost of ownership. For many teams, it can feel like you’re paying a premium not just for the platform, but for every additional capability you need as you scale.

タイトル: Powerful but heavy - great once it’s set up properly
投稿者: khyan オーストラリアのSenior Business Development Representative コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Powerful but heavy - great once it’s set up properly"
良い点: The flexibility and depth of the platform. You can customise workflows, reporting, and dashboards to fit almost any sales process, and it integrates well with other tools. Once it’s set up properly, it becomes a very powerful system for managing pipelines, tracking activity, and giving leadership clear visibility over the sales process.
改善点: The main downside is the complexity and cost. It’s not the most intuitive system when you first start using it, and setup can take a fair bit of time and effort to get right. If it’s not managed well from an admin perspective, the interface can also become cluttered with too many fields and workflows.

タイトル: Comprehensive CRM but challenging to use at the same time
投稿者: Toni アメリカのDirector of Market Research 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 市場調査, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Comprehensive CRM but challenging to use at the same time"
良い点: Its the standard CRM. It has everything you could want, and then some. But at the same time, the plethora of features is also its biggest pain point.
改善点: As with the overall Salesforce platform, things are clunky and all over the place. Salesforce is a sort of everything for everyone CRM which means it does not have a solid interface, but one that is customizable, but at the same time very disorganized

タイトル: A Powerful CRM With Excellent Features but a Steep Learning Curve
投稿者: Jennifer アメリカのCustomer Care Expert 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 消費者サービス, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "A Powerful CRM With Excellent Features but a Steep Learning Curve"
良い点: Salesforce Sales Cloud is extremely flexible once you get the hang of it. The customization options let you build pipelines, dashboards, and automations that match your exact workflow. Reporting is one of its strongest features — you can break down data in almost any way and create visual dashboards that make performance easy to track. It also integrates smoothly with other tools, especially within the Salesforce ecosystem. Once everything is configured, the automation tools save a lot of time and reduce repetitive tasks. Salesforce Sales Cloud offers strong value for money if your team fully uses its customization and automation features. Once configured, it replaces multiple smaller tools, which can justify the cost. Customer support is generally knowledgeable, especially for technical or admin-level questions, and the documentation library is extensive. Communication channels are well-integrated — email, calls, tasks, and follow-ups can all be tracked in one place, making it easier to keep customer interactions organized. The platform is extremely customizable once you understand its structure, allowing you to tailor pipelines, dashboards, and automations to your workflow. Reporting is powerful, with flexible dashboards and detailed data breakdowns. Integrations with other Salesforce products and third‑party apps are smooth and reliable. Automation tools (flows, rules, triggers) significantly reduce manual work once set up correctly.
改善点: The biggest drawback is the learning curve. Salesforce can feel overwhelming for new users, and setup often requires someone with admin-level knowledge. Some features that feel like they should be standard require additional paid add‑ons, which increases the overall cost. Customer support can be inconsistent — sometimes fast, sometimes slow depending on the issue.

タイトル: The CRM Cloud we should all be using!
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "The CRM Cloud we should all be using!"
良い点: First of all, it is very easy to use. The real other benefit is that everyone uses it so the reps are used to using Salesforce and love it.
改善点: The implementation time to go from one CRM to Salesforce takes time and you may need to hire some consultants to help implement it.

タイトル: Simple, Reliable, and Convenient Communication
投稿者: Kadala タンザニアのteacher 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ネットワーク, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Simple, Reliable, and Convenient Communication"
良い点: What I like most about WhatsApp is how easy and convenient it is to stay connected with people. I use it to communicate with friends, colleagues, and clients through messages, voice calls, and video calls. I especially like how quickly I can share documents, photos, and other files. The simplicity of the app makes it easy for me to use both for personal communication and work.
改善点: I like least that large group chats can sometimes become overwhelming because of too many messages and notifications.

タイトル: WhatsApp in a Business Setting
投稿者: Samm カナダのOffice and Finance Manager 保険, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "WhatsApp in a Business Setting"
良い点: WhatsApp is a great way to connect with people when end-to-end encryption is of utmost importance. Having app and desktop software makes it easier for all staff to use regardless of whether they are in office or on the road. Messaging and file sharing are simple, even for users who are less technically savvy. Our business has found WhatsApp most beneficial when the Leadership team is traveling internationally as it gives the opportunity to avoid SMS messaging fees.
改善点: Unfortunately, WhatsApp has two major flaws that make it difficult to use consistently. In order to function, WhatsApp requires an internet connection and not everyone uses the App or is open to downloading it. In addition, backing up data requires understanding of separate settings.

タイトル: WhatsApp_review
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 人材, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "WhatsApp_review"
良い点: What I liked most about WhatsApp was its ease of use and reliability for instant communication. The app makes it simple to send messages, make voice and video calls, share files, and stay connected across different devices. I also appreciated the end-to-end encryption, which helps provide a secure communication experience, and the widespread adoption of the platform, making it easy to communicate with colleagues, friends, and family.
改善点: While WhatsApp is effective for communication, I found that managing high volumes of messages and group discussions could be challenging. The platform offers fewer collaboration, task management, and information organization features than enterprise communication tools.

タイトル: Versatile Messaging Tool for Productivity and Coordination
投稿者: Demilade Peter 英国のLearning and Development Advisor 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Versatile Messaging Tool for Productivity and Coordination"
良い点: WhatsApp is a highly versatile messaging tool that is easy to use for communication, coordination, project management, team development among other tasks without costing a lot, delivering great value for money from a literally free tool. Features I have used and found valuable include the chat, the document uploads, meeting set up, etc
改善点: WhatsApp is consistently making improvements, so it is sometimes hard to point out a fault that has now been fixed or corrected. One area of improvement is the inability to edit live polls

タイトル: Simple and convenient platform for messaging and group communication
投稿者: Nikitha アメリカのAI Proposal Intern 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Simple and convenient platform for messaging and group communication"
良い点: WhatsApp is easy to use and provides good value for money for everyday communication. The Messaging and Chat features make it simple to communicate with individuals and groups, while media and document sharing make conversations more convenient. The interface is straightforward, so it is easy to start conversations and manage ongoing communication without much setup.
改善点: When there are many group conversations and messages, it can sometimes become difficult to keep track of important information. I have occasionally experienced minor bugs and issues such as delayed notifications or messages taking time to synchronize. Some group conversations can also become cluttered when there is a high volume of messages. I have limited direct experience with Customer Support, so I cannot strongly evaluate that aspect. Project Management is also not a primary use case for me, although group chats can be useful for coordinating tasks and updates.

タイトル: Good and customisable tool for project management
投稿者: Maria 日本のProduct and UX Editor 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 病院、ヘルスケア, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Good and customisable tool for project management"
良い点: Jira works well for project management, especially when many team members are involved. The customisation requires skills, but the everyday use is relatively easy. Also, it creates nice diagrams and stats on how the work goes, which is pretty handy for meetings and presentations.
改善点: It is expensive if you use it for a large team, and it is not easy to justify the expense to top management.

タイトル: In regards to Jira
投稿者: Arvind 日本のSr. Talent Acquisition Partner 金融サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "In regards to Jira"
良い点: ・Workflow Efficiency ・Ease to Learn ・Cross department efficiency has increased by tenfold.
改善点: ・There is a learning curve for non PM background candidates. ・Implementation took a while.

タイトル: Super Helpful
投稿者: Federico 日本のSoftware Engineer 情報技術、情報サービス, 自営業 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Super Helpful"
良い点: Jira is super helpful for tracking tasks and bugs. It also lets you customize workflows and has great reporting tools
改善点: The price is also a bit high if you’re just looking for something simple

タイトル: Love the real-time insights to make accurate project decisions.
投稿者: Jane 日本のOperations Manager 情報技術、情報サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Love the real-time insights to make accurate project decisions."
良い点: Dreadful to easily match teams processes with workflows customization.
改善点: Seamless integration for third party application with Confluence.

タイトル: Pays off at scale, overkill for a small team
投稿者: Guillaume カナダのDirector of AI 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Pays off at scale, overkill for a small team"
良い点: The traceability is what I keep coming back to. Six months later I can open a ticket and see who decided what and why. No chat tool gives you that. Integrations and automation rules also do real work. A lot of the manual back and forth we used to do just disappeared once we set the rules up properly. And it holds up when you grow. We went from one project to several teams without the whole thing falling apart, which is not true of most tools I have used.
改善点: It is heavy for a small team. Under ten people the ceremony costs you more than it gives back, and you feel it every day. The admin side is a job in itself. Workflows, permissions, schemes, you need someone who actually owns the configuration. If nobody does, it drifts into a mess within a few months. We learned that one the hard way.

タイトル: A Flexible and Reliable Platform for Building and Managing Websites
投稿者: Andrea スペインのInnovation Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 翻訳、ローカライゼーション, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A Flexible and Reliable Platform for Building and Managing Websites"
良い点: What I like most about WordPress is its flexibility. It's relatively easy to use for everyday website management, even without advanced technical knowledge, while still offering a huge range of customisation options through themes and plugins. It makes it easy to update content, create new pages and manage a website without having to rely on a developer for every small change.
改善点: The main downside is that managing plugins, updates and compatibility can sometimes become complicated. Some issues require more technical knowledge to troubleshoot, and having too many plugins can also affect performance. The interface is generally intuitive, but certain settings could be more straightforward.

タイトル: Cool for building websites if you don’t know how to code
投稿者: Alicia スペインのFull stack developer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー インターネット, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Cool for building websites if you don’t know how to code"
良い点: I like how easy is and also is well integrated with other tools. Even if you don’t know how to code, you can built a website for free. The mobile experience is also nice. Their plugin library is amazing.
改善点: It could be quite confusing for a programmer because I couldn’t find the settings I wanted to change. With codes is easier.

タイトル: Wordpress User for years
投稿者: Susan アメリカのFounder CEO 消費財, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Wordpress User for years"
良い点: My small business has been using wordpress for many years and it is reliable, and user friendly. Once you learn where things are the page layout is predictable and makes editing easy which saves time over always having product updates with changes that make you have to re-learn where things are.
改善点: Probably what I like least is that I don't receive many emails or on screen tips to let me know about new ways, tips, tricks or optimizations to do.

タイトル: Very flexible, but not always easy to manage
投稿者: Davis アメリカのHead of Finance 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 機械・産業工学, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Very flexible, but not always easy to manage"
良い点: WordPress gives you a lot of freedom with page layouts, templates and plugins. Adding blogs, news and simple content changes is fairly easy once everything is setup. There are also plenty of developers who know WordPress, so finding support is not difficult.
改善点: Page editing was not always as simple as it looks. Many small layout changes still needed a developer. An update could sometimes break something that was working fine before. The site can also get slower when too many plugins are installed, and you still have to think about hosting, backups, updates and general maintenance. Even some changes that looked simple ended up needing a developer, which adds cost and takes time.

タイトル: Flexible, Scalable, and Powerful CMS for Modern Web Development
投稿者: Salman インドのDirector and Senior Full-Stack Developer 情報技術、情報サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Flexible, Scalable, and Powerful CMS for Modern Web Development"
良い点: Extremely versatile open-source CMS with an extensive ecosystem of plugins and themes. It allows rapid website development, custom theme integration, easy content updates, and strong SEO optimization capabilities out of the box.
改善点: Plugin compatibility issues and security vulnerabilities can arise if updates aren't properly managed. It requires regular maintenance, caching configuration, and performance tuning for high-traffic sites.

タイトル: Great software to home office work!!
投稿者: João イタリアのArchitect 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 建築、設計, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Great software to home office work!!"
良い点: I like the convenience and the easy way that working with Zoom helps the work to be flawless and easier due to the tools and the intuitive way of participating in a meeting on it.
改善点: I do not have anything in particular to say, however. i prefer to use this software in comparison to the ones on the market.

タイトル: Best Video Conferencing
投稿者: Lluvia アメリカのGeneral Manager 経理, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Best Video Conferencing"
良い点: The zoom workplace is a great way to hold professional meetings. The video calls are easy to use and send invitations. The file sharing and collaboration feature makes sending documents easy, with the drag and drop feature.
改善点: The least thing I liked about the Zoom Workplace is that if you have bad internet connection it does not work as well. The buffering takes some time which makes communication difficult.

タイトル: Every day space tool for enterprise
投稿者: Edwin カナダのDEV Manager 金融サービス, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Every day space tool for enterprise"
良い点: Zoom Workplace has become one of the two tools my team uses almost every day because it brings meetings, chat, file sharing, and scheduling together in one place. The video quality has been consistently good, even when several people are sharing their screens at the same time. I also like the AI Companion features that automatically summarize meetings, create action items, and highlight important decisions. That saves me from taking detailed notes and makes it much easier to catch up if I miss part of a discussion. The interface is clean and easy to learn, so new team members can start using it quickly. Team collaboration feels smooth because chat, meetings, and document sharing are connected instead of being spread across different apps. Overall, it has improved productivity and reduced the amount of time spent organizing meetings and following up afterward.
改善点: The biggest downside for me is that some of the newer features make the application feel more crowded than it used to be. There are many menus and options, so finding a specific setting can sometimes take longer than expected. While the AI features are useful, the meeting summaries occasionally miss small but important details or misunderstand technical discussions, so I still review the notes before sharing them with my team. I have also experienced occasional bugs, such as delayed notifications or brief audio issues after waking my laptop from sleep, although restarting the meeting usually fixes the problem. Customer support has been helpful when I needed assistance, but response times have varied depending on the issue. Pricing is reasonable for business use, but smaller teams may find some advanced collaboration features available only in higher-tier plans.

タイトル: Uniting people in business all in one
投稿者: Toni アメリカのCEO ベンチャーキャピタル、プライベートエクイティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Uniting people in business all in one"
良い点: I like that it is an easy to use. Usually when people want to go on a meeting, they call it a zoom meeting. Most people have it and know how to use it more than other types of meetings.
改善点: There’s always something to approve upon. I believe when you’re in the medium it’s a little bit limited on what you can do as far as using some features including changing your background or your name, it just a little bit bulky. When people are presenting, the writing can be extra small unless you make it zoomed in or part of the large screen. I wish it was a little bit more simpler so you can still see the writing easily.

タイトル: Reliable for Meetings, Training and Team Collaboration
投稿者: Harsh Vipul ドイツのCEO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー イベント企画運営, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Reliable for Meetings, Training and Team Collaboration"
良い点: I like how reliable and easy it is for online meetings. Joining or hosting a meeting takes very little effort, and features like screen sharing, breakout rooms, and recording are very useful for team meetings and sessions.
改善点: Sometimes the app feels a little heavy, especially with frequent updates and the number of features available. The free meeting time limit can also be inconvenient for longer sessions.

タイトル: Great for Simple, Organized Project Management
投稿者: Nikitha アメリカのAI Proposal Intern 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Great for Simple, Organized Project Management"
良い点: Basecamp makes project management easy by keeping tasks, team communication, files, and project updates organized in one workspace. The interface is straightforward and easy to learn, while features such as file sharing and team collaboration make it convenient to keep project information accessible. It also provides a good balance of useful features without making day-to-day project management feel overly complicated.
改善点: Basecamp works well for basic project management, but some features feel limited compared with more advanced tools. Reporting and customization options could be more extensive, and occasional bugs or issues can make certain workflows less smooth. The invoicing and payment capabilities are also less comprehensive than dedicated financial management tools.

タイトル: A Great All-in-One Project Management Tool
投稿者: Nikki アメリカのoffice manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 建設, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "A Great All-in-One Project Management Tool"
良い点: I like how easy Basecamp makes it to keep projects, tasks, files, and team communication organized in one place. It’s user-friendly, easy for our team to navigate, and helps keep everyone on the same page without making project management feel overly complicated. The file sharing and communication features are especially helpful for keeping project information accessible and organized.
改善点: Some features can feel limited compared to more advanced project management platforms. The invoicing and payment options could also be more robust, and it can take some time to get everything organized the way you want. Overall, though, the simplicity is also one of Basecamp’s strengths.

タイトル: Basecamp 5 is a perfect failure

Another major strength is transparency. It is much easier to see who is responsible for a task, what needs to be done next, and where a project currently stands. 改善点: The flexibility of Asana can also make it challenging. Some features and permissions can also be difficult to understand at first, especially in larger organizations with different user roles and license levels. In addition, there are situations where I would like even more flexibility when configuring workflows and automations. For new users, I would therefore recommend providing some initial guidance and establishing clear conventions for how projects, tasks, custom fields, and workflows should be used.

Connections are fast and reliable, even to machines on locked-down networks — it just works without firewall or VPN configuration on our end. Cross-platform coverage is the real strength: Windows, Mac, Linux, and mobile all handled from one console, which no other tool we tried matched. Having remote access, session recording, and device monitoring under one login cut down the number of tools we pay for, and unattended access to servers has been rock solid.	Pricing is the main complaint — it's noticeably more expensive than comparable tools, licensing tiers are confusing, and renewal terms are rigid with little flexibility if your needs change mid-contract. 良い点: TeamViewer ONE's main appeal is that it bundles remote support, endpoint/patch management, and digital employee experience (DEX) monitoring into a single platform instead of stitching together separate tools. Beyond reliable, secure remote access and screen sharing, it proactively flags and often auto-resolves device issues (like low disk space) before they turn into tickets, and it layers in AI-generated session summaries and integrations with existing ITSM/security tools — so for an environment like mine, managing multiple client workstations, it's less about one-off remote sessions and more about catching problems early across the whole fleet.
改善点: My biggest complaints are around cost and licensing. I will call it expensive, with restrictive free plans and a frustrating cancellation process. There's also a learning curve for new users, occasional connectivity issues tied to internet quality, and some frustration with version compatibility and false commercial use detection flagging the free version.

投稿者: SHANNON アメリカのTEAM LEADER, BILLING ANALYST 病院、ヘルスケア, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Teams Player"
良い点: The feature I like most about Teams is as a team leader and being a remote company, I can see when my team members are active, in a meeting, away, or out of office. This is very beneficial as a remote company to be able to see how long any one person is away from their computer during the work day. It also makes the team members more mindful of how long they are away for reasons other than lunch.
改善点: I can honestly say, there isn't anything about Teams that I have not been satisfied with since I began using it.

タイトル: Helps us find the best candidates, but AI is muddying the waters
投稿者: Nicholas アメリカのSafety Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 運輸、トラック、鉄道, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Helps us find the best candidates, but AI is muddying the waters"
良い点: What I liked best about ZipRecruiter is that it allows us to find the best candidates for open positions as quickly as possible
改善点: What I like least about ZipRecruiter is how AI integration has made things worse for both candidates and employers. I feel trust is at an all time low.

タイトル: Tried and True
投稿者: Jabbara アメリカのOwner 食品製造, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Tried and True"
良い点: Zip recruiter brings me quality applicants very fast. And it simply just a great price for what they offer. They made the interviewing in hiring process easy.
改善点: I think ziprecruiter would benefit from having a section , specifically dedicated to the arts. This would help a lot of outside of the box.Business is fine creative people.

タイトル: Job Seeker Tool
投稿者: Jeannie アメリカのOwner Operator 消費者サービス, 自営業 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Job Seeker Tool"
良い点: ZipRecruiter makes it easy to find and apply for jobs. It saves me time, recommends jobs that match my experience, and keeps me updated on new opportunities.
改善点: I come aross some job listings that were outdated or showed up more than once. Sometimes the job recommendations don't fully match what I'm looking for, either. I also wish there were more updates from employers after applying.

タイトル: Good Platform Experience, Disappointing Hiring Results
投稿者: Ashley アメリカのHR Manager 海運, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Good Platform Experience, Disappointing Hiring Results"
良い点: ZipRecruiter is easy to use and makes it simple to get a job posting in front of a large audience. I appreciated the straightforward setup process, user-friendly dashboard, and the ability to manage applicants and communications in one place. The platform also generated a high volume of applicants relatively quickly. Pros: Easy to use, quick job posting setup, broad candidate reach, centralized applicant management, and high application volume.
改善点: Compared to competitors, our experience with ZipRecruiter was disappointing. Poor candidate matching, low applicant quality, and limited value for the cost. For the cost of the platform and the time investment required to manage postings and review applicants, we did not see a sufficient return on investment. Cons: Candidate matching was not accurate, applicant quality was low for our needs, and the platform did not provide sufficient value relative to the cost.

タイトル: User Friendly and a good value
投稿者: Martha アメリカのPayroll and Admin Specialist 広報・渉外, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "User Friendly and a good value"
良い点: Zip recruiter is a great tool for our recruitment process. It was an easy platform to use when it came to employee recruiting and management. It was nice to be able to customize the posting how we wanted it to show up. Customer Service was easy to get a hold of and they were very responsive which made it even more of a value for the money paid.
改善点: What I liked least was that we did not get as many candidates as we did on other recruiting platforms. Like maybe not as many people are looking on Zip Recruiter as we thought.

タイトル: Growing up by WIX.
投稿者: Kittin 日本のEverything by owner 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Growing up by WIX."
良い点: I like Wix owner app and Wix have stat for analytics my customer. App for make VDO high quality is the best.
改善点: Notifications is not stable for my account. Visitors notification and reservation contact forms in the past sound is different but now sound of notification for reservation contact forms is same some sound. It hard to handle when I have the same sound hand I am lost customer a lot so Wix can help me this problem.

タイトル: Empowering Non-Technical Owners to Build Beautiful Sites Fast
投稿者: Ekpono 英国のSenior Software Engineer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 翻訳、ローカライゼーション, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Empowering Non-Technical Owners to Build Beautiful Sites Fast"
良い点: Wix gives a non technical business owners the option as an absolute beginner to chat with an AI bot to create a remarkably beautiful website that would need a software developer and cost a whole lot and takes a long time. There are a lot of already made template and blocks that can be used immediately to save time. You can insert videos and images from your laptop into your website and easily purchase your domain or connect to an existing one with just few clicks.
改善点: You pay monthly to keep your website running and it feels a bit too much if you are not making money immediately from the website. Sometimes the flexibility needed to design some sections of the application is not available. And also custom integrate needs someone technical

タイトル: Easy-to-Use Website Builder with Great Design Flexibility
投稿者: Anil K. インドのSoftware Developer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Easy-to-Use Website Builder with Great Design Flexibility"
良い点: Wix makes it very easy to create and manage a professional-looking website without requiring advanced technical knowledge. I especially like the drag-and-drop editor, wide range of templates, customization options, and the ability to manage website content from one platform. The design flexibility and built-in business features are also very useful.
改善点: Some advanced features can take time to understand, especially when customizing the website beyond the standard templates. Pricing can also become relatively expensive when additional premium features or business tools are required. The editor may occasionally feel a little overwhelming because of the number of available options.

タイトル: Read this and choose another website platform ...not Wix for sure
投稿者: Jodie オーストラリアのDirector 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Read this and choose another website platform ...not Wix for sure"
良い点: Nothing...my website is useless...Wix have been of zero help over an issue that is soley their fault. Despite paying for a premium subscription, they have not provided any help for 4 days now to have it back up. I have called 8 times and about to call a 9th.
改善点: Lack of tech support totally. My website is still not re-instated even though a fully paid for premium plan plus extras has been paid for. My business has not been able to operate at all for 4 days and counting. You get nice non-expert people who are scripted to care yet nothing gets done and you cannot get them to do anything except say sorry. After 8 phone calls, the sorry completely wears off.

タイトル: Good entry point
投稿者: Tanya カナダのPsychotherapist メンタルヘルスケア, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Good entry point"
良い点: One of the strongest aspects of Wix is its user-friendly and intuitive design. After several years away from web design, I was initially concerned that getting back into it would involve a steep learning curve. However, Wix made the process straightforward and accessible, allowing me to get started quickly and build confidence as I worked. The platform provides a good balance between ease of use and creative flexibility. Its range of templates, customization options, and built-in tools made it possible to create a professional-looking website without requiring extensive technical or coding knowledge. I also appreciated being able to make changes and see the results immediately, which made the overall design process more efficient and enjoyable.
改善点: One area where Wix could be improved is the flexibility of its page design. The use of frames and predefined sections can sometimes feel limiting, particularly when trying to create a more customized or unique layout. While these features help maintain consistency and make the design process easier for beginners, they can also restrict how elements are positioned and arranged on the page. It would also be beneficial to have more drag-and-drop functionality throughout the platform. Having greater freedom to move, resize, and position individual elements exactly where desired would provide more creative control and make it easier to achieve a specific design vision. Expanding these options would allow users to maintain the simplicity and accessibility that Wix is known for while offering more flexibility for users with greater design experience.

タイトル: Mostly great, sometimes a challenge...
投稿者: Ann アメリカのPublic Information Supervisor 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Mostly great, sometimes a challenge..."
良い点: Used across all kinds of fields for all purposes. Most people versed on its use, comfortable with accessing.
改善点: I currently dislike the feature of opening photos as a PDF, which requires me to use my Adobe subscription to export the created PDF as a jpeg file when it started out as an image file. Can't find a setting to change it.

タイトル: Solid PDF Reader with Limited Free Features
投稿者: Brooks アメリカのSubstitute Teacher 初等・中等教育, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Solid PDF Reader with Limited Free Features"
良い点: VALUE FOR MONEY Adobe Acrobat Reader is a solid free option for basic PDF viewing and commenting, but many advanced tools (like full editing and advanced conversions) require a paid upgrade, which can feel expensive for casual users.
改善点: What I liked least about Adobe Acrobat Reader is that many of the most useful tools are locked behind a paid subscription. Features like full file conversion and advanced editing are limited in the free version, which affects overall value for money. It can also feel a bit restricted when you need more than just basic PDF viewing and signing.

タイトル: Adobe Acrobat Reader – My Paperwork's Best Friend!
投稿者: Sudeep カナダのSr. Accountant 不動産, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Adobe Acrobat Reader – My Paperwork's Best Friend!"
良い点: What I like most about Adobe Acrobat Reader is how easy it makes opening, reading, and managing PDF documents. I often need to review documents, check important details, and share files, so having a reliable PDF reader is really useful. I especially like being able to highlight text, add comments, fill out forms, and sign documents electronically without printing everything. It saves me time and helps me keep my paperwork organized. I also appreciate that the basic PDF reading features are available for free.
改善点: One thing I find frustrating is that some useful features, such as advanced PDF editing and certain file conversion options, require a paid subscription. The number of menus and options can sometimes make the application feel more complicated than necessary. I have also noticed that larger PDF files can occasionally take a while to load. I would appreciate more affordable access to advanced features and a simpler interface for everyday tasks.

タイトル: Adobe Acrobat Reader, sometimes upgrades just add bloat
投稿者: Danielle オランダのOwner-operator 不動産, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Adobe Acrobat Reader, sometimes upgrades just add bloat"
良い点: Adobe Acrobat Reader is an universal oriented program. It opens almost every PDF, big or small, across several devices, OS, and computers.
改善点: Adobe Acrobat Reader has this many (big) pop-ups/prompts and ads. Almost an agressive way to push you to upgrade to the Pro/paid version.

タイトル: The standard for PDF’s
投稿者: Savannah アメリカのAssociate Dentist 病院、ヘルスケア, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "The standard for PDF’s"
良い点: Adobe Acrobat Reader is frequently updated which make it the benchmark standing for reading PDF documents, so much so that it's almost all i use for documents.
改善点: Overall is okay for reading pdf, you are unable to do more with it instead switch to Acrobat without "Reader" in title. Not free but you could do edits like filling out forms or adding you signature.

タイトル: Easy-to-use, reliable tool to collect feedback
投稿者: Dre' アメリカのSenior Educator Support Specialist 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 非営利団体運営, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Easy-to-use, reliable tool to collect feedback"
良い点: SurveyMonkey is very easy to use and it has great flexibility. I really like that I can generate a survey very quickly or use it for something more elaborate if necessary. Specifically, I like the number of question formats that are either more difficult to create with other products or not available.
改善点: For some reason, I have had a hard time with download options. It's not hard. But I almost always select options incorrectly before I remember the settings for getting all the individual responses in a spreadsheet format. I don't now what the barrier is to me remembering that. User error, I'm sure.

タイトル: Easy to Use and Great for Collecting Feedback
投稿者: Heather アメリカのOwner Operator 消費財, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Easy to Use and Great for Collecting Feedback"
良い点: SurveyMonkey is very user friendly and makes it easy to create and distribute professional surveys without needing a lot of technical knowledge. I like the variety of templates and question types, as well as how quickly surveys can be customized and shared with customers or employees. The reporting features are also helpful because responses are organized in a way that makes feedback easy to review and understand.
改善点: My biggest drawback is the pricing structure. The basic features work well, but many of the more useful customization, reporting, and advanced survey features require a paid or higher tier plan. This can make it expensive for a small business or for someone who only needs to create surveys occasionally.

タイトル: Survey Monkey - Quick and Easy
投稿者: Natalie アメリカのAdmissions Coordinator 教育管理, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Survey Monkey - Quick and Easy"
良い点: I am able to easily poll students about a variety of questions. It's quick, and very easy to use to gather information at school.
改善点: The number of questions I can use with the free programming are limited. Also, the number of students that can respond is capped as well.

タイトル: It works just fine for collecting basic feedback.
投稿者: Pritam アメリカのEarly Childhood Educator 教育管理, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "It works just fine for collecting basic feedback."
良い点: We mostly use it for post-event surveys and checking in with customers every now and then. The templates are a lifesaver when we’re in a rush to get something sent out the same day. Plus, the question logic actually works without much fuss, and exporting to Excel is simple enough that our small team can handle the data ourselves without needing any fancy extra software.
改善点: The pricing jumped way up once we hit their response limits, and honestly, that happened a lot faster than we expected during our product launch. Some of the branding options feel pretty locked down on our current plan, too. It’d be great to have more flexibility with question types, and I’m just over being constantly upsold to the enterprise tiers.

タイトル: Sent 47 supplier surveys last Tuesday, had 31 responses by Friday morning.
投稿者: Nelson アメリカのOwner 鉱業、金属, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Sent 47 supplier surveys last Tuesday, had 31 responses by Friday morning."
良い点: Last month I polled 8 equipment suppliers on delivery windows and payment terms. Setup only took me 22 minutes, and I had all the responses back within 72 hours. The export to Excel gives me clean data I can actually use in our procurement spreadsheets, which is a huge help.
改善点: The template library assumes you're running customer satisfaction surveys or employee reviews. Finding question formats that work for supplier evaluations or safety compliance checks took me 40 minutes of trial and error. Would save time if they had an industrial operations section with pre-built logic.

タイトル: Give your review a title*
投稿者: Bob アメリカのCEO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 消費財, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Give your review a title*"
良い点: I liked that DocuSign made it easy to send, sign, and track documents electronically. The process was convenient and fast, and it eliminated the need to print and scan.
改善点: A common drawback is that the interface can feel a bit complex, and some features and pricing can be confusing for occasional users.

タイトル: great go to contract signing platform
投稿者: Arran 英国のDirector 小売, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "great go to contract signing platform"
良い点: 30 day free trial so that I could decide if I wanted to continue using docusign, overall great value product and simple to use / set up
改善点: Its hard to say what i like least. its an overall well designed contract and document management software

タイトル: Signing takes a minute, template upkeep takes an afternoon
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 金融サービス, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Signing takes a minute, template upkeep takes an afternoon"
良い点: Short signer side. I open the email, click through the fields, and finish in under a minute without creating an account. The signed PDF and the audit trail come back to my inbox, so I never had to chase anyone for proof that a document was signed. Legal accepted the signatures in every country we dealt with, and in a few years I never saw an envelope get lost or a signature fail to register. The API is documented well enough that I pulled envelope status into another system without opening a support ticket.
改善点: Template setup. You place every field on the PDF by hand, and when the document layout shifts by a line or two, the fields land in the wrong spots and you rebuild the template. Anchor text helps until someone edits the wording it anchors to. The web interface also adds clicks to things that should take one: finding an old envelope, resending it, checking who has not signed yet. On a phone the signing view zooms in a way that makes long contracts hard to read, so I stopped signing anything over two pages from mobile. None of this breaks the product. It costs time every week that a cleaner editor would give back.

タイトル: Not a week goes by that I am not grateful for docusign!
投稿者: Michele アメリカのCEO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 教育管理, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Not a week goes by that I am not grateful for docusign!"
良い点: I love how unbelievably user-friendly Docusign is, no matter what your comfort level with technology is. What’s amazing is how seamlessly the desktop version is mimicked on the mobile version. The way everything is formatted it makes it virtually impossible to make a mistake and the fact that everyone gets a copy immediately is such a time saver. No one can ever dispute when a document was signed when it was sent or when it was received! It’s all there in black-and-white. I will say this repeatedly, there is not a week that goes by in my life that I don’t say out loud how much I appreciate this technology. It is a game changer and a life changer. When you can do business, review contracts, get them signed, or sign them yourself from no matter where you are, including laying poolside! That to me is priceless.
改善点: I honestly wish I had something negative to say about Docusign as I know that that makes a review more valid, but there is not a single thing that I could think of. Not a single thing.

タイトル: Easy and Convenient for Signing Documents
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 人材, 自営業 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Easy and Convenient for Signing Documents"
良い点: I like how easy it is to sign and send documents online. The interface is user-friendly, and it's convenient for handling documents remotely.
改善点: Some features are only available with paid plans, which can be a bit limiting for occasional/guest users.

タイトル: Convenient and Easy-to-Use Payment App
投稿者: Ethan アメリカのContractor 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 建設, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Convenient and Easy-to-Use Payment App"
良い点: What I like most about Venmo is how simple and convenient it is. It’s easy to send and receive money, and the app is straightforward to use without feeling confusing. I think it offers good value for the money, and I like having the option to use a credit card when I need to. The fees are generally reasonable and easy to understand, and Venmo can also be really useful for small businesses or anyone who needs an easy way to accept payments. Customer support has been helpful when I’ve had questions, and although I’ve experienced an occasional glitch or delay, nothing major has gotten in the way of using the app. Overall, Venmo makes payments quick, convenient, and hassle-free.
改善点: The biggest thing I like least about Venmo is that some of the fees can add up, especially when using certain payment methods or transferring money instantly. I’ve also experienced occasional glitches or delays, which can be frustrating when I need a payment to go through quickly. Customer support can sometimes take longer than expected to respond, and I wish there were a little more protection and flexibility when dealing with payment issues or disputes. Overall, Venmo is convenient, but the fees, occasional technical problems, and customer service delays are the main areas I think could be improved.

タイトル: Great asset for parents of college students.
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 農業, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great asset for parents of college students."
良い点: I started using Venmo to send my college student kids money. I sent my daughter a card in the mail with cash one time and it was stolen. Venmo solved this problem and it was very easy to use and made it easy to send them money when they needed it.
改善点: I do worry when I'm sending $ that it is going to the correct place. I have never had an issue though.

タイトル: Free and easy to use but security is a concern
投稿者: Md アメリカのResearch Assistant 高等教育, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Free and easy to use but security is a concern"
良い点: It is very easy to set it up to transfer fund to and from bank account. Creating an account was very straight-forward for me. I liked how easy I could add friends and family.
改善点: The interface and the size of writing looks oddly bigger. Also, the transaction history is tough to access and see. I do not see any referral bonus system.

タイトル: Consider only for convenience
投稿者: Jessica アメリカのOwner 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Consider only for convenience"
良い点: The ease of tap to charge your customers for small business p.o.s. and the many different methods of how to withdraw the money to whatever card or account you prefer
改善点: When you have a problem with your account , not something you're in control of they'll ask you to verify yourself for them to unrestrict your funds for you to use. I had a situation where it was literally life or death and received donations for redemption of a dog from the pound or they would euthanize him the following day. Well I swear Venmo restricted the account and they have a 3 day waiting period for them to look at the documents you uploaded and they cannot bypass that mark it urgent or speed it up no matter the situation

タイトル: Fast, Convenient Payments with Minor Fee Friction
投稿者: christopher アメリカのBrand Strategy Lead マーケティング、広告, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Fast, Convenient Payments with Minor Fee Friction"
良い点: Venmo makes person‑to‑person payments incredibly fast and intuitive, removing friction from everyday transactions. Its interface is clean, predictable, and easy for anyone to navigate without needing technical guidance.
改善点: The platform’s fee structure can feel inconsistent, especially when transferring funds instantly or using certain payment methods. Occasional verification delays also interrupt the otherwise smooth experience.

タイトル: For track time and stay Focus
投稿者: Federico 日本のSoftware Engineer 情報技術、情報サービス, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "For track time and stay Focus"
良い点: Clockify is very easy to use and it's free! I can track my time on different projects and tasks. The reports are also helpful for analyzing my productivity.
改善点: Nothing really bad! Clockify is a great tool for time tracking.

タイトル: Overly impressed by its realtime productivity monitoring.
投稿者: Jane 日本のOperations Manager 情報技術、情報サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Overly impressed by its realtime productivity monitoring."
良い点: Overly impressed by its real-time productivity monitoring.
改善点: Fascinating for it's real-time collaboration.

タイトル: Highly recommended! Clockify improved the way I spent my time and definitely increased profitability.
投稿者: Sandra アメリカのAccountant Owner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 経理, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Highly recommended! Clockify improved the way I spent my time and definitely increased profitability."
良い点: I use Clockify daily and recommend this product to most of my clients. Clockify is easy to use, cost effective and a usefull tool when it comes to task management and client billing. One of the best things about this product is that it can be tailored to specific needs. I love that there are multiple subscription levels so most people can just pay for the features they need. Clockify also offers free basic time tracking. Once I started using the free version, I was able to really look at where my time was spent and realized I was not using my time as efficiently and profitably as I thought. I also use the mobile app to track time, billing and driving when I consult with clients out of the office.
改善点: I have not find anything I do not like about Clockify but I also do not use any of the advanced features or highler subcription levels. The time tracking features, reporting and mobile app are perfect for my needs to help me manage my business and small team of contractors.

タイトル: Simple, affordable, and effective time tracking tool
投稿者: Elena スペインのFreelance Copywriter 認証済みLinkedInユーザー マーケティング、広告, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Simple, affordable, and effective time tracking tool"
良い点: The best thing about Clockify is the price. It’s cheaper than other tools if you want to upgrade your billing plan or your team grows. If you work remotely with other people, it’s a great way to track time, see where you’re spending most of it, and spot opportunities to be more productive. It’s also very easy to use and you can quickly create projects and track tasks without much setup.
改善点: The interface isn’t as polished or visually appealing as some other time-tracking tools I’ve tried. It’s quite simple, effective, but not very customizable. You can’t personalize reports that much, but it’s not a big issue overall.

タイトル: Glad it really works as expected
投稿者: Gurjeev アメリカのBusiness Analyst コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Glad it really works as expected"
良い点: Clockify does keep an accurate record of all of my work hours and doesn’t crash (which I find impressive). The dashboard is available and is “fine” I suppose. I can view my hours worked for each client in their local time zone, therefore no need to perform some type of mental arithmetic.
改善点: The photo taking feature is very odd and somewhat creepy; What if I have a personal medical email open and it captures a photo of that? The desktop application frequently makes me login again.

タイトル: Powerful tool for professional design. Way better than Canva for certain things
投稿者: Roger カナダのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー マーケティング、広告, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Powerful tool for professional design. Way better than Canva for certain things"
良い点: I like how powerful Illustrator is for vector design and illustration. It gives a lot of control and precision for creating logos, icons, and graphics.
改善点: The learning curve is high and it can be overwhelming at the beginning. Also, it requires a good computer to run smoothly.

タイトル: Powerful Product

良い点: I like that it is the standard in the industry for use of digital art and desing work. I use it primarily for logo and content design and features like the Image Trace tool stand out as something I use almost every day.
改善点: There is a huge learning curve. Even as someone who has used it for 5 plus years, there are still things I have not figured out and am still learning how to do.

タイトル: Adobe Illustrator - High Performance Capabilities
投稿者: Anne アメリカのSenior Developer 保険, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Adobe Illustrator - High Performance Capabilities"
良い点: Adobe Illustrator is a fantastic tool for illustration and drawing. It can be used to create and edit images and has many tools and features to enhance images. Once you jump in, it can be easy to use to edit images.
改善点: There is a learning curve to learn all of the tools and capabilities Adobe Illustrator has to offer. Once you dive in, you can create spectacular images.

タイトル: The main vector illustration program out there.
投稿者: Clifford 英国のGraphic designer グラフィックデザイン, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "The main vector illustration program out there."
良い点: Creates scalable vector artwork, which can then be imported into a number of other software application applications.
改善点: Overcomplicated; earlier incarnations of illustrator were simpler to use. Too many functions available that I will personally never use as an illustrator. Not happy with having to pay annual subscription fee.

タイトル: Best for Illustrative Design
投稿者: Octavia アメリカのGraphic Designer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー グラフィックデザイン, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Best for Illustrative Design"
良い点: Adobe Illustrator is an industry-standard platform that allows for graphics creation. It has many features and recieves frequent updates, allowing for you to keep up to date with modern design. Great for creating illustrative graphics as well as drawings, due to the pen features, brush features and vectorization (allowing for a "sleek" or professional look). Very easy to use after watching simple tutorials or using the in app help.
改善点: The app can occasionally experience glitches that cause it to become difficult to use and require you to reconfigure your workspace, though these are usually resolved easily by checking your in-app settings or restarting the program.

タイトル: Runs my firm and most of my clients' books
投稿者: Eri アメリカのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 経理, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Runs my firm and most of my clients' books"
良い点: I have been using Quickbooks for years. Orginally starting on Enterprise before moving to Quickbooks Online. Overall Quickbooks online covers most of my clients needs and still remains as one of the competing accounting software for small business owners. The big stand out compared to its competition is the amount of integrations available via their app market. My clients use different software unique to their industry, Quickbooks makes this seamless by offering an integration for most if not all.
改善点: Support is the weak spot. The biggest challenge is when something goes wrong it can be difficult to get good help. Often I'm using forums and searching for solutions to the issue online. They are not as frequent but when they do happen, it can be troublesome.

タイトル: Does what you want, and they'll listen to feedback too
投稿者: Andrew カナダのPresident 不動産, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Does what you want, and they'll listen to feedback too"
良い点: Fairly straightforward, being able to send invoices directly and provide direct access for the accountant to pull the reports needed for tax time. No need for me to send anything, it's all right there. I liked how I was able to find something available in the US that wasn't working in Canada, and their engineers actually dug into it and found a resolution. Big points to them for that.
改善点: QBO is fairly pricey for what it does. You'd think with the extra fees they have on payment processing etc, they'd lower the subscription tiers.

タイトル: Avoid Quickbooks Online
投稿者: Office アメリカのOffice Manager 非営利団体運営, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Avoid Quickbooks Online"
良い点: It's ubiquitous, most know how to use it. We assumed it would be a seamless transition from Quickbooks Desktop to Quickbooks Online - not true. Two different products.
改善点: We are not ok with the forced connection to our bank account (or they would shut down payroll), nor the overstep of them Quickbooks paying our taxes. We have a trusted accountant/tax person & that is NOT Quickbooks role. What was a payment that should be part of our payroll taxes (that we have handled with our chosen vendor) showed up on our statements today as a payment to Intuit and not a tax payment. Quickbooks Online/Intuit is now merging with yet another company called Mineral where they are marketing HR to us and doing "Mineral Intelligence monitors your company profile.." thanking us for being a Mineral customer - we did not sign up for Mineral.

タイトル: Convenient and reliable for all sizes of business
投稿者: Bill カナダのVice President of Sales and Operations 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Convenient and reliable for all sizes of business"
良い点: What I liked most about QuickBooks Online was its ease of use and accessibility. It made it simple to manage finances, track expenses, create invoices, and access important information from anywhere. The automation features and clear reporting tools helped save time and made staying organized much easier.
改善点: The subscription fees can add up, especially for small businesses or users who only need a limited set of features. Some essential tools and advanced functionality require higher-tier plans, which can make the overall cost feel less competitive.

タイトル: CEO & President
投稿者: Jeff アメリカのPresident 情報技術、情報サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "CEO & President"
良い点: Invoicing is straightforward—create, send, and track payments with online options that reduce chasing clients. Bank feeds and categorization help keep books current without constant manual entry, and the basic financial reports (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) are usable for day-to-day small business oversight. The cloud access means I can check things from anywhere, and the mobile app handles quick tasks like recording expenses or sending invoices on the go. For a simple MSP operation it covers the core accounting needs without requiring a full desktop install or heavy local setup.
改善点: Pricing has climbed and the fee structure feels nickel-and-dime once you add payroll, higher tiers, or extra users. Customer support is often slow or scripted, with long waits and limited real problem-solving for anything beyond basic questions. The interface has grown cluttered, and performance can lag or throw odd errors during busy periods. Advanced reporting and customizations are limited unless you pay for higher plans or third-party apps, and reconciling or cleaning up messy data sometimes requires more workarounds than expected. Occasional sync issues with bank feeds or third-party integrations add friction.

タイトル: Highly stable, secure, and professional video conferencing suite for corporate client meetings
投稿者: Leidymar ブラジルのSocial Media 認証済みLinkedInユーザー マーケティング、広告, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Highly stable, secure, and professional video conferencing suite for corporate client meetings"
良い点: What I like most about Webex Suite is its exceptional audio and video stability during high-profile client meetings, even on weaker internet connections. The built-in security protocols and background noise-cancellation features are highly professional, making it a very reliable tool for conducting corporate freelance presentations.
改善点: What I like least about Webex Suite is that the desktop application can take a bit longer to load and join a meeting compared to lighter browser alternatives. Additionally, the user interface feels slightly corporate and complex, requiring a short learning curve for external clients who do not use it daily.

タイトル: Webex in Education

良い点: As a teacher, what tend to like most about using Webex is how it makes parent communication fast, organized, and all in one place.
改善点: What I like least about Webex Suite is that people may experience calls dropping or internet lagging if internet is weak.

タイトル: Reliable Platform for Professional Meetings

良い点: I like the reliability of Webex for professional meetings and video conferencing. Screen sharing, meeting controls, and audio/video quality work well, especially for formal meetings and larger sessions.
改善点: The interface can feel a little less intuitive compared with some other meeting platforms. For everyday team communication and collaboration, I sometimes find Microsoft Teams or Zoom more convenient.

I am able to record a training or a digital training with a team member for future reference.
改善点: Sometimes when there is an update with webex, my preference or setting get changed. Not a big deal, i am pretty savy on fixing the issue.

投稿者: Thaura フランスのDirector 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 研究, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Evernote, ever present across all my devices"
良い点: Ease to use, multi-task, real-time edition, access easy across devices. Its all in one approach is great.
改善点: Value for money, it is quite expensive compare to alternative tools. It is true that it’s multitask environment is very convenient, however, some users choose to navigate through multiple tools to avoid the costs.

タイトル: A trustworthy center for coordinating outreach and content notes.
投稿者: Wesley M. アメリカのDigital Communications Director 非営利団体運営, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A trustworthy center for coordinating outreach and content notes."
良い点: Evernote Teams provides a centralized space to capture meeting notes, outreach drafts, donor communication templates, and campaign plans. I particularly love the tagging feature and shared notebooks even though we’re a small team it makes it a walk in the park to keep everything in sync, even when remote.
改善点: The formatting can also come across as somewhat barebones compared to Notion or Google Docs. Also, syncing sometimes lags if more than one person is editing a note at the same time.

タイトル: Zero Stars

改善点: Zero stars. Evernote's Scrooge of software—Christmas Eve, mid-subscription, caps on exports, legacy links nuked, cancel button buried. Support? ‘Check settings.' Closed through January six. Bah Hum Bug.

タイトル: Excellent for knowledge management and team alignment
投稿者: Brendan 英国のWorkshop Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ハードウェア, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Excellent for knowledge management and team alignment"
良い点: Evernote Teams is fantastic for creating a central 'brain' for our team. I love how easy it is to capture meeting notes, store project documentation, and keep everything synced across devices—the web clipper and search functionality are real lifesavers for finding information quickly. The shared notebooks and spaces make it easy to keep everyone on the same page without a ton of administrative overhead.
改善点: It can definitely get expensive, especially compared to some of the more all-in-one project management alternatives. I also find that while it's great for note-taking, the project and task management features are a bit basic; if you're looking for advanced Gantt charts or complex workflow automation, it might feel a little limited for the price.

タイトル: GA 360- giving you the insight you need, when you need it

改善点: The cost and the very steep learning curve are top of the list for looking at other platforms, but if you need the details for your organization, you very well can benefit from what you get.

It general, it is intuitive and has all the information needed in one place.
改善点: If you are not a frequent user, it sometimes takes a while to track down the information you are looking for. This may be more a function of how our institution set up the information.

タイトル: Easy for All Ages; Some Connectivity Issues
投稿者: Katie アメリカのTeam Gymnastics Coach 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Easy for All Ages; Some Connectivity Issues"
良い点: ADP Workforce Now has been an easy-to-use product for our gymnastics facility. We have lots of hourly employees, many of them teenagers. We also have some employees in their 50s+. Everyone, regardless of age, is able to clock in and out using this product.
改善点: Sometimes, the app struggles to stay connected to the wifi. We use an ipad for all employees to clock in and out. Sometimes, it let's you log in to your account, but then just spins and spins and you're never able to actually clock in. I don't know whether the fault is our wifi connectivity or the app itself. We do keep a paper clock in sheet nearby to record hours when the app isn't working properly.

タイトル: Convenient Employee Management
投稿者: Alexandra アメリカのMA 代替医療, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Convenient Employee Management"
良い点: What I liked most about ADP Workforce Now is how convenient it is to access important work-related information in one place. The platform makes it easier to view pay statements, check work schedules, review timecards, and access tax documents when needed. I also appreciate being able to access the system online without having to rely on paperwork or contact someone for every question. Having these features available in one system helps save time and makes managing employment information more organized. Overall, ADP Workforce Now provides useful tools that make completing everyday work-related tasks simpler and more efficient.
改善点: One thing I liked least about ADP Workforce Now is that some features can be confusing to navigate, especially when trying to locate specific information or complete certain tasks. At times, the layout could be more straightforward and user-friendly. It would also be helpful if the system loaded more quickly and made important information easier to find. Improving the navigation and simplifying some of the steps would make the overall experience smoother for employees. Although the platform offers useful features, making it more intuitive and consistent would help users complete tasks with less frustration and save additional time throughout the workday.

Permissions, authentication, Actions, branch protection, and some repository settings are spread across different areas and aren't always intuitive. Error messages could also do a better job of explaining exactly what went wrong and what needs to be fixed.
