タイトル: A highly visual and customizable Work OS for tracking complex automation and development workflows
投稿者: Guillermo エクアドルのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "A highly visual and customizable Work OS for tracking complex automation and development workflows"
良い点: Monday.com excels at providing a flexible environment that adapts to almost any workflow. The most outstanding aspects include: Ease of Use & Features: The user interface is incredibly intuitive, colorful, and visually appealing. You can set up a new workspace in minutes, and the rich feature set—including diverse views like Kanban, Gantt, and Dashboards—makes data visualization simple. Task Management: Assigning owners, setting deadlines, and tracking granular tasks is seamless. The custom columns allow for highly specific data entry tailored to precise project needs. Process Management: It truly shines when handling multi-stage processes. The native automation recipes eliminate repetitive manual updates, automatically moving items across boards as their statuses change or notifying team members when a specific phase is complete.
改善点: While it is a powerful platform, there are a few drawbacks depending on the scale of your operations: Bugs and Issues: While generally stable, boards with a massive amount of data, complex dependencies, or heavy automation rules can occasionally experience minor UI lag or slow load times. Customer Support: For basic queries, the knowledge base is great. However, getting rapid, specialized phone or direct support for complex API integrations or advanced billing questions can sometimes take longer than expected. Pricing Structure Constraints: The per-seat pricing model requires you to buy licenses in specific increments (e.g., blocks of 5). This can be a bit frustrating for smaller teams if you only need to add one extra user.

改善点: That it didn't link to our company page. As a person in HR it is hard when our employees are posting on their own without some protection to the organization.

タイトル: Powerfull All in one platform
投稿者: Junaid オーストラリアのNational IT Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー ホスピタリティ, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Powerfull All in one platform"
良い点: Integration with Microsoft own products like Outlook, Teams and Power BI is seamless and boosts productivity.
改善点: The platform can be overwhelming to setup and configure due to its complexity. Licensing costs add up quickly, especially if you need multiple modules. performance can sometimes lags if not optimized correctly.

タイトル: Technically a CRM
投稿者: Breanna カナダのOnboarding Coordinator 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Technically a CRM"
良い点: We use Dynamics for our CRM because it’s customizable. Dynamics is cost efficient for a larger company 20 employees or more. It supports sales tracking and member communications as well as classroom roster features. In that sense it does support communication between customers and staff and allows the team to effectively support customers.
改善点: It can be sometimes having a lot of bugs and we have a tech guy full time dedicated to looking after it.

タイトル: Powerful CRM Platform with Strong Microsoft Integration
投稿者: 匿名レビュアー 教育管理, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Powerful CRM Platform with Strong Microsoft Integration"
良い点: I like how Dynamics 365 brings CRM, sales, customer information, and business processes into one platform. The dashboards and reporting tools make it easier to track sales activities and customer data. It also integrates well with other Microsoft products, which is useful for managing data and workflows across teams.
改善点: The platform can feel complex for new users, especially when setting up workflows, permissions, and customizations. Some features require additional configuration or training, and the overall cost can increase depending on the modules and number of users.

タイトル: Stick with Salesforce or Hubspot
投稿者: Evan アメリカのDirector of Inside Sales 医療機器, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Stick with Salesforce or Hubspot"
良い点: I liked that it brought a CRM into the whole M365 Platform. The sales funnel was decent as well, but not great.
改善点: Where do I begin? As someone who used Salesforce for 10+ years, I had no idea how badly an awkward CRM can mess up your entire sales cycle.

タイトル: Dynamic Tools with Dynamics 365
投稿者: Eduardo アメリカのSafety Coordinator II 建設, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Dynamic Tools with Dynamics 365"
良い点: Dynamics 365 has been a really solid tool overall. I like how it brings different business functions together in one place, which makes keeping track of customers, tasks, and data much easier. The interface is pretty straightforward once you get familiar with it, and there are plenty of features to help streamline everyday work. It also feels flexible enough to fit different business needs without being overly complicated. There’s a bit of a learning curve at first, but once you get the hang of it, Dynamics 365 can save a lot of time and make work feel much more organized.
改善点: One downside of Dynamics 365 is that it can feel a little overwhelming at first. There are so many features and settings that it takes some time to figure out where everything is and how to use it efficiently. It can also take a bit of effort to customize it for specific business needs. Once you get familiar with the system, though, it becomes much easier to use.

タイトル: Easy for Ticketing, Expensive for Free Events
投稿者: Sadaf Yusuf クウェートのHOD 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 教育管理, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Easy for Ticketing, Expensive for Free Events"
良い点: The platform is incredibly intuitive for event creators, boasts fantastic built-in marketing discoverability tools, and simplifies the mobile check-in process.
改善点: The ticket processing fees eat heavily into profit margins, and their recent pricing change now charges organizers to host free events.

タイトル: Reliable and User-Friendly Platform for Event Management
投稿者: Kamal アメリカのCEO 病院、ヘルスケア, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 ""Reliable and User-Friendly Platform for Event Management""
良い点: Eventbrite offers a reliable and user-friendly platform for creating, promoting, and managing events. The interface is intuitive, making it easy to set up events and track registrations. Reporting and attendee management tools are useful, and the integrated payment processing simplifies ticket sales. While the platform delivers strong functionality overall, transaction fees and occasional customization limitations prevent it from being a perfect score. Value for Money: Good, though fees can add up for larger events. Customer Support: Generally responsive and helpful. Ease of Use: Excellent, even for first-time event organizers. Bugs and Issues: Few significant issues encountered, though occasional glitches occur. Email: Built-in email tools make attendee communication convenient. Payment: Secure and straightforward payment processing. Reporting: Provides useful registration and sales insights.
改善点: The ease of creating and managing events is the feature I value most. The platform streamlines ticket sales, attendee registration, payment processing, and event promotion in one place. I also appreciate the professional event pages and reporting tools, which help track attendance and revenue efficiently.

タイトル: Convenient Platform, but High Fees and Poor Customer Support
投稿者: Kai アメリカのswe 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Convenient Platform, but High Fees and Poor Customer Support"
良い点: Eventbrite makes it easy to discover events, purchase tickets, and keep everything in one place. The checkout process is usually simple, and having tickets available digitally is convenient.
改善点: The fees are excessive and often make a reasonably priced ticket feel much more expensive by the time you reach checkout. Customer support can also be frustrating when something goes wrong. It often feels difficult to reach a real person, and resolving refunds, cancellations, or ticket issues can take far more effort than it should. The platform is convenient when everything works, but the experience becomes much worse as soon as you actually need help.

タイトル: Easy and Reliable Event Management
投稿者: Furkan トルコのFounder 認証済みLinkedInユーザー デザイン, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Easy and Reliable Event Management"
良い点: Event creation and ticket management are very easy to handle, even when setting up an event quickly. I especially like having registration, payments, attendee emails, and basic reporting in one place. The dashboard makes it simple to track ticket sales and attendee numbers without having to use separate tools.
改善点: The fees can become noticeable for paid events, especially as ticket volume increases. I also think some of the reporting and email customization options could be more flexible. These haven’t been major issues for me, but more control in these areas would make the platform even better.

タイトル: RSVP for your Account Today!
投稿者: John アメリカのManager 通信, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "RSVP for your Account Today!"
良い点: Eventbrite provides a great resource for ticketing and RSVP as well as communications with prospective attendees. It also allows users across teams to share access to events so they can collaborate. Their features are cost-effective and provide tremendous value. It is easy to use and set-up. The reporting features are exactly what you need (check-ins).
改善点: The design of the event pages require some imagination to make your page stand out among other events.

タイトル: Still a solid choice
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 教育管理, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Still a solid choice"
良い点: The primary function is straightforward, and there's plenty of room for customisability when new and old clients view the scheduling page.
改善点: Email accounts that are added by an administrator as users, can't then set up their own account. Maybe this is more appropriate for big business that manage their own internal email addresses.

タイトル: Awesome product for small business owners
投稿者: Heather カナダのHolistic health practitioner and cycle coach 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 代替医療, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Awesome product for small business owners"
良い点: Product is awesome and relatively easy to use. love how many automations I can send for reminders to clients and for follow ups about re-booking and leaving reviews, etc. The payment integrations is also awesome too!
改善点: I don’t like that they don’t have an HST addition option built in to client receipts. It really makes my accounting messy and occasionally I consider changing software for this reason only. I als wish that it connected directly to square so I don’t have to switch between apps. Would be really awesome if EMT was an option for payment as well.

タイトル: Good product for scheduling
投稿者: Tracie アメリカのExecutive Director 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 非営利団体運営, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Good product for scheduling"
良い点: Acuity Scheduling made it easy to set up and integrate my calendar to reduce the risk of booking conflicts, improve booking notifications, and integrate the product into my website.
改善点: The cost of Acuity scheduling to access all premium features is high compared to alternatives for small businesses and small non-profits.

タイトル: Easy to Use and Gets the Job Done
投稿者: MaChelsea アメリカのCEO 経理, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Easy to Use and Gets the Job Done"
良い点: I like how easy Acuity Scheduling makes it to manage appointments and stay organized. Clients can book appointments based on availability without having to go back and forth about scheduling. The automated reminders are also helpful and make the overall booking process more convenient.
改善点: One downside is the cost, especially for small businesses that may not need every feature offered. Some of the customization options can also take time to figure out. Overall, it’s a good scheduling platform, but there is room for improvement in pricing and flexibility.

タイトル: Straightforwards and Grows with you
投稿者: Rachel 英国のCEO エグゼクティブ・オフィス, 自営業 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Straightforwards and Grows with you"
良い点: Fairly easy to setup and use from day one, some other products are more indepth to setup and get going but this was straight forward and support function easy to use if needed
改善点: Sometimes when I thought things had been scheduled and setup they weren't working quite as expected but that was part of the learning

タイトル: Handy instrument for content collaboration
投稿者: Maria 日本のUX writer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 薬品, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Handy instrument for content collaboration"
良い点: It is easy to collaborate on documents. I can leave comments or propose changes in the text - it is very handy for articles and other documents, because we have a lot of people involved in the content creation and coordination.
改善点: The interface might be confusing for less technically sophisticated people. I had to create a video tutorial on commenting because some colleagues couldn't figure out how to open the document and leave their notes.

タイトル: Very good file storage & collaboration platform
投稿者: David アメリカのIT Operations Manager コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Very good file storage & collaboration platform"
良い点: The ability to send an "upload" only link to someone is a great feature when working with external people. It allows them to upload their files without being able to view or access the original folder or see what other people may have uploaded. The folder structuring is pretty standard compared to other platforms but Box does a really good job with granular collaboration permissions from the parent folder and down. Configuring organization wide settings is easy to setup as well. UI is modern, clean, and easy to navigate.
改善点: Box is a little on the pricier side when compared to other platforms and some of the more advanced features are hidden behind an additional license/add-on. There is no native "team/shared folder" feature. If you need to create a team/shared folder, it has to be created within someone's individual account. You essentially need to start off with creating a service account user and then creating all your team/shared folders within that service account.

タイトル: Build a Better Workflow with Box
投稿者: Zachariah アメリカのData Entry 建設, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Build a Better Workflow with Box"
良い点: Using Box software has been my go-to for document management and team collaboration. By utilizing the AI features, the value of money shows in how the user can produce automated content workflows and receive email and notifications throughput the process. As for the collaboration features, the ease of using each one has each member of the team working efficiently with file sharing.
改善点: I didn't find myself frustrated with the software at all, and the AI tools were easy to understand for someone starting out with using Box.

タイトル: Horrible Customer Service

タイトル: Great tool for external file share management
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 教育管理, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Great tool for external file share management"
良い点: Box is very easy to use and has a CLI interface for automating file shares and backups. Sharing and removing access to files with external parties is also very easy which is our main use case for Box.
改善点: Box is very expensive for what it provides. This was a driver for our migration to an internal solution, even though it did work very well.

タイトル: Reliable platform for document management and team collaboration
投稿者: Nikitha アメリカのAI Proposal Intern 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Reliable platform for document management and team collaboration"
良い点: Microsoft SharePoint is easy to use and provides good value for money for organizing and managing business information. Its Document Management capabilities make it convenient to store, organize, and share files, while the User Interface makes navigating documents and team resources straightforward. It also supports Communication and collaboration by giving teams a centralized place to access information and work together.
改善点: SharePoint can become difficult to navigate when there are many sites, folders, documents, and permissions involved. Some advanced features can also take time to understand, particularly for new users. I have occasionally experienced minor usability issues when accessing or organizing documents. I have limited direct experience with Customer Support, so I cannot strongly evaluate that aspect. Employee Management is also not a feature I have used extensively.

タイトル: A Powerful tool for specific scenarios
投稿者: Philippe カナダのIT Director 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A Powerful tool for specific scenarios"
良い点: Sharepoint, while a bit unintuative at first, is a very powerful tool for collaboration. It integrates perfectly with the Microsoft Office suite and offers lots of options for those types of file format when stored in Sharepoint Sites.
改善点: Sharepoint is not for all scenarios, it can be a very powerful tool for collaboaration given that the right file type are used. Setting us security is also quite different for traditional NTFS security.

タイトル: Microsoft SharePoint - Vital but difficult to learn and use.
投稿者: Tara アメリカのFinance and Administrative Officer 非営利団体運営, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Microsoft SharePoint - Vital but difficult to learn and use."
良い点: Microsoft SharePoint has been our main means of sharing documents within our organization. We are a fully remote organization and utilize SharePoint to help give access to our documents. Since the cost is rolled into our M365 subscription, the cost is low compared to alternatives.
改善点: Microsoft SharePoint is not a very user-friendly interface. It is difficult to use and learn, the employee management section is difficult, and guidance from the customer support team does little to help.

タイトル: I love collaborating on Microsoft Sharepoint!
投稿者: Callum 英国のSocial Media Marketer 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "I love collaborating on Microsoft Sharepoint!"
良い点: I love how easy it makes collaborating on documents with my team in real time. Having everything stored in one central place with seamless Microsoft 365 integration keeps us organized and cuts out endless email attachments.
改善点: The learning curve can be pretty steep, especially when it comes to managing permissions and site structure. If it isn't set up properly from the start, the search function can get cluttered quickly, making it tricky to find specific files. It can also feel a bit clunky and overly complex compared to simpler cloud storage options.

タイトル: Great all-in-one tool for managing a small team
投稿者: Vinicius 日本のTravel エンタテインメント, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Great all-in-one tool for managing a small team"

タイトル: Top Choice for Visual Social Media Marketing
投稿者: Natasha 英国のOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 小売, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Top Choice for Visual Social Media Marketing"
良い点: Instagram stands out for its vast global reach and powerful visual storytelling tools. It is user-friendly, highly effective for brand awareness, and makes showcasing products and connecting with an audience simple.
改善点: What I like least about Instagram is how heavily reliant it is on changing algorithms. Organic reach for regular posts has reduced over time, making it harder for accounts to stay visible without constantly posting video Reels or spending money on paid promotions.

タイトル: Essential for Brand Growth, but Lacks Reliable Support
投稿者: Adarsh Kumar インドのStudent 認証済みLinkedInユーザー インターネット, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Essential for Brand Growth, but Lacks Reliable Support"
良い点: What I like most about Instagram is its incredible ease of use for social media management. Setting up a professional user profile is quick, allowing businesses to maximize their reach efficiently. The platform offers exceptional value for money, as organic content posting through Reels, Stories, and carousels is entirely free and highly effective for brand growth. Furthermore, managing social media interactions is seamless; direct messaging and interactive features enable instant customer support and strong community building. Overall, Instagram combines a highly intuitive interface with powerful business tools, making it an indispensable asset for any modern digital marketing and engagement strategy.
改善点: What I dislike most about Instagram is the lack of responsive customer support. When technical glitches occur or account security issues arise, reaching a live human representative is nearly impossible, which can be devastating for small businesses. Additionally, unpredictable algorithm shifts have drastically reduced organic reach, making consistent social media management difficult without increasing paid advertising budgets. Content posting tools on the desktop browser version also feel limited compared to the mobile app, complicating team collaboration. Lastly, the aggressive push toward video content often sidelines traditional photo posts, forcing creators to invest far more production effort for everyday brand visibility.

タイトル: Insta got still got room for improvement, other apps are really catching up.
投稿者: Adarsh インドのLawyer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 弁護士業界, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Insta got still got room for improvement, other apps are really catching up."
良い点: Easiest way to have a vast reach with the least effort. The huge userbase of Instagram and certain features like public stories make it much easier to get views from a variety of audience. When it comes to messaging, the message request and filtering is very efficient as help maintain quality to what we see or want to see.
改善点: The messaging feature have much to improve in Instagram, it focus too much on restrictions. Despite having filtering and request, it gives further restrictions based on type of account or follow status, which sometimes prevents genuine connects.

タイトル: A Powerful Platform for Visual Brand Building
投稿者: Samuel カナダのCoFounder 不動産, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "A Powerful Platform for Visual Brand Building"

改善点: Organic reach can be inconsistent and heavily dependent on the algorithm. It can also require a significant amount of content production to maintain visibility, especially as the platform continues to prioritize short-form video.

良い点: The biggest win for us has been bringing our digital signage entirely in-house. Prior to using OptiSigns, we had to rely on external vendors and agencies every time we wanted to push updates or manage display content, which was costly and caused unnecessary delays. Moving to OptiSigns gave us total internal control over all our screens across the company. The value for money is outstanding compared to traditional signage solutions. Screen, device, and playlist management are very solid, making it simple to organize and schedule content in real time right from my laptop. Being able to eliminate ongoing vendor fees while keeping our internal communications fresh and timely has significantly reduced our overall operations spend.
改善点: If there’s one feature I really miss, it’s a native, direct integration with Zoom to easily broadcast live video streams or town halls directly to our screens without relying on workaround links. Additionally, while the main setup is straight to the point, a few of the deeper settings and dynamic display options aren't immediately intuitive, so you definitely have to spend some time digging through their documentation and knowledge base articles to get everything configured just right. 検討した類似製品： Yodeck OptiSignsに切りかえた理由： We chose OptiSigns primarily because of its transparent per-screen pricing and hardware flexibility. Many alternative digital signage platforms required proprietary, expensive hardware players or locked us into high enterprise contracts with mandatory setup fees. OptiSigns allowed us to use affordable, off-the-shelf devices like Amazon Fire TV Sticks and Android players while still giving us enterprise-level features like remote screen scheduling and playlist management. Combined with the ability to handle everything completely in-house without paying third-party vendor retainers, it was by far the most cost-effective and practical choice for our business.

タイトル: Sales & Onboarding Experience Did Not Match What We Were Promised
投稿者: Jeff アメリカのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 自動車, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Sales & Onboarding Experience Did Not Match What We Were Promised"
良い点: The CRM itself appears to have a robust feature set and offers a wide range of tools and integrations in one platform.
改善点: Before signing on March 30, 2026, I repeatedly explained that one of my biggest concerns was getting our third-party vendors, systems, and integrations successfully set up. We were reassured during the sales process that HubSpot would help us through the process and that getting everything set up would not be a problem. We were also told the onboarding fee was being waived as an end-of-quarter concession. After signing, we discovered that implementation was considerably more complicated than we had been led to expect and that obtaining the level of assistance we understood would be available could require thousands of dollars in additional services. Had this been clearly explained before we signed, we would not have purchased the subscription. We raised the issue shortly after purchase, never meaningfully implemented or used the platform, and requested a refund of the $1,262.40 we paid. What followed was weeks of emails, transfers between Sales, Support, Billing, and Contract Management, repeated internal reviews, and ultimately a denial of our refund request. HubSpot acknowledges that onboarding was discussed and that the onboarding fee was waived, but disputes our understanding of what implementation assistance was represented during the sales process. タイトル: Logical and Robust
投稿者: Monica アメリカのAccountant 非営利団体運営, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Logical and Robust"
良い点: Payroll is easy in BHR. There are good payroll reports, so I can check my numbers and deliver them to my manager for approval. It's easy to change a payroll parameter on the fly if I need to add, modify, or delete something -- and then re-run the report. The system also keeps me informed about items I need to know, like the potential effects of OBBB on payroll. I can also add notes for specific payrolls, like "no medical deductions since this is the 3rd payroll this month." For timesheets, I like the fact that payroll is not directly tied to timesheets. Sometimes folks don't complete their timesheets in time for me to run payroll. Gladly, I don't have to hold up payroll waiting for completed timesheets (FT folks). In addition, I can approve multiple timesheets at once - which saves some time. The performance questions are pretty self-explanatory and easy for staff to navigate. I like how the system alerts Admins as to who and how many staff have completed annual enrollments.
改善点: There are lots of clicks if I want to individually approve timesheets. It's annoying how many clicks there are for the task. I actively avoid approving timesheets until everyone has their timesheets completed, in order to avoid being annoyed. A certain part of navigating Goals is not intuitive. I'm thinking of the suggested goals that pop up. If you don't click the right thing, the suggested goal disappears. In some instances, folks have looked at the goal and simply wanted to close the screen and think about whether to use it. But the goal *poof goes away! I am still not sure how to get the suggested goals to re-appear. This may be operator error: our employees can see and change their retirement elections in BHR, but BHR is not the correct place to make those changes. They should instead make the change in the retirement portal. But if someone forgets, they could change it in BHR without officially changing it for real. Fortunately, I can see that change when I run payroll - but I would like some stop gap that either prevents employees from making the change in BHR or an emphatic note that tells them what to do.

タイトル: Smartsheet is Perfect for the Small Business
投稿者: Julieann アメリカのOffice Manager Project Assistant 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 建設, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Smartsheet is Perfect for the Small Business"
良い点: Smartsheet takes all the benefits of Excel and creates an intuitive and super-simple to use platform. We use it to manage construction jobs and track job costs and documents all in one place. And the platform could not be more affordable! With other construction project management software, what you pay for one year of Smartsheet will get you maybe a week for those other platforms. If you wanted to use just the basic sheets or take advantage of their feature rich workspaces and templates, you can use Smartsheet to track projects, office operations and costs, and as a document center (we use it to track our subcontractors certificates of insurance expirations dates), Smartsheet is definitely invaluable to us as a central project and operations management system that we can all access anywhere.
改善点: Smartsheet cannot completely manage a project, meaning you will have to incorporate other tools (like budgeting software) to fully monitor and analyze the profitability of a project. Smartsheet keeps the raw data in one place, but does not help to analyze and make sense of it.

タイトル: A powerful, flexible tool for managing complex projects and data-heavy workflows
投稿者: Elena スイスのDigital Strategy Senior Specialist 非営利団体運営, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A powerful, flexible tool for managing complex projects and data-heavy workflows"
良い点: powerful spreadsheet-like interface combined with project management features. automations save time on repetitive tasks, and the variety of views (Gantt, grid, card, calendar) makes it flexible for different types of projects
改善点: Steeper learning curve than simpler tools, especially for non-technical users. Some advanced features and formulas require trial and error to master. Mobile app feels less robust than the desktop experience.

タイトル: Don't get used to it, they will drop parts with no warning and force change.
投稿者: albi アメリカのMarketing 経理, 5,001～10,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Don't get used to it, they will drop parts with no warning and force change."
良い点: it was helpful in card view but the board view does not allow for automatically not showing the nested cards
改善点: They dropped card view with no warning! and with required showing of nested cards, the interface is too overwhelming. BAD IDEA!!

タイトル: Flexible and Powerful Tool for Team Organization
投稿者: Jennifer アメリカのOffice Manager 化学, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Flexible and Powerful Tool for Team Organization"
良い点: What I like most about Smartsheet is how easy it is to organize projects, tasks, and information in one place. The customizable spreadsheets, automation, and collaboration features make it easy to track progress and keep teams organized.
改善点: What I like least about Smartsheet is that it can take some time to learn all of the features and customization options. Some advanced features may also feel overwhelming for users who only need basic project and task management.

タイトル: Excellent tool for managing projects and improving team collaboration
投稿者: Nigel カナダのcustomer care officer 運輸、トラック、鉄道, 5,001～10,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Excellent tool for managing projects and improving team collaboration"
良い点: Easy to create and manage project plans. Spreadsheet-style interface is familiar for Excel users Strong automation capabilities that reduce manual follow-up Excellent collaboration features with comments, attachments, and notifications Cloud-based and accessible from anywhere
改善点: Advanced features have a learning curve I find the interface dated compared to newer project management tools Mobile app functionality is more limited than the desktop experience

タイトル: Reliable and User-Friendly Email Marketing Platform
投稿者: Amila 日本のMarketing Team 卸売, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Reliable and User-Friendly Email Marketing Platform"
良い点: Brevo is an easy-to-use email marketing platform with a clean interface. It offers useful features such as a no-code email designer, contact management, marketing automation, and detailed analytics. We can easily create professional email campaigns without any coding experience using the drag-and-drop editor. The customer support team is responsive and always provides clear explanations whenever we need assistance.
改善点: One drawback is that the subscription is automatically upgraded when the contact limit is exceeded. It would be better if users received a notification and could choose whether to approve the upgrade before it takes effect.

タイトル: Easy and Useful for Managing Email Campaigns
投稿者: Harsh Vipul ドイツのCEO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー イベント企画運営, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Easy and Useful for Managing Email Campaigns"
良い点: I like how easy it is to create and send email campaigns to a large audience. Managing contacts, designing emails, and checking campaign performance can all be done from one place.
改善点: Some of the more advanced features take a little time to understand, especially when setting up automations. The interface can also feel slightly crowded in some sections.

タイトル: Brevo is great value and easy enough!
投稿者: Melisa アメリカのGeneral Manager 飲食店, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Brevo is great value and easy enough!"
良い点: Brevo is consolidated and affordable. I can access my customer list, create segments, send out enough emails for my small business and do it all for better than anyone else is charging. The interface is easy enough to use.
改善点: Creating segments or downloading users (specifically with information about their subscribed/unsubscribed status) is a bit of a to-do. I've had to do this a few times now and still couldn't tell you how.

タイトル: General experiences after a year of using Brevo
投稿者: Konrad ポーランドのFundraiser 慈善活動, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "General experiences after a year of using Brevo"
良い点: Free plan for unlimited contacts with not so small amount of e-mails per day (300). In the past also custom variables were very useful for personalise my e-mails, but last time it disappeared. The customer support is very good - my experience with your support-persons is also very good ( [sensitive content hidden]). Marketing campaigns allow me to send my most important messages for the donors of my organisation.
改善点: I'm not familiar with spam filtering, so I cannot say anything about it. Drag-and-drop e-mails creator is also quite problematic - aspecially auto-refreshing/saving hinders the work. There's not a possibility to save blocks - I need to create a section to save them.

タイトル: Easy to use with responsive customer support
投稿者: Prajwal インドのConsultant 情報技術、情報サービス, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Easy to use with responsive customer support"
良い点: Brevo is quite easy to use, even for someone who is setting up email campaigns for the first time. The interface is clean and most features are easy to find. I liked the email campaign builder, contact management, and reporting dashboard. The pricing is also reasonable compared to many other email marketing tools, especially for small businesses and startups. One thing I really appreciated was their customer support. I recently had an issue related to an automatic plan upgrade, and the support team, especially [sensitive content hidden] handled it professionally. My issue was resolved quickly, and the communication throughout the process was clear and helpful.
改善点: The contact limits on some plans can be restrictive if you are working with a large database. Also, a few automation features are not very intuitive and take some time to understand. It would be helpful if there were more ready-to-use templates and better guidance while creating advanced workflows.

タイトル: Blender: Professional Image Editing Software for Businesses and Creative Teams
投稿者: Bruno イタリアのMarketing Executive Intern 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 自動車, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Blender: Professional Image Editing Software for Businesses and Creative Teams"
良い点: I had the opportunity to use GIMP as a Marketing Executive Intern for Hackett & Hackett International Group Limited. I had many reasons to like the software, but the most notable one was that it is free, open source and runs on various platforms. Firstly, speaking of strengths, I should mention that GIMP has an impressive set of Image Editing Tools (cropping, resizing, colour correction, image restoration), as well as non-destructive editing options (layers, masks, blend modes, opacity).
改善点: However, I also have some cons to discuss. For one, GIMP has a rather complicated interface, which is especially challenging for novices. Secondly, it is somewhat outdated and does not support many modern technologies. Additionally, its compatibility with various operating systems is limited. Moreover, one essential downside of GIMP is that it recognises only RGB image mode while ignoring CMYK and other modes. There are also limited professional design tools, such as smart objects, AI-powered photo editing and cloud collaboration.

タイトル: Best Replacement for Photoshop
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Best Replacement for Photoshop"
良い点: Gimp is the most reliable replacement for Adobe photoshop! There's nothing that comes close. And it works on linux ;)
改善点: The UI is quite clunky compared to photoshop, although I appreciate that they attempt to emulate most of the original features.

タイトル: A Good Free Alternative for Image Editing
投稿者: Jordan アメリカのGraphic Designer デザイン, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A Good Free Alternative for Image Editing"
良い点: The biggest advantage for me is obviously the price: GIMP is free and open source. I also appreciate the number of tools available. With some practice, it is possible to produce fairly professional work.
改善点: However, I find its interface less intuitive than some competing software. When I first started using it, I had to look for tutorials to understand certain functions. For very complex professional projects, I generally prefer Adobe tools.

タイトル: Free toolbox for image tweaks
投稿者: Tabarak オーストラリアのGraphic Designer デザイン, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Free toolbox for image tweaks"
良い点: I reached for GIMP whenever I needs a quick fix or a poster idea. Cropping, colour tweaks, and a sprinkle of filters run along nicely, and stacking layers costs me nothing but a click.
改善点: Big files are another story. Throw a hefty blur or glow at them and the progress bar begins to crawl, while tool panels crowd the screen like chatty neighbours.

タイトル: GIMP review from a developer
投稿者: Daniel アメリカのSolutions Engineer 市場調査, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "GIMP review from a developer"
良い点: I used GIMP as a free option instead of Photoshop and I was quite pleased. I was able to create an image project with many layers and resize the layers as needed.
改善点: It was a bit tricky to figure out how to be able to move the different layers as needed. I just had to play around with the software options to figure it out.

タイトル: Reviewed by samala vamshi
投稿者: samala インドのAssociate and securities associate 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 経理, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Reviewed by samala vamshi"
良い点: Freshdesk is super intuitive and easy to navigate, so our team can move through conversations and tasks without getting bogged down. The ticketing system is well organized, making it simple to filter tickets and set priorities based on urgency. That helps us tackle the most pressing customer issues first, which speeds up resolution times and keeps our whole support workflow running smoothly.
改善点: Connecting our mailbox to Freshdesk is usually pretty straightforward, but we've run into an annoying bug where it occasionally creates duplicate tickets for a single client email. It causes unnecessary confusion for our support team and slows down how quickly we can get back to people.

タイトル: Streamlining Support, Enhancing Efficiency through Freshdesk
投稿者: Rajneesh オーストラリアのITSM Consultant 情報技術、情報サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Streamlining Support, Enhancing Efficiency through Freshdesk"
良い点: What I valued most about Freshdesk was its intuitive and user-friendly interface, which enabled efficient management of customer enquiries and support tickets. Its automation, reporting, and organizational capabilities also contributed to a more streamlined and efficient customer support process.
改善点: With its extensive product roadmap and advanced AI capabilities, complemented by Freddy AI, Freshdesk continues to evolve and deliver significant value. Overall, there is nothing to dislike about the platform.

タイトル: Using 4 seats but locked into paying for 19
投稿者: Fiodas シンガポールのCS Manager 家電製品, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Using 4 seats but locked into paying for 19"
良い点: Freshdesk keeps customer emails, ticket history, tags, and agent assignments in one searchable system. This has helped us preserve customer communication records and coordinate support work.
改善点: The product is cumbersome to administer, but the worst problem is the contract model. We currently need only 4 agents but are locked into paying for 19. Freshworks emphasized monthly billing and a two-year price freeze. It did not explain the practical consequence clearly enough: monthly billing only divides a fixed 24-month obligation into monthly charges. It does not provide monthly flexibility, and committed seats cannot be reduced when business needs change. In plain language: we use 4 seats and pay for 19. That is an extremely poor value for money.

タイトル: Great ticketing platform with fast team onboarding, though reporting takes effort
投稿者: Kira アメリカのSoftware Reviwer 情報サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Great ticketing platform with fast team onboarding, though reporting takes effort"
良い点: The Centralized Communication was smooth it combines emails, social channels, and web forms into single, unified customer ticket threads. Also the Quick Onboarding i highly enjoyed. The clean interface allows new support agents to get trained and productive almost immediately.
改善点: I really disliked The Tier-Gated Features: Certain advanced features (like automated skills-based routing or deeper integrations) require upgrading to higher plan tiers. Also Performance Under High Volume Occasional loading lag when managing heavy ticket or switching between multiple tabs quickly.

タイトル: Freshdesk review by suchith
投稿者: Suchith インドのTechnical writer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Freshdesk review by suchith"
良い点: With Freshdesk, we have been able to centralize communications from multiple channels, whether through chat, email, or other means, into a single, unified platform. This consolidation has significantly streamlined our workflow, giving our team a comprehensive view of every client’s interaction regardless of its source. As a result, we have been able to resolve client issues more efficiently and respond with greater speed and accuracy
改善点: Freshdesk falls pretty short on customization, so we can't really tweak it to match our specific workflows. On top of that, the reporting is basic and needs work. Without deeper, customizable analytics, it’s hard to get useful insights, track how we're actually doing, or make solid, data-driven decisions.

タイトル: 日本語対応してほしい

タイトル: Zoho Social - surprisingly good social media management
投稿者: 表示する詳細を増やす Stephen 英国のManaging Director 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Zoho Social - surprisingly good social media management"
良い点: The interface is very clean and simple to use. I also liked the ease with which I could attach our social accounts to the tool; in the past I've had trouble with this on other platforms, particularly Instagram Business, but Zoho handled this seamlessly.
改善点: The only things I dislike are: - significant price hike between Standard and Premium, for only one or two extra features I'd consider using - 50% extra if you want to pay month-to-month; for SMEs wary of making long-term buying decisions this feels like a lot (but I appreciate it's standard practice these days)

タイトル: Best products all round...not just Zoho Social!
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 小売, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Best products all round...not just Zoho Social!"
良い点: I love all of the Zoho products due to the generous free plans they have for those of us who are just starting and barely making it as is. I have been testing Zoho Social lately and I believe its my favorite out of all other social tools. I have been trying lots of them too. Very easy to use. Tons of different features.
改善点: I do have to say the only con I have with Zoho Social was the fact for some reason I thought all their products was completely free but turns out there is different plans available. But at least free is one of them. Buts that more on me than it is them. The paid plans are really decent priced also so I really have no bad things to say.

タイトル: A Helpful All-in-One Social Media Management Platform
投稿者: thabo 南アフリカのAccount manager 市場調査, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "A Helpful All-in-One Social Media Management Platform"
良い点: Zoho Social makes it easy to manage multiple social media accounts from one platform. I especially like the scheduling features, content calendar, and analytics, which help make social media management more organised and efficient.
改善点: Some features can take a little time to get used to, and the interface can feel slightly overwhelming when managing multiple accounts. It would also be helpful to have more advanced video editing and content creation options built into the platform.

タイトル: Top 2 Social Media Mangement
投稿者: Fambegbe ナイジェリアのDirector 認証済みLinkedInユーザー メディア制作, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Top 2 Social Media Mangement"
良い点: A friendly environment, platform integration, and premium features for maximum productivity. This is one of the best platform
改善点: While Zoho offers immense value, several workflow friction points persist: Instagram Post Constraints: Zoho Social does not let you craft separate captions tailored specifically for Instagram when multi-posting alongside other platforms, forcing generic messaging or extra manual edits. Cumbersome Telegram Management: Navigating Telegram channels within Zoho’s interface feels clunky and non-intuitive, hindering quick community engagement and message routing. Limited WhatsApp Integration: Setting up WhatsApp requires rigid Meta API approvals and third-party gateways, leaving the integration feeling restricted, prone to sync delays, and far less seamless than native channel support.

タイトル: I'm an Architectural Designer and Cad Draftsman in 6 years until now.
投稿者: Huynh ベトナムのCAD Draftsman 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "I'm an Architectural Designer and Cad Draftsman in 6 years until now."
良い点: This is the first time I review for this software after using it in several years. In fact, I like this software because it's very easy to learn and use at the beginning level, anyone can learn it without taking a course. But if you want to become an advanced user with AutoCad, you must need some skills in IT area and get a course seriously. For the new interface, to be honest when I used it at the first time in several years ago, I didn't like it, I was familiar with the old one. But I tried and I found it is very effective and easy to use than I thought, because it gave me more chance to discover the other functions in AutoCad that I didn't know, for instance when I tried with dynamic block and parametric in the first time since a long time ago, I really felt in love with it. I also like the new purge function, it really didt good job. When I used Autocad 2013, I had to install AutoCAD_2013_2014_DGN_Hotfix to purge the large files. But the new AutocCad version already installed that function and I like it, it helped me so much when I worked with large files.
改善点: I have a big problem with the dimension in layout, it always change its value to larger, for example when I make dimension 200mm in layout, after I reopen the AutoCad file, the dimension will change to 1000mmm or more automatically, I tried to find many ways to fix it but I can't. I also change the computer or work with another files or create new dimension style but the problem was still the same. When I was trying to find a solution on the internet, I saw many people had the same problems like me and they didn't know know to fix it too. I like to create dimension in layout but because of this problem I always have to check the drawing files again and again whenever I want to print or export it to pdf, sometimes I missed some places and I have to correct the dimension and print it again. I hate it so much. Now I have a change to tell to you (the AutoCad software developer), I wish I can know this page earlier, but I hope it's not late for me to contact to you now. Can you tell me how to fix that problem? I really appreciate if you can give me a solution.

タイトル: Powerful and Reliable CAD Software for Professional Design Work
投稿者: Divya インドのMechanical Engineer I 医療機器, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Powerful and Reliable CAD Software for Professional Design Work"
良い点: AutoCAD is a powerful and industry-standard CAD software that provides excellent precision for creating 2D drawings and detailed engineering designs. The drafting tools are comprehensive, the interface is highly customizable, and the DWG file compatibility makes collaboration with other teams and vendors straightforward. It is reliable for electrical, mechanical, and architectural drawings, and the extensive command set helps improve productivity once users become familiar with the software.
改善点: The software has a steep learning curve for new users, and some advanced features can be difficult to discover without training. Licensing costs can be high compared to some alternatives, especially for occasional users. Performance may slow down when working with very large or complex drawings, and certain workflows still require multiple manual steps that could be more streamlined.

タイトル: Autocad review
投稿者: Adam アメリカのProject Engineer 機械・産業工学, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Autocad review"
良い点: What i like most about autocad is that it is very easy to use once get used to it and know what around the program/functions.
改善点: What I like least about autocad is that sometimes very large files with a lot of detail can lag and crash, or not open on computers that are not capable.

タイトル: A Necessity in the Workplace
投稿者: Rebecca アメリカのProject Engineer and CAD Specialist 土木工学, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A Necessity in the Workplace"
良い点: The capabilities of Autodesk products far exceed those of similar softwares. There is a reason why AutoCAD is so heavily utilized in the workplace and a huge part of that is its versatility. The cost does not feel steep when you pair it with unlimited applications and a library of resources to reference.
改善点: While this system is undoubtedly invaluable, the capacity in which you can utilize the software is directly linked to the time spent learning it. With nested menus, hyper-specific commands, and premade templates as just a few examples - AutoCAD requires an expertise that should not be undervalued.

タイトル: Using AutoCAD for event production/management
投稿者: Steven アメリカのShow Manager エンタテインメント, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Using AutoCAD for event production/management"
良い点: I personally liked the exclusivity of it, which kept demand up for anyone AutoCAD savvy. In my opionion it is the pinnacle of software for technical creation that needs to be finite in details or measurements. What really sealed the deal is when they integrated BIMS and endless libraries for everything and anything. From textiles to furniture and specialty equipment, there is now a BIM for everything, which is so much better than a dedcade ago when you had to draw in everything yourself.
改善点: Some projects don't require measurements to be so finite therefore making it more time consuming for simplier tasks that don't require precision work. Or in other words trying to use this software to do things it can do but wasn't necessarily designed for.

タイトル: In regards to Squarespace

タイトル: Excellent Website Builder with Professional Designs and Easy Management
投稿者: Félix フランスのDesigner 自動車, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Excellent Website Builder with Professional Designs and Easy Management"
良い点: What I liked most about Squarespace was how easy it is to create a professional-looking website without needing advanced technical skills. The templates are modern and visually appealing, the page editor is intuitive, and the platform includes everything needed to manage content, domains, e-commerce, and payments in one place. It offers excellent value for money and makes website creation straightforward and efficient.
改善点: While Squarespace is very user-friendly, customization can sometimes feel limited compared to fully open platforms. Some advanced design changes require custom code, and the pricing can be higher than some competitors for users with basic website needs. I also experienced occasional limitations when integrating certain third-party tools.

タイトル: Not worth the money, but technically does the job.

タイトル: Squarespace does everything you need it to do.

タイトル: Excellent document for developers to integrate payment into their application

タイトル: Reliable and Easy Platform for Online Payments
投稿者: Aasil カナダのTax Accountant 経理, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Reliable and Easy Platform for Online Payments"
良い点: Stripe makes accepting credit card and online payments very easy. タイトル: Saves me from writing glue code, but the task count adds up fast
投稿者: Koshish アメリカのSDE 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Saves me from writing glue code, but the task count adds up fast"
良い点: The integration library is the real selling point. Almost every service I wanted to connect for a side project already had a working app, so I skipped writing and hosting my own webhook handlers and cron jobs. As a software engineer I could have built most of these flows myself, but Zapier gets a multi step automation running in about ten minutes and I do not have to babysit a server or pay for one. The editor is clear, testing each step while you build catches bad field mappings early, and the run history makes it obvious which step failed and what data it received. Multi step Zaps with filters and formatter steps cover far more ground than I expected before you need real code, and the built in Code step is there for the cases that do.
改善点: Pricing is the main problem. Everything is metered per task, and a task is any single step that runs, so a five step Zap burns five tasks every time it fires. A polling trigger on a busy source eats through a monthly allowance quickly, and the jump between plan tiers is steep for a personal project rather than a funded team. I ended up adding filter steps early in my Zaps purely to avoid paying for runs I did not need, which is not how I want to design an automation. Polling intervals on the lower tiers are also slow, so anything that needs to feel immediate has to be rebuilt around a webhook trigger.

タイトル: Simple enough to actually keep using

改善点: It works well for personal task management, but it can feel limited when tasks become more complex or require detailed project planning and dependencies.

タイトル: A Beginner Tool for Task Management with Noticeable Limits
投稿者: Shaun アメリカのFreelance Editor 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 執筆、編集, 自営業 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "A Beginner Tool for Task Management with Noticeable Limits"
良い点: 1) It has a low learning curve and is very easy to use right out of the gate. The navigation is intuitive. 2) If all you need is a basic task manager that works with the Microsoft ecosystem, it is perfectly suitable for that task. 3) Within the Microsoft ecosystem, it does a solid job provide reminders and notifications, connecting to your calendar, etc. The mobile app is also, in my experience, perfectly usable. 4) For most basic task management needs, To Do's features make it perfectly suitable. When I first used it for a single large project, its features let me differentiate types of work, steps, and due dates.
改善点: 1) If you need it to interact with anything outside of the Microsoft ecosystem, I found that you needed to use a third party service as a router between Microsoft and the other ecosystem. For me, this would have required navigating two different ecosystems and manually moving things from one to the other. 2) It is not feature rich. The features it has work great for small project management or general to do lists, but beyond that, it lacks some of the common features of its competitors. I won't fault it too much for this because it is a free piece of software. 3) It isn't, in my opinion, well-designed for managing large projects or multiple projects. The features it has could technically do this work, but I found that this created more confusion and mental drain than a more feature rich alternative. This might not be an issue for someone who does not manage multiple projects which run regularly and all year. 4) Some integrations between To Do and other Microsoft software either isn't possible or requires a third party solution. This is unfortunate.

タイトル: Campaign emailing is extremely misleading
投稿者: Mark アメリカのLicensed Real Estate Salesperson 不動産, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Campaign emailing is extremely misleading"

改善点: Signed up for the Campaigns email feature and spent a month building my CRM around it. Because of how 25 contacts were sourced, Pipedrive locked double opt-in across my entire account, blocking campaigns to all ~560 of my contacts, including 25-year relationships. My contacts are legitimate, nothing bought or scraped, and I am breaking no laws. US email is opt-out, not opt-in. This is Pipedrive's own internal policy, stricter than the law and not disclosed in their marketing. Ironically, they sell prospecting tools built to surface total strangers, but won't let me email people I've done business with for years. Cost me real time, money, and energy.

I’ve found it to be responsive in both the Windows application and the web version. It’s also much cheaper than other software, for example Smartsheet, which saves a lot of money for the organization. As an admin, I’ve onboarded multiple users and found it very easy to provide KT to new users. From my own experience, I was also new to the application, and it was still easy to utilize the functionality. Cigna AI has not been enabled yet, but I’ve tried a few functions as a beta tester. タイトル: Powerful Project Management Platform with Excellent Visibility and Collaboration

良い点: Wrike excels at providing clear visibility across projects, tasks, and team workloads. Features such as customizable dashboards, Gantt charts, and automated workflows make it easy to track progress and keep projects moving forward. The ability to assign tasks, set dependencies, attach files, and maintain discussions directly within each task helps reduce email clutter and keeps all project information in one place. We have found the reporting tools particularly useful for monitoring deadlines, identifying bottlenecks, and giving stakeholders real-time updates on project status. Once configured, Wrike becomes a highly effective platform for improving collaboration, accountability, and overall project organization.
改善点: While Wrike is a powerful project management platform, some features can be confusing and require a significant learning curve for new users. The hierarchy between Spaces, Folders, Projects, and Tasks is not always intuitive, making it easy to lose track of where information is stored. Custom workflows and request forms are highly flexible, but setting them up correctly can be challenging without prior experience. Reporting and dashboard customization can also feel overwhelming due to the number of available options, and users may need to navigate through multiple menus to find specific settings or project views. Although these features provide tremendous flexibility, they can make the platform feel overly complex for teams that only need straightforward task and project tracking.

タイトル: Great Support and Reliable Features

タイトル: The pros and cons of using Constant Contact
投稿者: Bob アメリカのCEO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 研究, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "The pros and cons of using Constant Contact"
良い点: I liked Constant Contact most for its ease of use and straightforward email marketing tools. It makes creating professional-looking campaigns, managing contact lists, and tracking results relatively simple, even without much technical experience.
改善点: The main thing I liked least about Constant Contact was that some of the more advanced features can feel limited or require a higher-priced plan. The interface is generally easy to use, but certain customization options and automation tools could be more flexible for users with more complex marketing needs.

タイトル: Great email marketing platform
投稿者: Katie アメリカのDevelopment and Communications Manager 医療業務, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great email marketing platform"
良い点: Constant Contact meets all of our needs for email marketing and integrates well with our CRM, making data management seamless. Also super user friendly!
改善点: There are some features that our out of our price range, like automated emails and email series. The features exist, but just not within our plan.

タイトル: A formidable organization tool
投稿者: Marc アメリカのDigital Media Specialist 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 教育管理, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "A formidable organization tool"
良い点: What I liked most about Constant Contact is its simplicity and reliability for email marketing. The platform makes it easy to build, schedule, and send professional-looking emails without needing extensive technical knowledge. The drag-and-drop editor is straightforward, and the templates provide a strong starting point, which helps streamline the content creation process.
改善点: What I liked least about Constant Contact is that it can feel somewhat limited in terms of advanced customization and automation. While the platform is great for straightforward email campaigns, it doesn’t offer the same level of flexibility or sophistication you’d find in more robust marketing automation tools. Things like complex workflows, deeper personalization, or behavioral triggers can be harder to execute.

タイトル: Constant contacts makes email communication easy

I like the structure and design of the newsletter and ad templates. I liked the preview view so you know how it would appear to subscribers. For a beginning like me, constant contacts was easybto grasp and understand. If i had trouble, i would simply search for tutorials or reach to constant contacts for support. Also the newsletters and email ads were mobile friendly!
改善点: What i liked least of constant contact was the price. It was more expensive than the other software.

タイトル: Constant Contact has been a solid weekly tool

Simple activity reminders make it easy for people to close them rather than ignore yet another notification.
改善点: I would not stretch to invent a weakness. Constant Contact has been working well for our size of team.

タイトル: Data Collection Game Changer

It is very easy to use for both our staff and the clients we serve. It makes document management a breeze compared to other platforms. The value for your money is incredible!
改善点: It did take me a bit of time to learn how to download my documents so make clearer instructions may help ease any frustration for first time users. Overall, it is an excellent program.

タイトル: Great Free Tier - Professional Looking Forms
投稿者: Rowan アメリカのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 建設, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Great Free Tier - Professional Looking Forms"
良い点: The free tier of Jotform has plenty of features to handle simple projects. The form builder is easy to use and intuitive, I was able to customize it to get what I wanted. It was simple to embed into my existing website (hosted with GitHub Pages) and looks very clean. The Jotform branding, included on the free tier, is only at the bottom of the form and not at all intrusive.
改善点: The feature to have users take a photo as part of their submission seems to result in really low quality images. But the same component gets much better quality images when they select an existing photo off their device. It's frustrating because having the ability to open the camera on the form is a nice touch.

タイトル: Helpful Tool for Managing Client Information
投稿者: MaChelsea アメリカのCEO 経理, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Helpful Tool for Managing Client Information"
良い点: What I like most about Jotform is how easy it is to create and customize forms for my tax business. It helps me collect client information, organize responses, and reduce unnecessary back-and-forth. I also appreciate the templates because I don’t have to create every form from scratch. It’s convenient for both me and my clients.
改善点: The biggest drawback for me is the pricing when you need more submissions or additional features. Some of the customization options can also take a little time to figure out. I wish certain features were included in the lower-priced plans, especially for small businesses.

タイトル: jotform review
投稿者: ville フィンランドのspecialist 経理, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "jotform review"
良い点: In my evaluation of Jotform, what stands out most is its evolution from a simple form builder into a comprehensive no-code productivity suite. In 2026, it is widely considered the most versatile tool for anyone who needs to collect data and immediately do something with it.
改善点: While Jotform is a powerhouse of features, it is often described as a "jack of all trades, master of none." For every feature it adds, there is a corresponding layer of complexity or a trade-off that can be frustrating.

The user interface has always made for an easygoing process and workflow for any documentation that needs typing up or editing while working on a project that requires team collaboration.
改善点: Since Microsoft Word has a daunting amount of features, customer support comes down to searching through help FAQs to find your answers.

タイトル: Microsoft Word is still my go to for documents

Collaboration and team collaboration have gotten better over the years, but I still think they could be smoother. Customer support is available, although finding an answer to a very specific problem can sometimes take more effort than it should. I usually end up figuring things out on my own.

タイトル: Powerful Tool for Everyday Document Creation
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ、ネットワーク・セキュリティ, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Powerful Tool for Everyday Document Creation"
良い点: Microsoft Word has been my go-to word processing software for creating assignments, reports, and professional documents. The interface is easy to navigate, and the formatting tools make it simple to create clean, well-structured documents. Features like spell check, templates, tables, and collaboration through comments have been especially useful. While some advanced features take time to learn and the subscription cost may not suit everyone, Word remains one of the most reliable and feature-rich document editors available. Overall, I would recommend it to students, professionals, and anyone who regularly works with documents.
改善点: The biggest drawbacks are the subscription cost and the complexity of some advanced features. New users may need time to learn everything, and very large documents can occasionally experience performance issues. Despite these limitations, Microsoft Word remains a powerful and dependable word processor.

タイトル: Notion vs Airtable: Choose Based on Your Use Case, Not Just Features
投稿者: Japhet ケニアのData Analyst 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Notion vs Airtable: Choose Based on Your Use Case, Not Just Features"
良い点: Beautiful, intuitive interface that's incredibly easy to learn. Excellent for note-taking, documentation, and wikis. Great for team collaboration and knowledge management. All-in-one workspace reduces tool sprawl. Flexible database structures for simple to medium use cases. Affordable pricing. Excellent customer support and community.
改善点: Not optimized for real-time data operations and analytics. Sluggish performance with large databases (10,000+ rows). Limited formula capabilities compared to dedicated data tools. Mobile app is basic. Automation is limited compared to Zapier/Make. Better for organization than actionable data insight.

タイトル: Worth Every Penny: The Only App You'll Ever Need (Once You Learn It)
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー メンタルヘルスケア, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Worth Every Penny: The Only App You'll Ever Need (Once You Learn It)"
良い点: Unmatched Customization: It is incredibly flexible. You can build a workspace that fits your exact workflow—it worked for all the things I need: documentation for clients, writing scripts for content, managing my time/calendar, and storage. It links to so many different apps; it's better than Google in every possible way. Stop using Google. All-in-One Powerhouse: You genuinely don’t need any other app. It combines an amazing calendar, robust document editing (far better than Google Docs), and seamless notifications into one affordable platform. Future-Proof Investment: The value is so high that it’s worth purchasing an annual subscription—a rare move for me, but Notion has earned it. Efficiency Once Set Up: While it takes time to build, once the system is running, it makes everything easy and keeps your mental load lighter.
改善点: The "Overwhelming" Factor: The sheer number of features can be a double-edged sword. It is almost too customizable, which can feel overwhelming at first. Steep Learning Curve: Because it is an "all-in-one" app, it’s easy to overlook features or get lost in the options. It requires a dedicated investment of time to learn how to use it to its full potential. Initial Intuition: It might feel slightly unintuitive when you first dive in, even though it becomes very intuitive once you understand the logic.

タイトル: Notion is clunky and over-complicated for most simple tasks.
投稿者: Pupp 英国のOwner イベント企画運営, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Notion is clunky and over-complicated for most simple tasks."

改善点: I found Notion to be overly complicated even for simple things. It is also not the easiest software to use. This isn’t a drag and drop situation with a user friendly interface.

タイトル: Best digital signature software!
投稿者: Kim アメリカのParalegal 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 法執行機関, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Best digital signature software!"
良い点: Eversign is great if you need authenticated signatures on legally binding documents. It is easy to use and simple but still has advanced and custom features. There are several templates to choose from and you can create custom autofill text. Sending the document out is quick and easy, even if you're sending to multiple people. Eversign allows you to upload your signature and can even generate a signature for you! I love this! You have the options of typing or drawing your signature as well. You're able to store documents securely in your eversign account, when you no longer need them you can permanently delete them from eversign. You can also export them to your private file location with ease or set them to automatically expire. Eversign features an audit trail for each transaction/document with detailed information like IP address and a time stamp, very useful if a document is ever disputed.
改善点: Eversign does not have a separate android and IOS app. At times the mobile version does not work properly, and I have lost my autofill data several times. The price is somewhat high if you need to use the more advanced features/versions.

タイトル: A great solution for managing client documents for our travel agency
投稿者: Laura スペインのTravel Consultant and manager レジャー、旅行、観光, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A great solution for managing client documents for our travel agency"
良い点: We've been using Xodo Sign at Burgos Travel for several years to send travel contracts and other documents that our clients need to sign before travelling. The platform is very easy to use, both for our team and for our clients, even for people who have never used an electronic signature before. Creating a document, adding signature fields and sending it only takes a few minutes. It has made our daily work much easier because we no longer have to print, scan or wait for signed paperwork to be returned. We can keep all our signed documents organized in one place, which is very helpful when managing bookings and client documentation. The software has all the features we need for our business, and whenever we've had a question, customer support has been helpful. Overall, it offers very good value for money and has become part of our everyday workflow.
改善点: We honestly haven't had any major issues while using Xodo Sign. If I could suggest a couple of improvements, I would like to see more options to customize email notifications and document templates. More integrations with other business or CRM tools would also be useful, although the current features already cover everything we need on a daily basis.

タイトル: Extreme Poor Treatment of Long-Time Client
投稿者: Ben ニュージーランドのDirector 経理, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Extreme Poor Treatment of Long-Time Client"
良い点: This system was easy and simple to use, our clients loved it, easy to create templates, and upload documents.

We only ever send stuff to our clients for signing and we have the clients email address correct in our database. タイトル: Assitant Director
投稿者: Giovanna アメリカのAssistant Director 教育管理, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Assitant Director"
良い点: The new Room Runner has been the feature I like most. It has helped improve efficiency and has been especially useful for planning for the upcoming school year. Being able to access information more easily has made forecasting enrollment and classroom needs much simpler. One enhancement I would love to see is the ability to view projected income and child assignments for the next three months directly within the" Outgoing and Incoming tab". This would make long-term planning and budgeting even more effective.
改善点: While Procare offers many helpful features, I feel there are still several processes that could be further automated to improve efficiency. For example, when a child is assigned to a specific classroom or program, related tags should be applied automatically rather than requiring additional manual steps. I would also like to see more automation within billing. If a tuition rate or fee is attached to a specific program, the system should automatically apply those charges to the child's account when they are enrolled, reducing the risk of errors and saving administrative time. Another enhancement I would recommend is the addition of a school-wide communication wall or announcement board. Currently, most communications are sent through messages that generate emails, which can quickly overwhelm parents' inboxes. A centralized communication feed where families can view announcements, reminders, and updates would improve communication while reducing email volume.

タイトル: A Family Plan That Can't Help Your Family
投稿者: Julie アメリカのVP of Marketing 認証済みLinkedInユーザー マーケティング、広告, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A Family Plan That Can't Help Your Family"
良い点: For nearly six years, LastPass served my family well as our password manager. It was easy to use, simplified password management across multiple devices, and made it convenient to securely store and organize login credentials. The Family plan was straightforward to set up and made sharing passwords between family members simple. Day-to-day, the product generally worked as expected, which is why I remained a loyal customer for so long. Unfortunately, those positives were overshadowed by the account recovery experience and poor customer support. A password manager is only as good as its ability to help when something goes wrong.
改善点: LastPass completely failed when it mattered most. The biggest drawback of LastPass is its account recovery process and the lack of meaningful support when something goes wrong. Family Managers are unable to help family members regain access to their accounts, making the Family plan far less useful than expected. Customer support was slow, unresponsive, and ultimately dismissive, even suggesting that resetting the account was acceptable because there "wasn't much information" saved in the vault. Seven days without access to an account is unacceptable for a password manager, especially when there is no practical path to resolution. Compared to competing password managers that offer family account recovery features, LastPass falls short where it matters most.

タイトル: Great Organization and Data transfer with Procore
投稿者: Michael アメリカのConstruction Survey Manager 建設, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great Organization and Data transfer with Procore"
良い点: What I liked most about Procore is how it centralizes the entire construction project into one platform that’s actually usable in the field. Instead of relying on scattered emails, spreadsheets, and paper drawings, Procore keeps RFIs, submittals, drawings, punch lists, daily logs, photos, and change events organized in one place so everyone works from the same source of truth. The biggest benefit is visibility and accountability. It’s easy to see what’s pending, what’s overdue, and who owns the next step, which helps prevent small issues from turning into major delays or cost impacts. I also appreciate how well it connects the office and the jobsite—superintendents can document progress quickly, teams can communicate updates in real time, and project managers can track decisions without chasing information.
改善点: What I liked least about Procore was that it can feel heavy and overly complex for smaller projects or teams that don’t need every feature. The platform is powerful, but that also means there’s a learning curve, and new users can get overwhelmed by the number of tools, menus, and settings. Sometimes workflows require too many clicks, especially for quick field updates. I also found that standardization depends heavily on how a company sets it up—if permissions, naming conventions, and processes aren’t consistent, things can get messy fast. In some cases, reporting and dashboards can be limited without additional configuration or integrations. Finally, cost can be a downside, since Procore may not be the most budget-friendly option for every contractor or project size.

After using it for over a year across different projects, it has become second nature and never gets in the way of my actual work.
改善点: My main frustration is that the reporting features feel a bit rigid, especially on the free plan. Basic Summary and Detailed reports are fine for a quick overview, but if you want to slice the data differently or build something more tailored to a specific client or project, you quickly hit a wall. Custom reporting and deeper filtering are locked behind paid plans, which feels limiting for more advanced needs.

タイトル: Effortless Time Tracking with Toggl Track: A User-Friendly Experience
