良い点: Toggl Track is very user-friendly. It is simple to navigate. I like how easy it is to continue with a previous project or add a new one. The colour-coding also helps to breakdown the areas in which I am spending most of my time. I also really like the reports tab - it's nice seeing how many hours have been worked and the percentage of my time spent on each project.
改善点: Sometimes, at the end of the day, I will use the mobile app to 'end' a task that I had started through the desktop webpage. I can see the task still counting when I enter the app, and so I will press the 'stop' button, but it does not always register. If I don't double-check it, then it will continue tracking time until the next morning when I return to Toggl Track. This just seems to be a small bug within the system.

The automation builder is very good, has plenty of options and easy to use.
改善点: I have a real gripe. I built an automation with a goal of checking if a lead had visited a certain page on my website. This would enable me to know if they had purchased a product. My website was integrated so this could be done. But upon testing this automation, over and over again, even when someone fulfilled the actual goal, it did not register in the automation... so they kept receiving the promo emails. I got customer support on this issue multiple times and they all suggested different fixes, none of which worked. Eventually someone told me that it was an issue with a deep tech issue of the platform and that would take a lot of time to resolve. They never got back to me to let me know when it had been resolved. Even though I left comments on their ads and their fb page. They said 'we hear you. we know its not working and we're working on it'. But if they did ever fix it they never informed me. It was such a simple Goal trigger. Its a fundamental functionality that should have worked. So I gave up on that automation and others like it. Then they decided they wanted to charge me signficantly more for my subscription because ' there have been so many developments in our system'. Well they never sorted out that basic issue that was important to me. And I never used the other fancy things they had created. So I'm disappointed with them. And now I'm moving to GoHighLevel. It offers so many more features - I can run the whole of my business here, without having multiple platfo

The platform supports Team Collaboration through email, calendars, meetings, and shared communication, while its overall features make it practical for everyday professional work.

It feels like a complete system that I can count on.

Also, I have to adjust the screen view each time in order to maximize the screen area that I can see and work from. It's a minor issue (and not really necessary), but I choose to adjust it every time I use it.

タイトル: Best In Class to Keep Your Computer from Becoming Crass

The user interface in the cloud management console is clean, modern, and very simple to navigate, making endpoint deployment across workstations straightforward. Backed by 20 years of innovation and crushing malware! You cant go wrong with MWB - best value for the money on the market, amazing customer support that actually cares AND WILL HELP YOU! Customer support response times via ticketing can sometimes be a bit slow when you need quick answers on policy configurations. THERE ARE NO OVERALL CONS. THIS IS AN AMAZING PRODUCT.

There is a desktop which is not linked to our Microsoft 365 account. When using this computer I have to use Numbers instead of Excel. Personally, I struggle with this program. I find it harder to use than Excel. The way the page is laid out (a finite grid instead of an infinite grid) seems strange to me. Having the status bar with the equation written when clicking into a cell is something I take for granted when using Excel but you realise how essential this is when you begin to use numbers and it is not there. Maybe there are ways to make numbers more personalised and therefore user friendly to myself but I have not spent the time to explore it when Excel is exactly set up with no editing.

改善点: The main drawback was the complexity of the platform. With so many services and configuration options, it can take time to learn and manage effectively. Pricing can also be difficult to predict, especially as usage grows.

改善点: The biggest issue with GCP is that it often feels less familiar with AWS and Azure in enterprise environments, which isn't great considering that navigating either of those alone doesn't feel very intuitive. in an enterprise environment this can mean even fewer teams or administrators knowing the tooling and how to efficiently leverage it. The learning curve coming from a MS background is incredibly steep and the difficulties with mapping concepts between GCP and Microsoft on-prem means that it's difficult to have high level standardisations and cleanly integrated workflows.

タイトル: Good tools, but cancelling my subscription did not stop the billing
投稿者: Theo タイのFounder 航空会社/航空産業, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Good tools, but cancelling my subscription did not stop the billing"
良い点: Keyword research and Site Audit are genuinely good. The competitor data is reliable and having everything in one platform saved us from paying for two separate tools.
改善点: Cancelling the subscription did not stop the billing. I cancelled and was charged 285.25 EUR anyway on the next renewal. Their own policy says a cancellation request is confirmed within 3 business days. No confirmation ever arrived, and support later confirmed that no cancellation request had been recorded at all. Refunds are explicitly excluded for month to month plans, so a cancellation that silently fails costs you a full month with no recourse. Their BBB profile shows a D- rating with dozens of unanswered complaints describing the same thing.

良い点: Lucidchart stands out as a versatile platform for visual project management. Its intuitive drag-and-drop interface make it incredibly easy for everyone on our team to build,edit and refine diagrams without requiring any special skills. The flexibility of being able to access and update our diagrams from any device with an internet connection means we can capture ideas immediately whether we are in the office, at a client site or reviewing infrastructure on the ground. タイトル: LibreOffice: A Powerful Free Alternative for Everyday Business Productivity

良い点: I used the LibreOffice office suite while working as a Digital Marketing Assistant for HostHelp. I am confident that this product has many advantages. First of all, this application is completely free of charge. Secondly, it includes a great Office Suite helpful in almost any workplace setting. It is easily customizable and compatible with a variety of different formats. In addition, the software has a lot of various tools for advanced users, like complex spreadsheet formulas, pivot tables, and data analysis. Finally, LibreOffice is open source; thus, anyone can contribute to its development and improve the existing code.
改善点: Unfortunately, there are also some significant disadvantages of LibreOffice. First of all, it lacks real-time document editing, collaboration, commenting, and co-authoring. Moreover, the interface of the application is not up-to-date and may seem somewhat old-fashioned. Another disadvantage of LibreOffice is that it works slowly on large files such as complex spreadsheets or presentations. Additionally, this application has rather limited cloud storage and does not offer advanced collaboration tools. Finally, LibreOffice lacks some features for enterprises and large companies, such as user management and cloud deployment.

I mainly use it for writing research papers, reports, grant drafts, and for light data handling in spreadsheets. Writer is particularly strong for long-form academic documents, as it handles styles, references, footnotes, and large files very well, which is essential when working on journal articles or collaborative reports. I also appreciate that LibreOffice is open source and free, which aligns well with the ideals of open science and makes it easy to recommend to students and collaborators regardless of their institution’s budget. Its compatibility with common document formats (especially .docx, .csv, and .xlsx) allows smooth collaboration with colleagues who use proprietary software.
改善点: The main downside is that compatibility with Microsoft Office is not always perfect, especially for very complex documents with advanced formatting, tracked changes, or heavily styled tables. Occasionally, layout issues appear when exchanging files back and forth multiple times. The user interface, while functional, can also feel less polished or less intuitive than some commercial alternatives, particularly for new users. Some advanced features exist but are not always easy to discover, which can slow down workflows unless you already know where to look or customize the interface.

良い点: MATLAB is an exceptional tool for advanced data analysis and high-level engineering tasks. Its most impressive feature is the comprehensive ecosystem of specialized toolboxes that allow for sophisticated work in fields like signal processing, deep learning, and image analysis without the need to build complex functions from scratch. For those heavily involved in simulation and modeling, the integration with Simulink provides a seamless visual environment that is significantly more efficient than traditional text-based coding for complex control systems. Furthermore, the documentation provided by MathWorks is incredibly thorough, featuring clear examples and a professional community that makes troubleshooting and learning new features very straightforward.
改善点: Despite its technical power, the most significant drawback is the overall value for money, as the licensing fees are quite steep for individual users and small businesses. The cost can escalate quickly when multiple specialized toolboxes are required, which often makes open-source alternatives more attractive for those on a tight budget. Additionally, the software is quite resource-intensive, which can occasionally lead to performance lag when managing heavy dashboard data or complex graphical user interfaces on standard hardware. Because it is a proprietary language, it also poses some challenges for collaboration with researchers or developers who do not have access to a paid license.

タイトル: Easy to Use and Convenient Remote Support Software
投稿者: Elizabeth アメリカのEndpoint Support 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Easy to Use and Convenient Remote Support Software"

タイトル: Great working remote support tool but UI is outdated

タイトル: BeyondTrust is required for remote access control

タイトル: Easy to use remote support solution

It has different ways to access a user system, you can simply send the user a link or inform the user to find you on the public URL. The solution is very easy to set up compared to some other products. Third-party integration with solutions like SysAid was also seamless. With little or no training, the solution is good to go for anyone.

タイトル: Notepad++ is Everything You Need in an Editor
投稿者: Gene アメリカのPrincipal Consultant 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 金融サービス, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Notepad++ is Everything You Need in an Editor"

タイトル: Makes working across my Apple devices effortless
投稿者: Furkan トルコのFounder 認証済みLinkedInユーザー デザイン, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Makes working across my Apple devices effortless"
良い点: The best part of iCloud for me is how naturally it works across my iMac, iPhone and iPad. I can save a work file on one device and continue with it on another without having to manually transfer anything. File management feels simple, sharing documents is quick, and there is almost no learning curve if you already use Apple devices. It removes a lot of small steps from my daily workflow.
改善点: Storage management could be a little clearer, especially when backups, photos and work files start using a lot of space. Sometimes it takes a bit of checking to understand exactly what is consuming storage. I have also seen occasional delays in syncing, but they have been rare and have never been a serious problem for my workflow.

タイトル: Seamless and Reliable Cloud Storage for Apple Users
投稿者: Jonathan アメリカのChief Marketing Officer 保険, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Seamless and Reliable Cloud Storage for Apple Users"
良い点: The biggest thing I like about iCloud is how seamlessly it works across Apple devices. Files, photos, contacts, and other information stay synced without having to manually move things around. It’s simple, reliable, and makes accessing information from different devices very convenient.
改善点: The main downside is that storage can fill up fairly quickly, especially with photos and backups. The pricing for additional storage is reasonable, but I wish the included storage was more generous. Some settings and file management options can also be a little confusing at first.

タイトル: Eh, iCloud could be better.
投稿者: Justice アメリカのFounder 認証済みLinkedInユーザー プロフェッショナル・トレーニング、コーチング, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Eh, iCloud could be better."
良い点: I like that I can sync my photos, files, messages, and music across multiple devices. ICloud also makes it easier to communicate via wifi when cellular service is unavailable.
改善点: Where do I start? There is never enough storage on your device, even though you have iCloud access. I currently pay 2.99 for additional storage, yet I still get the message that iCloud is full. If you have a device that is updated and another that isn't, the sync function is thrown off. Why can't I remove Apple apps that I do not use?

タイトル: Convenient, Reliable, and Seamlessly Integrated Across Apple Devices
投稿者: Kamal アメリカのClinical Psychologist 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 病院、ヘルスケア, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Convenient, Reliable, and Seamlessly Integrated Across Apple Devices"
良い点: What I liked most about iCloud was how seamlessly it kept my information and content synchronized across all of my Apple devices. It made it easy to access photos, files, contacts, notes, passwords, and other important information without having to manually transfer or update anything. I also appreciated the automatic backups, which provided peace of mind that my data could be recovered if I lost or replaced a device. The overall experience felt convenient, reliable, and well integrated into the Apple ecosystem, with minimal setup or ongoing effort required.
改善点: One of the things I liked least about iCloud was that the free storage capacity felt limited, especially with photos, videos, device backups, and other files accumulating over time. Once the storage filled up, it could become difficult to manage what was being backed up or synchronized, and upgrading to a paid storage plan felt almost necessary for regular use. I also found that iCloud could sometimes be confusing when managing storage, understanding what was actually stored in the cloud versus locally on a device, or troubleshooting synchronization issues. While the overall integration with Apple devices was convenient, the experience could be less straightforward when something wasn't syncing correctly.

タイトル: By the time I get back, the job site photos.
投稿者: Keith アメリカのField Operations Manager ファシリティサービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "By the time I get back, the job site photos."
良い点: I coordinate crews across twelve facilities, and honestly, everyone’s already on an iPhone anyway. Photos from maintenance jobs just hit my desk automatically. Inspection reports stay current between the truck and the office, and when a crew lead updates a site checklist, I see it in real time. No more texting myself files or waiting for someone to get back to the office to upload documentation.
改善点: Storage fills up faster than I expected with all the job site photos and equipment manuals we keep accessible. The Windows app on our office machines feels clunky compared to how smooth everything works on the phones. Occasionally a file takes longer to sync when someone's out in a facility with weak signal, but that's more the building than the platform.

タイトル: My sign up genius review.
投稿者: Tesla アメリカのNone 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 執筆、編集, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "My sign up genius review."
良い点: Its easy to sign up for things for my children's classroom and also see who has signed up for what items so i know whats available.
改善点: Theres nothing i dislike, i have had a great impression of the app.

タイトル: Flexible tool, recent update was a set back.
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 教育管理, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Flexible tool, recent update was a set back."
良い点: We use SUG for such a variety of volunteer and meeting/appointment management we have probably explored most of the features to their fullest. The flexibility to adapt the various types of signups used for different types of opportunities and extending the signups using forms and notifications is powerful. The service can handle a pretty heavy load as we've pounded it with over a hundred signups in under five minutes for things like Parent-Teacher Conferences.
改善点: The few types of signups you have available are powerful but not necessarily intuitive and you have to think about how you want the signup to look like and how the signup will flow for the user, leading to some trial and error when you first begin. The requirement for time slots to have a start and end time, makes it tricky to use for items that are just at a particular time, like dropping off items for a bake-sale, but other open ended signups don't read right. Particularly because our primary type of signup is time-slots, it took us a bit to get used to and understand the process of creating the day and time on which something is occurring, then add the slot that is happening at that date and time. The recent updates attempted to combine the pages on which those two steps occur, but make it even harder to intuit out how to attach the two items together.

タイトル: Not a bad tool, but there are others I like better.

Jotform is it's only near competitor

タイトル: Great free tool for even signups
投稿者: Kylee アメリカのDirector of youth and internship ministries 非営利団体運営, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great free tool for even signups"
良い点: SignUpGenius is a great tool for organizing volunteers and sign-ups. It is free, simple to use, and keeps everything in one place. Participants can quickly see what is needed and sign up with ease. I especially like that it sends reminder emails, which help people follow through. Overall, it is an efficient and reliable way to manage events and donations.
改善点: The free version of SignUpGenius has ads that can be distracting, and some advanced features require a paid upgrade. The design looks dated compared to other platforms, and deleting a spot does not always remove the entire row, which can be confusing.

タイトル: Powerful for project notes, but takes time to master
投稿者: Furkan トルコのFounder 認証済みLinkedInユーザー デザイン, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Powerful for project notes, but takes time to master"
良い点: OneNote is one of my preferred tools when I need a structured place for project notes, meeting records and information that needs to stay accessible over time. Some of the teams I work with specifically prefer Microsoft tools, and OneNote fits very naturally into that workflow. I like being able to separate information into notebooks, sections and pages while still keeping everything searchable. Shared notebooks are also very useful for team collaboration, especially when several people need to contribute notes or keep project information in one place.
改善点: The main downside for me is that it can become more complicated than a simple note-taking tool needs to be. The notebook, section and page structure is powerful, but larger workspaces can start to feel crowded, and some features or settings are not immediately obvious. There is definitely a learning curve if you want to use OneNote beyond basic notes. I have also experienced occasional syncing delays, although they have not been frequent enough to seriously affect my work.

タイトル: A flexible solution - strong syncing, flexible noting and 365 integration
投稿者: connor 英国のit team lead メディア制作, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "A flexible solution - strong syncing, flexible noting and 365 integration"
良い点: A strong app for free-form notes; allowing mixed-media notes (i.e handwritten input, sketches, images and clips etc). Being part of the 365 ecosystem is supports strong collaboration and integration with other MS tools, and provides easy organising through notebooks; sections; pages; tags and more.
改善点: It doesnt feel as well-structured as other dedicated note or KB tools, which could pose a problem i9f seeking explicitly defined databases, rigid workflows or formal information architecture. It is perhaps not the best choice for users seeking strong control over xync behaviour or advanced document formatting, and is stronger as a note capture tool rather than a process, document management and presentation platform.

タイトル: Convenient note taking
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 食品、飲料, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Convenient note taking"
良い点: The ability to share notes and collaborate with team members with updates to notes in real time. Versatility with the free form layout
改善点: Search functionality is poor - often can't find what I am looking for. Interface is not great and looks outdated

タイトル: My Favourite Tool for Staying Organised
投稿者: Megan 英国のSystems Administrator 図書館, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "My Favourite Tool for Staying Organised"
良い点: Microsoft OneNote is one of the best tools I use for document management, particularly because I have a heavily admin-focused role where keeping information organised and accessible is extremely important. I can draft and develop my work in OneNote without having to worry about losing information, as everything is automatically saved and can be filed and organised exactly how I need it. This makes it much easier to manage large amounts of information and quickly find what I need. The collaboration features are also excellent. My team can share a page and contribute our own information, allowing us to work together in real time without having to constantly send documents back and forth. This makes teamwork much more efficient and helps ensure everyone is working from the same information. Overall, OneNote has a really positive impact on my productivity. Features such as easy organisation, search, automatic saving, page sharing and the ability to add notes, images, links and other information all make it a flexible tool that fits very well into my day-to-day work.
改善点: The main area I would improve is Microsoft’s customer support. This is more of a general Microsoft issue than something specific to OneNote, as support often directs you to online help pages and guidance rather than providing the opportunity to speak directly with someone who can assist with a specific issue. This can be frustrating when you need more personalised support or are dealing with a problem that is not easily resolved through the available guidance. That said, I have experienced very few issues with OneNote itself and therefore have rarely needed to contact customer support, so this has not significantly affected my overall experience with the software.

タイトル: The Most Powerful and Flexible Note Taking Tool on the Market
投稿者: Eric アメリカのManager, Project Management Office 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 通信, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "The Most Powerful and Flexible Note Taking Tool on the Market"
良い点: I have been a long-time user of OneNote. It is one of the most powerful and user friendly note taking apps available. Now it has become even more powerful with its integration with Copilot, MS Teams and Loop. OneNote can be connected to MS Teams based meetings and populated with everything captured by the MS Teams Facilitator. IT'S AWESOME!
改善点: Literally nothing. There is nothing that I dislike about OneNote, especially since it integrates across all of the Microsoft applications, including Dynamics.

タイトル: All-in-one unified collaboration and communication
投稿者: Chinthaka スリランカのHead of Global IT 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "All-in-one unified collaboration and communication"
良い点: Microsoft azure provides excellent version control over data when using records. Has diverse front end and backend features to capture most scenarious. The built in automations support continuous deployment. The bundled fetures provide value for money and provides administrators with ease of use.
改善点: The platform is already cluttered with numerous features and options and during most times admins feels overhelmed with tech features. The customization features shiuld be provided to perform this function easily.

タイトル: Excellent Cost for Value, but complexities in management and system up time could be better.
投稿者: Ben アメリカのInfrastructure Architect 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 教育管理, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Excellent Cost for Value, but complexities in management and system up time could be better."
良い点: The value to cost for Microsoft Azure for K-12 is the main reason why the product is used at the vast majority of school districts.
改善点: Microsoft Azure has had and continues to have too many global outages. The overall interface and management is complex and cumbersome.

タイトル: Extremely capable, but complicated and not always cost-effective
投稿者: Joshua アメリカのSenior Support Engineer 情報技術、情報サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Extremely capable, but complicated and not always cost-effective"
良い点: There's very little you can't do with Azure. It's particularly useful for businesses already running Microsoft products, and the integration with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and Windows environments is a big advantage. Being able to spin up servers and other resources without purchasing physical hardware is great, and there are plenty of options for just about any situation.
改善点: The pricing is very confusing, and costs can add up quickly if you're not careful. Even relatively simple setups can involve several different services, each with its own configuration and charges. The Azure portal can also be overwhelming, and Microsoft has a habit of changing names, interfaces, and where settings are located. Troubleshooting certain issues can be more complicated than it should be.

タイトル: A Flexible and Powerful Cloud Platform
投稿者: Muhammad オーストラリアのSoftware Specialist 情報技術、情報サービス, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 ""A Flexible and Powerful Cloud Platform""
良い点: Microsoft Azure comes with strong deployment features and it is very easy to get applications with few clicks. Its integration with version tools like GitHub makes easy for keeping record of code changes. Monitoring and logging tools for identifying bugs and issues are also very helpful and allow problems to solved quickly.
改善点: Its interface is complex for learning and finding the right thing among countless services and options become confusing sometimes.

タイトル: Robust Cloud Performance with a Steep Learning Curve
投稿者: christopher アメリカのBrand Strategy Lead マーケティング、広告, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Robust Cloud Performance with a Steep Learning Curve"
良い点: Azure excels in scalability and reliability, giving you enterprise‑grade performance without forcing complex configuration. Its ecosystem integrates smoothly with existing Microsoft services, making cloud adoption feel natural and efficient.
改善点: The platform’s pricing structure can be difficult to predict, especially when workloads scale unexpectedly. Some services also require deeper technical knowledge, which raises the learning curve for new users.

タイトル: Reliable relational database platform for structured data management
投稿者: Nikitha アメリカのAI Proposal Intern 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Reliable relational database platform for structured data management"
良い点: Microsoft SQL Server provides a strong set of Features for storing, organizing, and working with structured data. The Data Management capabilities are useful for handling databases and querying information efficiently, while Relational Data Management makes it practical to work with structured relationships between tables. Once the basics are understood, the platform is fairly straightforward to use for common database tasks. Overall, it provides good Value for Money for organizations that need a reliable relational database platform.
改善点: Some advanced database administration and configuration tasks can have a learning curve, particularly for users who are new to database management. Working with larger databases can also require careful optimization and monitoring. I have occasionally encountered minor Bugs and Issues during database operations or configuration that required troubleshooting. I have limited direct experience with Customer Support, so I cannot strongly evaluate that aspect.

タイトル: Microsoft SQL Server is the databse of choice for no-nonsense, fast, and easy to use SQL enviroments.
投稿者: Ben アメリカのInfrastructure Architect 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Microsoft SQL Server is the databse of choice for no-nonsense, fast, and easy to use SQL enviroments."
良い点: Microsoft SQL Server “MSSQL” has been the most stable and capable database I have ever user. In over 30 years I have never had, seen, or even heard of a MSSQL database corruption. The application is easy to use, fast, consistent, and integrates into everything with no problems.
改善点: The costs for Microsoft SQL Server “MSSQL” can get extreme, but especially when working within K-12 the discounts make it basically free to use.

タイトル: Ease of using Microsoft Sql Server
投稿者: SREEREKHA カナダのLead Developer コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Ease of using Microsoft Sql Server"
良い点: Convenient to develop a database using sql server
改善点: Integrates with mostly microsoft softwares and tools only

タイトル: Powerful Database Platform for Business-Critical Applications
投稿者: Dave アメリカのManager 機械・産業工学, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Powerful Database Platform for Business-Critical Applications"
良い点: Microsoft SQL Server provides a stable, secure, and high-performance database platform for business-critical applications. It offers excellent reliability, strong security features, robust backup and recovery capabilities, and integrates well with other Microsoft products. From an IT perspective, it provides dependable performance while simplifying database administration and long-term maintenance.
改善点: Licensing costs can become significant as environments grow, and some advanced administration, performance tuning, and high-availability features require specialized database expertise. Smaller organizations may also find the licensing and edition options somewhat complex.

タイトル: Tried and true SQL Server that works well with other Microsoft apps.
投稿者: David アメリカのVP of Technology 電気・電子機器製造, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Tried and true SQL Server that works well with other Microsoft apps."
良い点: Ease of use with current ERP system (Aptean Made 2 Manage V. 7.51). Works well with MS Report Builder and Power Query within Excel.
改善点: There is a steep learning curve for non-SQL and non-database users. It's a skillset that is not standard, but necessary for any database management.

タイトル: Best App to save Time & maximise profits!!!!
投稿者: Marla トリニダード・トバゴのFinance Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 建設, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Best App to save Time & maximise profits!!!!"
良い点: First of all, the set up and training was super easy!!! I love that it can be used via both web & cell phones. This app tracks employees far beyond time-in and time-out. It also allows you to follow the total hours taken when completing tasks/projects with no hassle. The jobs, tasks and employees were all easily added and the reports are also the best and precise on hours for projects and employees. I am over the top satisfied that we have switched to ClockShark!!!
改善点: So far, ClockShark actually meets our requirements at our company but if I had to pin point any additional wants, I would like further accounting systems to be linked to this one to create more expansive reports. Other than that, this is great for any company!!!

タイトル: Clockshark Positive Review
投稿者: Glen カナダのGeneral Manager 建設, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Clockshark Positive Review"
良い点: Easy to use, and easy for my employees to use.
改善点: I little clunky, not as polished as I would have liked, and not as many features.

タイトル: Terrible!
投稿者: Toni アメリカのAdministrator 建設, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 ソース：SoftwareAdvice 共有 "Terrible!"
良い点: The only good thing about the application is the scheduling section. We liked the drag and drop feature for either the employee or the job. Adding additional shifts and/or employees to a job was very easy as well.
改善点: There are so many things we did not like about this application. 1. GPS IS UNRELIABLE! I could sit right at my desk, clock in, and it would show me clocking in 3 miles away. I have a new phone with great Verizon service. The GPS should have been accurate. Unfortunately, this happened to at least one or more employees on a daily basis. 2. No way to track Prevailing Wage. There is no way to set a prevailing wage rate for a job. I would have to manually go into the weekly time report and change and re-add the wages for those jobs. 3. REPORTS - The reports are AWFUL! No way to customize them other than the basic per job or per employee, and date. So many of them were useless, and none of them are accurate for us because of the fluctuation in prevailing wage rates. 4.0 CUSTOMER SERVICE was almost NON-EXSISTANT! After several months of asking for help with the GPS and Reports, we pretty much was ignored because they couldn't help us. I was asked repeatedly to rate them, and kept sending messages about the issues, but didn't get any reply. It took 6 months to get an automated e-mail reply for one of our inquiries.

タイトル: 4 years with Clockshark, Best timeclock solution out there.
投稿者: Drew アメリカのProject Manager 建設, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "4 years with Clockshark, Best timeclock solution out there."
良い点: It's easy for my guys to clock in and out. Reminds them when they get to the job sites (if I remember to add the GeoFence, see my Cons section for my gripe with that), Sends them a notification every morning reminding them to clock in (it's been a hassle to get some of them to remember..).
改善点: The geofence cannot be enabled by default when adding a new job. I use Zapier to create my jobs in Clockshark and there's no way to automatically enable the geofence. That's my only qualm with Clockshark to date and we've been using them for nearing 4 years.

タイトル: Organizations wanting to consolidate tools to save on licensing costs.
投稿者: daisuke 日本のManager 病院、ヘルスケア, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Organizations wanting to consolidate tools to save on licensing costs."
良い点: Compared to enterprise giants like Microsoft Intune or Jamf, Endpoint Central offers a much more flexible and budget-friendly licensing model, making it a go-to for SMBs and mid-market enterprises.
改善点: Getting the on-premise version up and running—configuring ports, agent deployment, and server hardening—requires significant technical effort. You’ll likely need to lean on their documentation or support during the first month. While it supports mobile devices, it lacks some of the deep, platform-specific finesse found in specialized tools like Jamf for macOS/iOS.

タイトル: Effortless Automated Patching and Reliable Remote Device Security
投稿者: Md Mahmudul バングラデシュのLead Engineer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Effortless Automated Patching and Reliable Remote Device Security"
良い点: The automated patch management is really good which is quite rare now-a-days. Managing multiple hardwares , devices in a single dashboard is powerful. The remote device wipe is what we wanted for a long time but all other competitors products are not reliable as we expected but Mangageengine is perfect.
改善点: The configuration has some learning curve for new admins as it has dense, non-initiative feature rich dashboard.

タイトル: Excellent Endpoint Management Solution for Enterprise IT Operations
投稿者: Pandian インドのTechnical Lead 情報技術、情報サービス, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Excellent Endpoint Management Solution for Enterprise IT Operations"
良い点: ManageEngine Endpoint Central provides a comprehensive platform for endpoint management, patch deployment, software distribution, remote troubleshooting, and asset inventory. The centralized console makes it easy to manage a large number of devices efficiently. The patch management feature helps keep systems secure and compliant, while remote control capabilities enable quick resolution of user issues without requiring physical access. The solution offers excellent value for money and significantly reduces administrative effort for IT teams.
改善点: The user interface could be more modern and intuitive in some areas. Certain advanced configurations and reporting options have a learning curve for new administrators. Additionally, some deployments and agent-related troubleshooting may require detailed investigation. However, these are minor concerns compared to the overall functionality and capabilities of the product.

タイトル: Efficient Endpoint Management with a Slight Learning Curve
投稿者: pavan インドのsystem admin 政府関係, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Efficient Endpoint Management with a Slight Learning Curve"
良い点: Its centralized management made it easy to monitor, update, and secure all endpoints from a single console, saving time and reducing manual effort.
改善点: The interface can feel outdated and sometimes slow, and certain advanced features have a bit of a learning curve to configure properly.

タイトル: A Comprehensive Solution for Centralized Endpoint Management
投稿者: Sarath インドのIT Coordinator レジャー、旅行、観光, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "A Comprehensive Solution for Centralized Endpoint Management"
良い点: What I liked most about ManageEngine Endpoint Central is its ability to manage and support multiple endpoints from a centralized console. It provides useful features such as software deployment, patch management, remote troubleshooting, inventory management, configuration policies, and reporting. The remote access and troubleshooting capabilities are particularly helpful for IT teams supporting users across different locations. The asset and hardware information available through the console also makes it easier to track devices and maintain an accurate inventory. Overall, Endpoint Central helps reduce manual effort by bringing several endpoint management tasks into one platform, making daily IT operations more organized and efficient.
改善点: One area that could be improved is the user interface and overall navigation. With so many features and configuration options available, new users may initially find the platform slightly overwhelming. Some settings and advanced configurations require time to understand, and locating specific options can occasionally take longer than expected. The reporting and dashboard experience could also be made more modern and customizable. In some cases, troubleshooting agent communication or deployment issues may require additional investigation. While the platform is feature-rich, a simpler interface, improved search and navigation, and more streamlined workflows would make it easier for administrators to use all of its capabilities efficiently.

タイトル: Great for IT support in the background
投稿者: Danielle アメリカのIT Analyst 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great for IT support in the background"
良い点: I'd say Backstage mode is what I like most about Screenconnect! Being able to run background commands, run scripts and transfer files without contacting or interrupting users is extremely valuable!!
改善点: I'd say I drop out of 1 out of 5 remote sessions randomly and for no reason. I've checked mine and the users network connections and have never located a latency issue.

タイトル: Reliable Remote Support
投稿者: Nelson アメリカのIT Systems Admin 金融サービス, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Reliable Remote Support"
良い点: ScreenConnect provides quick and reliable remote connections that make user support seamless and efficient. The appearance is neat and user-friendly, and it is not complicated to arrange unattended access. Performance is always good, even on low-speed networks. Features such as fast transferring of files, executing commands, and displaying multiple screens are really worthwhile.
改善点: Certain settings hide behind layers or need several clicks to reach. Updates sometimes bring new screen layouts that take time to get used to. How do smaller groups really understand licensing and pricing levels?

タイトル: Reliable Remote Support Tool That's Fast, Simple and Easy to Use
投稿者: Josh 英国のIT Support Engineer 情報技術、情報サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Reliable Remote Support Tool That's Fast, Simple and Easy to Use"
良い点: ScreenConnect offers great value for money and is one of the better remote access tools I've used. We primarily use it for connecting to user devices and servers, and it provides fast, reliable remote access with very little effort from the end user. The interface is simple and easy to navigate, making it quick to find devices and start support sessions. Performance is generally excellent, even on slower connections, with low latency and responsive controls. It also includes useful features such as file transfer, session recording and unattended access, which makes supporting users much easier. Customer support has been good whenever needed and the platform is stable and dependable for day-to-day use.
改善点: While it excels as a remote access tool, ticket management features are fairly limited compared to dedicated service desk or PSA platforms. Document management is also basic and isn't really one of the platform's strengths. Some advanced functionality can take a bit of time to learn and certain settings aren't always where you'd expect them to be. The user interface is clean but looks a little dated compared to some newer products on the market.

タイトル: ScreenConnect can get the job done

良い点: It was easy to use and provided the basics of what was needed to support our machines. It had enough structure to make it easy to onboard.
改善点: It sometimes felt that it had too many guardrails and left me wanting to be able to do more. When compared to other products, it felt lacking.

タイトル: Powerful and flexible platform for data analysis and visualization
投稿者: Nikitha アメリカのAI Proposal Intern 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Powerful and flexible platform for data analysis and visualization"
良い点: Microsoft Power BI is easy to use and provides good value for money for analyzing and presenting data. The User Interface makes it straightforward to build dashboards, create visualizations, and explore information. Information Analysis is one of its strongest capabilities, as it helps turn datasets into interactive reports and makes trends easier to understand. Database Management and connectivity options are also useful when working with data from different sources.
改善点: Some advanced features can take time to learn, particularly when working with complex data models, relationships, and calculations. Managing larger datasets and more detailed dashboards can also require additional configuration and optimization. I have limited direct experience with Customer Support, so I cannot strongly evaluate that aspect. Compared with simpler spreadsheet-based tools, Power BI can also feel more complex when only basic analysis is required.

タイトル: Efficient Reporting Solution With Premium Pricing
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 消費財, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Efficient Reporting Solution With Premium Pricing"
良い点: One of the industry-leading reporting tools in the current market. Relatively easy to generate reports using the drag and drop method. Can be connected with large DBs using connection strings in DirectQuery method helping in live tracking . Fast: large sets of data from different tables can be combined without much operational lag. For a multi employee company, the Power BI portal is really helpful as the user access and permissions are easy to manage.
改善点: The Power BI license for each user is comparatively not cheap. Sometimes the gateway to the specific database makes this a little complex. Premium features need high tier licensing. eventhough report creation is simpler, The DB connectivity , Gateway management, DAX etc. requires techincal expertise.

タイトル: Powerful data visualization, with a learning curve
投稿者: Álvaro イタリアのDeploy Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Powerful data visualization, with a learning curve"
良い点: It's very useful for managing historical data from one or more databases, ideal for creating analytical views to better understand that data. It's a great tool for tracking metrics from this information, which is valuable in a professional setting for analyzing the progress of a specific project or task, helping decide how to move forward and whether any adjustments are needed to correct certain data. It's reasonably easy to use when it comes to visualizing reports, it's a highly complete, interactive online document, showing additional data through features like hovering the mouse over elements. The interface is fairly simple and intuitive. Being able to compare data easily and visually is a great benefit, allowing you to immediately spot differences. It includes a very useful free Desktop plan. It also offers native integrations with Microsoft tools, typically connecting with Excel and SharePoint (in my personal work experience, the latter is the most important one).
改善点: It requires a fairly steep learning curve to create reports and connect to databases for use, typically, some knowledge of the DAX language is necessary. The cost can rise significantly as more people at a professional level need access to it.

タイトル: Easy-to-Use Tool for Data Analysis and Reporting
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 教育管理, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Easy-to-Use Tool for Data Analysis and Reporting"
良い点: I like Power BI mainly because it makes data analysis and reporting much easier. I use it to create dashboards, track KPIs, and present data in a way that is easy for both technical and non-technical people to understand. The integration with Excel and SQL is also very useful in my day-to-day work.
改善点: The basic features are easy to learn, but advanced DAX and data modeling can take some time to understand. Reports can also become slow when working with large datasets or too many visuals. The licensing can be another concern when using it across a larger team.

タイトル: Private Commercial Real Estate Debt Company Reviews Nimble
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 不動産, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 ソース：GetApp 共有 "Private Commercial Real Estate Debt Company Reviews Nimble"
良い点: We like the simplicity, browser plug in is really interesting. its engaging but we don't use a lot of the features.
改善点: 1) Like I said we do appreciate the simplicity but the biggest disappointment / the thing that would make the system a slam dunk for us if improved is simply the dropdown customization for contact categorizations. We have no use for "Hot Lead" we're not sales people, we're a capital source for the real estate world. We changed those to be subcategories of the lead type which we also customized. The disappointment is in that the system doesn't appreciate that more often than not, a Broker is often also a Buyer, an Attorney often dabbles as a Developer. It would be an easy thing for them to be both. For now we rely on tags although its prone to human error and I don't feel comfortable making mail lists off of them. In summary, our perfect system would allow for broad macro categories that we could customize and subcategories. As well as the ability to check multiple boxes 2) A couple of smaller things, When we connected our twitter account in uploaded all of the companies as people which was a disaster. There was no way to just flip them into companies. We had to delete them and remake them. 3) No customer service. It was a nightmare when we couldn't get an excel of contacts to upload properly, I think my associate had to tweet at Nimble to get any response. Eventually it was resolved. 4) For some reason we thought that connecting people's linkedin would tell us if they changed their job but so far it hasn't.

タイトル: A great tool creating hyper-quality and fluid content
投稿者: Ferent カメルーンのWeb Designer - Junior Platform Maintainance Engineer And Seasoned Online Marketing Assistant 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 建築資材, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A great tool creating hyper-quality and fluid
良い点: Jasper completely simplifies content creation and marketing processes. I like it because it's easy to use and results-driven. As a website designer and marketer, it helps me during the content creation stage. I leverage its intelligent generative powers to generate content for websites I design for customers and casual promotional campaigns I handle. It allows me to generate long-form content based on the number of words or paragraphs assigned. The way it reacts and responds to prompts makes an automated text-generation process extremely amazing. I could have gotten better at what I do now if it weren't for Jasper. Overall, I think it's completely different from most AI content generators and is almost able to generate human-like content because working with it gives me the impression that I'm actually dealing with a human. I do not know the technology behind Jasper but I think its developers are doing a great job already
改善点: I haven't experienced any issues with Jasper so far that's why I'm using it.

タイトル: Once was king, but has fallen behind
投稿者: Sarah アメリカのWeb Developer / Affiliate Marketer インターネット, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Once was king, but has fallen behind"
良い点: As an early adopter (March 2021), I was able to see the magic of AI for the first time. I was grandfathered onto an unlimited plan which I kept renewing even when not using as much, since the credits were pretty pricey. It was amazing to see the way content could be created and Jasper was initially innovating at a breakneck speed early on.
改善点: After Jasper got funding and expanded the team, innovation stopped. New features stopped being added. Jasper started struggling to produce full articles and was often repetitive. Quality slipped majorly. Then Jasper changed their pricing structure and reopened unlimited plans to everyone, leaving many early adopters who were grandfathered into unlimited plans feeling jaded.

タイトル: Consistent and reliable content generation that has delivered for us repeatidly.
投稿者: Ben 英国のManaging Director 認証済みLinkedInユーザー メンタルヘルスケア, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Consistent and reliable content generation that has delivered for us repeatidly."
良い点: Jasper has consistently delivered a standard of content creation we would be more than happy with from an in person team of copy writers, and it does this from the ease of an intuitive dashboard and all on demand.It has a use experience that is seamless, easy to create from and the standard of content that is created surprised and won over everyone in our business including those previously against the idea of AI content creation.
改善点: Our only comment towards the software would be an addition of an even longer format generation option. The system does allow repeated creation via the long format function but an extra long format button would save time and repeated use.

タイトル: The writing world has changed, and you deserve your sanity and time!
投稿者: Crystal アメリカのSr. Product Marketing Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 金融サービス, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "The writing world has changed, and you deserve your sanity and time!"
良い点: TLDR; Save time, and stress with an incredible AI writing assistant changing the ChatGPT game! For years, we've been told that content marketing is the holy grail of marketing but how many of us are actually good at it? Sure, everyone can write a blog post or two, but when it comes to creating long-form content that's engaging, actionable, and accurate? Not so much. It's an art, and SEO is important to drive engagement. Do you know what's worse than not being able to write great content? Not having enough time to do it. We all have jobs that we need to get done each day and if you're one of the unfortunate souls who's also responsible for managing your company's messaging/positioning and keeping up with other business requests well, then you know what I'm talking about.The good news is that there are tools out there now that can help make your life easier! And Jasper AI is one of them. It lets you add structured data to your website without having to lift a finger—which means you can spend more time on things like growing your business or spending time with your family instead of worrying about tedious tasks like updating your website.
改善点: NOT a deal breaker:Not having easy access to a cheat sheet for shortcuts or codes. Having to scour through blogs and the Jasper Bootcamp was time-consuming. As a product marketer, I want simplicity in the UX/UI, and one-pagers do just that!I created my own cheat sheet with codes, and screenshots to save me time.

投稿者: Stephen アメリカのManager 化学, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Google Maps Is A Life Saver"

タイトル: My Go-To Guide for Finding Places and Avoiding Wrong Turns
投稿者: Sudeep カナダのSr. Accountant 不動産, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "My Go-To Guide for Finding Places and Avoiding Wrong Turns"

I use it to check directions, compare routes, estimate travel times, and discover places worth visiting. The street view feature is especially helpful because I can get a better idea of what a location looks like before arriving. I also appreciate the reviews, photos, business hours, and location details shared by other users. It saves me time and makes planning trips much easier.
改善点: Sometimes the estimated arrival time changes unexpectedly, especially when traffic conditions change. I've also noticed that some business hours, addresses, or place details can be outdated. In unfamiliar areas, GPS directions aren't always perfect, and occasionally the suggested route isn't the most convenient one. I would appreciate more accurate information for smaller businesses and a simpler way to report incorrect locations or outdated details.

タイトル: A Strong Web Software
投稿者: Marc アメリカのDigital Media Specialist 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 事務用品、事務機器, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A Strong Web Software"
良い点: Ease of Use: The drag‑and‑drop editor made it very approachable, even for users with little to no web design experience. You could get a site up quickly without touching code. Clean, Structured Layouts: Weebly encouraged simple, well-organized page layouts, which helped keep sites visually clean and easy to navigate. All‑in‑One Platform: Hosting, templates, basic SEO tools, and forms were built in, so you didn’t need to stitch together a lot of third‑party tools to launch a functional site. Good for Small Projects: It worked especially well for small organizations, classrooms, portfolios, or basic informational sites where speed and simplicity mattered more than deep customization. Low Learning Curve for Editors: Once a site was built, non‑technical contributors could easily update text or images without breaking the design.
改善点: Limited Design Flexibility: While easy to use, the editor felt restrictive. Fine‑tuning layouts, spacing, or responsive behavior was harder compared to more modern builders. Stagnant Feature Growth: Over time, the platform didn’t seem to evolve as quickly as competitors, especially after its acquisition—new features and updates felt slow or minimal. Basic SEO & Blogging Tools: SEO controls and blogging functionality were fairly surface‑level, which made it less ideal for content‑heavy or growth‑focused sites. Template Constraints: Once you chose a theme, switching or deeply customizing it could be cumbersome without redesigning large portions of the site. Less Control for Advanced Users: For users who wanted more backend access, custom integrations, or advanced functionality, Weebly quickly hit a ceiling.

タイトル: Reliable, easy to use and lots of features (for free!)
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 医療業務, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Reliable, easy to use and lots of features (for free!)"

タイトル: Good for Square Users, Limited for Everyone Else

タイトル: Great software with many capabilities
投稿者: Deborah アメリカのController 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 建設, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great software with many capabilities"
良い点: The ease of use, functionality of software, the software being able to handle all tax withholding of various local jurisdictions.
改善点: It wasn't always easy to connect with the account assigned representative, however the next available staff was always very helpful and knowledgeable.

タイトル: Paychex Flex
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー バイオテクノロジー, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Paychex Flex"
良い点: What stands out most about Paychex Flex is how it brings multiple HR, payroll, and benefits functions into one intuitive platform. The dashboard is clean and easy to navigate, which makes routine tasks like running payroll, tracking time, and accessing reports much more efficient. Another strong point is its flexibility and automation—features like automatic tax calculations, compliance support, and customizable reporting reduce manual work and the risk of errors. The employee self-service portal is also useful, allowing staff to access pay stubs, tax forms, and personal information without constant HR involvement. Overall, it simplifies complex processes while maintaining compliance, which is especially valuable in a regulated environment.
改善点: One downside is that some features feel less intuitive than expected, especially when navigating more advanced functions like reporting or customization. It can take time to locate specific options or fully understand how to configure certain settings. Additionally, the reporting capabilities, while robust, are not always user-friendly and may require extra effort to extract the exact data needed. There can also be occasional delays or dependency on customer support for resolving specific issues, which can slow down workflows. Overall, while the platform is powerful, the learning curve and navigation for certain features could be improved.

タイトル: Legacy payroll provider with a robust offering at a price.
投稿者: Robert アメリカのVice President 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 政府関係, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Legacy payroll provider with a robust offering at a price."
良い点: Paychex Flex is a large company and with that comes a bit of security and knowledge that they can handle any sized customer big or small as well as the unique challenges that come from complex payroll solutions. The rub is that you pay a premium for that type of service. All in all they have a solid and very customizable product and it's well rounded given there several acquisitions to include just about everything under the sun under one product offering.
改善点: The cost. Being a legacy payroll provider, the cost certainly is high in comparison with all of the other providers. The other thing that could be a challenge was the revolving door of specialist that would be assigned to our account. It seemed like every month or two we'd be assigned to a new Paychex team member. Also given Paychex size it seems that the teams are geo-diverse and don't utilize the same tools and resources to manage customer accounts internally. i.e. probably no shared CRM or Salesforce platform. We'd routinely get calls from folks in different departments trying to upsell our service offering only to tell them we spoke to someone else about this less than a month ago and have no interest in implementing the additional services.

タイトル: Robust HR platform hindered by clunky navigation and frequent hidden fees
投稿者: Marquita アメリカのSALES MANAGER 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 経理, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Robust HR platform hindered by clunky navigation and frequent hidden fees"
良い点: Paychex Flex excels at accurate payroll processing by automating complex tax filings, direct deposits, and standard deductions, which effectively eliminates math errors. The platform provides a dedicated account representative who takes the time to understand your specific business needs, offering a level of personalized service that is rare in the industry. Additionally, the employee portal is highly intuitive, giving staff instant mobile access to paystubs, tax forms, and time-off tracking. Its modular design is also a major advantage, allowing the software to scale seamlessly by adding HR tools, health benefits, and retirement tracking features as the business grows.
改善点: The platform suffers from an outdated, clunky interface that makes navigation cumbersome, often requiring too many clicks to toggle between employee and manager views. The reporting module is particularly frustrating; building custom reports is not intuitive and frequently requires intervention from support. Additionally, the pricing model feels restrictive, as there are constant "nickel-and-dime" fees for necessary items like special payroll runs or year-end tax forms. Finally, the mobile app performance is often poor, characterized by slow load times and frequent logouts, while general customer support outside of a dedicated rep can be inconsistent and slow to resolve issues.

タイトル: Easy to use & excellent with compliance!

タイトル: Secure management of devices in the company.

タイトル: Awesome security and device control

タイトル: Anydesk lifesaver

改善点: Sometime you have to connect multiple times which is stressful to keep reconnecting but it works well after sometimes

タイトル: Excellent Software, but Extremely Unfair and Aggressive Subscription Policies
投稿者: Ashok オーストラリアのIT admin コンピュータ、ネットワーク・セキュリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Excellent Software, but Extremely Unfair and Aggressive Subscription Policies"
良い点: AnyDesk is an excellent remote desktop solution. It is fast, reliable, easy to use, and works well for IT support and remote access. The software itself is impressive and delivers good functionality. Unfortunately, the company’s subscription and cancellation policies significantly undermine an otherwise great product.
改善点: The biggest disappointment is AnyDesk’s extremely rigid and customer-unfriendly subscription cancellation policy. Requiring 30 days’ advance notice to cancel a prepaid subscription feels unreasonable and designed to trap customers into another billing period. I missed the cancellation deadline and, despite no longer wanting the service, was pursued for payment and even received a legal notice. In my opinion, this is an excessively aggressive approach to subscription management. A company offering such good software should not need to rely on restrictive contractual terms to retain revenue. It creates the impression that collecting money matters more than customer satisfaction or long-term relationships.

タイトル: BEWARE of Anydesk

Still waiting for confirmation that I have been unsubscribed, even yet.
改善点: That though I did appreciate the app when i used it a few years back. The experience of unsubscribing left me totally appalled at their complete indifference, rationale and integrity as a business.

タイトル: An essential tool that has transformed our customer support
投稿者: Jacopo イタリアのCEO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "An essential tool that has transformed our customer support"
良い点: The interface is intuitive and well-organised. No lengthy training required — everyone in the company uses it from day one without difficulty. Support has always been prompt and competent. Whenever we've needed assistance, issues have been resolved quickly without unnecessary delays.
改善点: The only area where we notice the trade-off of being an independent platform is in Google Workspace integration — it is functional but not as deeply embedded as we would ideally like.

タイトル: Great (new to us) product
投稿者: Scott アメリカのVP 写真, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Great (new to us) product"
良い点: LiveAgent has been great from the first time we reached out through onboarding. The simple interface makes for easy navigation and the integration with 2talk keeps emails and phone calls in the same place. Our team loves it! We have become more efficient since we started and are looking to add on additional features to improve our customer service even more. Their customer support is great. Whenever we have had a question they are quick to answer. Being able to assign and sort the tickets is simple and the value of the product you get is amazing. They could charge more, but we're so happy they don't.
改善点: I am not sure there was anything we didn't like, but we will keep you posted if we find anything worth reporting. ;)

タイトル: Liveagentden
投稿者: Denis カナダのCustomer service rep 運輸、トラック、鉄道, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Liveagentden"
良い点: Robust multi-channel ticket management and automation features. Good value compared to higher-priced competitors such as Zendesk and Intercom.
改善点: User interface can feel somewhat outdated compared to newer platforms. Some advanced features require higher-tier plans.

タイトル: Not nearly as robust as Freshdesk
投稿者: Alex カナダのPresident ホスピタリティ, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Not nearly as robust as Freshdesk"
良い点: It was well priced, although unfortunately the functionality is not great compared to Freshdesk, which we switched from. It has a few great features - one in particular is the ability to "postpone" a ticket until a certain date, but lacks many other.
改善点: It's a bit buggy, and some things are just plain stupid - eg, you can only have one window open at a time, which makes using 2 screens to compare notes from one ticket to another impossible, for instance. Several other things don't work well - it loses the connection very easily, sometimes causing a complete loss of what you were doing, and merging tickets is a pain compared to Freshdesk, where all you had to do was click on the tickets you wanted to merge and selecting "merge." Even closing a number of tickets at once in LiveAgent is painful, as it requires approving the step THREE times. I asked Customer Service to change that, but they think it's how it should be. In general, Freshdesk was a much more robust product and we are considering switching back to it at the end of our contract - which we asked to terminate shortly after onboarding but we were told we could not do. I believe a company should hold its customer because they provide great value, not because they are stuck in a contract.

タイトル: A Straightfoward Authoring Tool
投稿者: Rehjino Rence Matthew 日本のSenior Instructional Designer アウトソーシング、オフショア, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "A Straightfoward Authoring Tool"
良い点: I like how convenient it is to use, since it just sits right in the ppt ribbon. It feels really natural to work with, no steep learning curve, no complicated setup. It's pretty user-friendly and makes creating training content way easier and faster for me

タイトル: iSprin Suite - one stop shop
投稿者: Sonya アメリカのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 教育管理, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "iSprin Suite - one stop shop"

改善点: I would love some of the features to be "apply to all" as I'm creating learning tracks and setting languages. Don't get me wrong, it's still an amazing product

タイトル: iSpring supports my one-woman band operation
投稿者: Melissa アメリカのDirector 病院、ヘルスケア, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "iSpring supports my one-woman band operation"

It produces SCORM packages with capabilities very similar to Captivate, without the messiness I encountered with Captivate (It required much more technical knowledge, and the new version was not backward compatible, so I lost the ability to edit all of my old courses). Their customer support is quick and helpful, and it provides great value for the money for my one-person training department.
改善点: I did have to hunt pretty diligently to track down a few errors I initially encountered (my company did not want to use the cloud creation option, so all module creation needs to live on my hard drive while creating it). I was able to ultimately resolve those errors.

タイトル: Strong Concept, Let Down by Reliability Issues
投稿者: Edd 英国のPrincipal プロフェッショナル・トレーニング、コーチング, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Strong Concept, Let Down by Reliability Issues"

改善点: I have experienced repeated technical bugs and inconsistencies, particularly around project stability and publishing. These issues have at times disrupted workflow and required time-consuming troubleshooting. While support does respond, I have found the process slow and not always effective in resolving the root cause of the problems. In some cases, issues have reoccurred, which reduces confidence when working on larger or time-sensitive projects.

タイトル: Easy, intuitive, user friendly; even for the novice designer!

改善点: I do not dislike much about iSpring. I would like to see more interaction options, such as flash cards, or something more complex like simulations. We are currently in need of ways to get our learner to perform a process in an online course that immediately grades their performance, then offers feedback and branches to a specific part of the course based on their scores. We are currently using the hotspot interaction, but would like to see a more complex option.

Also, like that there is a reporting component built into the product so that as we configure new features we can also report on them. Also, it is beneficial in that it is translated/translatable so it can be used globally and also has a mobile interface so users can utilize it via a mobile device.

タイトル: Robust Search Capabilities and Document Automation
投稿者: Matthew アメリカのFounding Partner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 弁護士業界, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Robust Search Capabilities and Document Automation"
良い点: Clio's robust search field allows you to easily scan your existing legal universe to reference documents and information, and you can create templates easily to automate routine tasks. The pricing is in line with the industry, and for a solo or small business, it's actually a pretty modest expense.
改善点: The Personal Injury has module started off with exciting possibilities, but we are waiting and hoping for more Insurance-oriented updates and pre-built fields for that.

タイトル: Full Spectrum Operations Support
投稿者: Rendi アメリカのAttorney 弁護士業界, 自営業 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Full Spectrum Operations Support"
良い点: The integrated workflow across intake, case management, document drafting, and billing has been transformative for my practice. In seven months, Clio has significantly streamlined how I handle client intakes and document preparation. What used to be scattered across multiple systems now flows seamlessly in one place. Specifically, the document management and drafting features let me build and reuse templates efficiently, which has made my output faster and more consistent. Paired with the time tracking and case management tools, I can see the full picture of each matter from intake through invoicing without jumping between platforms. The time tracking integration with billing is particularly valuable; I'm capturing hours accurately as we work rather than reconstructing time logs later. It's made me more efficient and reduced the errors that come from manual data entry and disjointed systems.
改善点: It is expensive for a solo practitioner. Having to pay additional fees for each state's template library seems unnecessary. May attorneys are licensed in multiple jurisdictions.

タイトル: Good for billing, bad for migration.
投稿者: Jay アメリカのAttorney 法律サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Good for billing, bad for migration."
良い点: Clio document management and the billing and invoicing is easy to use and is helpful. The email reminders have already brought up some old AR that was unrecognized, and started bringing it in.
改善点: THe data integration was a mess. It still is. I signed up in October, migrated end of December, and in mid February cannot get an accurate report for the fees earned in January. I have called and spoke with multiple people, and none are able to help. I asked to generate one report - and Clio is unable to generate the one report after the migration - how much revenue did my attorneys actually bring in based upon the hours they worked. Clio does not migrate this data. Despite me saying this is the one report I want, and being reassured I could get it. When they could not generate it, they just told me to hire an outside consultant. They are evaluating an offset of my fees, but no promises, and no solutions as of yet.

タイトル: Reviewing Clio
投稿者: Bhawna カナダのTech support 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Reviewing Clio"
良い点: Clio is easy to use and provides helpful tools for managing cases, documents, contacts, billing, and legal workflows. It keeps important information organized in one place and makes collaboration and case management more efficient.
改善点: Some advanced features can take time to learn, and certain customization options could be improved. The overall cost may also be higher for smaller firms or teams.

タイトル: Solid, future focused platform!
投稿者: Megan アメリカのCOO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 弁護士業界, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Solid, future focused platform!"
良い点: From my perspective, Clio has been a really solid platform for managing a modern law firm. One of the biggest positives is that it is fairly easy to use compared to a lot of other legal software. It brings together calendaring, matter management, billing, documents, client communication, payments, and workflows all in one place, which helps create more consistency across the firm and a better experience for clients. It has also been helpful from an operational standpoint because the cloud-based setup makes remote work and accessibility much easier. Without Clio we would have had a really difficult time navigating the Covid years. I also think Clio does a good job with integrations. It connects with a lot of the other tools firms already use, which helps avoid having everything live in separate systems. The client-facing features like payment links, portals, and scheduling tools also make things feel more streamlined and professional for clients.
改善点: A few frustrations - like most platforms, it is geared toward firms that bill by the hour and we do not. Reporting is one of the weaker areas, especially if you want detailed operational data or more customized tracking. As the firm grows, you also start to notice that some workflows feel a little rigid, and there are times where you have to adjust your process to fit the system. Costs can also add up quickly once you start adding users, integrations, and additional features. Also, our initial migration did not go well, but Clio bent over backwards to remedy the situation which we greatly appreciated.

タイトル: Wave is free but has limited customer support
投稿者: Tim アメリカのPartner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 小売, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Wave is free but has limited customer support"

Wave went silent for weeks, only resolve was to email the company and those went unanswered. Had to turn to Redditt for workarounds, worst part was Wave never took responsibility for their mistake, switched to another provider which I pay for but willing to do so after my experience with Wave.

タイトル: A very sensible way to automate at least parts of the tedious accounting.
投稿者: Kalvin アメリカのInventory Analyst エンタテインメント, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A very sensible way to automate at least parts of the tedious accounting."
良い点: I want to express my enthusiasm for Wave. It's an incredibly useful tool that offers me numerous advantages. First of all, I can store and manage all my invoice information in one place - which has significantly simplified managing invoice records! I can even receive automatic notification reminders when payment deadlines are approaching or have been missed - so I'm always on top of things. Furthermore, I have access to detailed reporting tools for monitoring finances as well as real-time updates on the status of each transaction. This tool makes it easy for me to keep everything under control and saves me time. Considering these fantastic features, I'm so glad Wave exists and I'm already looking forward to further improvements in the future!
改善点: One of the biggest weaknesses is the user interface, as it is neither intuitive nor user-friendly. Furthermore, it lacks features such as automatic reporting functions for invoice information.

タイトル: LiveChat + HelpDesk - take a chat and summarize it into a ticket, perfect!

タイトル: Outstanding Company and Service

タイトル: I'm not sure about the hype
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 非営利団体運営, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "I'm not sure about the hype"
良い点: It reminds me of the tech-solution optimism of the early aughts. It is "user-friendly" and offers a lot support. All of the compliments towards DonorPerfect (DP) are true. You can set up online donation forms to receive donations and DP has a native processing gateway to process that.
改善点: You can find a lot of out-of-the-box-plug-and-play database apps on the market today such as Notion, Airtable, etc. If you have any experience using those or learning about databases, nothing about DP makes sense. I just want to see "what is the latest donation?" "show me the last 5 donations" and I cannot get that answer immediately. It takes at least 8 clicks (Reports > Report Center > choose report > four clicks to set period > hit Run Report) and a little time drinking coffee before you can see the answer. DP is user-friendly in that, it has its own language and logic about where any information or feature is. A new user who's less tech literate will have to learn this, and yes there ARE resources, webinars, on-demand webinars, help articles, support chats, all available for you to fully master DonorPerfect. I am not sure how much of what you learn could be applied outside of DP. An impatient user familiar with databases will throw up their hands immediately just like I did.
