タイトル: Simple, reliable e-signatures for client agreements
投稿者: Jerrid アメリカのCEO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 自営業 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Simple, reliable e-signatures for client agreements"
良い点: What I like most about Dropbox Sign is how easy it is to get documents sent, reviewed, and signed without creating extra work for my clients. As a solo Product Management consultant, I often need signatures on proposals, statements of work, agreements, and other client-facing documents. Dropbox Sign makes that process feel professional and simple. The signing experience is straightforward for clients, which reduces the amount of explanation or follow-up I need to provide. I also like the status tracking because it helps me quickly see whether a document is still pending, viewed, or completed, so I can follow up at the right time without digging through email threads.
改善点: What I like least is that the pricing can feel a little high if you only need to send documents for signature occasionally. For a solo consultant or small business, the value depends a lot on how frequently you use it. I also think the template and document setup workflow could be smoother. When I am reusing similar agreements or statements of work for different clients, I would like the process of updating fields, preparing templates, and making small changes to feel a bit faster and more flexible

タイトル: Keeps client document signing simple and organized
投稿者: Chris U. カナダのBookkeeper and Administrative Support in Canada 経理, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Keeps client document signing simple and organized"
良い点: Before using Dropbox Sign, I handled documents through email and PDFs, sometimes asking clients to sign and send them back. It worked at first, but as the number of clients grew, it became harder to keep everything organized. After I started using it, the process felt more contained in one flow. For example, when sending onboarding documents like engagement letters, service agreements, or simple confirmations, I can upload the file, place signature fields, and send it out without breaking the process into multiple steps. It noticeably reduced the time spent handling documents. One thing I didn’t expect was how much it reduced follow-ups. I can see whether a document has been opened or is still pending, so I don’t have to check in as often. During busy periods, this makes a real difference. From the client side, things have been smooth. They can open the link from email and sign right away without creating an account, so I rarely need to explain anything. This has been especially helpful when working with clients who are not very familiar with these tools. Since I already use Dropbox, document handling also feels more connected. I can take existing files, send them for signature, and keep everything organized in the same place afterward. Over time, it’s been easier to keep track of signed agreements and documents. It also made things move a bit faster overall. Without printing or scanning, documents are often completed much sooner.
改善点: There are still some limitations depending on the situation. For example, when a document needs to be reviewed and signed by multiple people in a specific order, or when the next step depends on a previous approval, the setup can feel a bit limited. In some cases, I’ve had to send documents in separate steps manually, which adds extra work. Managing repeated documents could also be smoother. When sending similar agreements to different clients, some parts of the setup still need to be checked or adjusted each time, which can add up over time. Cost was also something I had to consider, especially coming from a free workflow. If it’s only used occasionally, it may not feel necessary. But once I started using it more regularly, the time it saved made it feel worth it.

タイトル: Gmass: My favorite Gmail Mail Merge Tool
投稿者: Matt アメリカのCEO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー マーケティング、広告, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Gmass: My favorite Gmail Mail Merge Tool"
良い点: I’ve tested dozens of email platforms…but GMass is the one I keep coming back to. Here’s why: Daily Consistency I use GMass to send 10–20 outreach emails per day. It’s a daily habit that keeps networking warm and partnerships flowing. Instead of mass blasts that feel cold, this approach helps build actual relationships. Affiliate Program Power When we run large-scale affiliate launches, we use GMass to communicate with thousands of partners. We can personalize updates, send reminders, and deliver swipe copy…all without switching tools or compromising quality. Personalized at Scale Merge fields from Google Sheets allow us to reference names, URLs, stats, or past interactions. So even a 2,000-person campaign feels like it was written individually. The recipient doesn’t feel like a number. Batch Sending + Scheduling GMass lets you space out your email delivery. That means better inbox placement and lower chances of hitting Gmail’s spam filters. It also spreads out responses so you’re not flooded all at once. Powerful Reporting The built-in analytics tell us who opened, who clicked, who replied, who bounced, and who unsubscribed. It’s actionable, fast, and doesn’t require extra integrations. Google Sheets Integration This is a game changer. Link your Sheet once, and GMass reads all the data dynamically. Want to update a name or tweak a message mid-campaign? Just edit the Sheet. No re-importing needed. Email Verification GMass verifies email addresses before you send…so you’re not
改善点: There’s a learning curve The interface is simple, but it does take a few days to fully grasp how to use Sheets, merge tags, and campaign scheduling. Thankfully, the GMass blog and help docs are solid. Once you’re in the flow, it’s second nature. It’s not the cheapest option At $25/month, GMass might seem expensive compared to some email tools. But considering the features, flexibility, and Gmail-native experience, it more than pays for itself. Especially when you factor in saved time and increased deliverability. Test your emails first Always add yourself to the Sheet and run a real test. Occasionally, merge fields don’t populate as expected…not often, but often enough that you’ll be glad you checked. It’s a quick fix that avoids awkward sends. These are minor trade-offs considering how powerful GMass is…but they’re worth knowing before you dive in.

改善点: I've had recurring, shady issues with Expensify’s billing system, and after my latest experience, I can’t recommend this platform. I never canceled my personal subscription, yet it was automatically canceled due to a failed credit card charge—without any notification that my card had declined. Somehow, my new credit card (which I never manually updated) was mysteriously applied to a Group account I never created or authorized—and I started getting charged $10/month for it. Expensify’s billing system is confusing, opaque, and borderline deceptive. There was no email or notification when my new card was added, no transparency about how this happened, and no easy way to fix it. Given that I travel frequently, I expect clear, upfront billing—instead, I keep running into unauthorized charges and a lack of accountability. If you’re considering Expensify, be extremely cautious about their billing practices. They make it way too easy for unexplained charges to show up, and their lack of transparency is concerning. I highly recommend looking for a more reliable alternative. 🚨

タイトル: A costly trap for small business owners – Stay away from GoDaddy Airo
投稿者: Paola アメリカのCEO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー Eラーニング, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "A costly trap for small business owners – Stay away from GoDaddy Airo"
良い点: It's easy to use and a friendly platform, and easy to implement when you first get a website as a brand new website designer.
改善点: As a brand-new, first-time business owner, I trusted GoDaddy’s Airo website builder to help launch my enterprise (Chaos to Calm Pets). Unfortunately, it turned into an absolute nightmare and a massive financial drain. The AI builder frequently claims it has completed complex multi-step tasks (like building course catalogs), only to leave behind broken pages, missing routes, and 404 errors. Worse, it executes unapproved batch updates that consume hundreds of "credits"—which you have to pay real money for—while completely wiping out your content and replacing it with incorrect data or fabricated images. When confronted with its own failures in the chat log, the AI literally admits it "lied" or wasted credits, but GoDaddy support refuses to issue refunds or restore credits. It feels deliberately designed to frustrate users into spending more and more money just to fix errors the AI itself created. Save your sanity, your time, and your hard-earned money and use a traditional, stable website platform instead.

The monthly summary has become the most reliable business document I have. My conversations with my accountant are now half the length they used to be — they get clean, consistent numbers without me having to prepare anything separately.

タイトル: Cross mapped our properties, sent a guest into an occupied unit
投稿者: Mohammed アメリカのOwner ホスピタリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Cross mapped our properties, sent a guest into an occupied unit"

改善点: We manage short term rentals across Airbnb, Vrbo, and Booking.com. Our Vrbo integration was not activated for weeks after onboarding, which caused double bookings. When it went live, our two properties were cross mapped to the wrong Vrbo listings, so every Vrbo reservation landed on the wrong unit. Because the correct unit's calendar never blocked, a guest walked into an occupied condo at 10 PM on another guest. That resulted in a refund, cancelled reservations, channel penalties, a restricted Vrbo listing, and legal threats. Support replied slowly, told us the mapping was a self service process, and stated there was no indication of financial loss while we were refunding money and cancelling bookings.

良い点: I've used Zenoti for a couple months at the spa where I work. It's nice to be able to use the desktop version when at work and still be able to see my client schedule and client forms on the mobile app from home. There are also a lot of features that make it clear and easy to use, and to customize different codes or icons so that with just a quick glance I can see if I client is new, is an existing member, and some of the specifics for their service booking.
改善点: There seems to be some issues with integration between the desktop version and the mobile version. When at the spa on the desktop which is hard wired to internal servers within the location, on sporadically for random clients I'm not able to load the profile information, yet for the same client/appointent I am able to open it from a mobile device that is on the same server wifi. The GM has reviewed all of the permission settings as well as contacted our customer support and there doesn't seem to be a consistent reason or "fix". Additionally the mobile app is really glitchy both from my home wifi and on the spa wifi connection. The screen windows sometimes come up out of view, for example when opening my client schedule for the day only 1/4 of the schedule "window" is viewable to the far right of my screen and the rest is cut off with no ability to scroll or swipe over. Usually after I switch calendar/schedule layout views a couple times then it will come up like it's supposed to. Also, the mobile app takes a really long time to process when trying to open client profiles and forms which is very frustrating when on a tight client schedule.

投稿者: Latasha アメリカのMedical Office Manager 病院、ヘルスケア, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Medical Office Manager"
良い点: Our organization uses NextGen Healthcare EHR for our primary care clinics. Through NextGen Healthcare EHR, our organization is able to order medications, document patient charts, manage appointments, and process billing and coding for medical claims. The system helps address several key business and operational needs within our clinics, including: * Billing and coding primary care claims * Managing patient appointments and scheduling * Maintaining electronic medical records and chart documentation * Ordering medications and managing prescriptions * Improving workflow efficiency and patient care coordination Overall, the platform supports the day-to-day clinical and administrative operations of our primary care services.
改善点: One issue we have experienced with the system is that appointments cannot always be fully deleted when necessary and instead must be marked as canceled. This limitation has resulted in a higher number of canceled appointments appearing within the system, which can impact scheduling reports and appointment tracking accuracy.

タイトル: NextGen Office Review for an integrated care model
投稿者: Nicole アメリカのCounseling with Care Office Manager 病院、ヘルスケア, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "NextGen Office Review for an integrated care model"
良い点: Fairly simple system to use. It does well with integrating our two offices. It allows both sides to access the other side, as well as providing patients a continuity of care between the two offices.
改善点: All updates seem to make the entire system crash in some way. When this happens it seems to us that the help desk has no idea how to assist with the problem, as we can not run either office without our EMR running correctly.

タイトル: Working on CEIPAL is a fantastic experience, and while working on CEIPAL, job has been simpler.
投稿者: Bruce インドのRecruitment Professional 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 人材派遣、人材紹介, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Working on CEIPAL is a fantastic experience, and while working on CEIPAL, job has been simpler."
良い点: Ceipal's Integrated Search has made things easier for me because I now have access to all of the job sites I use, and recruitment has been a breeze since I started using it. Working has been an amazing experience.
改善点: Backend issues with CEIPAL, such as difficulty opening resumes and errors while moving resumes, are considerable. I experienced this a few days ago, and there is occasionally a lag when loading resumes.

タイトル: Ciepal All-in-One best way for Recruitment Success.
投稿者: Arpit インドのIT Consultant 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Ciepal All-in-One best way for Recruitment Success."
良い点: Ciepal ATS is a handy applicant tracking system. It has all the integrated job portals, which are useful for finding the best talent globally.
改善点: it has problems finding resumes from the internal database for the particular locations.

タイトル: What I imagine being stuck in a labyrinth would feel like
投稿者: Tiffany アメリカのSite Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 人材派遣、人材紹介, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "What I imagine being stuck in a labyrinth would feel like"
良い点: There are a lot of filter options the user dashboard, and the cards are somewhat customizable. The most useful feature is it's ability to integrate sourcing sites like Dice, Monster and CareerBuilder directly into Ceipal's platform. Does a decent job of populating work authorization statuses for candidates (mostly due to its integration with Dice).
改善点: Where to begin...this is the most convoluted platform I have ever seen, no exaggeration. There is no way any team, no matter the size, could possibly utilize every piece of Ceipal, which is true of a lot of ATS, but this one is overwhelming to the nth degree. Parsing a resume takes a long time to load because the data entry page has about 150 blanks you can fill in (obviously not all are required, but it is a LOT to sift through regardless). You cannot reassign ownership of old candidates at the user level, must be done by an admin. Email tracking is spotty at best, at least with Gmail. Mobile app does not work at all, I have not once been able to successfully log into it (keeps telling me wrong password, and I know it isn't), and there isn't a responsive version of the system you can access on a mobile device's browser. I'm just going to stop there.

タイトル: My review on Ceipal ATS platform
投稿者: Satish インドのUS IT Recruiter 人材派遣、人材紹介, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "My review on Ceipal ATS platform"
良い点: user friendly dashboard and interface, once logged in there you can see the dashboard with pie chart for the submissions of profiles you make and list of interviewed candidates placed candidates and so on, then you can find the integrated search where you can use job boards like carrier builder, monster and dice apply the boolean and start searching profiles all the profiles are shown in algorithm with ranking system helps me to find the qualified candidate easily and can send inmail via ceipal and mail merge upto 999 which is very helpful when there a common requirement like java, python with mail merge and through responses getting the profile is very easy they'll check the JD and respond back submitting the qualified candidates to the client and getting interviews and placements through ceipal qualified candidates
改善点: there is an lot of empty profiles from dice, carrier builder and monster like there won't be any contact number or email, the resume would look good but won't able to find contact details which sometimes frustrating

タイトル: Helpful Tool for Managing Candidates
投稿者: Vivek インドのHR Manager 人材派遣、人材紹介, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Helpful Tool for Managing Candidates"
良い点: I liked that CEIPAL ATS is easy to use and helps save time. It made it simple to find and manage candidate information, and I liked how it connected with LinkedIn and job boards. It also helped keep everything organized and accurate
改善点: Sometimes, CEIPAL ATS can be a bit slow when loading large amounts of data. Also, some features take time to learn at first. But once you get used to it, it works well.

タイトル: Ultimate IDE for productivity
投稿者: Ekpono 英国のSoftware Engineer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 翻訳、ローカライゼーション, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Ultimate IDE for productivity"
良い点: I use Webstorm and Phpstorm and they are literally the best IDE I have ever used. The code intelligence and autocompletion is actually the best in the industry. Code navigation, plugins to get extra figures, database management right inside the IDE, terminal support, notification on portal bugs, code extraction and refactoring into a different file or method. The list of endless. Every subscription payment is worth it.
改善点: Phpstorm needs RAM and high CPU. Also, it takes a little time for indexing to kick in. The customization and settings needed to tailor the IDE to your unique taste and preference acquire a little curve.

タイトル: Excellent IDE for Java Development and Enterprise Projects
投稿者: Adinath インドのSoftware Engineer 情報技術、情報サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Excellent IDE for Java Development and Enterprise Projects"
良い点: IntelliJ IDEA significantly improves productivity with its intelligent code completion, powerful refactoring tools, excellent debugging capabilities, and seamless integration with build tools like Maven and Gradle. It provides a smooth development experience for Java and Spring Boot applications.
改善点: The IDE can be resource-intensive, especially on systems with limited RAM. Some advanced features are available only in the Ultimate edition, which may be costly for individual developers.

タイトル: Intuitive, reliable, and perfect for startups

改善点: Honestly, nothing stands out as a negative. In the past, the pricing was a bit high for startups, especially since we weren’t using all the features, but their new pricing is much more startup- and small team–friendly.

タイトル: Fast, reliable and great for everyday creative work
投稿者: Furkan トルコのLead Designer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー デザイン, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Fast, reliable and great for everyday creative work"
良い点: What I like most about Adobe Express is how quickly I can create something that still looks professional. I mainly use it for social media content, quick client visuals, simple presentations and short video edits. The templates are useful without feeling too restrictive, and being able to resize and adapt the same design for different platforms saves a lot of time. I also like that it works well with the rest of the Adobe ecosystem. For quick design creation, it gives me most of the features I need without having to open Photoshop or Illustrator for every small task. For the amount of time it saves, I think the subscription offers very good value for money.
改善点: For more detailed design or video editing I still need to move to Photoshop, Illustrator or Premiere. Some of the advanced controls are naturally more limited in Express. I would also like to see a little more flexibility in some templates and animation options, but these are minor limitations for the type of work I use it for.

タイトル: Tired of being let down. Try Adobe! Adobe does it ALL!
投稿者: Book アメリカのPhoto stenographer コンピュータ・ハードウェア, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Tired of being let down. Try Adobe! Adobe does it ALL!"
良い点: To be honest, the subscription itself is so self explanatory when it comes to video editing and design creation that customer support is or security is not even needed when using this program. The features are top notch and the value for money is better than most.
改善点: I truly have no complaints about adobe Express, as this program put other similar programs to shame due to the newly updated add ons.

タイトル: Great potential but not there yet
投稿者: Anna 英国のOwner, designer and webdesigner グラフィックデザイン, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Great potential but not there yet"

タイトル: Adobe Express: Professional Design, Zero Learning Curve
投稿者: Bruno イタリアのMarketing Executive Intern 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 自動車, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Adobe Express: Professional Design, Zero Learning Curve"
良い点: In the past, I had used Adobe Express as a Marketing Executive Intern at Hackett & Hackett International Group Limited. My experience with this platform was good for various reasons, which include having an excellent Creative Cloud Integration helpful when creating logos, vectors, and graphics. Moreover, Adobe Express has compatibility with most file formats in the market, which is perfect for individuals working on different computers and operating systems. It also has an amazing Generative AI Engine with great potential. It boasts of being dependent on 20,000 fonts and access to millions of stock photos.
改善点: However, I identify some weaknesses with this powerful platform. Initially, it lacks CMYK colours and only works with RGB. It also has a limitation in terms of Vector Editing. Additionally, it lacks advanced typography controls, and it does not have professional Colour grading and Effects. Furthermore, Adobe Express has a lightweight timeline, and its Video editor is not professional. It also has limited Monthly Generations of Text-to-Image and Generative Fill options. Finally, to access all the features, one may need to purchase more credit packs.

タイトル: Easy design tool for quick content

良い点: I like how easy it is for design creation. It offers good features for quick graphics and basic video editing.
改善点: Some features are limited unless you pay for a subscription. Customization options are not very advanced, and the interface is not enough friendly compared with others.

タイトル: Very Easy To Use

良い点: GitLab is very easy to use and it has everything I need for software development. I can manage my code, collaborate with my colleagues, and automate my workflow
改善点: Nothing really bad, except it can be a bit slow sometimes. But overall, it's a great tool for developers!

タイトル: One of the best comprehensive platforms for controlled, collaborative development
投稿者: Adam 英国のSenior Technical Writer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 5,001～10,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "One of the best comprehensive platforms for controlled, collaborative development"
良い点: The branching and merge-request workflow is particularly valuable. Changes can be developed independently, reviewed by colleagues and validated before they are incorporated into the main branch. This reduces the risk of uncontrolled updates and provides a clear history of what changed, why it changed and who approved it. The integrated CI/CD capabilities are another strength, as builds, tests and other checks can run automatically when changes are submitted.
改善点: GitLab includes a very broad range of features, which can make the interface feel crowded for occasional users. Finding specific repository, pipeline or permission settings is not always intuitive. Configuring more advanced pipelines can also require significant knowledge of YAML and GitLab’s configuration model. Some useful security, reporting and governance capabilities are restricted to higher subscription tiers. The learning curve seems sharp.

タイトル: A powerful DevOps powerhouse with a dense but complete interface
投稿者: Enguerran フランスのFullstack Web Developer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー スポーツ用品, 5,001～10,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A powerful DevOps powerhouse with a dense but complete interface"
良い点: GitLab has this biggest edge, like it really leans into a full, everything-in-one DevOps platform kind of approach. You get source code management, issue tracking, and CI/CD pipelines that are built in, all tied together inside one single interface, and yeah it feels like a huge productivity push. Setting up pipeline stuff through .gitlab-ci.yml is pretty direct, plus the native Container Registry makes it genuinely easy to roll out Docker images, especially during our day to day development sprints.
改善点: The user interface can feel kind of overwhelming and cluttered, especially when you’re trying to move through those deeply nested settings or while reviewing a complex Merge Request. For non-technical folks, like Product Owners who are tracking issues day to day the initial learning curve is pretty steep. On top of that, the self-hosted instance can get resource-heavy and it tends to need regular maintenance so runner performances stay optimal or at least not degrade to much.

タイトル: GitLab pipelines and merge requests accelerate team software delivery
投稿者: Conann スペインのSoftware Engineer コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "GitLab pipelines and merge requests accelerate team software delivery"
良い点: Configuring .gitlab-ci.yml pipelines accelerates build and development across services. Integrated code editing in the Web IDE and clear task tracking on issue boards keep merge requests organized.
改善点: Self-hosted runner daemon timeouts occasionally block merge queues, causing transient pipeline bugs and issues that require manual job retries.

タイトル: User interface is too old
投稿者: Ahliman フランスのFull-Stack Developer インターネット, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "User interface is too old"
良い点: I started using GitLab because private repositories were free. I've been using it less since private repositories became free on GitHub as well, but it remains a great tool. A large part of its features are sufficient in the free plan.
改善点: I hate GitLab's interface; it's just my personal opinion, but nothing feels intuitive. They use Cloudflare protection everywhere, the colors, etc., make it look like an old-school Microsoft application. Plus, it’s much less popular than GitHub in terms of open-source projects and community activity.

タイトル: Zoho Expense, a great tool for my small business.

改善点: I don't like that I can not easily enter small towns or cities as the destination for per diem expenses. I have to determine the nearest large city that that is included in Zoho's list of destinations. I know I can create new destinations, but I am not going through that process for every small town I travel to.

タイトル: Trustpilot’s Business Model Feels Like a Trap
投稿者: Erik ノルウェーのEcommerce and CRM Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 小売, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 ソース：GetApp 共有 "Trustpilot’s Business Model Feels Like a Trap"
良い点: Trustpilot’s platform is well-known, and having customer reviews in one place can be useful for businesses. The integration options are solid, and the basic functionality does what it promises.
改善点: Trustpilot’s aggressive renewal tactics and lack of transparency make them a risky partner for any business. They enforce automatic renewals at drastically increased prices without clear consent, and their support team does little to resolve disputes fairly. Instead of prioritizing customer relationships, they seem focused on locking businesses into overpriced contracts with little room for negotiation.

タイトル: A Well‑Known Review Platform That Supports Transparency
投稿者: Radha カナダのLegal Assistant 法律サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "A Well‑Known Review Platform That Supports Transparency"
良い点: What I liked most about Trustpilot was its transparency and credibility as a review platform. It provides a trusted space for customers to share genuine feedback while helping businesses understand their reputation and identify areas for improvement. I also appreciated how easy it is to collect, manage, and respond to reviews, as well as the visibility Trustpilot offers to build consumer trust and brand credibility.
改善点: What I liked least about Trustpilot was the limited control businesses have over negative or misleading reviews. While transparency is important, disputing or removing reviews that appear inaccurate or unfair can be challenging and time‑consuming. Additionally, some of the more useful features—such as advanced analytics, customization, and review management tools—are locked behind paid plans, which can make the platform feel somewhat pay‑to‑play for businesses trying to actively manage their reputation.

タイトル: Marketing 360

It can also be more expensive than using separate, simpler tools, which might not be ideal for small businesses with tight budgets. Overall, while it’s powerful, it may feel like more than you need and take time to fully understand.

It drastically reduces the amount of time we spend jumping between separate software applications to run our daily marketing operations.
改善点: Another exceptional feature of Marketing 360 is its robust performance tracking capability. The deeper analytics and reporting functions give our business clear, actionable insights into exactly where our ad spend is working best and which campaigns are driving conversions. This highly organized approach to marketing data management ensures we never lose track of customer leads or historical performance trends. タイトル: Homebase- Great Scheduling System and Payroll Integration for Small Businesses.

タイトル: A Powerful (Albeit Flawed) Tool for the Enterprise
投稿者: Taylor アメリカのDigital Marketing Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 非営利団体運営, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A Powerful (Albeit Flawed) Tool for the Enterprise"

タイトル: My Buddy Punch Experience
投稿者: Andre アメリカのSupervisor 高等教育, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "My Buddy Punch Experience"
良い点: What I appreciated most about Buddy Punch was its user-friendly interface and overall reliability in tracking staff time and attendance. The system made it easy for employees to clock in and out using mobile devices or desktops, which was especially helpful for staff who worked across multiple buildings or shifts. The GPS and location verification features added an extra layer of accountability, ensuring staff were clocking in from approved locations. I also liked the reporting tools, which allowed supervisors to quickly review hours worked, overtime, and patterns of attendance. This streamlined payroll preparation and reduced the need for manual corrections. Overall, Buddy Punch improved organization, accuracy, and transparency within scheduling and time management processes.
改善点: One of the main drawbacks of Buddy Punch was occasional technical issues, such as slow loading times or difficulty clocking in during periods of poor internet connectivity. This sometimes caused frustration for staff who needed to clock in quickly, particularly during shift changes or emergency situations. Additionally, while the system offers many features, some of them were not very intuitive at first and required extra training for staff to use properly. The mobile app could also benefit from smoother navigation and clearer notifications.

There are several modules in Planning Center, which allows users to pick and choose what they desire to utilize the program for, including donations, emails, CRM database + member management, scheduling events (including volunteer schedule/event timeline and room/resource requests), and event registration for attendees. They have great customer support, providing timely answers to specific questions, as well as a database of videos and articles on specific topics. There is even an app for the admin-side of the program, as well as an app for the customer-side (event signup, etc.). It's primarily designed for churches, although I'm sure other non-profits could utilize it as well. When a user understands the options available, it can be a powerful program in comparison to the monthly cost. When compared with other programs, Planning Center seems to have great value for the cost, with the abilities it includes. It's also great because users can customize which level they want for each module of Planning Center, giving a greater ability to cut back on potential product costs.
改善点: Sometimes specific features aren't available that I would like. They are open to feedback for future updates, but don't always incorporate feedback. For instance, I've asked about including a "signature" feature on their forms (for parental consent, for example), but the still haven't updated for this feature. Also, while the cost is not unreasonable, each module only has specific levels available for each cost. Moving from the each level seems to have a large increase in capacity (i.e. number of attendees allowed) and somewhat high jump in cost. For instance, the Registration Module allows for 150 registrants at $69/month, but then jumps to 400 registrants at $115/month. It would be helpful to have more options in-between 150 and 400.

タイトル: Solid choice for AWS-native storage and Terraform backends
投稿者: Bibhishan インドのDevOps Engineer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Solid choice for AWS-native storage and Terraform backends"
良い点: The reliability and simplicity of the core service stand out most. Whether I'm storing application data, build artifacts, or Terraform state, S3 just works consistently without needing constant babysitting. The integration with the rest of the AWS ecosystem is seamless too — IAM policies for access control, encryption options, and native Terraform backend support mean it fits naturally into an existing AWS-based infrastructure without needing a separate storage solution or vendor.
改善点: Versioning and lifecycle rule management is more cumbersome than it should be. When we enabled versioning on the bucket holding our Terraform state (to protect against accidental state corruption or bad applies), managing the lifecycle rules to clean up old versions without accidentally deleting something we needed took more trial and error than expected.

It provides a platform that, using extended functionality (APIs, SSH, web console, etc) provides a plethora of various mediums for interfacing with files (or, 'objects') in this respect. Being part of the AWS platform means that there is almost infinite redundancy, functionality for global regional accessibility, and many more other admin settings/configs that can expand on the baseline service.
改善点: As with all AWS services; nothing is as straight forward as they would have you believe from the name ("Simple" storage solution is perhaps an exaggeration). Dependencies can/do include additional configurations such as region locking (Unless you want to get fancy with advanced settings and integrating other services); IAM permissions and access keys for access (How you configure this really is use case dependent); etc - Also worth mentioning that unless you are already familiar with AWS and their suite, expect to spend a good few hours going through and navigating the platform to understand the interconnectivity between functions and services. A final note to mention that trying to specifically find an easy readable guide on best practices is a bit like finding a needle in a haystack - difficult and likely to be difficult to extrapolate for your use case (especially when integrating it with more AWS solutions).

I'm still newer to this app, but I can already clearly see how supportive, helpful (many happy to provide tips, tricks, and advice!), encouraging, inspiring.. and generously KIND all around! Second, I find it extremely helpful and generous (especially while on a VERY tight budget!) that Fotor gives easy ways to earn free credits DAILY, and so it IS possible to use this app completely freely (THOUGH I'd love to fully subscribe as soon as my funds allow)! They have encouraged me to try new types and styles of images, have provided inspiration to "think outside the box", and are perfect during times of "artist's block", when we may feel "stuck" on what ideas/concepts to try NEXT! These challenges gives opportunities to step outside EACH of our go-to concepts, themes, styles, elements, and etc! (And the lucky handful of winners for each get wonderful rewards, too!)
改善点: I chose a rating of 4 stars, rather than 3, as the PROS outweighed the CONS, but I definitely feel this app is BEST FOR VIDEO CREATION (in which I do not feel ready to learn quite yet... and the credits needed would take time to save up without a real subscription), while it has definitely caused me some frustration in generating IMAGES. (Since I haven't yet had the chance or funds to try the Video Generation Features yet, I can only speak of IMAGE GENERATION!) First, I feel there are a lot less features for IMAGE generations. Second, it seems Fotor has it's own special ways to create prompts, which takes some time to learn. (So, it seems more difficult to use than many other Text-To-Image apps, BUT, for someone who has had more time to experiment with Fotor, this "con" may actually turn into a "pro"?! I guess I shall see...! Third, I've found myself frustrated with creating prompts to generate anything close to what I envision. (I will use the EXACT SAME PROMPT with a few other Text-To-Image apps, and most of the other apps will generate images MUCH closer to what I was hoping for, and one in particular will EXCEED what I had hoped for, capturing my vision FURTHER than my expectations! BUT, with Fotor, I find myself stuck on the same idea for days at a time, trying to change my prompt to slowly inch closer and closer to what I'm hoping for.. and, many times, eventually "settling" for one I feel is "halfway there", feeling the need to "settle", give up, and move on to my next

タイトル: Vimeo: Flawless Playback. Zero Compression Compromise.
投稿者: Bruno イタリアのMarketing Executive Intern 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 自動車, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Vimeo: Flawless Playback. Zero Compression Compromise."
良い点: When working as a Marketing Executive Intern for Hackett & Hackett International Group Limited, I had the opportunity to use this product. I like it for several reasons, such as the fact that it is intended to be a professional workspace and not just another tool to share and publish videos. It also offers excellent options for higher bitrate and less aggressive compression than similar products, as well as the absence of Compression Artifacts. In this regard, it is optimal for filmmakers, motion designers, and videographers who want to publish their work without any loss in quality.
改善点: However, the software has some significant disadvantages, such as a lack of a Recommendation Engine and Algorithmic Distribution. Simply put, if someone wants to host a video on it, they need to promote it and drive traffic to it themselves, as there are no tools for increasing visibility apart from one’s own website and social media. Furthermore, to access essential business features, one needs to subscribe to a higher-tier plan on a monthly or yearly basis, as the lower ones only allow uploading a few videos per month. Finally, one might encounter an issue when trying to embed a lot of videos on one’s website. It may result in limiting one’s account and being forced to subscribe to a more expensive custom plan for an enterprise-level bitrate and traffic.

タイトル: While useful to our design and build clientele, the QuickBooks syncing means actual reconciling on our part
投稿者: Eri アメリカのFounder 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 経理, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "While useful to our design and build clientele, the QuickBooks syncing means actual reconciling on our part"
良い点: In terms of accounting, the most valuable feature of the Houzz Pro service is the fact that our clients' billing and payments, along with the project finances, are all organized in one system rather than residing in individual documents or scattered spreadsheets. Assuming that everything works properly when syncing with QuickBooks, then there is sufficient information coming through for us to be able to recognize transactions rather than having to recreate them. Payments and approvals from the client side are managed through one portal, thus making it easier for us to follow the trail of any deposits or milestone payments down to the signed contract. Our small design and remodel clients have found it much simpler to keep track of finances with time and billing managed together.
改善点: Syncing QuickBooks remains the issue at hand. It seems the new iteration of the platform brings with it issues of transactions being uploaded incorrectly, creating a tedious process of reconciling line by line, not knowing whether the fault lies with us or with QuickBooks. Another hindrance lies with the method of paying: fees incurred from using ACH payments, coupled with the maximum fee charged on each project, can cause a large project for our clients to be broken into smaller parts that may create problems when matching the deposit to the invoice at month end. Expenses tracking within the application does not offer much help, making it difficult for clients requiring job costing services. Pricing is an issue we have to deal with often.

The software gives you professional-level tools for video creation, live streaming, and screen recording without forcing you into a paid subscription. We use for example for internal work events and stream it using Webex or Zoom. The ability to create multiple scenes, add overlays, manage different audio sources, and customize layouts makes it very flexible. I especially like the screen capture features because I can record tutorials, gameplay, presentations, or demonstrations with good quality and control. The performance is also impressive because it can handle high-resolution recording and streaming without using too many system resources when configured correctly. The community support is another strong point, with many plugins, guides, and tutorials available. OBS Studio also provides good control over privacy and security because everything runs locally on your computer, giving users more confidence over their recordings.
改善点: The biggest downside of OBS Studio is that it can feel overwhelming for new users. When opening the software for the first time, there are many settings, panels, and options that can be confusing without prior experience. The setup process for audio devices, streaming platforms, and advanced recording settings requires some learning. While the customization options are excellent, beginners may spend a lot of time figuring out the best configuration. Another area that could be improved is customer support because there is no traditional support team like some commercial software products provide. Users usually depend on community forums and online documentation for troubleshooting. Some features, such as advanced video editing or built-in collaboration tools for chat communication, are limited compared to all-in-one content creation platforms.

改善点: Despite its strong points, Zoho Mail definitely comes with a noticeable learning curve and a few administrative headaches. And with 3D warehouse feature I was able to create very realistic simulation making the design process quite easier. Even as a beginner SketchUp was simple and effective tool. Got many tools to help users in modelling. Best feature is in SketchUp is walk around option which will give real life simulation how the final design will be. Also SketchUp got great plugins which will save both time and money of a designer. With 3D warehouse and extension warehouse a user can build any design using very little effort. What makes SketchUp the best 3D design software is unlike any alternative is ability to run smoothly in any computer. Most CAD software require a high-end computers with high performance system but SketchUp works fine in just any mediocre laptop.
改善点: Using SketchUp through browser was lagging and very slower compared with installed version. And I faced issues with gaps in walls and floors if you meddle with it few times. Also SketchUp need to upgrade to create complex designs because presently it's hard to do so.

Its tools are varied and very helpful, you will not run out of resources, because there are many ways to do things, the rest depends on the creator. It has a store that already has models made so it facilitates the task when you need an existing resource, so you don't have to do it from scratch.

In a short time you can reach an intermediate level of modelling, and there are many tutorials on the internet. If you add to this the large library of 3d objects available and all the plugins at your disposal, it is the perfect program.
改善点: The only flaw it might have is that the pro version is paid, but it's worth it.

タイトル: TweetDeck Makes Scheduling Content Easy!
投稿者: Andrew アメリカのManaging Editor 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 出版, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "TweetDeck Makes Scheduling Content Easy!"
良い点: TweetDeck is better than the actual Twitter site for my company. TweetDeck has made it effortless for me to schedule tweets for my company typically a week in advance so that we are not pressed to try to tweet live content. If something needs to be changed or rescheduled prior to the scheduled time, it is fairly easy to reschedule. TweetDeck also permits us to tweet for the multiple accounts I manage and follow the timeline and mentions for all accounts on one screen. I can also schedule content in advance for any time when I will be away, so that no one has to cover my work in my absence.
改善点: I have been unable to reschedule a tweet without deleting and reposting the scheduled tweet. It is not too difficult to copy the tweet and paste with a new date and time, it just adds a few steps that could be alleviated. It would be great to see TweetDeck add an option to schedule polls, as tweeting a poll recently is the only time I have used the actual Twitter site to post a tweet for my work.

タイトル: TweetDeck has more features than the original twitter and it works just perfect!
投稿者: Joel スペインのQuality engineer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 電気・電子機器製造, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "TweetDeck has more features than the original twitter and it works just perfect!"
良い点: Schedule tweets, multi account, everything in the same screen (feed, messages, your wall, future tweets, etc). It has been critical for my social and marketing post to organize my posts and my strategy. And it’s easy to use.
改善点: Even when you have everything you need in the same screen sometimes I feel I would like to personalize it even more and remove things and I don’t want to be there.

タイトル: Twitter to X

改善点: It is not easy to follow the main dashboard

タイトル: Optimize Your Social Media Workflow With Tweetdaeck
投稿者: Geoffrey アメリカのBassist, Instrumentalist, Composer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 音楽, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Optimize Your Social Media Workflow With Tweetdaeck"
良い点: Do you have more than one Twitter account that you need to monitor? Are you looking for an easy way to keep track of all your social media accounts in one place? If so, then Tweetdeck is the tool for you! Tweetdeck is a web browser experience that allows you to track your Twitter and other social media accounts easily. This blog post will discuss how to set up and use Tweetdeck to improve your social media workflow! - Easy to use - the interface is simple and easy to navigate, which makes it perfect for anyone who wants to keep track of their social media accounts - Multiple account support - with Tweetdeck, you can easily monitor multiple Twitter accounts in one place - Customizable - you can customize the way that Tweetdeck displays your information so that you can see what is most important to you
改善点: When you link your accounts together, your main account's icon is displayed at the bottom; however, your other profile logos are not. I wished that each profile's icon would appear at the bottom.

タイトル: Best Twitter management tool
投稿者: Guido アルゼンチンのPhoto Retoucher 認証済みLinkedInユーザー マーケティング、広告, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Best Twitter management tool"
良い点: Tweetdeck allows you to manage a multiple Twitter accounts. You can schedule tweets and check the analytics right in there. It's a browser app, so it doesn't require lot of resources, you just log in on any device and that's it.
改善点: It can get a little heavy when mentions flow on busy days. You also can't check all the users who have retweeted content (just the last 100). Analytics on tweets could be better.

タイトル: ClassDojo is the BEST

改善点: I love ClassDojo, however I did not like how it does not let parents message other parents. It requires the teacher to initiate the message or create a group.

タイトル: ClassDojo Rocks My Socks!!!

I also love the ability to post pictures and videos showing parents what goes on in our classroom on a daily basis.
改善点: Honestly there isn’t much that I don’t like, it has been an amazing communication tool with students and families and also a great way to award student behavior!

タイトル: Works for elementary aged children
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 消費者サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Works for elementary aged children"

I like any educational tool that gets my child excited to use it and excited to perform in an exemplary manner at school.

タイトル: Guesty Review
投稿者: Riley アメリカのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 不動産, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Guesty Review"

タイトル: Great App - Easy to manage
投稿者: Diego アメリカのCEO ホスピタリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great App - Easy to manage"
良い点: I’ve been using Guesty for the past three years to manage our properties, and it has been a very user-friendly and functional platform. One of the features I appreciate most is being able to manage all guest communications in one place, while keeping all of my calendars seamlessly connected. Overall, it’s intuitive, efficient, and very easy to use.
改善点: One area for improvement is the Guest Book feature. For smaller operators managing fewer than three properties, it does not currently provide enough value to justify the cost or effort involved. 検討した類似製品： Hospitable.com Guestyに切りかえた理由： User interface was better, I also had a good experience with customer support

タイトル: Good product. Terrible support.
投稿者: Kevin アメリカのCEO 不動産, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Good product. Terrible support."
良い点: Guesty as a product is solid. The features are there and it works well for managing properties at scale.
改善点: Customer service is not great, especially when you are dealing with anything above a basic support ticket. Anything related to account issues or more serious problems takes way too long. I canceled Guesty Shield, notified my account manager, followed up multiple times over email, had multiple calls with my account manager and her upper management, and the cancellation was confirmed. They kept charging me anyway. It has been 4 to 5 months of back and forth. They keep telling me they are working on fixing the invoice and correcting the balance. Still not fixed. My account keeps getting deactivated because of an unpaid invoice for a service I already canceled. Their solution is for me to pay the invoice first and get the credit back. Why would I pay for something I never used and already canceled months ago? On top of that, they tried to tell me I could cancel Guesty Shield myself through the dashboard, but you literally cannot do that. The account manager has to do it. So I did everything right and I am still in this loop.

タイトル: STR owner or manager? I'd recommend Guesty any day of the week
投稿者: Samuel カナダのCo-Founder ホスピタリティ, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "STR owner or manager? I'd recommend Guesty any day of the week"
良い点: They fully support us with any questions that we have and they've helped us evolve as a business every step of the way. Their Customer Success managers are great and really want to help you succeed. I recommend with my eyes closed.
改善点: They offer so many tools and perks (which is honestly really positive), but it can sometimes feel a little bit overwhelming given that they are rolling out so many new product updates that we don't have the operational bandwidth to test them all.

タイトル: Powerful Property Management Platform for Short-Term Rentals
投稿者: Raam アラブ首長国連邦のListing Manager ホスピタリティ, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Powerful Property Management Platform for Short-Term Rentals"
良い点: What I liked most about Guesty is how it simplifies managing multiple rental properties. The synchronization across booking platforms works reliably, which helps avoid scheduling conflicts and saves a lot of time. I also found the dashboard helpful for managing reservations, payments, and guest communication in one place. The platform feels secure when handling payments, and the support team has been responsive when questions come up. While small bugs occasionally happen, they are usually resolved quickly. Overall, Guesty provides strong value for property managers who want automation and centralized control of their listings.
改善点: The pricing can be a bit expensive for smaller property managers, and some advanced features are only available in higher-tier plans. The interface may feel overwhelming at first due to the number of tools available. Occasionally there are minor bugs or delays in synchronization across channels, and customer support response times can sometimes vary depending on the issue.

タイトル: Fast and simple for almost every PDF task
投稿者: Furkan トルコのFounder 認証済みLinkedInユーザー デザイン, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Fast and simple for almost every PDF task"
良い点: Smallpdf is one of those tools I can open and use immediately without having to figure out where everything is. There is almost no learning curve, and the interface makes common PDF tasks very straightforward. I use features like compression, conversion, merging and basic document editing, and they usually take only a few steps. Having all of these tools in one place also makes PDF document management much more convenient.
改善点: The main limitation is that some tools and higher usage levels require a paid plan. This is understandable, but it can be a little inconvenient when I suddenly need to process several documents or use a more advanced feature. For my normal workflow, though, it has never been enough of an issue to reduce my overall satisfaction.

タイトル: My Everyday PDF Helper That Gets the Job Done
投稿者: Sudeep カナダのSr. Accountant 不動産, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "My Everyday PDF Helper That Gets the Job Done"
良い点: What I like most about Smallpdf is how easy it makes handling PDF documents in my daily work. I often need to convert files, merge PDFs, compress documents, and make quick edits, and having these tools in one place saves me a lot of time. The interface is clean and simple, so I can usually find what I need without wasting time figuring things out.
改善点: The main downside is that some useful features require a paid subscription, which can be frustrating when I only need them occasionally. I would also appreciate more flexibility with the free version and faster processing when working with larger files.

タイトル: Great Support team
投稿者: Clare 英国のNA 研究, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Great Support team"

改善点: Unfortunately the PDF editing tool is very slow and glitchy, and I had to abandon it after my document froze twice and I lost all my edits.

タイトル: Intuitive and reliable for everyday PDF tasks
投稿者: Soumya アメリカのSenior Software Engineer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 金融サービス, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Intuitive and reliable for everyday PDF tasks"
良い点: The biggest win is how easy it is to use. There's essentially no learning curve the tools are laid out clearly, and I could compress, convert, merge, split, and reorder pages without hunting through menus or reading docs. Compression and format conversion (PDF to Word/JPG and back) are fast and produce clean results. Merging and splitting documents "just works," and basic editing and annotation are convenient for quick markups. The web-based interface means I can jump in from any browser without installing anything
改善点: The main frustration is feature gaps. The document editing is fine for light touch-ups but falls short for anything more involved deeper text editing, precise layout control, and more advanced document management leave you wanting a dedicated PDF editor. Some capabilities are gated behind the paid tier or hit usage limits on the free plan, which can interrupt you mid-task. It covers the common needs well but isn't a full replacement for a heavyweight tool when you need more control.

タイトル: Great tool to merge and edit pdfs for free

改善点: Nohing much, wish there were lesser ads but can't complain with free features. If they can improve the website ui, it would look refined.

タイトル: Reliable Document Management with Strong Collaboration and Support
投稿者: Falguni インドのSoftware Engineer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Reliable Document Management with Strong Collaboration and Support"
良い点: Revver makes it much easier to organize, store, search, and securely share documents from one central platform. I especially like the folder structure, access controls, search functionality, and collaboration features because they reduce the time spent locating files and prevent documents from being scattered across emails or local drives. The platform performs reliably, and the customer support team has been helpful when we needed assistance with setup or configuration.
改善点: Some parts of the interface feel less intuitive than they should, especially when configuring templates, permissions, metadata fields, or more advanced workflows. Initial setup can take time, and new users may need training before they feel comfortable using all the features. I would also like faster navigation, simpler workflow customization, better integrations with other business tools, and more flexible reporting options.

タイトル: Efficient, Organized, and easy to use
投稿者: Gaurav インドのManager DevOps 教育管理, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Efficient, Organized, and easy to use"
良い点: Revver helped us streamline our document management process without making things complicated. File sharing is straightforward, and it's easy to keep documents organized and accessible. The interface is user-friendly, which reduced the time needed for training. Customer support was also reliable whenever questions came up. It offers a strong balance of functionality and cost.
改善点: Some customization options are limited compared to other platforms. It would be nice to have more flexibility in tailoring workflows and document organization to fit specific business needs.

タイトル: An online file cabinet that has more cons than pros
投稿者: Dana アメリカのHuman Resources Manager ホスピタリティ, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "An online file cabinet that has more cons than pros"
良い点: It is very easy to set up new drawers and new folders. Editing it also very easy. The way the system lays out the drawers is user friendly and makes navigation fairly easy. Most documents that are individual files can be dragged into place, which is very convenient.
改善点: It takes a bit too long to load the entire system when first logging in. The system lags and does not keep up with fast typing or fast actions. The search feature is very clunky and not an easy straightforward search option. If folders are found, it is difficult to go right to the folder that is chosen. A file has to be downloaded before it can be viewed or removed which is time consuming. There is a "failed uploads" icon that shows documents that were successfully uploaded, which is confusing. There are frustrating times while in this system.

タイトル: Efficient document management with useful automation features
投稿者: Hiten インドのDevSecOps コンピュータ、ネットワーク・セキュリティ, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Efficient document management with useful automation features"
良い点: Revver made it much easier to organize and manage documents in one place. the search feature works well, file sharing is straightforward, and the workflow automation helps reduce manual work. I also found the interface fairly easy to navigate after a short learning period. customer support has also been responsive whenever assistance was needed.
改善点: some of the advance features can take time to understand especially when setting up workflows or permissions. there were also a few moments where platform felt a bit slow when handling larger document libraries, but nothing that significantly affected daily use.

タイトル: The ultimate one-stop solution to document management with cutting-edge AI features
投稿者: Syed Saad インドのSoftware Development Manager 教育管理, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "The ultimate one-stop solution to document management with cutting-edge AI features"
良い点: The thing I like most about Revver is its massive cloud storage ceilings. Unlike other alternatives in the market, the high tiers of cloud storage scaling up to 20TB completely remove the necessity of an external provider making it a one-stop solution. Furthermore, I really like the automation mirroring in Revver wherein the platform automatically replicates identical ecosystems across entire directories. I also really like the integrated OCR which saves us a lot of time and effort by allowing us to find a scanned paper invoice by just typing a random phrase. The AI summarization feature is also very helpful as it provides quick summaries so we don't have to read the whole PDF. Its Smart Extract AI feature automatically extracts the critical metadata from PDFs and even handwritten papers using pattern recognition which makes our workflow very efficient. The software also has a very easy-to-use and intuitive user interface which allowed us to easily get accustomed to the software.
改善点: The only thing that I dislike about Revver is the fact that the performance degrades a bit when a lot of team members log into the system simultaneously. However, the technical support team has been very helpful in this regard and has provided working fixes.

タイトル: Pay To Play and Rank At The Top For Searches
投稿者: Feraud カナダのOwner マーケティング、広告, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Pay To Play and Rank At The Top For Searches"

改善点: The pricing has really increased over the Year and also the changes to keyword / keypharse search relevancy. Even phrase match now get you some off topic words. Plus a lot of their AI recommendations don't make sense to a lot of businesses.

タイトル: High-Intent Traffic Driver with Strong Scaling Potential but Cost Sensitivity
投稿者: Michael カナダのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 音楽, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "High-Intent Traffic Driver with Strong Scaling Potential but Cost Sensitivity"
良い点: Google Ads is highly effective for a music and vocal coaching business because it allows precise targeting of people actively searching for singing lessons or related services. It provides strong intent-based traffic, which makes it easier to attract potential students who are already interested. The platform also offers detailed tracking and performance data, which helps optimize campaigns and understand what messaging drives conversions.
改善点: Google Ads can become expensive quickly, especially in competitive niches like music education, where cost-per-click can rise without strong optimization. It also has a steep learning curve, requiring constant testing and adjustment to avoid wasted spend. For a small or growing music business, it can feel complex and time-consuming to manage effectively without experience.

タイトル: Google Ads Are A Must For Any Marketer!
投稿者: Zach カナダのMarketing Coordinator 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 教育管理, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Google Ads Are A Must For Any Marketer!"
良い点: Our organization has been routinely using Google Ads for the past several years with great success. Year round we run Google Display, Demand Gen and YouTube ads for our various campaigns and we are always thrilled with the results we see. The advanced targeting really allows us to hone in on our target market and serve them ads across the web at optimum times. We've also been lucky to have received dedicated support through Google Ads specialists that have guided us to improve our campaign performance with actionable recommendations that have improved our CTR rates and our CPC costs.
改善点: There isn't many negative things I could say about Google Ads, but I do feel the back-end campaign manager user interface is due for a facelift to make it a bit more user friendly. This may just be nitpicking, but I do find that the UI is somewhat dated and could use a refresh to be more visually appealing and easier to navigate/find things.

タイトル: Powerful All-in-One CRM with a Steep Learning Curve
投稿者: Nurudeen ナイジェリアのBusiness Outreach Analyst 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 通信, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Powerful All-in-One CRM with a Steep Learning Curve"
良い点: What I like most about Bitrix24 is how it brings everything into one place without forcing me to juggle multiple tools. From leads to follow-ups and tasks, it’s all right there, which makes daily work feel more organized and less scattered. The ease of use stood out to me after spending some time on it. At first it feels loaded, but once you get familiar, moving between leads, activities, and different views like Kanban or List becomes pretty natural. Another thing I appreciate is the level of customization. You’re not stuck with a rigid system, you can adjust pipelines, fields, and workflows to match how you actually work, which makes a big difference in real-life usage. On the productivity side, the built-in automation helps cut down repetitive work like setting reminders or follow-ups, so you can focus more on actual outreach. The user interface also does a solid job of keeping everything visible in one place, like contact details and activity history, without needing to open multiple tabs, which speeds things up during busy work sessions.
改善点: What I liked least about Bitrix24 is that it can feel overwhelming, especially at the beginning. There are so many features packed into one system that it’s easy to get lost or slow down while trying to figure out where everything is. Some parts of the interface also feel a bit cluttered, which can make simple tasks take longer than they should. Another downside is that certain customizations and automations aren’t as straightforward to set up as expected, you sometimes have to dig around or go through multiple steps just to make small changes. It’s powerful, no doubt, but that complexity can work against you if you just want to move fast.

タイトル: Great overall product and customer service
投稿者: Christopher アメリカのOwner 不動産, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great overall product and customer service"
良い点: The customization of things, being able to make it what I needed for my company.
改善点: Can be a little hard to learn and navigate at first, they offer partners to help with thing if you can afford it but I like to know how to do things. Once you learn it though it is super easy to use.

タイトル: Terrible experience that only gets worse
投稿者: Larissa ブラジルのSRD LEAD 法律サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Terrible experience that only gets worse"
良い点: Almost nothing, if i'm being honest. I can find most of the features in any of the best software companies in the market right now.
改善点: I've been using Bitrix24 since last year, and I have to say: in the last few months, especially the last month, it feels like the platform has been abandoned and all the staff have been replaced by a dumb AI. Support has been taking days, if not weeks, to respond. We're experiencing an error with card merging that's been open for over a month. Changes are made out of the blue, without warning, and we have to constantly find new ways to do things. It seems to create more problems than solutions. No CRM card can be deleted, and merging doesn't work, so we created a column just to isolate cards that need to be merged and/or deleted. Automations don't pull updated numbers or contact names, so we have to create new cards when we correct someone's number or contact name, otherwise it sends automated messages with the old/incorrect information. We're constantly having problems connecting to WhatsApp, and we thought it was a Meta issue, but it's actually Bitrix. We're starting to evaluate new platforms to migrate our entire operation, and it's going to be a lot of work, but it looks like it'll be worth it.

タイトル: Provides a good overview of team and responsibilities for tasks.

改善点: So far, I'm very satisfied. I believe Bitrix24 has many more features that I just don't know about or use. More information, such as simple videos, would be helpful.

タイトル: best app to use

タイトル: Great Prices. Great Options. Great Shipping Tool!

タイトル: Lost shipment, zero accountability — $438 gone

タイトル: MyHours for the Time Tracking Win!
投稿者: Joni アメリカのCoach 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "MyHours for the Time Tracking Win!"

タイトル: A must-have product for any marketer's tech stack!
投稿者: Blair カナダのMarketing Manager 教育管理, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A must-have product for any marketer's tech stack!"
良い点: Typeform has fantastic user experience options for both the backend and frontend user. It's easy to make a form that looks beautiful but is also highly functional and achieves what you want it to, whether that's collect audience opinions, direct your client to a specific product or service, skip over questions, etc. There are a range of question types that make it easy to collect the info you're wanting to collect in a meaningful way. Further, any time I've had issues or a question customer support has been quick with a thoughtful and helpful response. At one point they even re-enabled a feature on our account after it had been mass disabled for user and the change was affecting our internal staff workflows.
改善点: I appreciate the range of options available for overall form design, but it can be a bit of a letdown when you see something is only available to higher tier users. I hope Typeform doesn't strip back lower tier memberships too much as the continue to launch new features. I would also like the ability to have at least two questions per panel. I realize the "one question per panel" is a selling point of Typeform, but there are times when it would make sense to have two questions on a panel (e.g., rate this as one question followed by "explain why you gave that rating" as a follow-up). I also don't love the increasing push of AI features. At times it is thoughtful, but I played around with their "AI follow up question" feature and the question only made sense in relation to the previous question about 50% of the time. It was like it was trying a little too hard to create "good questions" and as a result veering into questions that were outside the scope of my goals.

タイトル: bakiza on diolingo

タイトル: Duolingo: Easy and Engaging, But Missing Syntax
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 小売, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Duolingo: Easy and Engaging, But Missing Syntax"
良い点: Duolingo makes learning a new language very simple and fun. Here are the pro bullet points from my experience. Easy to use: The clear design lets you start learning right away without a complicated setup. Creative learning: Short lessons use games, pictures, and quick quizzes to keep your brain active. Never bored: Fast tasks and fun rewards stop you from feeling tired or losing interest.
改善点: The app has a few frustrating limits with how it saves progress and teaches sentence rules. Below I've included some cons based on my experiences. Slow syncs: Moving your progress from the computer to your phone can lag or fail to update right away. If you are competing in a league as I often do, that can cause a small panic. Focus on words: Lessons teach you single words instead of how they fit together in real conversation. While you learn sentences they don't teach how and why the verbs and nouns are placed the way they are. If you are an English speak for instance, the sentence structure of certain languages are difficult to understand. Missing context: It skips deep rules on syntax, making it hard to build original sentences on your own. Related to the sentence structure mentioned above.

タイトル: Book It!
投稿者: Ashely アメリカのRecruiter 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 消費者サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Book It!"
良い点: Booker is a godsend for so many salons. It is very user-friendly and they have implemented the use of embedded training videos for all the features; this is a wonderful tool and works very well for people who are visual learners, which most stylists happen to be. For salon managers and owners, Booker offers a variety of tools: time-clock, sales tracking, inventory, tip allocation, expenditures/budgets, etc. Being a web-based software, it's very easy to add a widget or embed a link on your website and/or Facebook page to allow customers to easily schedule themselves for services. In addition, there is a built-in point of sale system that makes it easy to check out clients without needing to switch over to another program and/or system.
改善点: The downside to being a web-based software: if the server is down or there is an issue with the website, you cannot access your calendar or your point of sale system. Booker has been awesome enough to provide a separate website where they allow you to report issues of the system being down and also announcing known issues. Their customer service makes up for this issue.

タイトル: Booker wants you to use endless work arounds because they can't get it right
投稿者: Laurie アメリカのowner 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 ソース：SoftwareAdvice 共有 "Booker wants you to use endless work arounds because they can't get it right"

タイトル: Powerful .NET components – exceptional for PDF creation and processing

The library is extremely stable, well-documented, and offers an impressive range of features – from precise layout control and form handling to digital signatures. What I value most is the performance: even complex, multi-page PDF outputs with embedded images and charts are generated quickly and reliably. Compared to other libraries, Syncfusion provides outstanding value – an ideal solution for professional .NET developers who depend on stability, strong documentation, and top-tier performance. Pros: Comprehensive set of features for PDF and Office document processing Excellent and responsive technical support High performance and reliability in production environments Great documentation and many code examples Cons: Can take a bit of time to get familiar with the full feature set

タイトル: Sortly Review
投稿者: Sal オーストラリアのICT Security Manger 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 5,001～10,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Sortly Review"
良い点: What I liked most about Sortly is its simplicity and ease of use. The platform has a clean, intuitive interface that makes it quick to get started, even for users with limited technical experience. The mobile app is particularly useful, allowing inventory to be managed on the go with features like barcode and QR code scanning. I also appreciate how visual the system is, with photo-based tracking and customizable fields that make organizing items straightforward. Overall, it significantly reduces the complexity of inventory management and saves time by streamlining day‑to‑day tracking and reporting tasks.
改善点: What I liked least about Sortly is that it can fall short in several key areas. From a security perspective, there is limited visibility into controls and integrations compared to more enterprise-grade tools. In terms of value for money, pricing can increase quickly as inventory grows, making it less suitable for scaling small businesses. Customer support can be inconsistent, and response times aren’t always ideal. There are occasional bugs and syncing issues reported, especially with larger datasets. Tracking lacks real-time updates in some scenarios, and reporting capabilities are fairly basic, limiting deeper analysis and insights

タイトル: Very fortunate to have found this system!
投稿者: Jordan アメリカのOutside Plant Superintendent 通信, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Very fortunate to have found this system!"

It has been very easy to upload items using a bulk file, but it's also easy to edit them if I didn't have all the information in my initial bulk file. The creation of labels and label printing is very user-friendly. I like the fact that I can choose where to start my labels on a label page so that I'm not wasting label sheets but I'm getting the most out of them.
改善点: I'll preface this by saying I'm fairly new to Sortly but I already have nearly 600 items added to my database so I've gotten a fair amount of use of this product in the last few months, however, there may be features that I'm just not good at that may alleviate my issues (but I haven't found them). Three things... 1) There needs to be a better 'transactional' procedure for me to "checkout" items to employees from our inventory that I know they are not bringing back. I know that I can move them to a separate file for tracking but I want the peace of mind to know that they are out of my system completely and not involved in any sort of my inventory count. 2) I would like the ability to further customize my labels. I need mainly barcodes on the labels but there are only two sizes offered for them which means I have to print out a qr code label with all the pertinent information on it, then add a barcode. I know they both scan the same but I have barcode scanners that I need to use so a barcode has to be on there. 3) I have my inventory listed in 'sections' so I would like to see a feature where I could print off an inventory checklist for someone to count an individual section and report back so that I can make adjustments.
