タイトル: Blender: Professional 3D Design, Animation & Rendering Software
投稿者: Bruno イタリアのMarketing Executive Intern 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 自動車, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Blender: Professional 3D Design, Animation & Rendering Software"
良い点: I had the opportunity to use Blender for the last time during my recent work as a Marketing Executive Intern for Hackett & Hackett International Group Limited. In my opinion, this software has a lot of useful features for creating and designing different products. Firstly, it is free and does not require any payment for using its services. Secondly, it is integrated with creative software like 3D modelling, Sculpting, Animation, Rigging, and Texturing. Moreover, it has two rendering engines that ensure high-quality and realistic images or videos. Additionally, Blender has sophisticated and powerful modelling tools that allow working with different objects.
改善点: However, there are also some significant disadvantages associated with this software. To begin with, Blender has a steep learning curve due to the numerous functions and tools that it provides. That is why it can be confusing for someone who has never worked with this program. Despite its recent improvements, the interface still seems too complicated and cluttered. Another demerit is that it has high demands on the computer configuration, especially when working with images or videos of high resolution. Consequently, rendering may take a long time if someone works with complex objects and special effects.

タイトル: Really great software that just didn't quite meet our needs
投稿者: David アメリカのOwner 経理, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Really great software that just didn't quite meet our needs"
良い点: Right off the bat, Teamwork is a beautiful and easy to use project management system. They made some tweaks to the interface a couple of years ago that made things a little more difficult to find, but overall they are still the best. There are extremely granular permissions, allowing you to basically setup any user however you wish, even at the project level. There are templates for both projects and task lists, a custom login URL, capacity management, and most anything else you could want except a few items. Overall, it is a great value for the price.
改善点: The first is the lack of email integration. We ended up switching from Teamwork to a different project management system and this was one of two deciding factors. With our new software we can communicate with our clients through email or chat directly from the current project we are working on and it attaches to the project so we always have a record. The second drawback for us was the lack of recurring projects. We do monthly accounting services for clients and we need repeatability. The recurring tasks feature did not work well for us, and quite frankly, was not well thought out. If you do a search for the feature you will see a lot of complaints around the internet. Another feature that would be extremely helpful but was not a deal breaker for us, would be a client portal. A login where clients can upload files and send up questions. We used other software for that but it would have been great to have them all in one place like we do now.

タイトル: Avast for Business - One of the cheapest options for your company.
投稿者: Victor ブラジルのProject advisor 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 非営利団体運営, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Avast for Business - One of the cheapest options for your company."
良い点: 1 - Much more customizable than other antiviruses in the same price range. 2 - Detects a reasonable number of threats. 3 - The program's firewall is exceptional in its detection. 4 - Its compatible with Mac OS, Windows and Windows Server (best value I found for server protection solution). 5 - Three different types of protection, so you can choose the one that best fits your use and your company.
改善点: 1 - Some more advanced threats were not detected, which started to worry me. 2 - Although it protects you (sometimes try to protect) from spam and other threats, the program opens several pop-ups, visually polluting your desktop a little. 3 - Strong problem to protect against some types of spam. 4 - The difference between the three versions: Regular, Pro and Pro Plus, are not so significant to justify the price difference between them, being that it would be more interesting to have only a more robust version.

タイトル: Warning: Athenahealth may put you out of business
投稿者: dana アメリカのPresident 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Warning: Athenahealth may put you out of business"
良い点: nice looking software but the training is all videos that are cryptic and not helpful. Customer service just gives the run around, hardly any answers.
改善点: I want to be honest with all potential clients. This review is not one star. It is zero. I changed from Curemd to Athena because they made claims that they could increase my income as a solo medical practitioner. 3 months after changing over to Athena, our income was slipping. By 4-5 months we were having trouble meeting payroll. Six months in it was clear we may be going out of business after 26 years. I took no salary for 7 months, worked 24/7 and finally was given the advice that the only way to save the company was to go back on Curemd which we did. Six months later we are back on our feet. Over $600,000 in collections remains missing. Athena barely worked claims. Their customer service barely speaks our language and is of no help. The "Customer Success" manager seemed to be hell bent in putting us out of business. When I finally got our case escalated to the VP of Sales, he only made it worse and was actually agressie toward us. Curemd is honest, reliable, and goes to the wall with each and every claim. You can always reach someone who knows what they're doing. Do not get involve with this company. They were sued for millions by a hospital for fraud. They were bought by Bain Capital 10 years ago and they probably gutted whatever value there was.

タイトル: Elementor Pro: the only “pro” is how professionally they ghost you
投稿者: Riccardo イタリアのWeb designer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 写真, 自営業 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Elementor Pro: the only “pro” is how professionally they ghost you"
良い点: The only thing worth appreciating about Elementor Pro is the abundance of third-party tutorials and community resources online — especially on YouTube. Without those, you'd be completely lost. If you had to rely solely on Elementor’s own support team to solve even basic issues, you'd be absolutely screwed. The user community is doing the heavy lifting that the company clearly doesn’t care to handle
改善点: I’ve been completely locked out of my account for days, and Elementor's support has been utterly useless. After updating my email, 2FA stopped working entirely — no authentication codes are being sent. I've tried logging in over 50 times. Still nothing. I opened 6 support tickets. The only two times someone replied, they asked for basic info and then said they needed to escalate the issue to another department. The first time, I actually got a response from that department, asking for a new email to replace the broken one. I sent it — and never heard from them again. The second time, I wasn’t even lucky enough to get that far. I’ve followed up multiple times, and I know they’re reading the messages (I'm using Mailtrack), but they’ve completely ignored me. It's a black hole. Elementor Pro is not a professional-grade tool. It may look sleek on the surface, but if something goes wrong — especially something critical like account access — you’re completely on your own. The support team is unresponsive, disorganized, and not trustworthy.

タイトル: Amazing Insight
投稿者: Kira アメリカのEmployee Engagement Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Amazing Insight"
良い点: Using Emplify has changed our company for the better. We are now able, thanks to Emplify, to track detailed data on how our associates are feeling about their work. We then use this data to help improve the work experience for all of our associates, particularly teams who need extra help. Emplify enables us to put data around something that leaders may feel, but can't really identify. Taking these "feelings" and putting them into actionable data, which is something Emplify helps with significantly via the engagement dashboard, has been huge for our company. The dashboard that displays data is very easy to use and understand and contains a lot of meaningful visual elements that are easy to drop into presentations for C-level and board members. Emplify's software is extremely easy to use from an admin perspective, and the survey process is very easy and painless for associates. It takes 5-6 minutes 4 times each year. The data we get from that small investment of associate time is invaluable. We have decreased regrettable turnover and have seen an increase in topline revenue since using the Emplify product.
改善点: I struggle to come up with things that I dislike about Emplify. It is incredibly easy to use and has made a huge difference for our company.

タイトル: A tool for disconnected members of HR to get an incorrect sense of team satisfaction
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 金融サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A tool for disconnected members of HR to get an incorrect sense of team satisfaction"
良い点: The tool can be used by workers to alert team managment of dissatisfaction in a way that has a lower bar to action. In this i mean raising dissatisfaction can be difficult with team management often because it requires a push from workers to raise complaints. This software can provide an outlet that has a lower barrier to participation to alert dissatisfaction - this can get the process rolling to resolve these issues. Anonymous feedback can be given if the software is configured for this. This can be useful to understand how a team feels.
改善点: This software to me feels like a solution that is better resolved by a more human touch from team management and company HR. This software helps to provide feedback from multiple levels of a team to ensure members of the team are satisfied. I shall focus on what i feel is the most important purpose of this software, helping resolve dissatisfaction in a team. This should in my opinion be dealt with using a human touch and face to face help from management for employees and not through a semi automated tool. 15Five sends out surveys and feedback requests every week to employees to ask for their feedback on how work is going. This to me feels not like the best solution for organisations.

The tool also keeps teams organized and provides for smooth collaboration and our teams perform better with the tool in place.

タイトル: Flexible design and prototyping platform for collaborative projects
投稿者: Nikitha アメリカのAI Proposal Intern 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Flexible design and prototyping platform for collaborative projects"
良い点: Figma is easy to use and provides a flexible environment for creating and organizing digital designs. The Features support different stages of the design process, while Prototyping is particularly useful for creating interactive mockups and demonstrating how a design will work. Navigation is generally straightforward, making it easy to move between files, pages, and design elements. The Customization and Templates options also provide flexibility when starting new projects or adapting designs to different requirements.
改善点: Some advanced design and prototyping features can take time to learn, particularly for users who are new to collaborative design tools. Large projects with many files, pages, and design elements can also make Navigation more difficult. I have occasionally encountered minor usability issues when working with more complex designs. Security is important when sharing design files, so permissions and access settings need to be managed carefully. I have limited direct experience with Customer Support, so I cannot strongly evaluate that aspect.

タイトル: A modern, powerful, and essential design tool
投稿者: Nicolò イタリアのWeb developer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A modern, powerful, and essential design tool"
良い点: Figma is extremely intuitive and fast to use. Compared to Adobe XD, it feels much more advanced, especially in terms of real-time collaboration, component management, and design systems. Being cloud-based makes teamwork seamless. I’m also very happy to see AI features being introduced, which make the tool even more powerful and future-oriented.
改善点: The main drawback is the cost of granting access to temporary external collaborators. If they don’t already have a license, it can be expensive to add them just for a short period. Automatic renewals can also be a downside, as it’s easy to forget to remove or downgrade a license once the collaboration ends.

タイトル: An Incredibly Powerful Design Tool for both Designers and Engineers
投稿者: Mat アメリカのSenior Engineer Eラーニング, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "An Incredibly Powerful Design Tool for both Designers and Engineers"
良い点: Figma makes reviewing, collaborating and implementing designs extremely easy. As a design tool, it seems very easy to use.
改善点: I wish there was a way to integrate it with Tailwind and our Tailwind configs. This is an industry-wide utility used for frontend development. I wish there was a way to integrate Figma with our custom component library, even third party component libraries for front end development, so that designers can work with what the engineering team has built. This would help sync designs to the design system.

改善点: I do find it quite tricky to navigate around and it can be very slow at times and also loses connection

タイトル: The best collaborative design tool I've ever used
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー デザイン, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "The best collaborative design tool I've ever used"
良い点: Figma completely changed the way I design digital products. Its real-time collaboration is unmatched, making it easy to work with teammates and clients without worrying about version control. I use it for everything, from wireframes and high-fidelity UI design to interactive prototypes and presentations. Features like Auto Layout, Variables, Components, and Dev Mode have significantly improved both my workflow and handoff to developers. It's also incredibly fast, intuitive, and constantly evolving with meaningful new features.
改善点: Defineteley, the pricing model. It's very difficult to understand how it works, and they also changed the plans many times, so this is a real pain I have and I would love they could do something to solve it. Also, as Figma keeps adding more capabilities, it has become more complex for new users. Some advanced features have a learning curve, and very large files can occasionally impact performance.

改善点: At the end of the year, it cannot predict the next month, and occasionally cannot extrapolate enough data for perfect future commissions.

タイトル: CIQ Ease of Use and Functionality
投稿者: Zach アメリカのSenior Accountant Eラーニング, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "CIQ Ease of Use and Functionality"
良い点: CIQ offers such a diverse amount of functionalities, all of which have their own beneficial aspect that contribute to our company daily. The ability for our sales reps to login and view their payout statements in a user-friendly manner as well as provide us a snapshot of what occurred in order to determine errors (if applicable) is amazing. It also allows the users/admins to dive into the back-end weeds of the system to ensure it's data connectors are working appropriately - for which CIQ is great as it can easily connect with essential systems such as Salesforce, DocuSign, and NetSuite. Integration of this system is perfect as you're able to dictate how you want to design the production instance, no matter how complex or simple you may prefer.
改善点: Some areas for improvement would be providing a few high-level data points that can be easily accessible for relaying monthly/quarterly/annual information to higher-ups. Items such as total commissions paid for the period in USD - you can certainly retrieve this information; however, it's not readily available as one may think. Another area is determining what fields/workbooks have impacts on other areas of the system. Luckily the sandbox instance allows for practice prior to implementation, but when trying to diagnose a fix in a query - you are not exactly sure what the impact of changing a column header or deleting a column may have on your reporting.

タイトル: FACEBOOK REVIEW
投稿者: Jessie アメリカのowner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 消費財, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "FACEBOOK REVIEW"
良い点: What I liked most about Facebook Apps and Tabs is how they make a page more organized and interactive. Tabs help keep important information in one easy place, like events, photos, or special offers. Facebook app can also add fun features like sign-ups, videos, or links to other websites. This makes it easier for people to find what they need and stay engaged with the page. Overall, they help pages look more professional and user-friendly.
改善点: What I liked least about Facebook Apps and Tabs is that they can sometimes be confusing or hard to find. On mobile devices, many tabs don’t show up clearly, so people might miss important information. Some apps also load slowly or don’t work properly, which can frustrate users.

タイトル: A Solid Tool for Page Organization, But Sifting Through the Clutter Takes Work
投稿者: Ysaura Maria イタリアのpsychologist 認証済みLinkedInユーザー メンタルヘルスケア, 自営業 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "A Solid Tool for Page Organization, But Sifting Through the Clutter Takes Work"
良い点: What I love most is how much structure and professional framing it gives to a business page. It allows us to centralize different campaigns—like an email newsletter sign-up, a running contest, and our store links—all under one roof. The automated publishing and keyword filtering are also massive pros for keeping the page clean and automated.
改善点: The predictability can be frustrating. Facebook frequently updates its platform interface and algorithms, which means certain custom tabs can randomly glitch, alter in mobile visibility, or require manual tweaking without warning. It can also sometimes feel a bit clunky for older target demographics to navigate.

改善点: There was nothing that I disliked about Yahoo Mail. Everything works very well and you can tell that the developers actually put thought and effort into creating it, because it is very well done.

The storage space is also useful because I don't have to worry too much about deleting messages just to make room for new ones. I appreciate the familiar interface and the spam filters, which help keep unwanted emails out of my inbox. For everyday communication, it does what I need without making things complicated.

I would also like the email organization and customization options to be more flexible. Occasionally, finding a specific setting takes longer than expected, and I think customer support could be easier to access when problems arise.

良い点: I have to say, this is a not really difficult application but it keeps an accurate account of time tracking. You don't clock in unless you are in the building of facility you work and you are connected to the app itself. It has a tracker on the app that lets you know that you are in the correct place at this time and it clocks you in when you go to the app.
改善点: I don't like the fact that you have to go into the app just to check in. I fell like the employee should be able to manage the app better from their phone. If you don't have your phone, then you have to waste time to physically go to a computer to check in. I honestly love the time cards better than this actual app. It can become complicated because it only shows the iphone compatible and it does work under the android system but it compiles complications. If the employee has any other type of phone because not everyone has the best type of phone, they will have issues.

タイトル: Timesheets.com has made it much easier for us to keep track of our time and do more efficient routine work
投稿者: Ahanaf Ahamed アメリカのResearch Assistant 教育管理, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Timesheets.com has made it much easier for us to keep track of our time and do more efficient routine work"
良い点: Keeping track of billable hours and total productivity is made very easy by the platform's ability to log hours spent on specific research projects. Finding it possible to sort time entries by project and task was especially helpful for me because it makes it clear how resources are being used for different study projects. Creating detailed reports quickly is another great feature. These reports show how time is being spent and how the project is going, which is very important for making sure that goals are met, and resources are used well. Easy entry is another great thing about the platform. I could easily access the platform on different devices, whether I was working from the office or from home.
改善点: Although the platform has helpful reporting tools, it would be better if users could customize reports to meet their specific research needs. Furthermore, the process of okaying time entries can sometimes feel a bit complicated, especially when there are a lot of tasks and team members involved.

タイトル: Affordable, Easy, and one less thing to stress about

良い点: This was extremely easy to get my staff enrolled. There wasn't a single question, delay, or need to call anyone for assistance with just getting things started. Timesheet sent an email to my staff, the staff enrolled and all I had to do was add the email address. It was super easy compared to ADP. I love that you can save the website to the desktop and clock in with you information without having to login first. It takes about 10-15 seconds to clock in. My favorite feature is the approval of mistakes to clocking in and out. The staff can make a request and you can select to approve it or deny it from the email the system sends you. There is no searching for requests.
改善点: I wish the home page was easier to navigate. The design of the page makes it difficult to get to something the first few times you use it. It could be cleaned up to make it smoother.

タイトル: In a word, "TeamSupport rocks!"
投稿者: Saskia アメリカのSenior Director Sales Marketing 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 飲食店, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "In a word, "TeamSupport rocks!""
良い点: TeamSupport's strongest feature is undoubtedly its ability to supply users with options that are easy to install and maintain. It's also so easy that anyone who wants to can pick it up and run with it in only two days. This program is an improvement over the Reading Desk and its ilk since it allows for individualized setup based on the user's specific requirements.
改善点: It would be helpful if TeamSupport worked with other cloud services like Google Apps and Office 365. TeamSupport's sluggish functioning and page load times are the service's biggest flaws in my opinion. It would be really helpful to have one-click shortcuts for commonly performed activities like moving or closing tickets.

タイトル: A Great Help Desk Solution For Business

良い点: I like the ease of communication and offering support with TeamSupport. The software is well equipped and I like the help desk support capabilities. It is awesomely affordable.
改善点: Well, I have used TeamSupport and no bad experience.

タイトル: Do Not Use - After merger, support decreased and prices increased
投稿者: Andrew アメリカのPresident 事務用品、事務機器, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Do Not Use - After merger, support decreased and prices increased"
良い点: The live chat function worked fine and has good intuitive tools
改善点: They do not communicate timely and their business practices are awful. They raised our rates without notice and then did not allow us to get out of our contract.

タイトル: Inventory Management
投稿者: Balasubramani カナダのTechnical Support Specialist 銀行, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Inventory Management"
良い点: I primarily use Team Support for Inventory Management. I like that I am able to search a terminal based on the serial number alone. It is helpful to leave a note for each terminal, I use the notes to indicate the current status of a terminal, whether it is ready to be loaned out or if it already been loaned etc. Team Support has a provision to assign an inventory item to a Customer. I find that very helpful. I like the feature where I am able to schedule the reports to be emailed to more than one email address. These reports need to be sent at particular time and day without fail. Auto scheduling the email report saves me a lot of time and complications. I also like the fact that Team Support is compatible for API Integration. We are looking to develop a centralised platform in our firm and want to be able to fetch info from Team Support for Data Analysis. This is in our pipeline and we are looking to implement this sometime in the future. In the past the upper management used to shoot us emails enquiring about the particular issue. It takes up our time to email the management back with the status of that issue. Now the upper management simply logs into team support to view and oversee the status of a ticket/issue
改善点: However, the frustrating part of Team Support is the reporting section. When I open up the inventory report, it displays a list of all the terminals I have added to the inventory and when I want to get more information on a particular terminal, I notice that I cannot click on the terminal to navigate to that terminals page. Not only that, I cannot copy the serial number of the terminal from the inventory report. This applies to pretty much all the reports. All reports are in read only format. I humbly request Team Support to make the items on the report as clickable and actionable in the future.

タイトル: Intuitive, Useful Software Company-wide
投稿者: Tyler アメリカのQA Manager 情報技術、情報サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Intuitive, Useful Software Company-wide"
良い点: I like the largely intuitive interface and functionality. Creating actions (public/private) are extremely easy as is pasting in-line images, adding attachments and customizing ticket types. Once saved, the formatting of actions are ideal and translate to what the user entered. Not all other ticketing software handles it this well.
改善点: Performance/stability has certainly improved over the years and has become more reliable. Despite that, there are the odd instances of slowness or degraded performance. The reporting could be more robust and easier. The ability to create more than one new (unsaved) ticket simultaneously would be very helpful.

タイトル: Powerful and Flexible, With a Learning Curve
投稿者: Furkan トルコのFounder 認証済みLinkedInユーザー デザイン, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Powerful and Flexible, With a Learning Curve"
良い点: Unity gives you a very complete set of tools for building and testing interactive 3D experiences without constantly moving between different applications. I especially like the flexibility of the editor, the animation workflow, and how quickly you can prototype scenes and interactions. The amount of tutorial-based training and community documentation also makes it much easier to learn unfamiliar features. For smaller projects, I think it offers good value considering how much functionality is included.
改善点: The editor can start to feel heavy as a project becomes more complex, and some settings are spread across different menus or packages. There is also a noticeable learning curve once you move beyond basic tutorials into lighting, optimization, animation systems, and more advanced 3D workflows. Documentation and community support are strong, but getting direct support for very specific technical issues can be less straightforward.

タイトル: Unity, powerful but complex
投稿者: Etân フランスのDeveloper コンピュータ・ゲーム, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Unity, powerful but complex"
良い点: It is a very powerful tool. You can do almost everything with it, whether it's 2D or 3D. The interfaces allows you to work around whatever you want, and the programming language is not too hard to learn. The no code part is also really well made.
改善点: It is very hard to learn. The difficulty curve is really steep, and starting with Unity can be a nightmare. Also, the interface for 2D games is not so good, as it is treated like a 3D one, but in a layered way.

タイトル: NOT THE BEST

タイトル: Unity provides a powerful environment for interactive software development

タイトル: TrueCoach is the best!
投稿者: Sophia アメリカのPhysical Therapist 認証済みLinkedInユーザー プロフェッショナル・トレーニング、コーチング, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "TrueCoach is the best!"
良い点: I love how easy it is to organize a training plan for competitions, including book marking particular days and planning peaking, Deloads, etc.
改善点: Has had some occasional glitches throughout the years but the customer service team has always been great about fixing any issues as they come up.

タイトル: Excellent for 1:1 personal training – less suited for full online coaching
投稿者: Elke ドイツのOwner 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Excellent for 1:1 personal training – less suited for full online coaching"
良い点: I used TrueCoach for almost two years and really enjoyed it. The platform is flexible, the training plan builder works very well, and the customer support has always been excellent. For managing workouts and client communication, it’s straightforward and reliable.
改善点: My coaching focus shifted over time, and I found myself needing more automation around recurring habits, structured check-ins, and additional tools for nutrition coaching. TrueCoach wasn’t designed for that type of workflow, which made it harder to run a 100% online coaching business with a strong emphasis on behavior change.

タイトル: AMAZING PROGRAM!!! Clients love it and so do I!
投稿者: duane カナダのtrainer and founder 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "AMAZING PROGRAM!!! Clients love it and so do I!"
良い点: TrueCoach was a godsend for me to keep training clients during the pandemic. I've never used an online platform for any of my training, but this made it easy for me to program for my clients' needs as well as keep them accountable. They have an extensive library of exercise videos, but you can also add your own or grab a link with youtube etc.- simply amazing! On the client side of things, the feedback I got was "simple to use"; "love the video demonstrations"; "love checking in". If my clients are happy, I'm happy!
改善点: There was nothing I didn't like about this program. It met all my needs, which in turn met my clients' needs too :)

タイトル: An Honest Review from a Real Trainer
投稿者: Casey アメリカのHead Coach/ Owner 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "An Honest Review from a Real Trainer"
良い点: I love the integration with Stripe. That feature alone sold me on the use of TrueCoach. Being able to take client payments and have the client manage their payment method saves me time and makes the onboarding process way less complicated.

タイトル: Great for emails and more
投稿者: Micah アメリカのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 小売, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Great for emails and more"
良い点: It easy to create and maintain email lists and create and send emails.
改善点: There is so much it can do that its hard to find the time to learn it all.

タイトル: Powerful Ecommerce Email Marketing Without the Klaviyo Price Tag
投稿者: Frank カナダのHead of Digital 事務用品、事務機器, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Powerful Ecommerce Email Marketing Without the Klaviyo Price Tag"
良い点: Omnisend delivers a lot of capability for the price, especially since billing is based on active subscribers only. The email builder is excellent—great templates, plenty of design flexibility, and strong tools for keeping everything on‑brand, including branded link tracking, which is better for both branding and deliverability. We also find its segmentation useful beyond email; syncing those segments into Google and Meta ad audiences helps keep our targeting current without manual exporting or relying on extra tools. Integration with BigCommerce is clean, and the back‑in‑stock automation works reliably at the variant level with clear visibility into requests and recovered sales. Documentation is thorough, support has always been good, and the new AI‑powered help widget is surprisingly effective at answering nuanced questions quickly.
改善点: The push notification feature feels too basic for real use because the permission prompt appears immediately when someone visits the site, which can come across as intrusive and not in line with the brand experience we want to create. Without any way to trigger it later in the customer journey, we avoid enabling it. SMS for back‑in‑stock alerts is also limited; while the email version links directly to the specific product a customer requested, the SMS can only send a generic message with no link, which makes it less practical for that workflow.

タイトル: Great Email Platfrom

改善点: I didn't have any issues with the platform, there are some issues you encounter but the support was really strong

タイトル: Too buggy, but keeps costs down
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Too buggy, but keeps costs down"

They claimed to fix it, made me jump through all these hoops to reconnect, and it still broke. So they don't even know how their product works. You need the 24/7 chat support because there are bugs after bugs. And they demand you keep everything in one long thread so it is very hard to find issues if you need to refer back to them.

タイトル: Great email platform

タイトル: Alboom Prosite is the best website builder that I use.
投稿者: Alexander 英国のCompany Director 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 経理, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Alboom Prosite is the best website builder that I use."

Lastly, It is a very affordable platform that allows users to create a website for free.
改善点: I think Alboom Prosite is a great tool only that it is not available to all countries which makes it hard for me to recommend it to my friends from such countries. The features can also be overwhelming when using them for the first time.

タイトル: Alboom Prosite: Empowering Creatives with Stunning Portfolio Websites
投稿者: Jon ベリーズのWeb Developer プロフェッショナル・トレーニング、コーチング, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Alboom Prosite: Empowering Creatives with Stunning Portfolio Websites"
良い点: Alboom Prosite has completely transformed the way I showcase my creative work online. One of the standout positive aspects of Alboom Prosite is its exceptional design flexibility and customization options. The platform offers a wide range of beautifully designed templates that serve as a fantastic starting point for creating a stunning portfolio website. Moreover, the drag-and-drop editor and extensive customization options allow me to tailor my website to reflect my unique style and brand. The seamless integration of media files, such as images, videos, and audio, further enhances the visual impact of my portfolio. Alboom Prosite has truly empowered me to create a professional and visually captivating online presence for my creative work.
改善点: While Alboom Prosite offers an impressive range of design and customization options, there is one negative aspect that I have encountered. The customer support can sometimes be slow in responding to inquiries or resolving issues. There have been instances where I had to wait longer than expected to receive assistance or clarification on certain matters. Improving the responsiveness and timeliness of customer support would greatly enhance the overall user experience.

タイトル: The number 1 CRM platform
投稿者: Hayden 英国のGraphic Designer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "The number 1 CRM platform"

タイトル: Hands down best customer service out there!!

タイトル: A great out-of-the-box platform with a few missing features
投稿者: Lucas アメリカのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 小売, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "A great out-of-the-box platform with a few missing features"

改善点: Out of the box the integration with WooCommerce does not provide live shipping quotes. I can use a third-party plugin to do this, but then I'm paying for the plugin plus Shippo. That's my second issue: Shippo charges $20/mo. and up for their platform, unless your package count is pretty low.

タイトル: A Refreshingly Simple Shipping Platform That Could Use More Depth
投稿者: Jonathan アメリカのFounder アパレル、ファッション, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "A Refreshingly Simple Shipping Platform That Could Use More Depth"
良い点: Shippo is fast, straightforward, and easy to learn. Compared to other shipping platforms we've used, it introduces far less hassle and feels less bloated. Label creation is quick, integrations work well when configured properly, and the overall experience is efficient. For many small businesses, it strikes an excellent balance between functionality and simplicity.
改善点: Shippo's simplicity can also be its biggest weakness. Some of the automation, reporting, and workflow tools feel too basic, especially as shipping volume grows. I frequently find myself wishing for richer features and more advanced controls without having to move to a more complicated platform. It's very good, but there's definitely room for improvement.

タイトル: Increasing costs and complications.

良い点: Too many changes to interface over the years and it’s not as user friendly as it had previously been.
改善点: The shipping rates are not as deeply discounted as they had been when I first implemented this software.

タイトル: Seamless but could use some improvements
投稿者: Michelle アメリカのVP Operations 電気・電子機器製造, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Seamless but could use some improvements"
良い点: Seamless integration into our inventory management system. It makes shipping domestic packages to our customers so much easier by eliminating double entry.
改善点: Inability to ship internationally because we still need to file EEI with USCBP. It would ideal if Shippo can also offer that service, even if it is paid. Another annoying issue is needing to pay for every single shipment with a different credit card transaction when using Shippo's accounts.

タイトル: The only "con" is NOT using Shippo
投稿者: Marc アメリカのRelationship Architect 認証済みLinkedInユーザー マーケティング、広告, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "The only "con" is NOT using Shippo"
良い点: Super easy to use and set up and link your various shipping accounts. They make it almost whimsically easy to "test" the product with a forever free account. Savings for free and paid accounts are the same. Today (May 20, 2021) I saved 32% on USPS and a whopping 62% on UPS!! I have been typically just printing labels from the namesake sites and thought the claims of savings were "up to" claims and the reality was going to be fairly negligible. Think eBay and then they turn around a charge you for buying shipping through them completely negating or making it more expensive to ship through eBay. NOT Shippo! Not only is it free and commission-free but they REALLY do have great rates and the savings are LEGIT not "UP TO" BS but real money! Heck if you are an eBay seller you would be foolish if you didn't give Shippo a whirl! So, in short, I love the money I save, the ease of set-up and use and the customer support is fast and furious. タイトル: Great for a first bike, but you'll grow out of it.
投稿者: Jason アメリカのService Desk Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 建設, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great for a first bike, but you'll grow out of it."
良い点: The turnkey nature of Freshservice is highly desirable for teams and organizations that can't justify spending either a lot of time or payroll on a full/part-time developer. The low to no code environment allows for you to immediate spin up modules and begin processing incidents, requests, etc. The built-in analytics tools allow you to create customized dashboards and reporting for strategic planning on operational metrics.
改善点: As with any turnkey SaaS product its greatest strengths are also the product's greatest weakness. Want to take Fresh's framework and tweak it a bit to meet your needs? Nope. Do you want to customize components of a module entirely operating within the expected limitations of an ITIL product? Negative. Have a feature request? You can submit to the backlog but it might be years before a version of it becomes a reality.

タイトル: Turned our messy ticket process into something that actually flows
投稿者: Mankeshwar インドのSoftware Engineer 情報サービス, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Turned our messy ticket process into something that actually flows"
良い点: Honestly, the thing I appreciate most is that it doesn't feel like you need an IT degree just to use it properly. Setting up ticket categories and assigning them to the right people took barely any effort. What really changed things for our team was the auto-routing - tickets land with the correct agent instantly instead of sitting in some queue waiting for someone to notice them. We also lean heavily on the self-service portal, and it's cut down a surprising chunk of "how do I..." emails since people just search and find their answer. Support tickets that used to take a full day to resolve now often close within a few hours because nothing gets lost in the shuffle.
改善点: If I had to nitpick, the analytics side needs polishing. You can pull basic numbers easily enough, but anything beyond that requires jumping through hoops, and half the time I end up copying data into a spreadsheet just to make sense of it. Notifications are another sore spot - sometimes they're a little delayed, and once or twice agents missed an update because it didn't ping in real time. Also, the sheer number of settings and configuration options can feel overwhelming when you're first setting things up; there's a bit of a maze to navigate before it clicks.

The software file transfer is the best I've tried much faster than the competitors.
改善点: A couple of things that I wish would be improved would be. When comparing to Teamviewer, ISL is considerably slower; if you have them sitting side by side, you will be able to complete tasks almost twice as fast with Teamviewer. When opening UAC within Windows, there is a considerable delay in displaying the Yes and No prompt that doesn't happen with Teamviewer. Multiple monitors work pretty well, but once you get past three monitors, the software starts to fall apart. It's even slower. Also, sometimes, it won't even show dialog boxes in the large zoomed-out view that exists when using Teamviewer. You won't see all the monitors at once, so you will need to toggle each monitor until you are on the right one. Switching monitors is also a drag as it's also very, very slow to display the content of each individual monitor. I've been told that one of the reasons for ISL slowness is that it is more secure than Teamviewer, and while that might be true, I wish they would give the End User the option to have faster speed/less secure or slower speeds more secure.

タイトル: Building with Firebase: Strengths and Limitations for Enterprises
投稿者: Peter ケニアのIT SUPPORT SPECIALIST 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 金融サービス, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Building with Firebase: Strengths and Limitations for Enterprises"
良い点: Google Firebase is a great tool for building and managing web and mobile applications. It is simple to set up and use, which greatly reduces development time. With features like Realtime Database and Firestore, they are very essential when building applications that require real-time updates and offline support. Since Firebase utilizes Backend as a Service (BaaS) model, it eliminates the need to manage servers, and with tools like Firebase Authentication, it makes it easy to implement secure cross-platform login options. The platform's ability to support cross-platform development is a win, this has allowed our Developers to simplify app creation for Android, iOS, and the web. Having Analytics and performance tools, especially Google Analytics and Crashlytics, they provide important insights into user behavior and app stability, helping our Developers make informed decisions and resolve issues quickly.
改善点: At times it feels like using Firebase ties you to the google ecosystem, We have noted it creates an over-reliance to other google services and might pose a challenge if you need to migrate your services to other platforms.

タイトル: Simple, Cost Effective Remote Tool

良い点: Splashtop's main draw for MSP work is cost-effective, fast remote access: it delivers comparable core remote access to competitors like TeamViewer at a lower price with concurrent-technician licensing, which usually wins for cost-conscious MSPs, and it offers high-definition video and audio streaming, cross-platform compatibility across Windows, Mac, Linux, iOS, and Android, and unattended access that lets technicians connect without end-user approval. It's also built for compliance-sensitive environments, with TLS and 256-bit AES encryption plus HIPAA, CCPA, GDPR, and SOC 2 compliance, and integrates with PSA/ticketing tools like Zendesk, Freshdesk, ServiceNow, and Autotask — though it's worth noting it's remote access/support only and would need to sit alongside separate patching, monitoring, and ticketing tools rather than replace them.
改善点: The main drawbacks: it's scope-limited — it handles remote control only, not ticketing, patching, or monitoring, so it works as one piece of a larger stack rather than a full RMM replacement. On the technical side, reviewers note limited compatibility with Linux devices, which reduces usefulness in Linux-heavy environments, and file transfer speeds that lag behind other remote support tools, slowing workflows. Billing can also be a friction point — Remote Access plans (Solo, Pro, Performance) require annual prepayment only, with monthly billing available solely on the Remote Support (SOS) plans.

投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー インターネット, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 ソース：GetApp 共有 "Worst experience we had"
良い点: Nice app, nice design, easy to use, good quality of sound.
改善点: Support and Billing needs to much time to reply. The billing system is not transparent at all. You cannot see the cost of each call in your dashboard. You never know when you will be overcharged. Nobody cares about you after you have signed the contract. They are interested only in your money.

タイトル: Why Talkdesk
投稿者: Leslie アメリカのTalent Support Specialist 消費者サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Why Talkdesk"
良い点: all the different features you can add or take away.
改善点: that it doesn't have a feature for noise cancellation. so that you can control the level of background noise that gets heard by the customer.

タイトル: McCarthy Witchery LTD Till system.
投稿者: Fay 英国のDirector 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 小売, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "McCarthy Witchery LTD Till system."
良い点: very easy to use for our small LTD company. Has everything we need from categories and coloured buttons to easy add and adjust and the ability to find out all our stats and best sellers. payments are always prompt and go straight into our business account keeping everything with in easy reach and easy to keep track off. The features in the back office are amazing and again so easy to navigate and find stats/ best sellers and records. Yes prompt and easy to get a replacement till when the till roll door broke. There's lots of training and advice calls as part of the contract.
改善点: There's lots of adviser calls and calls when you named adviser isn't available which can be over the top when you have already spoken to people. Wasn't made aware that if you don't use your card reader for x days you can be charged. The only real problem we had was the till was set up for a clothes shop and then a fruit and vegetable shop after our initial training on the back office which is neither what we are.

タイトル: brilliant Epos
投稿者: Sarah 英国のaccountatnt 飲食店, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "brilliant Epos"
良い点: Customer support is excellent, always sort out any issues on phone support. have sorted any technical issues.
改善点: cant really say anything i least like, I've had no issues. The service has always been immediately sorted.

タイトル: Unannounced service disruption and poor communication impacting trading
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー ホスピタリティ, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Unannounced service disruption and poor communication impacting trading"
良い点: The system was generally functional when operating as expected and had been suitable for day-to-day EPOS and card payment processing prior to the incident. It integrated with our existing setup for a period of time without major issues.
改善点: Severe lack of communication regarding critical changes affecting payment processing. No prior warning or transition period was provided when functionality was removed, resulting in unexpected business downtime. Support documentation was also inaccurate, directing users to unavailable applications, which added confusion during an already critical situation. Overall handling of the incident demonstrated poor planning, inadequate customer communication, and insufficient support for affected businesses.

タイトル: Great Customer Service
投稿者: Edward 英国のManaging Director 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 小売, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Great Customer Service"
良い点: I have looked at alternative suppliers and Epos Now were the most favourable. They have low fees so they are value for money and they provided us with an e-commerce solution too. Credit Card payments work very well and we receive funds quickly. The software is very easy to use, seems secure and I am impressed with the stock control management of the software.
改善点: I can't think of any negatives really but would appreciate a pro-active stance to improve our till and provide a larger screen. If they had a sales rep calling in once a year I would appreciate that.

タイトル: Happy Customer
投稿者: Sheila アメリカのpartner 飲食店, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Happy Customer"
良い点: customer support was very important to me because I was not very familiar with POS and I needed a lot of help which they gave me. The setup was easy and it has helped me to keep track of my sales better. It also helps me know what product is selling the best.
改善点: I am still learning the system and the things it can do. The only issue that I can think of is that I use I menu for all my streaming and it will not work on this POS.

タイトル: Great HRIS overall
投稿者: Simon カナダのSenior Vice President People and Culture 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 保険, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great HRIS overall"
良い点: UKG Pro does exactly what we need it to do. We really like that it has worked well for us as an "all in one" solution that handles HR, Payroll, Learning, Performance & Talent Management, Compensation, Recruitment & Onboarding etc... While there's no perfect "one size fits all" HRIS, UKG Pro checks a lot of the boxes for us and has been a great system to support our growth and scaling as a department over the last 6 years.
改善点: Ever since the merge between Ultimate and Kronos group, the service and support model has not been where I'd like to see it. Lot's of promises about focus in this area, but yet to see anything come to fruition. Some of the modules UX/UI need improvement and updating - can be a bit clunky.

タイトル: UKG Pro: Where HR Gets Better Every Release!
投稿者: Keith アメリカのGlobal HR Systems Manager 消費者サービス, 5,001～10,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "UKG Pro: Where HR Gets Better Every Release!"
良い点: UKG is not so complex that it requires third‑party vendors to help administer. When organizations are open to adjusting their processes, UKG Pro can streamline and enhance them, making it easier for HR to support the business effectively.
改善点: What I like least about UKG Pro is the way its modules connect. The integrations and APIs don’t always flow smoothly or quickly, which creates gaps in the end‑to‑end experience. Additionally, the look and feel varies from one module to another, and UKG needs to establish more consistency and uniformity across the entire platform.

タイトル: Unreliable and difficult to navigate
投稿者: Patricia アメリカのSenior HR Generalist プラスチック, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Unreliable and difficult to navigate"
良い点: Payroll Processing was seamless and uncomplicated. The onboarding process is also straight forward and seamless.
改善点: Communicating with ukg was a nightmare. The call center can't help you, it takes forever to find help or you won't ever receive any kind of support. Our business was left alone with too many issues. I'm sure the software itself isn't bad, but no one was willing to assist us in making it work for our business. The software was difficult to use and not user friendly. Users couldn't locate benefit enrollment and had issues adjusting tax setup and other info. The missing support for tax setup and filing was a nightmare. The reporting feature was extremely difficult to navigate and reports had missing or incorrect info at times.

タイトル: UKG Pro: Heavy-Duty Payroll, High-Maintenance Tech
投稿者: Marquita アメリカのSALES MANAgER 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 裁判外紛争解決, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "UKG Pro: Heavy-Duty Payroll, High-Maintenance Tech"
良い点: I have been really impressed with the Financial Wellness tools, specifically the ability to provide employees with earned wage access. It empowers our staff by allowing them to pull a portion of their pay ahead of regular cycles, which has been a great benefit for their financial flexibility.
改善点: Obtaining prompt technical resolutions is challenging due to UKG's ongoing changes in account management assignments. This inconsistency hinders effective support and resolution.

タイトル: HCM for the long haul
投稿者: Brian アメリカのIT Project Manager 建設, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "HCM for the long haul"
良い点: This solution has robust capabilities for our 2000 employee company. We have multiple union paygroups with different accruals and benefits packages and UKG Pro is able to handle them all. We have used it for 3 years and renewed.
改善点: We implemented during the time of the Kronos and Ultimate solution merger, so at times there were growing pains, both with the solution and with support.

タイトル: SoGoSurvey is good survey builder
投稿者: Zuhairah マレーシアのMarketing Communications Specialist 認証済みLinkedInユーザー インターネット, 5,001～10,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "SoGoSurvey is good survey builder"
良い点: I really like with SoGoSurvey's analytical report as they has many way to interpreted and presenting the data. I can view the data on charts, pie chart or any other data design that is easy to analyzed and view. The survey template also quite helpful especially when building a survey from the sketch.
改善点: It will be good if they can add more service and software that SoGoSurvey can integrated with. It will help me to managing all the software and service that i use on the one place, thus saving my time from have to accessing and login to each to all the software.

タイトル: Easy, yet powerful and compreensive
投稿者: Jose ポルトガルのLecturer 高等教育, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Easy, yet powerful and compreensive"
良い点: It has all the features that I use, or need, in a very intuitive platform that allows me to focus on my surveys and my research without unwanted distractions. I can use it on my PCs and on my iPad without issues or complications, making it a very useful tool whether I am deploying a survey or teaching my students how to structure or deploy one. The reporting features are getting better with each iteration, although I still tend to use the trouble-free export features to do my own statistical analysis.
改善点: Nothing, really. The frequent updates have been keeping ahead of my expectations.

タイトル: Online survey tool that relies on most other competitors for it's product features
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報サービス, 5,001～10,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Online survey tool that relies on most other competitors for it's product features"
良い点: Customer support is the main thing that I can talk about this survey software. There are a bunch of people who constantly reply to our queries and issues, and get them fixed at high priorities when required. The overall user interface is decent, although, it cannot be compared to the other brands. It provides a wide variety of functionalities and tools and thus seems really great as and overall application. (All under one roof). However, this sometimes looks densely populated when you are looking for one specific function and you have a lot of ways to do the same thing. Creating and distributing surveys is the most basic part, but the reporting features makes the application really stand out!
改善点: It copies a lot of other survey tools and tries to replicate their premium functionalities. The product management team seems to be pretty ordinary with their thinking and cannot go out of the box to widen the scopes of this application. The tools are way too expensive and no comments on how their overall performance or scalability measures are!

タイトル: Easy to Use, Great Features for the Cost
投稿者: Cris ブラジルのAssociate Professor 高等教育, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Easy to Use, Great Features for the Cost"
良い点: It's easy to use and allows me to group multiple questions into one category to report the results to participants. When participants know they will see their results, they are more likely to respond to the survey. I also feel that for the features provided, the software is reasonably priced. My institution purchases Qualtrics, and while excellent, that software is priced beyond the means of typical individual researchers.
改善点: Since I'm so interested in the reporting features for participants, I'd love to see more bells and whistles there - for example, the ability to automatically calculate the overall averages for categories and contrast that average with the participant's would be very helpful. However, I understand that such an advanced feature would be unreasonable for the charged price.

タイトル: An Outstanding Software
投稿者: Vikas Rai インドのChief Action Research Officer 教育管理, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "An Outstanding Software"
良い点: Of all the software I have tried, Sogolytics stands out in terms of functionality and customer service. What more would a student and researcher seek? It is very easy and friendly to build surveys on Sogolytics and the customer service is just EXCELLENT!!!
改善点: Honestly, I have yet to figure out what I did not like in Sogolytics....it is a very thoughtfully designed software and has excellent features.

タイトル: UiPath is great for RPA purposes
投稿者: Anirudh カナダのDevelopment lead 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 銀行, 5,001～10,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "UiPath is great for RPA purposes"
良い点: UiPath has really powerful and easy to use features for RPA. Having used other RPA products in the past I found it very easy to learn especially with the training available on their own website. UiPath customer support and forum are very active so its easy to get help on any specific issues. The collaboration between developers is also great with re-usable components and frameworks as well as synchronization with git and azure for deployments.
改善点: The UiPath Classic interface was easier to use in some ways compared to the modern version and in some cases you cannot get those features back. They are locked under the new modern interface.

タイトル: UI Path - A perfect path to automation
投稿者: Manish カナダのAI and Automation Engineer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "UI Path - A perfect path to automation"
良い点: I liked UiPath’s intuitive design. It made automating complex business processes feel approachable, fast to build, and easy to maintain, even when scaling solutions across teams.
改善点: I liked least the frequent version changes and stability issues, which sometimes broke existing workflows and required extra effort to re-test and maintain automations.

タイトル: Good automation platform with strong AI and bot creation features
投稿者: Arpit インドのIntelligent Automation Developer 情報技術、情報サービス, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Good automation platform with strong AI and bot creation features"
良い点: What I liked most about UiPath is that it keeps improving every year and now it is not only basic RPA anymore. I have used features like Document Understanding, AI Center and Maestro in different projects and they actually helped reduce a lot of manual dependency. Document Understanding was useful for invoice and PDF extraction work where normal bots were failing earlier. I also liked that bot creation has become faster now compared to older versions. The newer AI and coding features save time in workflow building and debugging. UiPath still has some learning curve for advanced things, but overall it feels more complete now for automation, AI and process handling in one platform.
改善点: One thing I did not like much is that AI Center and Document Understanding setup can become confusing in the beginning, specially while training models or handling different document formats. Sometimes extraction accuracy also depends a lot on document quality, so manual checking is still needed in some cases. I also felt Orchestrator and licensing management could be simpler because managing users, bots and permissions takes time in bigger projects.

タイトル: Utilizing Uipath as your company's RPA resource leads to improved efficiency
投稿者: Sadaharu 日本のMarketing Planner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Utilizing Uipath as your company's RPA resource leads to improved efficiency"
良い点: Minimizing costs can be achieved by focusing work on basic tasks. This allows for a wide range of business efficiency services such as technology consulting, business consulting, and customer support. Costs can be minimized by focusing work on basic tasks. This enables a wide range of business efficiency services, such as technology consulting, business consulting and customer support. The robot has an algorithm capable of recognizing images and characters. Thanks to this, the robot can instantly recall new procedures without the need for any preparatory work. Hiring talented, pricey employees will lead to more creative work that improves the overall efficiency of your business.
改善点: A large operating system is required to maintain the expense. It's private but costs a lot. It's necessary to examine what people are doing when implementing RPA closely.

タイトル: Proceed automatically with mechanical paperwork
投稿者: Ana スペインのSecurity Architecture Discipline leader 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 銀行, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Proceed automatically with mechanical paperwork"
良い点: It is possible to create everything from the creation of a simple engraving robot to complete flowcharts. From beginner to expert. From individual work in the office to running hundreds of processes across the enterprise, the balance between price and content is very good. Even in the BtoG world, popularity is high. The interface seems difficult at first glance, but if you study in the online academy, you can make a decent robot.
改善点: There are too many products, making it challenging to distinguish between them. I wish they would make the sales method easier for fans to understand, including the wording on the home page.

タイトル: Powerful but Complex for Pharma Marketing
投稿者: Yuta 日本のManager 薬品, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Powerful but Complex for Pharma Marketing"
良い点: I use Marketo Engage in the pharmaceutical industry, and I appreciate how it streamlines compliance-heavy marketing. The lead scoring and segmentation help us engage HCPs effectively, while CRM integration improves sales follow-ups. Plus, the analytics tools are essential for measuring success in a regulated environment.
改善点: One challenge with Marketo Engage in the pharmaceutical industry is that compliance-driven customization can be complex. Setting up workflows for regulatory approval takes time, and the learning curve is steep. Also, reporting could be more intuitive, especially when tracking multi-channel engagement.

タイトル: Marketo Express - Pricey but woth it
投稿者: Aaron カナダのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー マーケティング、広告, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Marketo Express - Pricey but woth it"
良い点: Marketo Engage is a powerful AI powered marketing and business tool with limitless features designed to help your marketing team stay in sync and optimise campaign effectiveness. Worth the price.
改善点: Quite expensive especially as you scale for the price of similar software. It is fairly complex to navigate.

タイトル: A.Mullican Views on Marketo Engage Utilization
投稿者: Andrew アメリカのOwner デザイン, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A.Mullican Views on Marketo Engage Utilization"
良い点: Marketo Engage facilitates robust marketing automation capabilities which help boost sales and in long run leads to high ROI.
改善点: Ever since I incorporated Marketo Engage, I have never come across bugs when creating, customizing and sending outbound marketing emails.

タイトル: The tool enables professional and targeted communication throughout the entire purchasing process.
投稿者: Luiz Fernando チリのCountry Manager 金融サービス, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "The tool enables professional and targeted communication throughout the entire purchasing process."
良い点: For me personally, Marketo Engage is a true powerhouse among analytics software tools! Its wide range of features is impressive and extremely practical. Customizing reports and exporting them to PDF is incredibly easy. This tool offers a comprehensive and powerful solution for collecting and analyzing data to gain crucial insights into user behavior and website performance.
改善点: I am completely satisfied with Marketo Engage. The user interface is intuitive and user friendly, making navigation and adjusting settings a breeze. The results speak for themselves; our sales have increased significantly since we started using the tool. I have absolutely no complaints and highly recommend it.

タイトル: Long winded email distribution
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー マーケティング、広告, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Long winded email distribution"
良い点: Keeps records and distribution lists up to date as you can easily make updates. Allows for easy approvals by other team members
改善点: Hard to navigate, feels repetitive. convoluted ways of filtering distribution lists which leaves open to error.

タイトル: Visme is Great for Marketing Teams!
投稿者: Meredith アメリカのVP of Marketing 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 小売, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Visme is Great for Marketing Teams!"
良い点: Incredibly easy to use. So many template options - everything from web-based graphics, to social, to large-scale print - I don't know what we did before Visme, honestly.
改善点: There can be tech issues - like it will ask us to sign in multiple times a day, or it won't refresh the projects we're working on. That's by far the most frustrating aspect of the platform.

タイトル: Visme, an awesome platform for making presentations and publishing them easily.
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Visme, an awesome platform for making presentations and publishing them easily."
良い点: One of the most interesting features of Visme is precisely its agility to adapt to the needs of each project, in addition to the fact that it has multiple templates to speed up our work.On the other hand, it interacts perfectly in the Web environment, where we make our updates online, and there are safeguards as we make changes to our project, and it also works perfectly in a local environment, to manipulate our designs offline. Additionally, we can interact with a web environment, for example, and if we want to switch to local mode, Visme makes sure that there are no referential integrity issues and produce some kind of inconsistency. This guarantees continuous and successful work on our projects.
改善点: Visme is undoubtedly an excellent product to generate successful presentations and disseminate our content in a new and fresh way, which often makes the difference, as opposed to organizations that are pigeonholed in traditional tools that are widely used in corporate environments; however, it may be that some other applications on the market have strengthened the collaborative environment even more, and additionally there is a greater number of options to handle multiple formats that are practically considered standards today. Finally, Visme is excellent at what it does and without a doubt is a great application to generate live and impactful content.

タイトル: Great option for creating infographics
投稿者: Karly アメリカのTeacher 初等・中等教育, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great option for creating infographics"
良い点: Visme has exceptional infographic capabilities and templates. They are easy to use and have drag and drop templates that even students can learn quickly.
改善点: The templates are somewhat limited, but overall it is still a great option for creating graphics, especially infographics.

タイトル: Perfect for any graphic design experience level - even complete beginners!
投稿者: Casey アメリカのVolunteer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 非営利団体運営, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Perfect for any graphic design experience level - even complete beginners!"
良い点: Visme is very easy to use, even for someone with no graphic design/technical experience. I created a stunning infographic to display all of my organization's "year in review statistics" without any frustration or confusion. I was able to create a proof of the design and export it to a JPEG file for review. When layout/aesthetic decisions were finalized, I purchased a membership to have access to down a PDF version of the design. I ended up sending the same PDF file to a local print shop where it was printed on a 24x36 foam board - which still appeared in the highest quality that was displayed in my browser. You can't have a high quality print without a high quality file to print from. The first of many great experiences!
改善点: Although it was nice to be able to size the canvas based on a ratio of pixels, it would have been nice to have an additional or alternative a way to size the canvas based on inches/centimeters for easy printing. If there is in fact already a way to do this, I would recommend having the options associated with the 'canvas size' feature.

タイトル: Never regretted it
投稿者: Näzih オーストリアのShop Manager & Data Analyst 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 小売, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Never regretted it"
良い点: Visme is a practical presentation tool that is easy to use, allows for beautiful designs and can impress listeners.
改善点: Except for small technical defects (e.g. undoing actions) and the somewhat limited selection of data analysis tools, there is really nothing to complain about.

タイトル: Agora Pulse - Life Saver CRM
投稿者: Lincoln アメリカのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー インターネット, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Agora Pulse - Life Saver CRM"
良い点: I think the best thing about this tool is the ability to schedule your social media so effectively and the additional analytic tools are a game changer. When you're looking for a tool that unifies your inbox and enhances your collaboration agora, pulse is definitely the way to go
改善点: There really isn't a whole lot not to like here. Some of the report formats are a little bit tricky, and the initial setup can take a moment but those are small things, and they definitely don't overshadow.The big benefits.

タイトル: Good program for the management of social networks, highly recommended.
投稿者: Terry アメリカのDigital Strategy Marketing Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 小売, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Good program for the management of social networks, highly recommended."
良い点: I've used a number of different social media management software, and Agorapulse is far and away the best of the bunch. Even if you have no prior experience with social media marketing, you'll quickly feel at home with the platform because to its user-friendly layout.The digital landscape is constantly shifting, so businesses need tools that can stay up and give them a leg up. That's exactly what Agorapulse does. This is a must-have for companies of any size!Finally, I want to give respect to the Agorapulse help desk staff. They are swift, thorough, and helpful, and they always find a solution to fix the rare problems that arise.
改善点: When I last used the service, not all social media were supported. This could be a problem for brands that use complicated or specialized distribution channels.Their web platform is reliable, but I've found their mobile app to be buggy and less user-friendly than I'd like.

タイトル: Persistent reporting bug, continued billing, and no refunds despite notice
投稿者: Adam アメリカのHead of Ops 認証済みLinkedInユーザー マーケティング、広告, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Persistent reporting bug, continued billing, and no refunds despite notice"
良い点: Clean user interface simple marketed good reporting features Responsive communication from support, but proved unable to solve bugs
改善点: Critical reporting bug persisted for months Continued billing despite written notice to pause No refunds for impacted months; only a small credit and cancellation Bottom line: If accurate Instagram Stories reporting is mission‑critical, validate it thoroughly during a trial and get remedy terms in writing. Our ROI was negative due to unreliable data and added manual work.

タイトル: AgoraPulse is indispensable if you are managing multiple accounts.
投稿者: Emily アメリカのDigital Marketing Specialist 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 航空会社/航空産業, 5,001～10,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "AgoraPulse is indispensable if you are managing multiple accounts."
良い点: I like that this product gives me the number of social profiles I need (35) without having to piece together multiple accounts with a product. It lets me have one dashboard to manage everything that is going on with our social accounts as well as who is mentioning us on their own accounts.
改善点: I don't have a lot to complain about with AgoraPulse. I really have two main complaints. 1. They develop tools that I don't feel are helpful at an enterprise level-such as their integration with Canva. I'm sure Canva is great for a lot of people, but at the agency level, invest in a designer or the correct software to follow your brand guidelines. 2. They have introduced some new features recently that require you to upgrade your account. As a Senior Executive, having immediate access to accurate contact information across devices is essential, and Google Contacts makes this effortless. The platform automatically syncs contacts in real time, making collaboration and communication more efficient. I particularly appreciate its intuitive interface, powerful search functionality, and the ability to organize contacts using labels and groups. The duplicate management feature helps maintain a clean and accurate database, while integration with Gmail, Google Workspace, and mobile devices streamlines daily business operations. Overall, Google Contacts is a dependable and user-friendly solution that enhances productivity and ensures important professional relationships are easily accessible whenever needed.
改善点: While Google Contacts is highly effective for basic contact management, it has some limitations for larger organizations and enterprise users. The customization options for contact fields are somewhat limited compared to dedicated CRM platforms, making it challenging to capture more detailed business-specific information. Additionally, advanced reporting, analytics, and relationship management capabilities are minimal. Another drawback is that managing large volumes of contacts can become cumbersome, especially when multiple teams need structured access controls or shared contact ownership. タイトル: A Useful Calling Platform with Room for Improvement
投稿者: Alex インドのDetailing デザイン, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "A Useful Calling Platform with Room for Improvement"
良い点: CallHippo is convenient for daily calling and makes it easier to manage business conversations in one place. I like having call history and recordings available when needed, especially for reviewing conversations and following up with prospects. The overall interface is straightforward, which makes it useful for sales teams that handle a high volume of calls.
改善点: There is still some room for improvement in call stability and overall performance. Occasional technical issues or delays can interrupt the calling workflow, which can be frustrating when working with clients. Improving consistency and making issue resolution quicker would make the experience much better.

タイトル: A Month of Silence While My Business Calls Went Unanswered
投稿者: Stephen アメリカのConsultant 金融サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "A Month of Silence While My Business Calls Went Unanswered"
良い点: Pros: None that I have experienced. Cons: The service is highly unreliable, with outgoing calls frequently failing to connect and incoming calls often not coming through at all. I have been reporting these issues for over a month without receiving a proper resolution. Customer support lacks urgency and accountability, requiring constant follow-up while providing little meaningful progress. Troubleshooting steps are shared weeks after the issue is reported, and the burden of diagnosing the problem seems to fall entirely on the customer. For a paid business communication service, the reliability and support standards have been extremely disappointing.
改善点: The service has been extremely unreliable. Calls frequently fail to connect, and incoming calls often do not come through at all. What is even more frustrating is the customer support experience. Despite reporting these issues repeatedly, there has been little sense of urgency or accountability from the support team, leaving customers to chase updates and solutions for problems that should have been resolved much sooner.

タイトル: Good platform to manage your calls

良い点: I like user friendly interphase. Easy to make calls, see history, listen call recordings. Commercials could be better.
改善点: Often it happens that sound lags at both caller and receiver's end. Resulting into unpleasant call experience.

タイトル: Good experience overall - but needs improvement.
投稿者: Amy オーストラリアのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Good experience overall - but needs improvement."

改善点: I found some of the videos quite outdated for the exercise demos, I sometimes struggled to find a good form video and so uploaded a lot of my own instead. The integrations were lacking, being able to integrate a android watch would have been beneficial for my clients. I had to go back and forth with the customer support team when I wanted to unlink my Stripe account from Trainerize - I got resolved but could have been smoother and more efficient.

タイトル: My Review of Trainerize

良い点: The platform made delivering structured training programs extremely smooth. I loved being able to upload custom workouts, videos, and progressions so clients could follow their plans clearly and confidently at home or in the gym.
改善点: Some clients found the app confusing at first, especially older adults or individuals unfamiliar with fitness apps, which required extra onboarding time.

タイトル: Okay Product
投稿者: Maegan アメリカのOwner 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Okay Product"
良い点: I like the ability to schedule in the calendar and even schedule auto messages. That feature is really nice and missing on a lot of platforms.

It would be nice to have the same food database in Trainerize so clients who eat out don't have to use MFP. The ongoing problems have made my job longer and more tedious, because I have to individually go into each person MFP and calculate averages myself.

タイトル: One stop shop
