タイトル: Fast, practical and very useful for everyday translations
投稿者: Fabrizio イタリアのStrategy Consultant 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 医療機器, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Fast, practical and very useful for everyday translations"
良い点: What I like most about Google Translate is its speed and ease of use. It allows me to translate words, sentences, and longer texts almost instantly, and it is especially useful when traveling or communicating in different languages. I also appreciate features such as voice translation, camera translation (very useful for product label) and, especially, the mobile app.
改善点: The main limitation is that translations are not always completely accurate, especially with technical terminology, complex sentences or some slang expression. When I use it for traslate professional documents in English or Italian, I always need to review the translation carefully before using it.

タイトル: Easy and fast everyday translation tool
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 消費財, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Easy and fast everyday translation tool"
良い点: Google translate is a good platform for easy translation with a low learning curve. The best thing about Google Translate is that it is worth every penny for the features it provide. The features like text and file management makes easy translation of copied text and other documents without any manual work. Translation speed and performance are also it's strong points as it take just few seconds in translating and that too in multiple languages.
改善点: The major thing I worry while using Google Translate is the privacy. I barely feel that my personal and confidential data is secure so, I avoid using Google Translate for something confidential. Also I occasionally noticed some bugs and issues while translating large text.

タイトル: Breaking Language Barriers in Just a Few Seconds
投稿者: Sudeep カナダのSr. Accountant 不動産, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Breaking Language Barriers in Just a Few Seconds"
良い点: What I like most about Google Translate is how quickly it helps me understand words, sentences, and messages in different languages. It's especially useful when I come across unfamiliar phrases or want to communicate with someone who speaks another language. I like that I can type text, use voice input, translate images, and listen to pronunciations without much effort. The conversation and camera translation features are also convenient when travelling or trying to understand signs and menus. It's simple to use, free for most everyday needs, and saves me a lot of time.
改善点: Sometimes the translations sound unnatural, especially when dealing with idioms, slang, or sentences that depend heavily on context. I have also noticed that longer passages may lose some of their original meaning. While the basic interface is easy to use, I would appreciate clearer explanations of alternative translations and more guidance on choosing the right wording. Improving accuracy for less commonly spoken languages would make it even more useful

タイトル: A lifesaver for communication in my daily work and life
投稿者: Manpreet カナダのPhysiotherapist 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A lifesaver for communication in my daily work and life"
良い点: What I like most about Google Translate is how quickly and accurately it helps bridge language barriers. The conversation, voice, and camera translation features are incredibly convenient and easy to use. It has helped me communicate with people I otherwise would not have been able to understand, making my work as a healthcare professional easier and improving my interactions with patients and their families. It has become one of those apps that I rely on regularly and always keep on my phone.
改善点: The only drawback I have experienced is that very technical or complex conversations are not always translated perfectly, so I sometimes need to rephrase sentences to make them clearer. The app also works best with an internet connection, although offline translations are useful in many situations. Even with these small limitations, it has been an invaluable tool in both my professional and personal life.

タイトル: Google Translate does the job well for automatic Help Centre and Customer Feedback Translation
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 海運, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Google Translate does the job well for automatic Help Centre and Customer Feedback Translation"
良い点: Easy API integration with Intercom and AppFollow enables automatically refreshed customer help articles to be published and developer responses to customer feedback to be sent in the customer's native language. This is important to ensure our customers can read our help content and feedback replies easily, to improve the effectiveness of both.
改善点: While Google Translate's APIs do an excellent job of translating language, there are certain instances where it would be helpful to have more powerful tools for configuring specific technical terms and words specific to our industry to be auto-translated correctly, so context isn't lost. At times, though Google Translate has provided transparent passthrough of HTML with no issue, we have had issues with content tags not being accepted via API for Intercom, which means that formatting of tables and rich text has been lost via automatic translation. This is an Intercom issue though, not Google.

タイトル: Canto is a fantastic asset management tool
投稿者: Craig アメリカのConsultant of Continuous Improvement 保険, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Canto is a fantastic asset management tool"
良い点: I often create visual (mostly infographics) and video content that’s widely distributed around my company and sometimes externally. With that said, what I like most about Canto is how easy it helps me find essential brand assets and guides. The auto-tagging and version control features stand out because the some of the assets change quite often. Without Canto’s easy-to-understand UI, I’d be left behind using old media in my new creations.
改善点: As a user I have few issues to report. However, I know that Canto is on the more expensive side and there were some questions about how quickly we’d see a return on our investment. Thus far, it’s been worth the cost and more.

タイトル: A robust and user-friendly DAM that supports growing creative teams

From a studio perspective, it’s particularly good at enabling wider teams to self-serve assets without constant oversight from design. Customer support has also been consistently responsive and helpful during onboarding and ongoing use.
改善点: Very few downsides in day-to-day use. As with any DAM, ongoing organisation and tagging require discipline, but the platform provides the right tools to do this well.

タイトル: Steady in keeping track and managing the money.
投稿者: Nguyen H. アメリカのDeputy Service Manager ファシリティサービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Steady in keeping track and managing the money."
良い点: With Zoho Books, we've streamlined our service contract management and client billing process. I really enjoy the fact that it is possible to customize invoices according to distinct customer contracts, with both recurring and one payment. The bank feed connection has saved us hours a month working on reconciling transactions. It's got everything that we need for a small team like ours for the price.

We would also like to see the mobile application have more editing functionality, so you can edit an invoice on-site when working remotely. Customizing reports could be more flexible at times, but it's not a dealbreaker. Certain operations such as importing bulk data are a bit cumbersome.

改善点: I only have complaints about the mobile. We want to manage and see proper analytics on the go but we currently can't do that.

タイトル: Captivate Prime - getting better
投稿者: Tony 英国のDirector Eラーニング, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Captivate Prime - getting better"
良い点: The product is evolving and starting to become a lot easier to use - a simple PDF manual would also help to bring new administrators on. It does the job well and the licencing is flexible. It is so much improved from around 18 months ago. I have found the product easier to manage and the addition of some simple features like deletion of modules has made content easier to catalogue and manage.
改善点: The product still has not adopted to meet commercial training provider needs, there is no paywall for example. There are also some simple things that commercial training providers need - after much discussion with ADOBE ACROBAT PRO DC teams, the pdf security (no printing or copy/pasting settings) are undone by PRIME when content is loaded (users can simply highlight, copy and paste content). This means a student or anyone accessing the programme can easily copy/paste content. This simply creates the capacity for IP loss. Its a small change I suspect - but critical in protecting IP for commercial providers. In the end I have had to use a workaround with MP4s. Support on the PRIME side was contradictory - despite ACROBAT testing the feature.

タイトル: Adobe Captivate Prime - Make Sure You vet them well
投稿者: Herb アメリカのLeadership Development 金融サービス, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Adobe Captivate Prime - Make Sure You vet them well"
良い点: The user experience is strong and the look of the platform is very eye appealing. You can customize tiles by your own images and branding. The UX can be customized to your organization colors as well. SSO has worked very well for users.
改善点: Integration in Workday has taken 2.5 years to resolve and they advertised it would instantly work. There are a lot of reports but they only come in excel files and if you want something more comprehensive, you need a strong analyst or a Power BI license with someone who knows how to extrapolate data into dashboards. The dashboards in ACP are on a day lag for reporting. The basic calendaring functions for live or virtual classes (send out invites, update invites, cancel meetings) is the most basic function and is still inconsistent/unreliable for us. Their support team takes extensive time to resolve problems or never resolves them or takes them a long time to provide a work-around or just acknowledge they cannot fix something.

It appears that the software will all set an actual date due.

タイトル: A solid platform and a rising star
投稿者: Rasmus Bernt アメリカのExternal Senior Management Consultant (Time Limited Assignment) 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 経営コンサルティング, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "A solid platform and a rising star"
良い点: I love how ambitious the team is, and how solid and well thought out new features are, when they are rolled out. The CS content planner give you a nice and easy to use overview. While the system has a very strong 'Content Discovery and Insights' feature, it also post to several social channels (9 at the moment if I remember right). Their 'Automation Recipes' module is quite unique and let you find, schedule and post relevant content on autopilot, based on the rules you setup. As any serious tools it is also important that CS include 'approval features', so wrong content don't go online
改善点: As for almost every tool who have entered the market within the last years, Content Studio don't allow direct posting to Instagram. It has nothing to with the tool or the team behind, as they have worked extremely hard to make this happen. IG have simply 'closed the door' temporary, and don't let relative new tools get the needed access to their API. However I know the team continue to work with IG, but also look for any legit alternative. I would love you could post the same posts in more than 1 language (so your followers can read your post in their own language), and as far as I understand, this is already on their road map.

タイトル: [LiquidPlanner Classic] Decent product, feels dated
投稿者: Jason カナダのSr Director, Ops コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "[LiquidPlanner Classic] Decent product, feels dated"
良い点: We use LiquidPlanner to track ongoing tasks and client budgets/burn rates. In this regards, it is easy to set up clients, projects, and tasks, and from there, to log our efforts to those tasks.
改善点: Given that prioritization works by the 'higher' a task is in the list, the greater priority it is given, prioritization has been difficult as we list projects alphabetically. That means that all tasks in project "A" will be prioritized over project "Z". We've had to create separate packages for prioritization, which leads to a lot of overhead.We have a lot of 'retainer' type clients, who have monthly budgets. We need to track ongoing work, as well as remaing budgets. In order to calculate how much is remaining in some of our reports, we have had to create tasks with assigned roles (such as "Sr Consultant" or "Jr Consultant") to 'hold' time on accounts for specific skills sets, and then, on a daily basis, go and update those 'holding' tasks. We have validated with LP support and they felt this was the easiest approach, but again, leads to a lot of overhead.The platform has not really changed since I have been using it (the last 6 years). A new version of LiquidPlanner is rolling out, but would require a full migration in order to benefit from new features. We have seen some other platforms that appear to offer significant upgrades in certain areas.

タイトル: Automotive Owner/Tech

The information available helps me better understand my options and make informed decisions. Most importantly, I like having control throughout the process. ARI gives me the ability to stay involved, make decisions, and manage things in a way that works best for me.
改善点: What I like least about ARI is the constant changes that can sometimes make it difficult to keep up with new processes, features, or updates. However, I do understand that updates and changes are necessary to improve the system and provide a better experience. While the frequent changes can take some time to get used to, I appreciate that ARI is continuing to evolve and make improvements. I would just prefer for changes to be communicated clearly and consistently so that everyone has enough time to understand and adjust to them.

タイトル: Excellent CRM, Easy to Use

タイトル: A CRM I actually use
投稿者: Stacy アメリカのExecutive Recruiter エグゼクティブ・オフィス, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "A CRM I actually use"
良い点: I started using Less Annoying CRM when I launched my own recruiting business, and I had the entire thing built out and working for me within about a week. That was probably the biggest selling point. I’ve used much more complicated systems, and I didn’t want a CRM that required me to spend half my time managing the CRM. LACRM is simple, straightforward and does what I need it to do. I can see where every search stands, keep track of candidates and clients, and find the information I need without digging through layers of unnecessary features. Is there an occasional feature I wish it had? Absolutely. But I’ll take a system that I actually use every day over one with 100 features I don’t need. And whenever I’ve had a question, I’ve gotten help from an actual person who knew what they were talking about. The name is pretty accurate. It really is less annoying.
改善点: There are a few features I occasionally wish it had, but that’s the tradeoff for keeping the system simple. I’d much rather have a CRM that does what I need and is easy to use than one overloaded with features I’ll never touch.

タイトル: Great email platform for small businesses watching their costs
投稿者: Jaime アメリカのArtist 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 美術、工芸, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Great email platform for small businesses watching their costs"
良い点: To be honest, the thing I like most is that EmailOctopus is free. As a small art business, I watch costs very closely. I like that my account with EmailOctopus will grow only as I grow. As I grow my list, which means I have more opportunity to earn more, then I don't mind paying for features that I'll probably need down the line. Also, it's a simple to use platform which I appreciate. I have easy access to my data (my list). Another thing that I like is that they implement a verification process to get into my account. It's simple and fast yet gives a sense of protection that I want.
改善点: Some things I like least about EmailOctopus would be that I don't have access to my data reports for each individual campaign for very long. I think it's 2 weeks. However, they do give you the option to download them as a csv which is nice. You just need to catch it in time and download. Of course if you upgrade to a paid version you have access to your data at any time. Not having long term access is a price I'm willing to pay at the moment. The emails are fairly simple to make, however as a past graphic designer, I find myself wondering why the platform won't do a certain thing design wise but it's never been a big deal. Purely esthetics.

タイトル: Very happy with the campaign features!
投稿者: Bri アメリカのPresident 美術、工芸, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Very happy with the campaign features!"
良い点: EmailOctopus is straightforward and easy to use, which is probably what I appreciate most. The interface is drag and drop or click to add and it formats perfectly with no coding or complex design skills needed. I’m a small business owner and I don’t have time to fight with complicated email software just to send something to all of my customers. It gives me the tools I actually need to create nice-looking emails, manage my list and send campaigns without feeling overwhelming. I also really appreciate the pricing compared with some of the bigger email marketing platforms. I was able to import my previous client account lists from another provider very easily and I can one click remove or add new emails/customers as I need. I’ve reached out to customer support only a couple times and the response is very quick. Often I can search for help topics on what I’m looking for as well and the videos/ reviews online are very helpful. The security is sound and I feel confident sending my campaigns. When someone asks to unsubscribe, the platform alerts me and I can take care of it quickly. This security makes me feel better knowing I can comply with marketing rules and regulations quickly and be notified to make the change immediately.
改善点: There are a few areas where it feels a little more basic than some of the larger email marketing platforms, especially when it comes to more advanced features and customization of campaign fields and colors, but honestly it hasn’t been a deal breaker for me. It does what I need it to do.

タイトル: Joomla 6 so much better than prior version
投稿者: Bradley アメリカのIT Director 情報技術、情報サービス, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Joomla 6 so much better than prior version"
良い点: We use Joomla across both internal and external sites, and it’s been a very solid platform for that. What stands out most is the flexibility—you can build pretty much anything you need without fighting the system. The extension ecosystem is a big plus. There’s usually a third-party solution available for what we need, and it’s easy to plug in functionality without reinventing the wheel. That’s saved us a lot of development time over the years. It’s also modular in a way that works well for an IT team. You can structure things cleanly, scale sites as needed, and maintain consistency across multiple environments without a lot of overhead.
改善点: The biggest drawback is that it can be a bit heavier to manage compared to simpler CMS platforms. There’s a learning curve, especially for non-technical users, and even basic changes can require some familiarity with how Joomla structures things. Extension quality can also vary. While the ecosystem is a strength, not all third-party plugins are maintained equally, so you have to be selective and stay on top of updates to avoid issues. Upgrades between major versions have improved, but they can still require planning and testing, especially if you rely on multiple extensions. It’s not a “set it and forget it” platform—you need to actively manage it to keep everything running smoothly.

良い点: Deploying custom Playwright crawlers directly through the CLI eliminated our need to manage self-hosted browser clusters and residential proxy pools manually. We frequently chain specialized Store actors with our custom Python scrapers using the SDK, which cut our pipeline delivery time from weeks to days. The native MCP server also lets our AI agents discover actors and inspect schemas directly during development. It consistently saves our team around 20 engineering hours each month on scraping infrastructure.
改善点: Parameter schemas and input naming conventions vary across third-party Store actors, which requires extra schema verification during pipeline setup. タイトル: Cin7 or the others.
投稿者: Angelo アメリカのCEO 小売, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Cin7 or the others."
良い点: Inventory management in Cin7 gives a very clear and precise overview of our business. Managing inventory by using Cin7 is super easy and clear. We always had issues with gaining a bird eye view of our inventory with other past inventory softwares, but Cin7 gives a complete snapshot and details for our inventory, as we are a product-based company, inventory asset is the most valuable asset to us. Inventory tracking with Cin7 is very detailed! We can trace the sales order back to its source, which stock we used for a particular sales order. If there's quality issues or any other issues arise with a sales order, we know which batch or purchase order the stock comes from and we could perform quality inspections to the entire batch or purchase to prevent the same issue arising again, which ensures customer satisfaction. Inventory tracking at each location is also extremely detailed, it may not be the most user friendly (even though it's already very user friendly), but it gives a very detailed information of tracking every single unit we have on every single location, including Amazon FBA. Cin7 has some reports or functionalities for replenishment and re-ordering, but these features are a bit simpler than I though it would be. Improvements could be made on to these functionalities for sales demand forecasting, reordering based on lead time and safety stock. Currently, we use Inventory Planner to predict, forecast, and reorder our inventory.
改善点: The software integrates with ShipStation for label printing, there're multiple extra steps for our warehouse team to print the shipping label from ShipStation, rather than directly in Cin7. ShipStation only expose carrier packages, instead of custom package types via API, which we couldn't select the custom package types in Cin7's WMS app for direct label printing. And the workflow for packing and shipping in WMS could be improved, a lot to be improved. Custom product label needed to write CSS code. We print product or purchase order label on different label size and that took me 6 hours to write, since my major in university is not computer science.

良い点: ZeroBounce is super easy to use, it's more affordable than competitors, and the quality is generally higher than others. The one time we needed customer support, they were actually very helpful. They have multiple features to their verification that others don't that allow us to be extra cautious if we want to really protect our sending authority.
改善点: There's really not much to not like. I do wish it was easier just to pay-as-you-go rather than buying bulk credits or subscribing. We have a lot of variability that makes it hard to commit to a subscription at the volume we need sometimes.

タイトル: An Essential Tool for Cleaner Email Lists and More Confident Outreach
投稿者: Adam アメリカのManaging Partner 情報技術、情報サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "An Essential Tool for Cleaner Email Lists and More Confident Outreach"
良い点: We use ZeroBounce regularly to validate email lists before launching outreach campaigns. What I like most is that it helps us make better decisions about which addresses to email. We can remove invalid addresses, flag abuse and “Do Not Mail” contacts, and evaluate catch-all addresses to decide whether they are worth including. It takes much of the guesswork out of cleaning our lists and gives us more confidence in our outreach.
改善点: We haven’t had any major drawbacks with the email validation service. One feature we’d love to see added is validation of personal LinkedIn profile URLs. We use both email and LinkedIn for outreach, so being able to verify both in one platform would make our list preparation even easier.

タイトル: Lost time is never found, avoid all this by managing time with TimeCamp.

良い点: TimeCamp gives me the ability to analyze my daily routine which gives me important insights about how am spending my time which includes areas where am falling short of managing time. This gives me a start off in optimizing my performance and become more accountable. We also use it as team during projects to track our time usage and relating this with the budgeted time, we get to improve on our work by speeding up the lagging areas.
改善点: Up to this point, all has been going on well with TimeCamp and i have nothing that i have liked least about it.

タイトル: Great tool for time tracking your projects
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー インターネット, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Great tool for time tracking your projects"
良い点: I fist tried the trial version of this program which is long enough (30 days) and offers a very good overview of all the features of the tool and how much they can be useful (even when you have not consider them before!). Other similar tools are very restrictive with their features during this period. TimeCamp allows you to track the time spent on a project by an employee. It allows you to have multiple seats with different permissions and create multiple projects that can be divided in tasks. It is also possible to allocate just some of the team members to a project . It is not only possible to track projects but idle time and attendance. Reports are are very complete and have many options to filter and present the data you need. The Dashboard allows you to be updated very fast The tool is very user friendly and can be set up just in a few minutes.
改善点: I have tried the Desktop time tracker, which is a nice idea but you are not able to do many things from the widget so you will often have to come back to the website. It would be nice to have the possibility to switch projects or creates new ones directly from there.

タイトル: Company has disreputable billing practices
投稿者: Shana カナダのAccountant デザイン, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Company has disreputable billing practices"
良い点: Our staff like the ease of use of the product for time tracking.
改善点: Billing practices. Apparently they do not offer refunds. In the beginning we were paying monthly, but switched to annual billing. We realized when renewal came around that 1/2 our users were no longer using the software so we cancelled those users. However, when I contacted the company about a refund, they said they would hold the credit toward future subscriptions (but we are moving away from Timecamp so this is not helpful), but they do not offer refunds. So in other words, they are taking our money for something we aren't using. If we had stuck with monthly billing, this would not have been a problem. So word of warning - stick with monthly billing so you can cancel and avoid the issue we had.

タイトル: TimeCamp is a very quick and easy-to-use tool for time tracking

タイトル: Auto-Renew Trap and Canned Responses
投稿者: Leo アメリカのCFO 出版, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Auto-Renew Trap and Canned Responses"
良い点: The dashboard shows each individual's productivity. This helped us quickly see across departments the work and focus of our employees
改善点: DO NOT DO BUSINESS WITH THESE PEOPLE! All they seem to care about is locking customers into auto renewal and charging for another full year, whether you are using the product or not. In my case, the business division using ActivTrak no longer existed, the service was no longer needed, and instead of working toward a reasonable resolution, they kept repeating the same contract language and avoided directly answering my questions. What frustrated me most was not just the invoice, it was the canned responses. I asked for the signed order form, the renewal details, and clear answers to specific billing questions. Instead, I got the same recycled explanation about notice periods. If you do business with ActivTrak, watch your renewal date very carefully, because once they renew you, do not expect much flexibility or a real conversation. My experience was that billing enforcement mattered a lot more than customer goodwill.

タイトル: Lied to my face
投稿者: Calvin アメリカのMarketer マーケティング、広告, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Lied to my face"
良い点: Tidio’s chatbot system is easy to set up and very user-friendly. The interface is clean, and the templates make it simple to get started even if you’re new to automation or chatbots. It integrates smoothly with websites, email, and calendar tools, and overall the software itself works as advertised. From a product standpoint, it’s reliable and flexible for small businesses that want to automate customer responses or appointment booking. I also liked that it has several features included without requiring a developer to get it running quickly.
改善点: Unfortunately, communication and support were a major disappointment. After joining the Tidio Partner Program, I was told that my account would be upgraded, but after several follow-ups, no one ever responded. The product is solid, but the partner communication and support process were extremely poor. It’s frustrating to be invited to participate in a partnership program, make time for meetings, and then be completely ignored afterward. Good software loses its value when the people behind it don’t follow through on promises or maintain proper communication. That was the worst part of my experience.

タイトル: BUYER BEWARE
投稿者: David アメリカのOwner 飲食店, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 ソース：SoftwareAdvice 共有 "BUYER BEWARE"
良い点: Ease of use for administration and the team. Ability to have reports auto emailed to the appropriate people.
改善点: Buyer Beware! We had an issue where our team could not redeem the reward for new customers on one of our replaced clover flex devices. No big deal, we called clover support, they took down a bunch of information, and we waited for a reply. It went months and haven't heard a thing. When I called to check on the case number, they told me that it was closed. Pretty strange since no one called me and we were still having the issue. They reopened the case and we continued to wait, patiently. It got to be the 6 month mark and their solution was to reset the device. This didnt work so we asked for a replacement under warranty. We were advised that we were 2 weeks out of our warranty expiration! Seriously?! We gave the courtesy of giving their team 6 MONTHS to fix the problem and they won't honor the warranty? Fast forward a month and the more I thought about it the more angry it would make me. We are a multi-location business with many many clover devices, all of them work perfectly with the rewards program. I enter another support ticket, hoping someone will be able to help. I receive an email stating there is no item attached to that reward. Impossible since the other 20-some devices work just fine. I follow their steps and now we have 1 device that works and the rest do not! I called support to bring this to their attention and they tell me they will get back to me in 3 business days. They do not care about the merchants. We WILL be switching to Square.

タイトル: Reliable SEO platform with strong rank tracking and easy navigation
投稿者: Hemkesh インドのSenior Digital Marketing Team Lead 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Reliable SEO platform with strong rank tracking and easy navigation"
良い点: Ahrefs is very strong in rank tracking and competitor research. I can clearly see keyword positions and how they change over time. The navigation inside the tool is clean and easy, so moving between Site Explorer, Keywords Explorer and reports feels smooth. For website management, it helps me quickly audit pages, links and content gaps from one place. From a security point of view, access control and account management feel reliable for professional use. It also supports team collaboration well, because multiple people can review the same data and reports easily.

Some reports are powerful but not explained clearly, which can slow down work for new users. For customer support, responses are helpful, but sometimes not fast enough when you are working on urgent client projects.

タイトル: Declining quality of data since 2023
投稿者: Jana ブラジルのConsultant 認証済みLinkedInユーザー マーケティング、広告, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Declining quality of data since 2023"
良い点: We are still a paying user of Ahrefs at TheoryDigital but honestly, there's less and less to like. I have been extensively using the keyword research tool though, to produce writing prompts. That's the only thing that's keeping me there.
改善点: They quit tracking niche keywords in like 2023, probably because of the server cost. So for websites in tiny niches the traffic would routinely be estimated as 0 unless you ranked on major, mainstream keywords. This costed webmasters agency business because some agencies had a process where they evaluated traffic based on Ahrefs and would not accept any alternative way. And now in 2025 they no longer track any positions that rank at over 10th place in Google, because the forced pagination in Google API would make their costs also prohibitive.

I think just about everyone will find their own fairly unique way of doing the reporting they need but unlike some of the competition - that's fantastic! タイトル: I can't use this
投稿者: Adam アメリカのWorkforce Manager 消費財, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "I can't use this"
良い点: Support is responsive and helpful for things that work. Reporting for phones is decent. It's good to have everything all in one (ACD, IVR, WFM, QA).
改善点: You can only forecast LEGACY email and chat with CXone. If you went with Digital (DFO) chat and email, like we did at NICE's recommendation, then you can't forecast email and chat in CXone. The next logical step would be to build your own model with historical data. But the reports out of CXone do not provide interval level historical data (AHT, SL, RR, none of it). You can get totals by channel by day, but not by interval. There are only two reports in CXone Reports that provide data on digital contacts. There's an interval report in the Performance Management section, but if you enter a range beyond 1 day, the interval data is in aggregate, which is to say, pretty much useless. Multiply the number of skills by channels, and that's how many reports you'd have to pull each day. If you don't know how to work with APIs, you're out of luck and you'll have to pull a resource to help. Their regular support team can help with non-DFO. Their advanced support team that costs a pretty penny per 15 minutes, has only surface level knowledge of DFO. If you have trouble using their tool, they will refer you to their APIs. So you either have to take time out of your busy day/life to learn how to use APIs or lean on one of your internal resources who knows how to use them, if you even have any.Their Fall '23 release is supposed to address a lot of these issues, but NICE was not forthcoming with any of the above, we had to figure all of this out on our own.

改善点: The biggest drawback is that large projects can slow things down quite a bit. Since the takeover by Banzai, communication from the development team has also noticeably decreased, which used to be one of the strongest positives of the platform. I also think it’s important to be transparent about the pricing structure: the base software is useful on its own, but access to the extensive asset catalog requires a subscription, and AI features require credits. タイトル: Comprehensive Project Management Solution with Exceptional Resource Control
投稿者: Divyam インドのQuality Analyst 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Comprehensive Project Management Solution with Exceptional Resource Control"
良い点: The standout feature is hands-down the advanced resource forecasting and financial tracking. Having deep capacity planning built right into the core platform—without forcing you to rely on expensive third-party plugins—gives us total clarity on team utilization, prevents burnout, and offers great oversight of overall project profitability.
改善点: The biggest drawbacks are the heavy initial setup process and the dense, slightly dated user interface. Customizing workflows, reports, and onboarding new team members takes significantly more time and effort than it should, and the mobile experience definitely needs a modern refresh to keep up with remote workflows.

タイトル: Powerful project management that punches above its weight
投稿者: Nathaniel アメリカのSales 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Powerful project management that punches above its weight"
良い点: Celoxis is one of the most complete project management platforms I've used. The Gantt charts are genuinely powerful — full dependency tracking, critical path analysis, and resource leveling that you usually only find in much more expensive tools. The reporting and dashboards are a standout feature; being able to build custom reports and share them with stakeholders without exporting to Excel saves a ton of time. I also appreciate how much flexibility there is in project planning — you can handle waterfall, agile, or hybrid approaches without feeling like the tool is fighting you. The resource management module is solid too, making it easy to see who's overloaded and rebalance workloads across projects.
改善点: The interface feels dated compared to newer project management tools. It's functional, but the UI could use a modern refresh — navigating between sections isn't always intuitive, especially for new team members who are used to tools like Asana or Monday. The learning curve is steeper than average because of how feature-rich it is, which means onboarding takes longer. The mobile experience is also limited; it works for checking status but actually managing projects on the go isn't practical. Some of the more advanced customization options require digging through settings menus that aren't well organized.

タイトル: Celoxis review

It makes it easy to review requests, prioritize them based on business needs, and see whether we have enough resources to take them on. The customizable fields and workflows are also helpful because we can set them up around our own processes.
改善点: The initial setup can take some time, especially when customizing workflows, fields, and ranking rules. It takes a little time to understand all the options, but once everything is configured, it becomes much easier to use.

タイトル: Excellent data engine for tracking performance, but needs better visual reporting
投稿者: Rahul インドのData Analyst 金融サービス, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Excellent data engine for tracking performance, but needs better visual reporting"
良い点: I primarily use Celoxis to monitor the financial health of our entire portfolio. As a data analyst, I need to see how our total budget, actual spend, and projected margins are tracking across twenty different initiatives simultaneously. The portfolio dashboards make it incredibly easy to see which projects are eating up our margins and which ones are delivering the best ROI. What I find most valuable is the portfolio-level financial forecasting. It lets me run cost-benefit analyses across different project categories, so when leadership asks where we should allocate our capital next quarter, I can back up my recommendations with solid portfolio performance data.
改善点: While Celoxis is incredibly powerful, the user interface feels pretty dated and clunky compared to newer tools like Monday.com. There is a steep learning curve for non-technical team members, so I often have to hand-hold people just to get them to log their hours or update task statuses correctly. If your team isn't tech-savvy, onboarding them is going to be a struggle. Also, the mobile app is pretty limited—it's fine for quickly checking a task, but you definitely can't do any heavy portfolio analysis or serious reporting on it

タイトル: Basic needed video editor for enterprise
投稿者: Edwin カナダのDEV Manager 金融サービス, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Basic needed video editor for enterprise"
良い点: Adobe Premiere Pro has been my main video editor on my Mac for a long time because it gives me almost everything I need in one application. The timeline is flexible, making it easy to organize multiple video and audio tracks without feeling limited. I especially like the Essential Graphics panel for creating titles and lower thirds without opening another program. The color correction tools are powerful, and Lumetri Color makes it simple to improve footage from different cameras so everything matches. Audio editing is also surprisingly good. Features like automatic speech enhancement, noise reduction, and audio mixing save a lot of time when working with interviews or voiceovers. Project creation is straightforward because templates, sequences, and bins help keep large projects organized. I also appreciate how well Premiere Pro works with other Adobe applications such as After Effects and Photoshop. Dynamic Link is one of my favorite features because I can update graphics without constantly exporting files. Customer support has been helpful whenever I searched Adobe's documentation or community forums, and security updates are released regularly, giving me confidence that the software stays reliable. While the subscription is not cheap and you can not buy 1 time amount, I feel the value for money is reasonable if you edit videos frequently or professionally because of the number of advanced features included.
改善点: The biggest frustration for me is that Premiere Pro can be pretty demanding on my computer. If I'm editing long 4K videos with a lot of effects, playback starts to lag unless I create proxy files first. It works fine after that, but it's an extra step I'd rather not deal with. I've also had the program crash a few times while exporting or after working for a couple of hours. Thankfully, auto-save has saved me more than once, so I never lost an entire project. Another thing I don't love is the monthly subscription. There are months when I barely edit anything, but I'm still paying for it. I also think some updates are hit or miss. Every once in a while a new version introduces a bug that wasn't there before, and I end up waiting for Adobe to release another update. Customer support is okay, but honestly I've solved more problems by searching the Adobe Community forums than by contacting support directly.

タイトル: A Recruiting team's best friend
投稿者: David アメリカのDirector, Talent Acquisition 不動産, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 ソース：SoftwareAdvice 共有 "A Recruiting team's best friend"
良い点: Since we implemented Jobvite, it has been a valuable asset to the Lewis organization, not just the Recruiting team, but to hiring managers and employees. From it's easy-apply features for candidates to its reporting functions to show ROI and /source hiring data, my team and I have been very pleased. The feedback we received from managers and staff have been positive. New employees (with simple training) pick up its features quickly and start using Jobvite right away for interviews, candidate evaluations, social sharing and/or referrals.
改善点: Jobvite has a robust reporting function and we use it for about 2-3 weekly, monthly & annual reports. Some of the other reports are difficult to create on your own, requiring help from your Jobvite rep and/or Jobvite customer service. The Engage portion of Jobvite (an extra feature) hasn't been that successful for us, but that may just be that we need more training. Either way, we don't use it much. Also, integration is a factor. If an organization has a separate HRIS, identify integration possibilities.

タイトル: Don't recommend. Read review for details..

When I reached out to support for more clarity, the reps did EVERY possible not to get on a call with me. タイトル: So glad to have finally found and settled on Aha! Quite aptly named!
投稿者: Greg アメリカのFounder 認証済みLinkedInユーザー スポーツ, 自営業 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "So glad to have finally found and settled on Aha! Quite aptly named!"
良い点: I loved so many things about Aha!, but probably the most important thing was my ability to manage and prioritize a LOT of my product's features that can also be tied to Epics, Storys, Initiatives, and Goals in a very slick and powerful interface.
改善点: The product becomes cost-prohibitive, especially for startups, if you wish to use the "Develop" side of the product as well as the "Roadmap" side. For some reason, you need to step up to an extremely expensive Enterprise version, which makes little sense as smaller companies would of course want to use sprint planning and many other critical lower-level engineering and development features. The trials only allow one or the other, not both (without a very confusing experience), which seems odd for the same reason.

タイトル: An Amazing Tool to Align Strategy and Execution for Product Management
投稿者: Bastian アメリカのProduct Management Consultant 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 航空宇宙産業, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "An Amazing Tool to Align Strategy and Execution for Product Management"
良い点: Any organization that wants to be thoughtful, deliberate, and wants to link everything they build to the reason WHY they are building it should use this tool. It takes energy and effort to adopt, but the results are amazing. Every feature and release can be linked to a strategic element. In fact, what you are getting with AHA is not only a tool, but a best-practices thought model for product management (this can be challenging to implement but the rewards are high if you get through it. A key benefit is that once created, roadmaps and reports stay FRESH, meaning all changes to dates of features and releases are instantly reflected in your roadmaps and reports. No more updating Excel rows where cells are months!! Last but not least, their support is second-to-none!
改善点: While I really like AHA overall, the UI has many challenges. There are many inconsistencies (some places have a save, other autosave, some screens have a URL, others don't, some settings can be applied to everything at once, others have to be set manually one-by-one). Also for a single page app, it often struggles with refresh after edit more than it should in 2021.

タイトル: Reliable OTP solution for our SaaS projects
投稿者: Furkan トルコのFounder 認証済みLinkedInユーザー デザイン, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Reliable OTP solution for our SaaS projects"
良い点: We mainly use Twilio for OTP verification in SaaS products, both for client projects and some of our own products. What I like most is that once the initial setup is done, adding phone verification to a new project is quite straightforward. The API is flexible, the documentation is generally good, and there are enough examples to get an OTP flow working without spending too much development time on it. For us, this is especially useful when we are building and testing new SaaS ideas quickly. Message delivery has also been reliable for our use cases, so we don’t have to build or maintain this infrastructure ourselves.
改善点: The biggest downside for me is that the dashboard and pricing can feel more complicated than they need to be. Twilio has a lot of products and configuration options, so even when you only need something relatively simple like OTP, it can take some time to understand which settings and services you actually need. Costs are reasonable for smaller projects, but they become something you need to monitor more carefully as usage grows. Some of the verification and compliance steps can also make the initial setup slower than expected.

タイトル: Powerful Platform, Frustrating Business Verification Process
投稿者: Muhammed エジプトのTechnical Project Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 運輸、トラック、鉄道, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Powerful Platform, Frustrating Business Verification Process"
良い点: Twilio offers a comprehensive set of communication APIs with excellent documentation and a developer-friendly platform. The integration process is well designed, and the available SDKs make it easy to build SMS, voice, and WhatsApp features into applications. The platform is reliable and supports a wide range of use cases.
改善点: The account verification and compliance process was the most frustrating part of our experience. Our business verification was rejected multiple times despite providing the requested documents, and support was slow to resolve the issue. This significantly delayed our project and made the onboarding process much more difficult than expected.

良い点: I have given Time Doctor 10 out of 10 as I simply love it. We have been using it for more than 4 years and it has proved to be a great tool to manage the in-house and remote employees. It is pretty convenient to install and work with. It allows to track time and improve productivity. It gives your complete control over your work. The effective reporting system helps you to figure out a better use of your time. It provides browsing history, top website, and poor management of time. In the capacity of an HR Manager, I use Time Doctor to mark employee attendance. You can check time-in and time-out and total work hours of your team members. It shares employee activity by sending screenshots. I also get help in managing the payroll. There's another cool option that TD allows to manually edit time. Sometimes, people forget to start Time Doctor and then approach me to adjust their times. In all reality, you can do a lot of cool things to manage your team and work.
改善点: The only con that I observed as a user is the 'display of activity bar'. It stays on top and sometimes becomes quite irritating. There's an option to hide it but the chances that sometimes you forget to turn Time Doctor on. Likewise, the breaktime monitor is a bit irritating. When you're busy in a though process and staring on your screen but you have not moved your mouse or touched the keyboard, Time Doctor will assume that you're gone for a break. I don't know how to fix it but it would be really cool if there's some sort of a sensor.

タイトル: One of the best Freelance Time Tracker, if you agree.
投稿者: Roldan フィリピンのUX/UI Designer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー デザイン, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "One of the best Freelance Time Tracker, if you agree."
良い点: Ease of use. One of the best function of the tracker - just like any other software - it should be. Screen capture is the second, just if cases where your client needs to police your progress.
改善点: They might need to fix the redundant notifications. Such as it keeps checking you out if you are still working. If I'm a video editor and I'm rendering a video for 5 hours, the function needs to be intuitive or at least palpable. The software is obviously dependent on keyboard and mouse activities.

タイトル: Ex-user of Duo Security.
投稿者: Jim アメリカのLead application support analyst 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Ex-user of Duo Security."
良い点: As a two-factor authentication tool, it is easy to use, you can easily install it in different cell phones and OS.
改善点: I didn't find any cons in Duo security, as an user, I found it very convenient. You just need to register your phone in advance, then when the system requires two-factor authentication, it will direct you to the cell phone,.

タイトル: Dup 2 Factor, A simple, easy to use system for Network Authentication
投稿者: Glen アメリカのSystems Operator 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 政府機関, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Dup 2 Factor, A simple, easy to use system for Network Authentication"
良い点: Duo Security is probably one of the easiest 2 Factor authentication platform out there. It is a great Value for you money and the account and Device management is straight forward and easy with their Administrative panel
改善点: There was not much to dislike about this platform. The only issue is once in a while that device app would be unresponsive, but a simple reboot would solve any issue

タイトル: duo thumbs down. :(
投稿者: Elizabeth アメリカのSenior Product Manager 小売, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "duo thumbs down. :("
良い点: Hi, I am not sure I like much about this app. I continually have trouble with this product. And am on the phone with IT a lot about it
改善点: Well frankly it never works. And if I am stuck and cannot login to my server somewhere, it makes for very inconvenient work day.

タイトル: DUO gets it done
投稿者: Scott アメリカのIT Director 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 金融サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "DUO gets it done"
良い点: Learning curve was short, it was a great value for our needs and setup was very easy and suited our needs.
改善点: Support response wasn't robust and limited in the scope of solutions. They pointed me to FAQ's rather then support.

タイトル: Need MFA and SSO? Duo's Got You!
投稿者: Alexis アメリカのCentralized Services Technician 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Need MFA and SSO? Duo's Got You!"
良い点: Duo is a great choice for MFA! The users we deploy to like how easy it is to set up, and they have one MFA for most of their tools. It also has a great SSO option, which makes it reliable for our business use-case. The price is great for what we can do with it, and we feel secure in our business. Support has been wonderful as well!
改善点: We haven't run into too many issues with Duo. When we have a problem, they're here to help us get rolling! Our integrations were easy to set up, and we didn't have much pushback from users when implementing Duo as opposed to other MFA providers.

タイトル: Great for Apple Device Management
投稿者: Rachel アメリカのDesktop Support Supervisor 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 食品製造, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great for Apple Device Management"
良い点: Exceptional ease of use. I think the interface is very user friendly. Device enrollment, app deployment and updates is very simple. If I encounter an issue, the customer service is also very exceptional.
改善点: Really the only two dislikes I have is the apps not updating with me forcing the update and the price. We are not a large company with under 300 iPads/Apple TV's deployed, but the price is a bit much. The cost/benefit ration is not there.

タイトル: Apple hardware management made easy
投稿者: Curt アメリカのTech Support Eラーニング, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Apple hardware management made easy"
良い点: I could make an install package based on what has changed. this means I could install apps, change settings, add or remove files and make a deplorable package file easy
改善点: We only used it for apple products. We had to use other product for windows and chromebooks. This isn't really a problem with Jamf, it just that we had to use several MDM suites

タイトル: Reliable, Low-Maintenance Apple Device Management with Great Support
投稿者: Ben アメリカのInfrastructure Architect, CISO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 教育管理, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Reliable, Low-Maintenance Apple Device Management with Great Support"
良い点: Jamf Pro is the leading management interface and endpoint application management for all Apple devices. The application is extremely easy to install, backup, restore and upgrade. The cost to value it provides for the headache it solves it tremendous. Tech support is great and 100% web based makes the tool a top choice for anyone supporting Apple products in any enterprise.
改善点: The only con of Jamf Pro is not really a product with the product, but rather what Apple allows them to accomplish. When compared to a Windows environment, Apple products are extremely limited in management compatibilities. I would also not recommend Jamf Pro to manage and maintain a Windows environment as the native Windows tools are better equipped.

タイトル: IT & Process Manager
投稿者: Vincent ドイツのIT and Process Manager 化粧品, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "IT & Process Manager"
良い点: I didn't really like it because standard functions that every company needs where a total pain to setup and the documentation is behind a paywall aka courses.
改善点: Standard functions like auto-updates, self-service, auto-download apps when an employee opens the laptop for the first time, the dock configuration needing an extra script, ALL needed a bunch of scripts, workarounds and it's just a waste of time. Customer support needs ages to answer and if they do they refer you to some random article.

タイトル: Zero-touch deployment that actually works as promised
投稿者: Mohammed アラブ首長国連邦のTechnical Engineer コンピュータ、ネットワーク・セキュリティ, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Zero-touch deployment that actually works as promised"
良い点: Zero-touch deployment is the standout — a Mac ships straight to the user, they sign in, and it configures itself with no IT hands on the box. Depth of Apple support is unmatched: new macOS and iOS releases are supported on day one, and you get access to settings no general-purpose MDM exposes. Smart Groups make policy targeting genuinely dynamic, self-service lets users install approved apps without tickets, and Jamf Nation is a real community you can lean on when you hit something unusual.	There's a real learning curve — the interface is dense and getting the most out of it means comfort with scripting and Apple's configuration profiles, so it's not something you hand to a generalist. It's Apple-only, so you still need a second tool for Windows and Android. Pricing is on the higher end with minimum seat commitments, and support response times can drag depending on your plan. Reporting is also more basic than you'd expect at this price.

タイトル: Question pro for Education
投稿者: Megan アメリカのExecutive Director 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 教育管理, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Question pro for Education"
良い点: QuestionPro is powerful and offers a lot of functionality for the price. It is relatively easy to use once you get familiar with the platform, and it provides a wide range of tools and features for creating and managing surveys.
改善点: There is a bit of a learning curve when you first get started. Some features can take time to figure out, especially if you are new to the platform, but once you learn how everything works, it becomes much easier to use.

タイトル: Stop Struggling with Surveys
投稿者: Rita Mae アメリカのExecutive Director 美術、工芸, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Stop Struggling with Surveys"
良い点: I've found conditional questions a real struggle in Google Surveys, which is why we switched to QuestionPro. I'm glad we did! I also like the clean look of QuestionPro.
改善点: Let's face it, gathering customer feedback is hard. You create the most streamlined process you can to get just the data you need, and you still get little response. This isn't an issue with QuestionPro, it's the nature of the game, but if you think you'll get QuestionPro and your survey woes are over, you're wrong. Only your unnecessary woes are over, so now you can concentrate on engaging clients in the process.

タイトル: Non profit question pro account
投稿者: vicki 英国のDeputy President 非営利団体運営, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Non profit question pro account"
良い点: Provide free licence for non profit organisations. Allows for multiple surveys. Customer support very helpful to talk through any issues. Intuitive design.
改善点: For a very small non profit organisation, steps required to set the account up seemed excessive and involved other requirements we do not have or need and had to arrange specifically for this.

タイトル: A+ Service
投稿者: Bob アメリカのExecutive Director 非営利団体運営, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A+ Service"
良い点: Level of services are deep. They have what you are looking for... guaranteed. If they don't have it, you don't need it.
改善点: A bit of a learning curve but great customer service and functionality of site. The report feature is very thorough.

タイトル: A Powerful and Reliable Platform for Surveys
投稿者: Lourdes アメリカのParent Educator 非営利団体運営, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A Powerful and Reliable Platform for Surveys"
良い点: I appreciate the platform’s versatility, from simple surveys to advanced analytics and employee engagement tools. The interface is clean, and the reporting dashboards make insights easy to understand and share with stakeholders. QuestionPro offers a wide range of features at a competitive price. Brand customization is flexible. You can easily add your logos. Surveys and dashboards work well on mobile. Respondents can complete surveys easily from any device.
改善点: Some advanced features can feel overwhelming at first, and certain customization options require a bit of a learning curve.

タイトル: Coding for people who don't code
投稿者: Brenden アメリカのNight Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 卸売, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Coding for people who don't code"
良い点: AppSheet is an incredible piece of software that easily integrates with Google Sheets, Excel, Salesforce, and others. Its GUI is very user friendly, and allows new/amature coders to create full web-apps with minimal knowledge. Very easy to use, and produces apps quickly.
改善点: Price-point, and bugs. Knowing the number of variables AppSheet has to account for in any app, there are still certain kinks that need to be worked out. Also, AppSheet is free, unless you really want to utilize all of its features. Unfortunately, once you start getting into apps that require multiple users, or creating workflows, then you start paying per user, or a tier based price structure per app. With competition quickly rising, their prices are easily beat by competitors like PowerApps.

タイトル: Stong and Secure
投稿者: David アメリカのPresident 事務用品、事務機器, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Stong and Secure"
良い点: Appshett is very cost effective. The initial price is very low and with a small number of users, it is quite inexpensive. The design tool is ,imited but for the right application, it is more than enough. The custimization options are limited, but again, for a simple app it is more than enough.
改善点: The part I liked least is that some tools and setting are dificult to find. However, like anything, once you figure it out, it is quite easy.

タイトル: Very simplistic and limited app design tool
投稿者: Claude Real カナダのBusiness analyst and graphic designer グラフィックデザイン, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Very simplistic and limited app design tool"
良い点: It is very easy to setup and it is very easy to create a small web app.
改善点: There is almost no personalization options available on this tool. There is no way to create a minimum of complexity in the app.

タイトル: A great start for using no-code in place of siloed business apps
投稿者: Ryan 英国のCEO 情報技術、情報サービス, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "A great start for using no-code in place of siloed business apps"
良い点: Appsheet has allowed me to replace my high-cost crm with a lower-cost solution that is also quicker to use and customise.
改善点: Some more design customisation would be great, Appsheet has allowed me to replace my high-cost crm with a lower-cost solution, but it doesn't look as nice. It would also be useful for there to be more of a streamlined navigation with databases and storage in Google Cloud Platform, given they are both google. A free-tier or low cost SQL database would be a great addition to the product.

タイトル: Great tool for easily and quickly building product MVPs
投稿者: Xorla ガーナのDirector, Research & Innovation 情報技術、情報サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Great tool for easily and quickly building product MVPs"
良い点: The best thing about Appsheet is the app setup process. Simply by creating your spreadsheet data with all the basic designations you want in your app, the system automatically translates it into a functioning app. First time i tried it, I really couldn’t believe it worked. One great feature I love about building with Appsheet is also that you are able to make changes to base data structure right from the editor without needing to go directly into the source spreadsheet.
改善点: I didn’t like that I couldn’t set up a user sign up set up independent of the third party options available for signing up via google, etc.

タイトル: Feedback for LambdaTest
投稿者: Sergej 日本のFull Stack Engineer コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Feedback for LambdaTest"
良い点: LambdaTest offers a seamless cloud-based testing platform with extensive browser and device coverage, making cross-browser testing efficient and hassle-free. I appreciate its real-time testing capabilities, integration with popular CI/CD tools, and automated testing features that enhance productivity. The user-friendly interface and scalability make it a great choice for teams of all sizes.
改善点: I can't find any cons about Lambda Test.

タイトル: A Reliable and Efficient Cross-Browser Testing Platform
投稿者: Navneet カナダのDigital Marketing Specialist 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 物流、サプライチェーン, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "A Reliable and Efficient Cross-Browser Testing Platform"
良い点: LambdaTest's intuitive interface and extensive browser compatibility testing have significantly streamlined our testing processes.
改善点: To date, we have not encountered any issues while using LambdaTest.

タイトル: Very Helpful for iOS and Flutter App Testing
投稿者: Saumil インドのIOS and Flutter Developer 情報技術、情報サービス, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Very Helpful for iOS and Flutter App Testing"
良い点: What I like most about LambdaTest is the easy access to real devices and different iOS versions in one platform. It helps me test iOS and Flutter apps without managing physical devices. The interface is simple and testing setup is quick. It saves a lot of time in daily development and release cycles.
改善点: Sometimes there is a waiting time for popular real devices during peak hours. Also, a few devices can feel a bit slow when the network is not stable. However, overall performance and usability are still good for regular testing work.

タイトル: Real device cloud that’s rarely available
投稿者: Eshani インドのSoftware Tester 情報技術、情報サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Real device cloud that’s rarely available"
良い点: It’s easy to start using and requires minimal setup. UI is also clean The session recording feature is useful for capturing issues and sharing exact behavior with clients or developers during manual testing.
改善点: Real device availability has been a major issue in our use. New iPhones and Ultra devices are frequently unavailable or show “Device Not Available,” sometimes for long periods. Specially during our peak hours. There is also a gap between the device list you see on Free Trial and what can actually be accessed at the exact same time. Devices appear selectable but cannot be launched on paid plan when needed, making me question the entire point of this Over time, we also saw reliability decline, with sessions failing to start or dropping during manual testing more often than expected.

タイトル: Great platform for cross-browser testing and app validation
投稿者: Amara インドのSoftware Developer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Great platform for cross-browser testing and app validation"
良い点: I mainly used TestMu AI through the GitHub Student Pack while testing my Flutter application. I liked how easy it was to upload my APK and launch it on different browsers and devices without needing to configure everything locally. The interface is clean and beginner-friendly, and the performance during testing was smooth. I also found the support team responsive when I had questions about my plan.
改善点: The biggest downside was the confusion around the GitHub Student Pack benefits. I initially thought real device testing was included, but later found out it was only available through the freemium sessions. It would be helpful if the differences between browser testing and real device testing were explained more clearly on the dashboard to avoid confusion.

タイトル: Firefox is my favorite browser. Easy to use and reliable
投稿者: Michelle アメリカのMultiple Roles 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 小売, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Firefox is my favorite browser. Easy to use and reliable"
良い点: I love Firefox. I have used it for many years and love the tools and features it has. It is my secondary browser. It is very user friendly and customizable.
改善点: Not really anything. I only started using Chrome primarily because of the Google Tools I regularly use.

タイトル: My ride or die browser
投稿者: B アメリカのOperations 非営利団体運営, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "My ride or die browser"
良い点: Firefox was the first to use tabbed browsing which is why I began with them in 1999. Since then, their product has remained awesome and it's my favorite first browser. The bookmarks toolbar works well, as does bookmark management of saving all of my bookmarks. Now that you can log in and have functionality across any system, it's just about perfect.
改善点: When other, bigger entities started making tabbed browsers, I noticed that firefox functionality is sometimes difficult with some web sites. I don't believe this is a necessarily a firefox issue, but it does force me to use a secondary browser for a lot of sites.

タイトル: Your fired fox
投稿者: Joshua アメリカのCeo 建設, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Your fired fox"
良い点: Its content approval. Firefox will just about let you have access to most any format of data you desire.
改善点: Its Features and functionality of the browser itself, lack any quality or exuberance. Its just to outdated. Feels like im swimming in syrup, When trying to load pages.

タイトル: Fast and Reliable Browser
投稿者: Samuel アメリカのCoder 認証済みLinkedInユーザー デザイン, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Fast and Reliable Browser"
良い点: Firefox is one of my go to browser between that and chrome love both of them cause they are fast and relible browsers and are free which is even better. They can be sat up for different search engines in the settings very easy to navigate through their easy interface sidebar where all the settings, extentions and other menu's are. Creating seperate or opening content in new tabs are sat up about the same so switching back and forth there is no diffuiculties at all. If you need customer care or customer support it's available on their site.
改善点: The only thing I had a problem with firefox was it had a glitch the one time where it froze up but that is one time out of the 10 years I been using them.Other than that I have nothing else bad to say.

タイトル: A solid, well designed browser that has always come out on top.
投稿者: David 英国のPhoto editor and website admin 写真, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A solid, well designed browser that has always come out on top."
良い点: I especially like the fact that Firefox is a fast, security-oriented browser. By far its best feature is that on start-up, if it is set to open previous tabs, it doesn't automatically load tab contents, therefore its memory usage is well optimised. I'm yet to find any browser that does this so well.
改善点: I don't have many complaints, but on the latest update it seems that AI has been forced upon the user in the new side-bar. However this is a minor complaint as it seems to be easily turned off.

タイトル: Hotjar worked great for us until the pricing model changed
投稿者: Sarah アメリカのMarketing Technologist 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 教育管理, 5,001～10,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Hotjar worked great for us until the pricing model changed"
良い点: We used hotjar for several years for our web performance tracking, on-page quick NPS surveys, and to measure user engagement on pages. It's a lighweight web experience tools that complies easy to understand scroll maps and click maps. The feedback tab function was handy and helpful for users to provide immediate feedback and actually helped us discover bugs and issues in our ecommerce site.
改善点: The cost is way too high to scale up for an enterprise company. We were grandfathered in to a lower price point that eventually expired, so we moved away to a more scalable solution (VWO insights). Otherwise we probably would have stuck with Hotjar as it fulfilled all of our needs.

タイトル: Powerful Behavior Analytics Tool for Websites
投稿者: Radek ポーランドのboard member エンタテインメント, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Powerful Behavior Analytics Tool for Websites"
良い点: Hotjar offers strong Data Analysis and Monitoring tools like heatmaps and recordings. Survey Creation is easy, and it gives great insight into Conversion Funnels and user behavior.
改善点: Hotjar has a Learning Curve for beginners and can feel complex at first. Pricing is not ideal for small teams, affecting Value for Money at higher usage levels.

タイトル: Useful Heatmapping Tool
投稿者: Annie アメリカのMarketing Manager 代替医療, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Useful Heatmapping Tool"
良い点: It gave fairly accurate heat mapping and information regarding user behavior on our website. It was also easy to use.
改善点: Limits on how many pages it would scan, would love more comprehensive data and analytics, as well as reporting.

タイトル: Best of it's kind.
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー マーケティング、広告, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Best of it's kind."
良い点: Clean and simple tool to see activity on your site. Great for getting a pulse on the busy parts (and the dead parts) of your pages. (and browsing paths of your vistiors).
改善点: Not a ton to critique at the moment. We've used crazy egg before and it's fine, but nothing compares to the simplicity of hot jar at the end of the day.

タイトル: Our go-to tool for heatmaps, and User behaviour recording, but it is very expensive to get all the features
投稿者: Niccolo イタリアのCofounder, CTO 自動車, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Our go-to tool for heatmaps, and User behaviour recording, but it is very expensive to get all the features"
良い点: Hotjar is a great tool for insights on user behaviour. It makes you understand where's the biggest blockers in your UX, where the customers are going, what they're reading, where they're clicking etc. You can easily understand if some parts of your website are useless, or if they're good and grab attention. It also gives you insights on how much time users stay on each page, so that you know what's driving them around and for how long.
改善点: There's no real big cons in the product itself. However, we use the free version and it does the job in a fantastic way, but it's very limited: -The basic price above free is quite expensive. -You cannot see trends and data for free. just heatmaps and recordings -You're very limited to 35 recording/day on free plan Also, in the recording sections, you can easily get overwhelmed by not-relevant recordings, where users just idle.

タイトル: Having fun isn't the opposite of learning: Quizizz.
投稿者: Vladimir Azariel メキシコのEditor and VFX Maker 認証済みLinkedInユーザー エンタテインメント, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Having fun isn't the opposite of learning: Quizizz."
良い点: With Quizizz you can create interactive quizzes through which several people can interact to compete against each other in an evaluation against the clock. I see several pros with this software, the first is that it manages to be very dynamic when it comes to solving questions and that makes it very fun, in addition to being a good technique to clarify the different ideas that are seen in a school environment. As a second good thing, is that it has many ways in which "the administrator" can form the evaluation of it: multiple choice, arrangement of columns, open questions, etc. As a student, I really recommend Quizizz to teachers, because many times it is inevitable to get bored after long days of learning, but this software is a good way to cope with academics while having a good time.
改善点: Having quite a few options, Quizizz can be quite confusing with teachers, and in turn with students. For this reason, I highly recommend that whoever is going to use this software watch the series of visual and explanatory tutorials offered by Quizizz to have the best possible experience when taking quizzes.

タイトル: Quizizz is essential to the new landscape of virtual teaching
投稿者: Sandra アメリカのTeacher Eラーニング, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Quizizz is essential to the new landscape of virtual teaching"
良い点: The feature I like most, BY FAR, about Quizizz is the Teleport feature when creating a quiz. A teacher is multitasking now more than ever as we teach virtually and time does not always lend itself to typing up entire quizzes and tests. With the Teleport feature teachers can chose to import another teacher's entire quiz or select individual questions from various quizzes that are already created. The Teleport feature is the most important and functional feature of Quizizz.
改善点: I do not like how questions and quizzes in the Quizizz software are so easily accessed by students for the purpose of cheating. While I like to keep my Quizizz public so that other teachers can teleport my questions for their benefit, it is a double edge sword because a student simply has to search my username or Quizizz title and they can easily find my quiz with all of the answers. Quizizz is the best tool to hold students accountable when taking assessments, but its purpose is defeated if they have access to all of the questions and answers in advance.

タイトル: Site Does not function properly and support is offshore and ineffective.
投稿者: Todd Montgomery アメリカのPresident 保険, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 ソース：SoftwareAdvice 共有 "Site Does not function properly and support is offshore and ineffective."
良い点: none. site never functions as featured.

Students can work at their own pace. They have funny memes the kids enjoy. The power ups encourage students who aren’t the top of the class. It saves my student’s scores, so I can go back and track class participation. I can teleport in other teacher-created questions with a single click. I can assign quizzes for homework (or virtual students) or run them live in class. I don’t have to wait for that one student that has a slow connection to start the quiz because the code stays at the top of the screen once you start it. If someone doesn’t have a device, I can log in as a participant and project what they would see on the board while they write their answers on paper. I can’t really say anything negative about this program. It’s fantastic! (and I’m not paid to say this :)
改善点: There isn’t anything negative I can say about the program. I could see ways that you could further develop it in the future (allow more integration features...automatically add grades to Infinite Campus like GradeCam does, or add more slides features) but it functions very well just the way it is currently.
