タイトル: Better than all the rest
投稿者: Joel Chief CCO Officer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 ソース：GetApp 共有 "Better than all the rest"
良い点: + Easy to use + Incredible customization available + Rich, feature-packed filtering query language
改善点: What I dislike the most is that the experience isn't consistent - some data types can be created, renamed and tweaked extensively, while some others are set in stone and baked into the system. I would rather have that it was very scaled down, and that you could create your own data types for cards, instead of having a few baked-in types (Epic, Feature, UserStory, Request, Bug etc). And the cards are tied to metadata such as Release, Project, User, Role, Effort etc - these cannot be modified and you cannot use them as you will. - Cannot rename card types or create more, delete unused types etc - You have to choose between points or hours as Effort metric - but they don't work the same! Some features are not available when you choose points instead of hours. I'd rather it was only a label choosing "p" instead of "h". - Multiple stuff like the above - some stuff is build-in and cant be changed and it can be very confusing. - API is a mess. Everything can be modified in every request, instead of having separate requests for midifying different objects. For instance: you add a comment to a bug, you have to include the user (as an object, not just an id) that authored the comment. However, if you accidentally input the wrong name for the user (but the correct ID), it will actually *change the name* of that user. WTF? - Query language is very useful, but has some subtle bugs and inconsistencies.

Cloudflare is the best cloud service provider

タイトル: One dashboard for my domains, apps and security
投稿者: Nilesh 英国のFounder マーケティング、広告, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "One dashboard for my domains, apps and security"
良い点: I run a small outbound agency and Cloudflare holds all of it together. DNS for our main domain and hundreds of sending domains is in one place, and changes go live in seconds. I also build our internal tools on Workers, D1 and R2, so I get a simple app with a database and file storage without managing a server. Cloudflare Access with one-time PIN logins keeps those tools private to my team with almost no setup. Free SSL and DDoS protection come built in, and the free and low-cost tiers are very generous for a small business.
改善点: Usage-based billing on things like D1 can surprise you if a job runs more than expected, so you need to watch your usage closely. Some safety rules, like Workers refusing plain HTTP calls to raw IP addresses, are good ideas but cost me time until I understood them. The dashboard has grown huge, and it can be hard to find settings.

タイトル: Value, Function, and Top Notch Customer Service
投稿者: Kristin アメリカのOwner/Executive Chef 飲食店, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Value, Function, and Top Notch Customer Service"
良い点: We switched to CAKE from another POS system in 2016, after being in operation for 1.5 years. We have been impressed with the way CAKE constantly tries to provide new features. As a farm-to-table quick-service restaurant, our menu changes weekly and we find it simple and straightforward to make updates each week. Due to COVID-19, we recently activated the online ordering and we believe it has saved our business. We were able to activate and integrate it quickly and we love the reporting capabilities the system gives us. Our customer service has been top notch--from our sysco rep to our CAKE customer support manager, we have received a quick response to any question we've had. We feel very comfortable requesting new features and integrations based on our needs and we feel like they really listen to us and try to incorporate our ideas quickly and simply. We did not have this level of customer support with our previous POS system and we really value being able to get a live person on the phone quickly and easily when we have an issue. We love the intuitive, easy-to-read sales analysis reports and use them each week with our management team to evaluate our menu items and determine our next round of specials. We really like that we can make menu edits both on the POS and with the online platform---hoping for a mobile app next for very quick and simple edits!
改善点: We first purchased in Spring 2016. The software felt a little sluggish and honestly, we were not sure if it would easily keep up with our pace. But we have been very impressed with CAKE's constant evaluation and roll-out of new features and integrations--they haven't missed a beat! We don't use all the features yet, but because of the recent success with our online activation, we are now considering two more apps. I would prefer a tiered/capped monthly pricing system depending on how many apps/additional software platforms we integrate (like accounting, customer management, 3rd party delivery apps, etc)--rather than installing each a-la carte, but hopefully that will be an option in the future. The additional monthly fee per app has made us hesitant to try new ones. We would also like to have more control over the look and feel of the online ordering page--functionally it meets our needs, but would love to integrate it into our own website and select the background color, text color, etc, to make it feel like a seamless integration rather than making our customers feel like they are "leaving" our site to go to another. There are some features/edits that are only available from the POS system (not menu items, but system preferences/settings categories) In the future, I hope they make those features editable from the online access platform as well, because sometimes I want the flexibility of making certain adjustments from home on my computer during off-hours.

タイトル: An excellent video editing software for ambitious creatives and digital marketers
投稿者: 表示する詳細を増やす Bruno イタリアのMarketing Executive Intern 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 自動車, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "An excellent video editing software for ambitious creatives and digital marketers"
良い点: I had the opportunity to use the AVS Video Editor as a Marketing Executive Intern for Hackett & Hackett International Group Limited. I am inclined to note that this software product has a lot of attractive features for a user. First of all, it is really convenient to work with this application because of its accessibility and intuitive interface. Secondly, it supports multiple video formats and even 4K resolution. Moreover, it provides users with the opportunity to choose from more than 300 effects, transitions, and overlays. In addition, it has standard but effective correction tools, such as white balance and stabilisation.
改善点: Unfortunately, the application has some significant disadvantages. First and foremost, it lacks advanced tools such as professional-grade audio mixing, compositing, and masking. In addition, it has a rather limited set of tools for working with video on a professional level. Another issue is related to the complexity of the user interface, which may seem outdated at first glance. Fourth, the software’s performance may be inconsistent when working with 4K video. Finally, I found that this product has few third-party tools and resources in the form of plugins, templates, and tutorial materials.

タイトル: An honest consumer review for the Reach CMS
投稿者: Wayne カナダのWeb & Digital Developer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー マーケティング、広告, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "An honest consumer review for the Reach CMS"

改善点: Due to this being a web-based system, certain clunky response times for content updates, caching concerns, CSS consistency errors, etc - all account for a demerit in consumer value. Most of which can be addressed with future front-end updates to the Reach software. Largest concern from a front-end development standpoint would be major inconsistencies in responsive view (mobile, tablet). There should be no limitations between devices. Granted, although many of these appear concerning, the web-based route allows for flexible updates on a diverse set of systems, web-based integrations for RSS Feeds/Social Content, and many other valuable features which would hold its weight in limitations if Reach were a standalone application.

タイトル: Great product, and easy to use!

The intuitive layout makes it easy to create, update, and access training materials without a steep learning curve. The AI features are especially valuable, as they help with writing and refining content, which saves time and improves clarity and consistency across documentation. Trainual also does a great job of centralizing processes and knowledge in one place, making it easier for team members to find information and stay aligned. Overall, it simplifies onboarding, training, and knowledge management, which improves efficiency and supports consistency across the organization.
改善点: One of the aspects I liked least about Trainual is the formatting experience, which can be tricky and sometimes inconsistent. Adjusting layouts, spacing, and text styles does not always feel intuitive, and formatting changes don’t always apply uniformly across sections. This can make it time-consuming to achieve a clean, consistent look, especially when creating longer or more detailed content. At times, it requires extra manual adjustments to maintain consistency, which slightly slows down the documentation process.

We can schedule Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, Linkedin, and more social posts in the Loomly platform. I love the calendar view, where we can easily see all of our social posts in one section. I also love that you can drag-and-drop to quickly reschedule certain posts, making it very easy to organize and plan out our calendar. The auto-posting function is great, where it automatically publishes your posts to your social media accounts, saving us time and energy. There is also a great approval system where you can submit your posts for review if another coworker in your company would like to review them first before publishing.
改善点: I don't love that Loomly doesn't integrate with Instagram. Loomly can automatically publish your social posts to Facebook, Twitter, and Linkedin, but it doesn't connect to Instagram. You have to go through another 3rd party website called Zapier which costs money and is a little complicated to set up (it's also very glitchy in our experience). タイトル: Great Social Media Management Platform missing a few core features

良い点: Loomly does a great job of helping simplify and manage multiple social media platforms, providing a great experience for planning and executing your brands social media plans. I love the ease of use that Loomly provides in having multiple team members manage social media calendars, and how incredibly simple it is to create posts & plan out your posting strategy. Top that all off with very competitive and simple pricing options, this platform offers a good user experience & interface for all your social media needs.
改善点: Loomly is missing a few key features that you would expect on a Social Media Management Platform, but none are more important than the ability to automatically post to your brands Instagram account. This is a feature that they are working on, but it is the main feature that I wish they would add soon. Furthermore, if they were to add an Instagram story option to their software & eventually automatic posting to Instagram stories, this platform would improve 100x. Apart from those things, there are a number of simple UI issues that I wish they would remedy; including: (1) Quickly adding a post from the calendar Month view ignores your preset posting schedule times (defaults to 3:00pm, you have to manually change it) (2) Manually changing scheduled times from the "Add Post" option in Month won't allow you to type in a time - you have to obnoxiously click an arrow to get the proper time (3) Manually posting to Instagram does not support multiple images - even though you can schedule multiple images to be posted. To post multiple images, you have to go into the Loomly library from their mobile site (the app won't let you do it) & download each image individually - which isn't terrible, except... (4) The Loomly Mobile Website is not fully optimized for mobile devices, as the "Help"/"Contact us" button blocks parts of the bottom menu that appears when selecting an image in the library to download, making me have to use the desktop site to download images on mobile.

タイトル: Square is adequate…enough.
投稿者: Danielle アメリカのOwner 運輸、トラック、鉄道, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Square is adequate…enough."
良い点: Square simplifies the process of signing up and getting started. Small startups can easily benefit from their free plan to avoid incurring higher costs. Square’s transparent fee structure enables businesses to clearly comprehend the fees associated with payment processing. For mobile businesses or those without a physical location, Square provides convenient payment processing options using provided hardware or a cell phone. Additionally, Square offers quick transfers, automatically moving processed payments into a linked business account without any additional fees.
改善点: Square’s interface can be challenging to use initially. While the fee structure is clearly defined, using Square as the primary payment processor can result in significant fees if a large volume of transactions are processed or substantial amounts of money are rendered for services. Additionally, relying solely on a cell phone for the tap-to-pay option can be inconsistent if the area has poor data coverage. In addition, using larger hardware for payment processing can be expensive and add to the overhead costs for small businesses.

タイトル: Do Not Use Square
投稿者: Amy アメリカのOwner 建設, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 ソース：SoftwareAdvice 共有 "Do Not Use Square"
良い点: At first it was easy. Then I processed a large transaction and they closed the account and held money for 90 days
改善点: I processed a transaction for $13,800 through Square. Up until then, transactions had gone smoothly. Immediately after this transaction, Square closed my account and informed me that I would have to wait 90 days to receive the funds — with no way to expedite or reroute payment despite the urgent cash-flow implications for my business. Because these funds are tied up until February, my business is facing serious difficulty covering payroll and operating expenses. I operated in good faith, with no chargebacks or history of fraud, and now my ability to serve customers and pay employees is compromised. I request immediate review of my account closure and hold of the $13,800, with a pathway for either release of the funds now or cancellation of the transaction so I can process it through my preferred platform, Jobber, and continue business operations without interruption.

良い点: Only a few databases (such as IBM DB2) have this attribute. Due to this main features of the Oracle database, Oracle engineers have taken advantage of years of evolution and created a truly robust database that supports a large amount of data. I don't think any other database on the market can handle data volume like Oracle does while maintaining a high level of performance. Another thing I like about the Oracle database is that the company has invested in creating not only one of the best databases on the market, but also hardware with a high level of performance and has recently added interesting capabilities of artificial intelligence to the database engine.
改善点: There are two widely known issues about Oracle databases that most people in the database community complain about (and so do I). The first is related to cost, as the cost of Oracle licenses, training and consulting are generally higher when compared to other alternative products. Second, is Oracle’s licensing structure, particularly for those who are in the process of obtaining a new Oracle license. In general, Oracle licensing is complex; A lawyer will most likely be essential during negotiations, as Oracle's license terms are complicated.

良い点: What I liked most about Aircall is that it allows me to make and receive work-related calls without using my personal phone number. That added layer of privacy is a big benefit and makes it much easier to keep work communication separate from my personal life. It has been especially useful for maintaining that boundary while still staying accessible.
改善点: What I liked least about Aircall is the inconsistency. Calls can drop, notifications are sometimes missed, and that makes it harder to rely on when communication needs to be seamless. It also has not been the easiest app to navigate, so the overall experience can feel more frustrating than it should.

タイトル: A modern, VOip phone system that integrates seamlessly with your tools
投稿者: Louis フランスのCTO 不動産, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A modern, VOip phone system that integrates seamlessly with your tools"
良い点: Native Salesforce integration: This is, by far, one of Aircall's biggest strengths. The integration with Salesforce is seamless and powerful: calls are automatically logged in the corresponding contact or lead records, call recordings and notes are directly attached to Salesforce activities, and our sales team can initiate calls directly from Salesforce with a single click (Click-to-Dial). This has drastically reduced manual data entry and improved CRM data accuracy. Getting started was incredibly fast — numbers can be provisioned in just a few clicks, and onboarding new team members takes minutes, not days. VR, call routing, business hours, shared inboxes, call tagging, and analytics provide everything a growing team needs to manage calls professionally.
改善点: The analytics are good, but more advanced and customizable reports would be a welcome addition Occasionally, we've experienced minor call quality issues (echo, latency, or dropped calls), especially on weaker internet connections.

タイトル: Exceptional CRM Integration Hindered by High Costs and Seat Minimums

良い点: What makes Aircall exceptional is its best-in-class, frictionless CRM integration ecosystem. The app embeds seamlessly into platforms like Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, and Pipedrive. When a call comes in, the automatic contact pop-up instantly displays the caller’s past history, while call recordings, disposition tags, and AI summaries are logged automatically without leaving the CRM window. This eliminates manual data entry and dramatically increases rep productivity.
改善点: aggressive pricing model, strict seat minimums, and heavy feature gating. Enforcing a mandatory 3-license minimum makes it unnecessarily expensive for small teams, while essential tools like Salesforce integrations, live call monitoring, power dialers, and AI summaries are locked behind higher tiers or paid add-ons.

良い点: Call quality and day-to-day functionality were reliable, and outbound calling through the platform helped us close real business — we can trace concrete deals directly to outreach done via Aircall.
改善点: Contract and billing flexibility is poor. We ended up paying for unused plan capacity (5 users, international calling bundle) for roughly a year without any proactive check-in from Aircall to flag the mismatch. We were also forced into two separate unwanted full-price contract extensions: once from a missed cancellation deadline with zero flexibility offered, and again when porting our number out to a new provider required a full extra month at full price, with no reduced or number-only option available.

良い点: I LOVE the customer service. They are always willing to work with us and help us adapt the program to what we need. I love the many different reporting features and how they each have a unique description that helps me find exactly what I need. I also like that I can star the reports I frequently use. I like that I am able to easily fill in grades in the "gradebook" tab, as well as having the opportunity to quickly report final grades at the end of the term. I am also happy with the ease in resetting a password for a user who has forgotten theirs as well as the quick ability to change a username. I appreciate that many users can have access to the same information (meaning a student and both of their parents can have their own accounts but access the same information on their child). I think overall I am mostly impressed with Alma's support team, how quickly and professionally they respond, how they will not let me leave the conversation until they are satisfied that all of my questions have been answered and my concerns resolved, and I love that they are constantly updating, making the website better, and then sending out an email with all of the updates and detailed instructions on how to utilize them.
改善点: I feel the website could be slightly more user friendly. There are often times it takes longer than I would like to access the information that I need (a lot of clicking through redundant tabs and not a lot of short cuts). I also wish it was easier for parents to understand the website. I don't like that there is no easy way for a parent to access a student's missing work, instead having to look through each class and assignment to see what has and has not been turned in. I also wish there was a way for us, as administrators and teachers, to see exactly what the parents see. It is hard to give advice and support to a parent when their screen looks different from mine; and I often don't know if they can see everything that I can, like all of the notes and assignment descriptions and what not. Otherwise, I am mostly happy with Alma.

タイトル: Drupal is a fantastic CMS

良い点: Views is the best thing about Drupal. Pre-Views, Drupal is a decent CMS, perhaps a bit more logical than WordPress, but with a lot less users it's hard to justify it. However with Views, you can make advanced applications with a pretty easy to learn interface. It's really, really close to a visual programming language, although there are still some things you'll need to break out the code for. I also really appreciate that most of the modules don't make too many assumptions. With WordPress, I constantly have to fight against styling and strangely formatted HTML inserted by plugins, and that's less common with Drupal modules.
改善点: It requires a fairly beefy hosting setup and a good caching setup to perform well. I also strongly, STRONGLY dislike that sites created five years ago now HAVE to be rebuilt, or they are not secure. That may be fine for enterprise, but it sucks for someone who makes lots of small sites for small businesses. Platforms should be supported for at least ten years IMO, the web has been stable for a while now and there's no good reason to force complete rebuilds. WordPress does this better and manages to continually keep sites upgradeable without a rebuild.

タイトル: Powerful editing tools for enterpise

良い点: I've been using Adobe After Effects for creating motion graphics, animated titles, Internal POC concept videos, and visual effects, and it's one of the most powerful editing tools I've worked with. The feature I use the most is Motion Graphics Templates because it saves a lot of time when creating similar projects. I also like how well it integrates with Premiere Pro, Photoshop, and Illustrator, making it easy to move assets between applications without starting over. The AI-powered features have also improved my workflow. Content-Aware Fill is surprisingly useful for removing unwanted objects from video clips, and the newer AI-assisted tools for tracking and masking are much faster than doing everything manually. The animation controls are extremely flexible, and expressions allow for advanced automation once you learn them. There are thousands of plugins, templates, and tutorials available online, so it's easy to expand what the software can do. Overall, it gives me professional-quality results that would be difficult to achieve with simpler video editors.
改善点: The biggest downside is the learning curve. Even after using it for a while, there are still features and panels that can feel overwhelming. Beginners will probably spend a lot of time watching tutorials before becoming comfortable with the software. Performance can also be frustrating on larger projects because previews sometimes take a long time to render, especially when using multiple effects, high-resolution footage, or complex compositions. Memory usage is high, so having a powerful computer with plenty of RAM makes a noticeable difference even on a MAC Book Pro make sure you got M1 Pro or higher. While the AI features help speed up certain tasks, they are not always perfect and still require manual adjustments. The subscription pricing may also be difficult to justify if you only need motion graphics occasionally. Finally, the interface contains so many options that finding the right setting can sometimes interrupt the creative flow, especially when working under a deadline.

良い点: I've been eyeing Nextcloud for a few years now. Until recently, I would have said that Owncloud is more stable and has better features. But that's all changed... big time! I recently installed Nextcloud to re-evaluate it and it's gotten better... a LOT better... even better than Owncloud. For one thing, right out of the box, Nextcloud includes groupware features like an browser-based email client, shared calendars, and shared contacts. But one plugin stands out - the web-meeting / screen-share plugin! And it's nice! Besides having better features, I like the community better. While Owncloud is open source and free, many of the plugins are not and the community has gotten more commercially oriented as a result. The Nextcloud community is more helpful and user based.
改善点: Wishes: * I wish Nextcloud was themeable. As far as I know, none of the groupware products out there are but that would be a very nice feature. * I wish Nexcloud had better documentation for replacing Owncloud while preserving user accounts.

タイトル: Blackboard Collaborate Review

タイトル: Storage hosting is easy with ShareFile

良い点: Sharefile is a cloud-hosted file server at its most basic level that replaces the need to host one within a workplace or business. It also allows you to offer download links to consumers to upload or download specific files, provided you have the proper rights. Because it is hosted offshore, it has the advantage of not requiring the office to operate servers or an Infrastructure rack.
改善点: You won't be able to view your file structure if your external internet connection goes down. If you're a remote worker trying to connect to a server hosted by your company, this can happen. Another problem might be a lack of bandwidth while uploading/downloading to Sharefile. It was also quite sluggish and complicated when we initially started using it, requiring multiple periods longer to transfer or explore than a self-hosted server. We also have at least 1-2 service interruptions every month, during which users are unable to conduct their job for a while.

I also like options to customized my sharefile experience which helps my client orient themselves more easily. At one point we also used ability of sharefile to create custom web forms for uploading, and that was a huge time and resource saver too.
改善点: In almost ten years of using ShareFile I never had a single issue. There were few points in time when I had to warn my users to update their software, but web access was always there.

タイトル: Progess is not Citrix

Billing and renewal communications were routed in a way that the appropriate person responsible for payment did not see them, and our firm did not receive or review the invoice until shortly before our service was cut off. Rather than working with us on a reasonable transition or prorated resolution, Progress ShareFile insisted on payment of the full annual renewal to restore access. The company’s position appeared to be that the auto-renewal terms controlled, regardless of the communication issues during the transition. That may be their policy, but it was not a customer-focused way to handle a long-standing business account.

タイトル: Powerful Task Management Platform, Backed by a Responsive Team
投稿者: Robert アメリカのChief Executive Officer 不動産, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Powerful Task Management Platform, Backed by a Responsive Team"
良い点: I run a small business with a lot of moving parts, and Nifty has become the main place where we track tasks, deadlines, and goals throughout the year. The task management is flexible enough to handle everything from one-off to recurring work, and it’s easy to see who owns what and what’s falling behind. The built-in chat and comments help keep conversations tied to tasks instead of lost in email threads, and file sharing inside projects makes it simple to attach the right documents where they’re needed. I also appreciate that they take security seriously and continually improve the platform without bloating it with gimmicks, which makes it very good value for the money.
改善点: The main drawback is the learning curve, simply because there are so many ways to set things up and so many features to discover. It took some time to design a workspace that fit how my small team actually works day to day. My biggest early frustration was with Nifty Docs, which felt basic compared to the rest of the platform and lacked version control and document locking, so I chose not to use them much. I shared that feedback with their team, and they’re working on adding those features now, which should make Docs much more useful for things like listing notes and internal procedures that I want to protect. 検討した類似製品： Trello monday AI Work Platform ClickUp Asana Notion Niftyに決めた理由： Nifty gave me more robust task and workflow management, built‑in communication, and better organization without feeling overwhelming once I got through the initial setup. Niftyに切りかえた理由： Nifty hit the best balance between power and usability for my team. 切り替える前の製品： Trello

I also don't like the dashboard user experience. I've used another time tracker for years, and it has a much better dashboard UX; Everhour is not as intuitive as I'd like. That said, it is a nice time tracker, especially given all of its integrations.

It takes 90 seconds to come back with something (on a fast phone). Then email was found. I scan the code and I am in. But, the very first time I tried to log in, my company had not connected me with the app. Virtually the same log in process led me to create my own (personal) account, which I was not intending to do. Then when my company did add me to Envoy, now it seems my email exists in two Envoy accounts. When I log in now, I see some information (like company logo and full name) displayed, but it also seems to be my personal account that I had created. I am assuming the logo and full company name would come from my company domain the Envoy has on file. But I know it's my personal account, as there are no resources available, like no rooms etc. Ok. How do I delete the account? I go through the (confusing) set of menus (my profile, then drop down for company, then manage accounts. In there I see my name (and email), select, and delete. It takes me to the Let's Get Started page. When I "log in" again, the same thing happens. Ok. Let's try their support, right? Not available, as it is Saturday. Everybody in the company must be taking weekends off, there is no support. I must wait for Monday. But Monday is exactly what I am trying to reserve at the office, as the company policy is to use Envoy to be able to work at the office.

良い点: The only aspect I genuinely liked about Zoho Inventory was its user interface and compatibility across devices. We used it at First Response Healthcare, where our nurses were responsible for billing medications and medical consumables. The application worked well on laptops, Android phones, iPhones, Android tablets and iPads. The interface was simple, easy to navigate and convenient for staff. From a UI and accessibility perspective, I have no complaints. However, a good interface alone does not make it a good inventory management system.
改善点: My biggest concern with Zoho Inventory is that the implementation did not adequately address the operational requirements of healthcare inventory management. We faced limitations in managing critical information such as HSN codes, expiry dates, pricing and discounts. Medication-specific details, including generic names, brand names, strengths, LASA identification and high-alert medication flags, were also not adequately supported. Expiry management was a major concern. A medical inventory system should identify medications approaching expiry, particularly within the next three months, and provide proper batch-level traceability. Multi-location inventory management was another challenge. Our requirement was to have one central warehouse supplying multiple healthcare centres. Instead, individual nurses were configured as separate stores, making stock allocation, transfers and reconciliation unnecessarily complicated. User access controls were also poorly configured. Most users had access to functions beyond their responsibilities, and we could not effectively enforce role-based discount limits. The implementation affected billing workflows, stock accuracy and inventory reconciliation. タイトル: Good Patch Management Tool - Expecting some improvements

良い点: I like the centralized management and automation the most. It significantly reduces the manual effort involved in identifying and deploying missing patches across multiple servers and endpoints. The ability to schedule deployments, manage third-party application updates, and quickly check patch compliance from one console is very useful.
改善点: The main drawback is that troubleshooting failed patches can sometimes be difficult because the error details are not always clear. Reporting could also be more flexible, with better customization and more detailed failure information. and the patching process can consume a significant amount of disk space on the C: drive, especially when multiple missing patches are downloaded and stored. This can become a concern on customer servers where the OS drive has limited free space. It would be beneficial to have a more straightforward option to configure a dedicated drive specifically for downloading and storing patches, preventing patch-related activities from impacting the available space on the OS drive. The UI works well, but it can sometimes feel a bit complicated and requires quite a few clicks to find what we need. A cleaner and more modern layout, better organization of the menus, and a more customizable dashboard would make it easier to use. It would be great if we could have a quick overview of failed patches, pending patches, compliance, and other important issues on one screen.

Besides, you can create a landing page which will suit your cartoons. Well, it is really inspiring and impressive. And you can use the native music tracks or your own tracks. You can add your own pictures, quotes or statements. You can motivate your public, engage your customers, or capture the attention of your pupils, students or learners! タイトル: Difficult to get a simple explainer video done.
投稿者: Chris オーストラリアのManager 不動産, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Difficult to get a simple explainer video done."
良い点: It's easy to find pre-set scenes and if you are creating something very basic you can do it quite quickly. I tried to create a 30 second explainer video.
改善点: There are a lot of bugs which makes me surprised they are charging for the product at this stage. Text to speech results in speech volume going up and down across different clips. Means you can't use this function without putting it other software to fix the levels. Each text to audio seems to leave a full second at the end of the audio generation. If you drag the audio clip to shorten by one second, two things happen. When it renders it repeats the last word. The next audio clip cannot be picked and moved backwards to seemlessly join to the previous. Again, it appears the only way is to put it in filmora, premier or other software, thus defeating the purpose a bit. You can only click and extend or shorten a scene in second blocks. Nearly all other software allows you more control. The constant rendering drove me a little nuts. Every time you modify a scene and then press play it renders. It doesn't need to. You are in an edit mode. Two other key bugs included a regular (perhaps every 15mins) server API error box. Once closed the software appeared to run again. Secondly, you would be editing a scene and it would continually bring up "You need to Save" with the only click options as Leave or Stay. There was no save function I could find anywhere. There is the basis of a good product here but the bugs need to be ironed out. Perhaps it does other video options better but for explainer videos it fell short. At the moment, it is behind other products like easyvid and hypernatural.

タイトル: Lusha: Strong Features, Lacking Support

良い点: Lusha's LinkedIn integration is a highlight, the Chrome extension captures leads directly from profiles, making it a smooth and efficient addition to any sales process. The data extraction is solid too, often returning multiple phone numbers per contact. On price side, the subscription pricing is fairly reasonable compared to similar tools, making it accessible for teams of different sizes without breaking the budget. Overall, it strikes a decent balance between functionality and cost.
改善点: The biggest disappointment with Lusha has been the customer support. After reaching out via email regarding an account issue, I received no response, which is frustrating, especially when you're relying on the tool for active prospecting. For a paid service, that level of unresponsiveness is simply not acceptable. Beyond support, there are occasional bugs and issues that disrupt the experience, sometimes the extension fails to load data correctly or returns incomplete results, which wastes credits and slows down the sales process. These reliability hiccups, combined with the lack of support to escalate them to, make the overall experience feel lacking.

These would be things likes Hot Intent and Enrich seem to be driven by the current AI buzz, and have yet to really feel as substantive as some of their core features like Search and Recommendations, which are core functions. タイトル: The best web-based survey software for research ethics compliance
投稿者: Virgil 香港のResearch and Evaluation Manager and Advisor 非営利団体運営, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "The best web-based survey software for research ethics compliance"
良い点: It's easy to use with all the modern features for all types of social surveys and the reports can do segmentation which saves a lot of offline data analysis work. A really important selling point for me was the company's privacy policy and how they make it easy to tailor their product to be used for research on sensitive topics. Uniquely, Alchemer makes it really easy to activate the "response encryption" function which is the only way to prevent the company or its survey administrators from accessing or using anonymized forms of your survey data for other purposes. Secondary use of customers survey data is an important part of most online survey software company's business. They also specifically describe the use of this function being important for research on sensitive topics like personal health. They also are more straightforward in their privacy policy language when it comes to use of the "anonymous" survey function, which blocks the collection of IP addresses of survey respondents which happens by default for all online survey software. Competitors like survey monkey offer this feature but do not have as strong of guarantees in the privacy policy that they will not collect the IP addresses for their own business uses. Similarly the response encryption feature is generally available from competitors but at a higher price point and in the case of Qualtrics only as a non-disclosed cost add on feature.
改善点: It doesn't have the 100% smooth and premium feel that you'd expect. It's probably an 8/10 for design quality and has some quirks and occasional glitches. I've had issues with multi-language surveys and support for which Unicode/alphabet version for a language that the software supports, and separately problems with HTML script in the secondary language version of a survey being reset and erased spontaneously. Their customer support is really quick to respond on email however, and their help pages are really robust and easy to learn from.

The Design of Experiments (DOE) toolkit is incredibly powerful for systematically investigating process variables and identifying the exact factors that affect product quality. Another major advantage is the Assistant feature, which guides users step-by-step through complicated statistical concepts. This guided workflow reduces complexity and ensures that team members can perform rigorous process optimizations even if they lack a deep background in advanced statistics.
改善点: The biggest drawback is the highly restrictive and expensive licensing model, which can be prohibitive. Additionally, preparing and importing datasets from non-standard formats can sometimes be a tedious process that requires significant preliminary data cleaning before the analysis can begin. Finally, while the mathematical and statistical capabilities are unmatched, the data visualization tools and charts feel somewhat basic; it would be helpful to have more customizable and interactive charts for presenting complex findings to management or clients.

タイトル: Read this before signing the 1-Year contract!
投稿者: George アメリカのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 医療業務, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Read this before signing the 1-Year contract!"

改善点: Before signing a 1-year contract with Boulevard Software, I strongly recommend researching whether it truly fits your business workflow — especially if you own a medical spa. The software looked promising during the initial Zoom demos, but once we started using it daily, we experienced several major operational problems. Our biggest issue is client communication. Clients can reply to automated appointment reminder texts, but those messages are not reliably delivered unless someone is actively logged into the desktop dashboard. They are not properly accessible through the mobile app. This caused us to miss an important cancellation message for a $2,500 appointment on Easter Sunday, which resulted in unnecessary scheduling issues and lost family time. The mobile app is also extremely limited. There is no functional POS system for checking out clients directly from a phone, which is frustrating for businesses like ours that operate without a front desk. We also found the scheduling system, HIPAA forms, and medical intake workflows poorly designed for TRT, peptide, and wellness practices. Lastly, don’t accept the first price quote. We were initially quoted $400/month, but after negotiating, it dropped to $275/month. I’ll update this review after speaking with management tomorrow.

改善点: Honestly, it’s hard to find any major downsides. As we continue to grow and expand, having to pay full price for each additional location makes it difficult to scale affordably. Other software platforms such as Vagaro, Fresha, GlossGenius, and Mindbody offer discounted or tiered pricing for multiple locations, some even allow you to manage several under one plan or charge only a small add-on fee per site. Because our long-term goal is to continue expanding, we’ve started to explore these other platforms for the future. However, Boulevard still remains our top choice for its quality, design, and exceptional client experience.

タイトル: Seamless and "bullet-proof" remote control solution

良い点: FixMe.IT is intuitive and very simple to use for both the the consultant and the client. Connecting to a remote machine is as simple as having the remote user log into a website and advise the consultant of a numeric code. Another great feature is the "unattended access" feature which allows the consultant (with one time permission from the remote user) to access the remote device without requiring the presence of the remote user. In my years of experience with FixMe.IT I have never run into an occasion where it failed to load or run with any Windows machine user.

タイトル: Great piece of analytics software!
投稿者: Amber カナダのPhotographer 写真, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Great piece of analytics software!"

I love being able to see my top referrers without clicking around, it helps me keep track of the performance of ads I may be running to direct traffic to my site. I also being able to see the returning visitors - once one of them contacts you, so you can go see which pages they checked out and have a better idea of how educated they are about the services you offer.
改善点: The only thing I find I don't really like is that some referrers don't seem to be shown. I usually only see the referrals from top sites such as Facebook, Instagram and Google, but when I check my Google Analytics I can see other smaller websites that traffics is coming from.

タイトル: Quick and easy analytics reporting for wix websites

タイトル: My Experience with Visitors Analytics

It is much more accurate than Google Analytics and I can obtain immediate feedback in terms of the impact of my Google Ads campaigns. Since I am an exporter of live animals I must be focused on the results of my marketing efforts. I am now able to determine either the success or failure of my campaigns immediately and I can adjust and modify them very quickly.
改善点: I think the price of the subscription is high compared to other online services which use, like Dropbox and my current Zone Alarm Antivirus and Firewall. The price should be more competitive. I currently have three Visitors Analytics accounts for three different websites, and I do think I deserve a discount in compensation for my loyalty. It never happened!

タイトル: Easiest Proposal Creation Tool On The Market

良い点: The simplicity of this software is what makes it a "must-have" for agencies or businesses that need to send proposals to clients on a daily or weekly basis. At the end of the day this software does what it's meant to do and exceeds at it.

There are many reasons for this choice and mostly the liability, the process to licence in Canada is very difficult, time consuming and not always confirmed. The applicant is responsible for this process themselves. For all other Pharmacy staff, they must be a citizen for compliant placement.

タイトル: Humanity round two!
投稿者: Austin アメリカのPharmacy Manager 薬品, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Humanity round two!"
良い点: I used Humanity at my previous job and loved it so much I had to implement it at my new site. The customization and visibility of Humanity is my favorite part. The visibility for team members and schedulers makes the scheduling process so much easier to allow for shift management, scheduling, pick ups and payroll purposes. This has exponentially increased our accuracy for payroll by having this scheduling platform. The customer support has been very helpful with developing the platform, taking suggestions for improvements, and providing additional suggestions on ways we can continue to improve our existing platform. The regular communication with our customer success team really makes this value of this product worth the money, time, and effort put in to it's development. The notifications for team members as well as schedulers has also helped us provide real time responses and answers to scheduling related inquiries. I'm looking forward to the additional security benefits we will likely take advantage of with the single sign on option.
改善点: It's a mixture of something I like, but also struggle with. The level of customization can sometimes be intimidating to learn all of the different scheduling options that you have. It can take some time to fully comprehend the different options and what works best for your organization but the customer service reps are helpful.

タイトル: All bark, no bite

良い点: It appears to have all the features one would need to host life, evergreen, or hybrid events.
改善点: The features that are missing are critical. For one- you aren't furnished with a custom domain, meaning if you're using this for marketing purposes- you can't instal or use your Facebook pixel effectively. This is a deal breaker. The registration widgets are only compatible with their built-in, ugly AF landing pages. If you opt to use your own landing pages, it won't automatically redirect. This makes the registration process clunky and unintuitive for participants. Also, because it doesn't automatically redirect- your Meta pixel won't fire! The registration landing pages are ugly, require extensive CSS customization, and are useless because again- no ability to register the domain with your advertising account. Participants are prompted to touch the screen to start hearing the audio, but most miss this notice- it leaves a poor taste in their mouth when something doesn't work immediately and intuitively. There's zero security built-in, which means once a bot gets a hold of your URL you're flooded with bogus registrations- and if you use your own security it bypasses the block list. The analytics are NIGHTMARE with no ability to filter by date- which makes collecting KPIs a tedious manual task.

タイトル: Reliable and MSP-Friendly Backup Solution with Strong Day-to-Day Management

良い点: What I liked most about Cove Data Protection was how well it fit into an MSP environment while still being simple to manage day to day. The platform made it easy to deploy backups quickly across multiple client environments, monitor backup health centrally, and verify successful backups without adding a lot of administrative overhead. A few areas that stood out to me: The cloud-first architecture simplified deployment and reduced dependency on complex on-prem infrastructure. The management console was straightforward and efficient for monitoring multiple clients at scale. Backup verification and alerting helped ensure backups were actually completing successfully, which is critical in managed services environments. Restore options were flexible, whether restoring a single file, mailbox item, or a full system. It integrated well into operational workflows focused on backup success rates, disaster recovery readiness, and compliance-driven environments. From an MSP operations perspective, reliability and visibility are usually the most important factors, and Cove did a good job balancing both without becoming overly complicated.
改善点: What I liked least about Cove Data Protection was that while the platform is very streamlined, some advanced configuration and reporting capabilities felt limited compared to more enterprise-focused backup platforms. A few areas that could be frustrating at times: Reporting customization could feel restrictive, especially when trying to provide highly tailored executive or compliance reporting to clients. Large-scale restore operations could sometimes be slower than expected depending on bandwidth and recovery scope. Troubleshooting certain failed backups occasionally lacked deep enough error detail, requiring additional support engagement or log review.

良い点: What I like most about Cove Data Protection is its cloud-first backup approach. We no longer have to worry about backups failing because a local backup destination becomes unavailable. Having everything managed through a single online dashboard is also a huge advantage, as it gives us a clear global overview of all backup jobs and device statuses. We’ve experienced a very high backup success rate, which gives us confidence in the platform’s reliability. The process for adding new devices is simple and efficient, making ongoing management incredibly easy. Another major benefit is that the backup agents update automatically, eliminating the need for the manual update process we had to deal with in our previous backup solution.
改善点: One area where Cove Data Protection could be improved is the file recovery process when a device is offline or has already been decommissioned. In those situations, restoring files is not as straightforward as we would have hoped. Instead of simply opening the web interface and downloading the needed file, you must load the device into the recovery console first. We experienced this firsthand when a server had been decommissioned and we needed to retrieve a file from backup. The recovery process was more involved than expected and could be simplified to make restores faster and more user-friendly.

タイトル: A powerful all-in-one observability platform (just watch the cost)
投稿者: Kaynan カナダのSoftware Engineer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "A powerful all-in-one observability platform (just watch the cost)"
良い点: Datadog gives us a single pane of glass across our whole stack. I can jump from an APM trace to the exact logs and the host and container metrics behind a request without switching tools, which makes debugging production issues in our backend much faster. The dashboards are flexible, the out-of-the-box integrations covered almost everything we run, and monitors with alerting into Slack mean we usually hear about problems before users do. Distributed tracing across services has been especially valuable as our architecture grew.
改善点: Pricing is the big drawback: costs can climb quickly and unpredictably as you add hosts, custom metrics, and log ingestion, so you have to actively manage what you send. The sheer number of products and settings has a real learning curve, and getting sampling and index filters right takes effort. The UI can also feel heavy and occasionally slow when querying very large time ranges.

改善点: That said, support has noticeably declined since the company was sold. The process required us to complete a long, detailed questionnaire that largely defeated the purpose of outsourcing the work in the first place. If your team already understands the registration requirements, you’ll likely save both time and money by handling registrations directly with the states yourself.

Stripe integration, allowing you to use your existing Stripe account for direct rentals. Fleet/calendar management that made sense for your roughly 10-vehicle operation. Custom rental agreements and maintenance tracking, both important as you moved toward direct rentals. Price — roughly $120/month for up to 10 vehicles at the time we compared it, which was substantially more attractive than some of the heavier systems.
改善点: Insurance was still the big problem. HQ could collect insurance information, but it didn't solve your central goal of providing/validating renter coverage in the way you wanted—especially having the renter pay for protection rather than Drive Ready Auto absorbing that cost. Driver/identity verification required another service. We discussed using Vouched alongside HQ rather than having everything truly built into one platform. Extra integrations meant extra cost and complexity. HQ's base price looked good, but Stripe, identity verification, insurance-related services, and other add-ons could turn a ~$120/month system into a more expensive stack. Some automation wasn't as turnkey as you wanted. Your goal was essentially: customer books → verifies identity/license → verifies or buys insurance → signs agreement → pays/deposit → gets pickup instructions, with very little intervention from you. You wanted one system to do everything. HQ came fairly close on rental operations, but you still had to piece together several outside services. 検討した類似製品： Rent Centric HQ Rental Softwareに切りかえた理由： What I liked most about HQ Rental Software was that it gave Drive Ready Auto the right balance of capability, simplicity, and price.

良い点: 1. The app is very easy to configure & set up. 2. The user experience is seamless & functionality is very self-explanatory. 3. There are multiple ways to configure each component, so you can set up the app according to what works best for you & your company. (No "one size fits all" model.) 4. The ability to set up different workflows for different departments has been a huge help for us.
改善点: 1. It's a little hard to envision how each of the components should be set up for your organization when you're first getting in there (i.e., projects, workflows, milestones, epics, stories), so we ended up changing the setup as we went along after the initial configuration. This wasn't necessarily a bad thing, as it allowed us to improve the way we currently did things. 2. The biggest issue we have now, after using the app for a while, is that stories do not populate into the Gantt charts, only epics. This means if we have one-off tasks that are added as stories, those do not pull into the report we'd like. For that reason, we have to set up an entire epic just to set up a single story, for reporting purposes. I think it would be great if you had the option to pull the Gantt reports at the epic or story-level.

タイトル: GRAIL's Review
投稿者: John アメリカのAssociate Director, People Systems & Operations バイオテクノロジー, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "GRAIL's Review"
良い点: Easy to use from an employee perspective
改善点: No rules engine for approval process: No way for the system to skip approvers if they've already approved earlier in the cycle (example, Manager may also be the budget owner or HRBP. End of approving twice for the same person). No rules engine for approval process: No way for system to recognize and skip a person approving as themselves. No rules engine for approval process: Cannot use management chain or any other rule for assigning approvers at different approval levels. (Have to script this into the SFTP file and manually maintain). i.e. level 1 approver: use nominees line manager. Or approver 2: route approval to nominee's HR Partner. Or line 3: all people in department x, route to x for approval. For direct cash awards that are paid outside of the platform (i.e. what GUILD calls non-monetary awards), there's no way to edit the suggested amount or "Send Back" the step to prior step. Means if an amount changes through the approval process, we have to cancel the award, ask the Nominator to resubmit, then go through the entire approval process again. Clients have very limited configuration options available compared to what GUILD support can do. Means we need to submit a ticket for basic set-up. Example: we'd like to limit the number of nominations a person can receive (example 1 per month) to help avoid duplicate awards for the same body of work. This is possible on the platform, but only GUILD admins can set it up. Pictures are not diverse (4 white males)

改善点: The initial configuration and setup can take some time, especially when monitoring a large number of devices or configuring different monitoring requirements. タイトル: OpManager Review
投稿者: Laura カナダのNetwork architecte 政府機関, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "OpManager Review"
良い点: OpManager provides a centralized view of our network infrastructure and makes it easier to monitor a large number of switches, routers, servers, and other network devices from a single console. Device discovery, availability monitoring, performance metrics, and alerting are generally easy to configure and provide useful visibility for day-to-day operations. I also appreciate the flexibility of SNMP monitoring, custom thresholds, dashboards, and notifications. It helps our team identify connectivity or performance issues quickly and provides a good overall picture of infrastructure health.
改善点: Some configuration and troubleshooting tasks can be more complex than expected, especially when dealing with device credentials, SNMP settings, authentication, or monitoring issues that are specific to certain network equipment. In some cases, alerts do not immediately provide enough context to identify the root cause, so additional investigation directly on the device is still required. The interface also contains many configuration options, which can make administration less intuitive when working with advanced features. Documentation and troubleshooting guidance could also be more detailed for complex enterprise network environments.

タイトル: Flexible, Scalable Platform for Complex Catalogs and Hybrid D2C + B2B
投稿者: Frank カナダのHead of Digital 事務用品、事務機器, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Flexible, Scalable Platform for Complex Catalogs and Hybrid D2C + B2B"
良い点: One of BigCommerce’s biggest strengths is its true hierarchical category structure. When we replatformed from WooCommerce, we evaluated BigCommerce Enterprise against Shopify Plus, and Shopify’s Collections simply couldn’t replicate our deep category/subcategory structure without relying on apps. BigCommerce supports this natively, which made SEO planning and catalog organization much cleaner for us. Another standout is BigCommerce’s native product customization capabilities. The platform lets you add required acknowledgements, collect customer input via text or choice fields, and use the Product Pick List to let shoppers add compatible accessories or components directly from a product page. For anyone selling modular or configuration‑heavy products, this built‑in flexibility is extremely useful and reduces the need for app‑based workarounds. The Promotions editor is also very capable. I once suggested adding the ability to cap a percentage-based discount by a dollar amount, and that functionality eventually became available, which helps for certain promotional structures. For B2B, BigCommerce’s pricing tools are practical and flexible. On Enterprise, we choose between Customer Groups, Price Lists, or the Promotions engine depending on what fits the scenario, as each tool serves a distinct purpose. We also like that we can run D2C and B2B on the same platform—one catalog and promotions engine, with B2B‑specific pricing/visibility where needed—without maintaining separate stac
改善点: The built‑in AI copywriter isn’t particularly strong, so we rely on external AI tools for generating product descriptions. The biggest limitation for us is the lack of broader third‑party support for Multi‑Storefront and Multi‑Location. BigCommerce provides both features, but many OMS, ERP, and inventory systems still don’t integrate with them in a way that makes a single‑backend, multi‑storefront setup truly practical. The potential is there, but until the ecosystem catches up, we maintain separate stores. Another issue is the way BigCommerce presents its negotiated or preferred card rates with Braintree on the pricing page. The advertised rates look very attractive, but in practice there was no clear path to obtaining them. Documentation didn’t explain how qualification works, support redirected us to Braintree, and even after meeting the listed conditions, it became evident that the rates weren’t realistically accessible. We eventually negotiated with other gateways and moved on. BigCommerce’s newer BigCommerce Payments offering for non‑Enterprise plans lists rates that seem much closer to what merchants actually see in reality. On the search side, Semantic Search was announced for 2024 but still hasn’t materialized. Meanwhile, Shopify’s native search has improved significantly, so BigCommerce currently lags unless you use a third‑party search solution. BigCommerce appears more focused on agentic search initiatives and Feedonomics Surface, which doesn’t help onsite search

タイトル: Quick Setup and Feature-Rich Custom Compliance Widget

良い点: The UserWay Accessibility Widget is a powerful and cost efficient app that is simple to implement on just about any website. The widget natively integrates with several website platforms, including SquareSpace, and configuring the widget's size, display location on my website and updating it with custom branded colors took just minutes. I like that it auto-scans as many webpages as I want to provide detailing reports on areas that require updating to meet compliance. The report guides users step by step on necessary adjustments, anyone could follow along without any technical experience.
改善点: The only aspect that I dislike are some of the plan tiers, which offer a certain number of webpages that the widget will display on, scan and provide detailed reports. If you have a large website with many pages the total overall cost to add full compliance could get expensive, especially for a small business.

タイトル: Easy To Use - Flexible Payment
投稿者: Lake アメリカのDirector of Education 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 非営利団体運営, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Easy To Use - Flexible Payment"

The pay-as-we go type structure is flexible for our nonprofit. We do not bill frequently enough to justify a monthly fee, and so this option has been incredible. It was super easy to make our own, customizing the products, prices, receipts, and options at the click of a button. It integrates powerfully with other tools that use. This makes sales online, over the phone, through invoice, or on-site at events a breeze, and the platform is easy enough that anyone on my team can use it with their user/team options.
改善点: We have faced some challenges when out on the site with connectivity of card readers, particularly those that connect via Bluetooth to an iPad. Once connected they are quick and easy to use, however the initial connection during a period can be tough. We are an infrequent use organization, since we accept payments with this platform during events, it could be months without using and I think this contributes to the difficulty versus it connecting to the device every day. I do find the iPad layout to be a bit more clunky, feeling like an enlarged iPhone layout versus its own dedicated design.

To preview it, you have to turn on nav and preview while editing a live site. Large data sets are hopeless with their tools. Support is terrible. You get passed from department to department and often they can't verify your profile to help you. There is no way to build a content page that isn't a product record. 投稿者: Austin アメリカのAnalyst 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 医療機器, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Domo Provides Critical BI Functions at Lower Cost"
良い点: Domo provides all of the essential functions of other products including data connectors, data visualization, data ingestion and exports, as well as dashboard creation. Domo does have a learning curve to learn the difference in how the back end functions are different, but anyone with previous experience should be able to pick it up.
改善点: At times Domo can be slower than other products, and does sometimes crash when ingesting large amounts of data. We also used a browser based UI which could cause trouble if their were browser issues, etc.

タイトル: Domo: Great Product at a Fantastic Price
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー マーケティング、広告, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Domo: Great Product at a Fantastic Price"
良い点: It was easy to use to import data and build data connectors. One person could manage the entire data structure and system fairly easily.
改善点: There are limitations to software when its easy to use. Domo is not an exception.

タイトル: Nice to look at, not the easiest to navigate
投稿者: Eleanor アメリカのSenior Specialist, Education Programs 非営利団体運営, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Nice to look at, not the easiest to navigate"
良い点: The data it puts out is fairly easy to digest, and you can make edits to the cards in real time. It's also easy to collaborate with colleagues on projects within Domo.
改善点: The interface itself isn't the most intuitive. Trying to navigate to different boards/projects can feel a bit jumbled at times. It can also be confusing figuring out how to request to join a card/project if you don't know who the owner is, or having to contact them outside the platform since the notification system doesn't always seem to... notify people.

タイトル: Business Intelligence at the
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー レジャー、旅行、観光, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Business Intelligence at the"
良い点: Domo enables as to give a live 360 degree view on our business and makes data accessible and visible to everyone in the company. It’s not just about visualization of KPIs and other data. You can take the data and turn it into actionable steps. Furthermore, the existing integrations that are available makes it easy to have all our data available in Domo and combine them. You can still see the start-up mentality and the new features and the speed that they deliver new features and product improvements is amazing. For us Domo is so much more than just about data - we have it part of our product development process and have a lot of operational processes built on data transformations that we built in Domo.
改善点: DOMO is very costly compared to other BI tools, especially when you want to have separate user accounts for each user and do not share accounts among users. Other than that Domo worked already most of the cons that I had in the beginning.

タイトル: Domo's a fantastic tool for creating data-driven business processes
投稿者: Muhammed トルコのIT Director 建設, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Domo's a fantastic tool for creating data-driven business processes"

The interface looks great and is very suitable for users with little background in data tools. That was very important for us as several departments are using it at the moment and everyone was able to get the hang of it despite some not being 100% proficient with tools like it.
改善点: It's not as well known as some of the other data management tools out there, so there isn't much of a community behind it. It would be good to have the ability to exchange ideas with other users.

タイトル: 初めての設定でも簡単に設定できる

タイトル: Connected Forms
投稿者: Michael アメリカのCommunications Manager 卸売, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Connected Forms"

タイトル: Fantastic support team, solid ATS offering for 3rd party search firms
投稿者: Mickey アメリカのDirector of Operations & Research 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 人材, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Fantastic support team, solid ATS offering for 3rd party search firms"
良い点: After years of limited options, there are finally an increasing number of ATS platforms coming online that accomodate the nuanced process of external recruiters. RecruiterFlow's greatest asset is their responsive support team. They are clearly working hard to develop a useful product in a somewhat crowded marketplace.
改善点: RecruiterFlow is a fairly new software. After extensively canvassing the market, it's easy to look at the features of Lever or Loxo and think, why can't __________ do that, too? There are absolutely limitations as it stands now when comparing them to the heavy hitters, but the trade offs are worth it. You get an easy-to-learn, solid software that is active and focused in rolling out new features when they are ready and not too early. Our recruiters would love a mobile app, too.

タイトル: Recruiterflow tries harder!
投稿者: Jen アメリカのFounder, Managing Director 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 人材派遣、人材紹介, 自営業 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Recruiterflow tries harder!"
良い点: Recruiterflow works really hard to earn your business. +Product Updates: They solicit feedback on making product better and quickly turnaround product updates. For example, recently introduced new text feature in campaigns. +Customer Support: We speak with a real person, not a bot, every single time. We don't have to file a help ticket or wait for a call back, as I often did with Salesforce. Recruiterflow is a growing company with everyone invested in the success of the product and their clients. They're really interested in problem solving. I hope this never changes!
改善点: I wish they had a pricing option for groups vs. seats. Or lower cost for each additional user.

タイトル: Lots of glitches and not user friendly. But very affordable
投稿者: Sarah アメリカのPeople & Culture Manager 消費財, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 ソース：SoftwareAdvice 共有 "Lots of glitches and not user friendly. But very affordable"
良い点: Being that it's an ATS, it's better than not having one. It is about 1 step above keeping paper resumes. It's much cheaper than other platforms The customer service is prompt.
改善点: This system is extremely glitchy and not intuitive compared to the other ATS platforms I have used. - Setting up the application form is quite awkward within job set up is clunky. If you don't save the job on that particular screen, all that information will be lost (even though every other aspect of the job set up does not work this way) - Invites randomly get sent out in the Monrovian time zone. - You can't remove a job from your job board without it closing the job completely. Both Greenhouse and Workable allow you to take the job off your careers page, but leave it open. - Formatting the job description is always off. - About 20% of the resumes that come through are unable to be read by the software, even though they are either PDF or Word docs.

タイトル: Wish we'd known about Vincere years ago.
投稿者: Harriet Senior Sales Account Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー インターネット, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 ソース：GetApp 共有 "Wish we'd known about Vincere years ago."
良い点: Definitely, the biggest plus for us has been ease of use and the ability to customize searches and page views easily. Plus, there is no need to have to train new users on the system, they can get going by themselves. Vincere handles the entire life cycle of the placement process, from getting new customers on board through to invoicing and billing. It basically contains everything you need to get your job done with as little hassle as possible. The interface is also pretty cool- it feels super modern and works great on mobile. The analytics are also very, very good: you get several dashboards and the option to export out to excel.
改善点: None. This system has been an absolute lifesaver for our business- I can't recommend it highly enough.

タイトル: Ever-evolving, function-packed, value-for-money CRM/ATS

タイトル: Pipefy or Trello?
投稿者: Fabrício Yutaka ブラジルのFounder 認証済みLinkedInユーザー マーケティング、広告, 自営業 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Pipefy or Trello?"
良い点: That's the most common question I hear. If you don't have a minimum process established, you should use Trello. But, if you already have some business process designed for your routines — and need to guarantee they're followed, then your choice is Pipefy. Best of all, Pipefy is like a Lego, so, you can change and rearrange the process and its phases as you evolve them over time. You don't need to exaustly plan ahead every detail.
改善点: Some changes in the process are possible only at the cost of "losing" some historical data. For example, you can't move a field from phase A to phase B. You have to recreate it as a new field and delete (or hide) the old one.

タイトル: An enhanced visitor experience driven by the team's insatiable appetite to innovate!
投稿者: Mark 日本 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 使用期間： 1年以上 ソース：GetApp 共有 "An enhanced visitor experience driven by the team's insatiable appetite to innovate!"
良い点: Above all I am most impressed by the continuous innovation that accompanies a Proxyclick installation - it just doesn't ever stop and in my mind demonstrates just how committed and passionate the team is about their product. Proxyclick has elevated visitor management well beyond the simple act of registration... and incorporated notions of security, health and safety, brand promotion, customer communication and privacy. It is also the most globally-minded system we have found on the market... not just by incorporating multiple languages but also by paying special attention to the importance of design. The result is that users of any nationality can use Proxyclick very intuitively (at the kiosk or in the back office). The set up is simple, and the settings are very configurable (without adding needless complexity) to give administrators the flexibility required to customise the product by client (eg, personalised visitor badges or registration flows etc.). In an age where digital technology threatens to eradicate the role of people... it is very refreshing to have a digital technology on the market that compliments our teams' efforts on the ground and ensures they can deliver a more dynamic visitor experience where human interactions thrive.
改善点: Personal data, privacy and data security concerns are an ever-present concern for us and our clients. Not only do we need to contend with the threat of cyber attacks but also being compliant with new legislation (eg, the EU's General Data Protection Regulation). Proxyclick - as with all SaaS products in the marketplace - will therefore need to take their product to the next level to ensure it stays a best-in-class solution.

タイトル: Simple and Reliable Email Verification for Cleaner Data
投稿者: Shivam インドのData Scientist 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Simple and Reliable Email Verification for Cleaner Data"
良い点: What I like most about Bouncer is how straightforward it makes email verification and data cleaning. I can upload a list, review the results, and identify invalid or risky addresses without a complicated workflow. The API is also useful when email verification needs to be integrated into an application or an existing data process. The interface is clean enough for regular use, and the results are easy to understand.
改善点: There is a small learning curve when getting familiar with all of the verification and deliverability options. Some risky or unknown results can also require additional checking before making a final decision. I would like to see more detailed explanations for certain verification results and more flexibility for managing larger datasets.

タイトル: Effectiveness and Control for Effortless Email Cleaning
投稿者: Juan Daniel エクアドルのEngineer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Effectiveness and Control for Effortless Email Cleaning"
良い点: The best part is how easy it is to integrate their API (it’s completely headache-free). Also, the bulk list cleaning and Domain Management features are total lifesavers. I really appreciate that it identifies "accept all" servers and gives you detailed reputation reports; that level of detail is a game-changer for protecting your sender health and making sure your emails actually land in the inbox. The UIX it's very friendly.
改善点: There’s a bit of a "disconnect" sometimes between the web dashboard and the API. I’ve run into cases where the API marks an email as "unknown" due to timeouts or greylisting, but when I upload that same email manually to the dashboard, it validates just fine. It would be awesome if both interfaces were perfectly synced in terms of timing to avoid double-checking.

良い点: MindMeister is a simple online tool for creating mind maps, project tasks or meeting notes. My team has used it for around 1.5 years and we have absolutely loved it. It helps in brainstorming the ideas with your hybrid team members and organize those ideas in a structured way. It has extremely intuitive UI and anyone can start using it without any training. You can upload different files from your local system or google drive. This features is extremely helpful when you want to attach details for a particular step. Once you have created a mind map, you can export it in different format like .pdf, .png, .docx, .pptx etc. and share it with your team members or client stakeholders.I love the collection of pre-built templates in MindMeister as it saves up a lot of time during ideation sessions.
改善点: A big drawback of MindMeister is that it doesn't allow you to create process/data flow diagrams (like BPMN). Due to this limitation, you might need to switch to a different tool. Additionally, we have faced a bit of a lag if the mind map is extremely detailed out or having large files attached to it. Also, its free plan only allows you to create a few documents and doesn't provide enough features.
