タイトル: JumpCloud Pros and Cons
投稿者: Deepak インドのPre Sales - Tech Consultant 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "JumpCloud Pros and Cons"
良い点: Unified IT Infrastructure: It consolidates Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), cloud LDAP, RADIUS, and Mobile Device Management (MDM) into one centralized platform. Cross-Platform Flexibility: IT admins can seamlessly manage users and enforce security policies across Windows, macOS, and Linux devices from a single console. Serverless IT Footprint: Eliminates the need for on-premises domain controllers, significantly reducing maintenance overhead, patching requirements, and hardware costs. Generous Free Tier: JumpCloud offers a Free for 10 tier that gives smaller operations full platform access for up to 10 users and 10 devices without a time limit. Streamlined User Lifecycle: The platform simplifies onboarding and offboarding by allowing admins to deploy software backend configurations or drop multi-system access instantly.
改善点: Clunky Admin Interface: Users frequently note that the admin console can be unintuitive at first, featuring a steep learning curve and requiring too many clicks for advanced policy settings. Weak Native Reporting: The built-in compliance and reporting tools lack polished executive dashboards, often forcing administrators to export raw data to third-party business intelligence tools. Feature Gating & Scaling Costs: While lower tiers have transparent pricing, critical advanced features like Zero Trust Conditional Access and SaaS License Management are locked behind their most expensive "Platform Prime" tier. Offboarding Billing Pitfall: When offboarding employees, JumpCloud continues to bill for suspended users; billing only ceases once the user account is completely deleted. Limited Niche Capabilities: Some components, like the built-in password manager, rely on inconsistent browser add-ons that users find less robust than dedicated alternatives. It also lacks native network printer management.

タイトル: Powerful Client Reporting with Room for More Flexibility and Smarter AI
投稿者: Lukas アメリカのSenior SEM Manager マーケティング、広告, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Powerful Client Reporting with Room for More Flexibility and Smarter AI"
良い点: What I like most about Looker is how effectively it turns performance marketing data into clear, client-friendly dashboards. I can bring key metrics such as spend, impressions, clicks, conversions, CPA, ROAS, etc., into one central view. The filters and drill-downs make it easy to analyze performance by channel, campaign, audience, or date range without building a new report each time. Standardized metric definitions also give clients confidence that everyone is working from the same numbers. Scheduled dashboard deliveries save time and keep stakeholders informed without requiring repetitive manual reporting. Overall, Looker helps me spend less time assembling reports and more time interpreting results and identifying opportunities to improve performance.
改善点: What I like least about Looker is that building polished client dashboards can feel more rigid than it should. The visualization and formatting options are limited, especially when clients request specific branding, custom layouts, or presentation-ready charts. Larger dashboards can also load slowly when they include data from multiple marketing channels or cover longer date ranges. Looker’s Gemini integration adds useful conversational analytics, but the prompt-driven experience still feels limited. I can ask questions in plain language and generate metrics, charts, or new dashboard tiles based on governed data, which is helpful for quick analysis. However, I cannot simply prompt Looker to redesign an existing dashboard, rearrange the layout, or make a series of live visual changes. Most responses appear as standalone results or guided queries, so users still have to rely on traditional editing tools to implement changes. The AI functionality is promising, but it does not yet offer the intuitive, fully conversational dashboard-building experience that I believe would put Looker ahead of its competition.

タイトル: Good idea in theory, but misses the mark when it comes to overall functionality.
投稿者: Kevin アメリカのCustomer Operations Manager 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Good idea in theory, but misses the mark when it comes to overall functionality."
良い点: It was fairly easy to set up and get running. The supplied good write-ups for getting things installed and connected to things like Zendesk. The graphs are easy to just copy-paste the code and it looks pretty nice.
改善点: If you make a mistake when setting up your reviewing, you have to start from the beginning to fix that mistake, you can't just fix it. I ever reached out to support for help but, after several days of no response, I ended up just deleting all the work I did and starting over from scratch. Only then I heard back from support and they essentially told me to do just that. In addition to this, it's impossible to get an accurate measurement of historic data. I wanted to simply pull my team's average score on a daily basis and report that. First off, they don't allow you to pull this information via CSV or spreadsheet, I had to look at this tiny chart and hover over each day individually. Secondly, I noticed different scores when I changed the date range. For example, I set my date range as May 1st - May 31st and on May 1st, my average team score was 5.93. When I changed my date range to May 1st - June 23rd and looked at May 1st, my average team score was now 6.1. I emailed their support, waited a few days, and heard back that they would check with their engineering team about that. A few days later, they said "The graph has just an informative character and scores are changed a bit so graph doesn't look to "bumpy" when there are multiple different scores every day. " When I pressed more on this, they said that I'd have to change the date range to each day to get accurate historic information, which is absolutely awful. Searching for a replacement for this product...

タイトル: Feels like the programmers are reassigned constantly
投稿者: Dee アメリカのHR Director 消費財, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Feels like the programmers are reassigned constantly"
良い点: The sales team is actually a pretty awesome group of people, as are the people who handle training.

We were never able to really set a program and forget about it, it was constant baby sitting. There would be reports that would run, when it finally loaded it would be empty. We'd call to find out what is up and they'd say "oh, that report hasn't been built out yet." That report would be smack in the middle of runnable reports, and Arcoro had no intention of hiding or making note of which reports are "coming soon." System loading between the three systems (the LMS and Performance pieces weren't even listed in this review as an option to talk about) was not smooth. We were told it would take one day to load, turns out it could take 3 days. So, when trouble shooting issues, it wasn't just finding what was wrong, it could take three days to ensure it didn't load, but the software wouldn't tell us where the critical error was. Report running wasn't easy, making reports was almost impossible. Every part of the system felt like we had to crack a safe by listening to the dial for the right thing to push before we chose the next option.

良い点: ArchiCAD is one of the most innovative platforms for BIM available in the market today. It is a powerful software that can cater to the design needs of architects, interior designers as well as landscape and urban planners. One can either import 2D drafts into ArchiCAD and work on the same to prepare a 3D model; or work on ArchiCAD on Plan mode and the software will automatically generate elevations, sections and 3D views. If the building is multi-storey, it is much easier to correct any minor deficiencies in drafting (that can be missed in the plan view) through the 3D viewer, which makes it perfect to use when trying to pinpoint any errors. There is a wonderful feature in AutoCAD called Solibri Model Checker that can accurately analyse the BIM model to accurately locate errors along with any possible faults in design, and identify areas, where the components used, are clashing. As an Architect, I feel that it is a great tool that can be used to estimate the energy requirements of a building. Moreover, there is a plug-in called EcoDesigner STAR that offers features including energy model visualization, thermal zoning and simulations for energy performance. It is one of the better software I have used for 3D modelling and I never think of switching to any other.
改善点: As is with other similar software, ArchiCAD requires a robust system to operate with a high level of RAM especially when rendering. It does tend to slow down the system a bit especially when you are opening a data-rich file. Secondly, there is a steep learning curve with the software, which is easy to overcome with practice. Apart from these two shortcomings, I have no other major concern that would affect my opinion of this otherwise excellent software.

タイトル: Not a Good Service for JP-EN Text Localization
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 執筆、編集, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Not a Good Service for JP-EN Text Localization"
良い点: I like the fact that I can export files in Memsource to a format that I can actually work in and use the tools of my trade. This is genuinely the only thing I like about the program.
改善点: Compared to Google Sheets, this program is simply for managers who value quantity over quality because it provides them an overview of how many scripts are done without them needing to go in and actually read any text. As a worker in the workflow, I cannot view any documents without the potential of a major technical issue requiring a ticket to fix (to which the "fix" was to create an entirely new project), cannot provide feedback to translators as they are working. The use of translation memory or automated translation or repeat line auto-translation is not a welcome feature in the visual novel sphere, as context dictates how a line may read. For languages where context is not as necessary to understand a line, perhaps this program would be useful, but for the Japanese-English pairing, it absolutely is not. I am unable to use any of the regular expression or spell check tools without exporting the document to a difficult-to-format DOCX file (if you modify something incorrectly, it will not re-import), and then I cannot upload the completed file and mark it as complete because then I have to manually mark every edited line as complete. And while marking these lines as complete, I have to wait 10-30 seconds every 50 lines while Memsource works to catch up with me marking lines as complete. Google Sheets is free, has more utilities, and is more user-friendly to navigate and operate.

Customer support has been reliable over the years, especially when dealing with more complex issues that need proper attention. It is not trying to be everything, so things like image editing or video editing are not relevant here, but for what it is built to do, it delivers.
改善点: If I am being honest, it feels quite clunky and not particularly modern in terms of its out of the box experience. There is also a heavy reliance on internet access, and the lack of meaningful offline capability can be frustrating when you are on the go. タイトル: ''Secure Communication Solution With Secure login''

タイトル: My All in one and daily Driver
投稿者: Nishant インドのBDM 認証済みLinkedInユーザー ホスピタリティ, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "My All in one and daily Driver"
良い点: CloudTalk is intuitive and easy to use, with excellent call quality and reliable global connectivity. It integrates smoothly with popular CRMs like HubSpot and Salesforce, saving time with automatic logging. Features like call recording, smart routing, and analytics help improve team performance. Its cloud-based setup makes it ideal for remote teams, and customer support is responsive and helpful.
改善点: Pricing can become expensive as you scale or add premium features. The mobile app lacks some key functions compared to desktop. Occasional glitches or lag may occur in the desktop version. Complex features like advanced routing or automation have a steeper learning curve. Also, being entirely cloud-based, it relies heavily on a stable internet connection for optimal performance.

タイトル: Makes everyday work noticeably easier!
投稿者: Oliver ドイツのCFO 薬品, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Makes everyday work noticeably easier!"
良い点: The app runs flawlessly on both phones and laptops, unlike many other products out there. The design and user-friendliness are truly excellent. The modern and appealing layout makes making and receiving calls a pleasure every time.
改善点: So far, we have had absolutely no problems with CloudTalk. Every feature meets our expectations and contributes to improving our daily communication. CloudTalk's ease of use and reliability make it an indispensable part of our studio.

タイトル: intruitive for Both Admins and Users
投稿者: Eyituoyo ナイジェリアのLinux System Admin 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "intruitive for Both Admins and Users"
良い点: One of the most difficult issues with adapting to new software is not just getting the administrators to like and accept the software but to also get the final users of the solutions (support team) to use it with minimal setup and a short learning cycle. It was so easy for staff to make use of it right out of the box that we were running literally within minutes. Also as a Systems Administrator, nothing is better than having a clean interface to work with, you get a quick summary right on your dashboard and any function or feature you need is within easy reach. Plus with the support staff helping to iron out any and all issues that pop up, which was very few (was mostly our fault - a bad internet), we were more than happy having it as our default solution moving forward.
改善点: For now, I don't think there is anything negative I have to say about Cloudtalk. Would love to pick a number from a selection but that's not a con.

タイトル: Quartzy works!
投稿者: Desiree アメリカのResearch Associate 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 研究, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Quartzy works!"
良い点: I like how customizable and user friendly this software is. I don't spend hours trying to figure out how to input something into the system. This aspect also makes its very easy to introduce new lab personnel to it. I don't know how many times I have have been able to readily access our inventory find a specific item and *locate* it in the lab for someone else. And I can look up specific items or a group of items. That is invaluable to lab management.
改善点: This may have changed recently, but there should be a way, when requesting items to be purchased, that the software can tell you if the same item has been requested by someone else (and has yet to be delivered). This can also be done by careful humans so it is not a big deal . . .

タイトル: The good, the bad and the minor issues iv had.
投稿者: Anthony アメリカのlab manager バイオテクノロジー, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "The good, the bad and the minor issues iv had."
良い点: If you're ordering something familiar or defined within there system it gets easier and easier. Essentially its more to get it started then to maintain which is ideal and understandably a good thing. The inventorying and ease of use for finding previously ordered products arguably too convenient.
改善点: So the issue with the inventory and management of items once it arrives is that it requires the end user to document and track the usage to form a digital inventory. Which is reasonable but in academic sciences its a little less then realistic. More over for me the worst part is the combining of invoices which I love makes things appear very streamlined however in the end you will be likely charged for the individual vendors used. Which is understandable, except for the fact it clashes with my universities way of handling fiances at the end of each month.

タイトル: Good for Start-ups, but not Scalable
投稿者: Christy アメリカのLab Manager 研究, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Good for Start-ups, but not Scalable"
良い点: I like the automatic quoting and matching when it can save us money. I use the export feature to run statistics on our procurement process and spending. I like that its free and has an easy to use dashboard to see where items are in the process. Having access to punchouts as a small business is a perk!
改善点: I don't like that they quote items that'll cost MORE to get from Quartzy, and to a new user is can look misleading. I don't like that when you purchase items through Quartzy that they don't make the request form editable. Quartzy does not connect to our ERP, so we have to do a lot of manual work. The import template is awful because it doesn't match the request button, so I still get stuck doing manual entry work. Also I wish they had a "viewer" authority level because I have many people that want to check status of orders, but that should not be able to place orders.

タイトル: Almost Perfect
投稿者: Andrew アメリカのResearch Associate 研究, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Almost Perfect"
良い点: I absolutely love Quartzy. It is the easiest way to keep everything in the lab organized and it would be complete chaos without it. Just the overall presentation of everything is super helpful. Having a request section and an inventory section that allows a seamless transition of what you ordered to putting it into inventory is amazing.
改善点: There are three things that I do not like about the software. 1. It would be way more convenient to have an app that is just as good as the web portal 2. A little more customization on what I feel is necessary information when others are creating an order. 3. A more developed scanning feature (which may be more applicable with a mobile app)

タイトル: Quartzy for Inventory and Manufacturing

改善点: The only problem we have faced are duplicate serial number entries that are generated from manual and auto entries but I think the issue has been resolved quickly.

タイトル: Great customer service and reward options

My issue was corrected and fixed and I still had my reward the next day!
改善点: There were more gift card options than I was used to, so I got confused and selected the wrong reward type.

タイトル: Balanced and Professional

Support Delays: Customer service response times can sometimes be slow when resolving end-user redemption issues. Hidden Fees: The conversion rates or processing fees for certain international rewards can sometimes be slightly high.

投稿者: Vaibhav 英国のMonitoring DevOps Engineer 石油、エネルギー, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great for Logging only!"
良い点: Best in class Log analytics and real time log event monitoring. Friendly UI for all types of users. Quick dashboards with query insights in background.
改善点: Not presented as a holistic Observability platform for all needs, with focus more around logging pipelines only. A bit of strategic confusion after acquisition.

タイトル: Logs in a snap, but not all the way
投稿者: Rebecca 英国のSystems Analyst 経理, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Logs in a snap, but not all the way"
良い点: Splunk’s search capabilities let us pull logs from servers, containers and cloud services all in one place; the dashboards are pretty solid and we get real‑time alerts that pop into Slack; it’s a bit of a learning curve but worth it.
改善点: The interface can feel cluttered after a while, and the documentation is dense; the pricing is on the high side for a mid‑size team, and the support response time is a bit slow when we hit a snag. And the learning curve for the SPL syntax is a bit steep.

タイトル: Powerful Data Insights at a Premium Cost
投稿者: Gary オーストラリアのSolutions Architect 金融サービス, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Powerful Data Insights at a Premium Cost"
良い点: Splunk Enterprise offers powerful real-time search and analytics, making it easy to troubleshoot and monitor complex systems.
改善点: Splunk Enterprise can become very expensive at scale, especially with high data volumes and long retention periods.

タイトル: Splunk Enterprise: A Decent Log Analyzer
投稿者: Amelia 英国のIT Project Manager 広報・渉外, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Splunk Enterprise: A Decent Log Analyzer"
良い点: I've found Splunk Enterprise to be a pretty solid tool for monitoring and analyzing log data. We've set it up to track server performance and user activity, and it's worked well enough for our needs. The interface can be a bit overwhelming at first, but once you get the hang of it, it's pretty intuitive.
改善点: One thing that's kind of annoying is the steep learning curve. It took a bit to figure out how to customize the dashboards and reports, but once we got the hang of it, it was okay. I'd also like to see more detailed documentation for some of the more advanced features.

タイトル: Cognito forms makes data collection simple and easy
投稿者: Hillary 日本のCo-Founder and Chief Operating Officer ホスピタリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Cognito forms makes data collection simple and easy"
良い点: Cognito Forms is relatively easy to set up, with a low learning curve. My customers find it convenient to use as well.
改善点: I would like it if there was the ability to add more storage without jumping tiers. Moving from 1gb to 10gb doubles the price, and this much storage and the additional features are not required for my business.

タイトル: Very reliable, powerful, well thought and affordable
投稿者: Rolf スイスのAccount Director 認証済みLinkedInユーザー マーケティング、広告, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Very reliable, powerful, well thought and affordable"
良い点: It is very well thought. I am with Cognito for many years. Every new major feature they introduced was carefully crafted and integrated in the existing experience, e.g. workflow, status, users. Thanks to this kind of development, even the more sophisticated features are doable. It is very reliable. I can always trust its results, even with very complex instructions. It is very good integrated with zapier and api, it allowed us to build quite complex client applications for the fraction of the costs for a complete own development. And also, with the peace of mind that you don't have bugs in the logical handling. Your own logic may be wrong, but never ever did cognitoforms a mistake in handling the logic. I find it an extremely good value for money.
改善点: I am missing a real backup solution. We have automated exporting excel files in our cloud regularly. But I would prefer an integrated backup solution.

タイトル: I love Cognito forms, has been a game changer for our organization
投稿者: Victor メキシコのReservations Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー ホスピタリティ, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "I love Cognito forms, has been a game changer for our organization"
良い点: Cognito Forms has been a game-changer for our organization. It is intuitive, easy to use, and flexible enough to support a wide variety of business processes. Over the years, I have built numerous forms, ticket management systems, workflows, and approval processes using Cognito Forms. It has helped my team stay organized by managing and routing work efficiently across multiple departments, creating a structured and streamlined process for handling requests and tasks. One of the features I value most is its integration with Power Automate. This integration has enabled us to automate reporting across all our systems and generate real-time insights, significantly reducing manual effort and improving visibility for decision-making. Overall, Cognito Forms is a reliable, versatile, and powerful platform that has helped us improve productivity, organization, and automation across the business.
改善点: I would love to see native AI capabilities that leverage the data generated within Cognito Forms. A RAG-style feature allowing users to ask questions in natural language and retrieve insights directly from form submissions, tickets, and workflow data would make an already great platform even more powerful.

タイトル: Cognito Is the Only Form System I'll Use
投稿者: Amanda アメリカのDirector of Technology イベント企画運営, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Cognito Is the Only Form System I'll Use"
良い点: Cognito Forms helps me find creative ways to solve a lot of problems in my organization, and to create efficiency. With a little creativity, there is really almost nothing that I can't figure out how to do. Often, Cognito is a tool I use more as a process-driver than as an intake form. It's a great conduit to bridge systems and connect information. I love prefilled fields, lookups, and linked forms. The advanced calculations are also great.
改善点: I have a few forms which have images people upload. If I delete the images, I'm still "charged" for storage. I have to pay a hefty premium for that storage, but I don't need the images. This is the only reason I've given 4 stars ilo 5 for the platform.

タイトル: 🔴 I strongly advise against using this company.
投稿者: Alex アメリカのPresident 物流、サプライチェーン, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "🔴 I strongly advise against using this company."
良い点: It worked fine till it did not. I used them for years
改善点: 🔴 I strongly advise against using this company. If your business relies on functional forms, it's crucial to have real-time customer service to address any issues that may arise. It's unacceptable for a company to operate without this support. In today's competitive business environment, companies with good customer service thrive, and I hope businesses like this one realize the importance of providing real-time support before they become obsolete like Blockbuster.

タイトル: Why would someone still buy paid call center applications?
投稿者: Muhammad パキスタンのCEO/COO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 自動車, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Why would someone still buy paid call center applications?"
良い点: What i love about this Vicidial is that its free, which sometimes seems too good to be true. Scaling the deployments is far more easier than one can imagine. I have installed three different call centers in inbound and blended configuration. The flexibility to develope custom features is just matchless. "No vendor lock in" is one of the biggest reasons i would prefer this application over any other paid application. i had read some review where people woul put a server reboot overnight to gain stability, however i have an installation of a cluster of 4 servers which has not been rebooted since once year now. Its free, stable, reliable and flexible to build new features.
改善点: We had customisations which made updates tricky. I would also like to see a better agent screen.

タイトル: Great features and adaptability make this a powerful dialer.
投稿者: Ian 南アフリカのICT Consultant 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great features and adaptability make this a powerful dialer."
良い点: We run all manner of campaigns from Vicidial; sales, lead generation, support, data capture, etc. And Vicidial handles all the variables we've thrown at it, with aplomb. Using the group and user management, it's easy to ring fence and manage campaigns. Help is right there; alongside just about every setting is a link directly to the help section of that setting.
改善点: The user interface could do with a bit of work, could really be a bit more customisable, specifically the agent portal. The campaign management section could be broken down into labeled sections to make the vast array of settings easier to find.

タイトル: ViciDial
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 薬品, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "ViciDial"
良い点: Vici is easy to use and contains a significant amount of reporting to track agent efficiency.
改善点: The interface is outdated and could use a cosmetic overhaul. some of the reporting is inconsistent. The way abandonment is calculated in the real time main report is by taking dropped calls and dividing it into calls answered. Under inbound daily report it calculates the abandonment correctly by taking dropped calls and dividing it into calls offered. Lacks some of the modern features available in other phone software: After Call Survey, Track short abandoned calls, Forced call backs, Scheduled reporting. In the IVR we can only offer our customers to leave a voicemail with a window prompt instead of allowing them to press a number at any time to leave a vm.

タイトル: It's Great for a Starter Dialer, if you are making only outbound autodial calls
投稿者: Shilleah アメリカのSales and Marketing Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 消費者サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "It's Great for a Starter Dialer, if you are making only outbound autodial calls"
良い点: I've used this software with a few different businesses that I have worked for, it is great for a starter dialer, cheap to set up, and very basic. It gets the job done for an outbound autodialer. Loading lead lists was easy as well.
改善点: It can get expensive, as you pay for minutes. Customer support is pretty much non-existent. Overall, great for a start-up but not something you would want to use long term.

タイトル: Amazing software for outbound calling
投稿者: Juan Carlos メキシコのGerente de Servicio al Cliente Online 認証済みLinkedInユーザー エンタテインメント, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Amazing software for outbound calling"
良い点: I was looking for an inexpensive solution for a 400 seat call center and I ran into vicidial, it's very easy to use and you can tailor it to your company needs, it's also open source which allows you to add really helpful features. It has all you need for outbound, reporting, tools, dialer, user management, just the best.
改善点: I would say the installation, was a bit hard mainly on the telco side but that would be its only flaw.

タイトル: how to use Virtuagym as a white label
投稿者: Maikel スリナムのDirecteur 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "how to use Virtuagym as a white label"
良い点: Easy to use after you installed the app on your mobile phone. Also the security to enter the platform is great
改善点: but the security to install the app can be some of a problem if you aren't used to installing apps on your phone

タイトル: Virtuagym for the solo business owner
投稿者: Nancy タークス・カイコス諸島のOwner 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Virtuagym for the solo business owner"
良い点: I run boutique private training studio, as well run group classes at another facility. Because I am a sole operator, in my research many of these services can be too expensive as they are geared for gyms and bigger studios. Virtuagym worked with me to design a package that met my needs and I really appreciate that.
改善点: The report system is geared towards gyms and recruiting new members. I have had the same members for years so would love to see reports broken down by product sold each month vs new members.

タイトル: The WORST Customer Service ever....but really good App based system for workout tracking
投稿者: Amy アメリカのOwner 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "The WORST Customer Service ever....but really good App based system for workout tracking"
良い点: Their workout trackers are awesome. I love that they integrate with different companies (though maybe not particularly well) as I was trying to set up an integration with AccuroFit and after two month, it still seems they cannot figure out how to do this. I purchased their recommended bioimpedance scales which is great because we are able to run gym challenges, and members love being able to track their lifting workouts and have a workout player whenever they want. We regularly use the community portal aspects of the software and the app based system makes it easy to talk to members and send notifications about specific things.
改善点: Their salespeople are good. Good enough that with their features alone they can convince you to purchase a YEAR LONG subscription without trying it out. By the way, they don't ever explain to you what features you're paying for or when your pricing goes up, why that happened because you accidentally made some changes that affect your subscription. The customer support team/on-boarding team is absolutely dismal. From day 1, I felt like I was explaining to their support how their system worked. They have no idea what is going on and they basically give you 2 30 min phone calls and expect you to figure it out on your own (when they can't even figure it out). I wanted to setup a system that allowed for different credits and booking based on levels and their onboarding specialist asked me during our first phone call "What software did you switch from and why?" I explained that I switched from WellnessLiving and what I liked about them and person managing our account told me "Well maybe you should have stuck with them." They have an difficult system for trying to reach anyone to answer your questions. They use Zendesk, which is both incredibly confusing as it goes into (how I understand it) a central e-mail system which can take them 1-3 days to get back to you. At which point, they respond with very unhelpful advice or flat out ignorance. Also, their pay service integration sucks. It is very difficult to use them for bookkeeping and POS and I ended up just resorting to Square.

タイトル: I love this product for my fitness studio!
投稿者: Jessica アメリカのCertified Holistic Fitness & Behavioral Health Specialist + Studio Owner 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 自営業 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "I love this product for my fitness studio!"

改善点: My biggest struggles with the software are mainly due to tech issues to fully utilize the software AND represent all that I want to in the app, which are probably more due to user error.

タイトル: best phone system
投稿者: Lidia アメリカのmedical assistant 病院、ヘルスケア, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "best phone system"

タイトル: Functional But Not User Friendly

タイトル: RIngcentral CX is a great product for small call centers
投稿者: Holly アメリカのResolution specialists 消費者サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "RIngcentral CX is a great product for small call centers"

タイトル: Operations Hub works best for mid-large businesses.
投稿者: Rongen ブルネイのDigital Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Operations Hub works best for mid-large businesses."

There are still a lot of features that aren't available that many users are requesting. Hopefully, their developers will release an upgrade soon.

タイトル: User friendly for the non-techy people!
投稿者: Mandy アメリカのDirector of Marketing コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "User friendly for the non-techy people!"
良い点: I was nervous about integrating our CRM system with HubSpot. PieSync made it incredibly easy to set up all the sync integrations, even for me being a non-technical person. I like being able to see the statistics of everything. I love that everything syncs to our CRM system super quickly.
改善点: My only issue, and it's not huge, is that there are some fields that don't sync because of the type of field they are. I found a work around but it would be great if for example, a drop down in CRM could map to a drop down field in HubSpot. There is also a little button that sometimes pops on automatically when setting up an integration that will sync the other way around. That has gotten me in to some trouble a couple times but I have to just remember to turn it off. Would be nice if it didn't automatically turn on.

タイトル: Easy to use and good support

良い点: It is more flexible than any other tool, I can connect any custom field I want.
改善点: Updating based on lists would be a great addition.

タイトル: Don't see myself ever going back to Adobe Acrobat
投稿者: Scott アメリカのPrincipal Consultant 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Don't see myself ever going back to Adobe Acrobat"
良い点: Like most folks, I frequently need to view PDF files as this is how most documentation is deployed. On top of that, I also need to print out Microsoft Word documents and combine the files together into user manuals, as well as edit them. This software lets me do all of that and more. Even though PDF software might have the features you need, I want them to be intuitive. It's frustrating to spend a lot of time hunting and searching for what you need. PDF-XChange has done a pretty good job making it easy to accomplish what you set out to do. Finally, I guess that I am a "power-user". I get annoyed when I cannot customize the user interface so that just the tools I want are quickly available. For PDF software, this becomes even more important because I want to be able to easily configure the screen layout for reading different types of documents -- and the navigation tools have to be convenient and intuitive as it seems I'm rarely reading sequentially through the pages like a novel. I'm happy to say that PDF-XChange allowed me to customize the user interface with an extremely high degree of flexibility. It seems to let you configure almost anything - but, I didn't find that it was too difficult to figure out. Overall, I can't speak too highly of their software.
改善点: I'm struggling to find a fault with the software. Thus far, I haven't found a feature that's disappointed me. Oh, I know one, it would be great if they offered a version for the Mac OS!

タイトル: Highly recommended for engineers
投稿者: Nikolaos ギリシャのDipl. Civil Engineer 土木工学, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Highly recommended for engineers"
良い点: PDF-XChange Pro offers excellent value for money, fast performance, powerful editing tools, OCR, custom stamps, digital signatures, and reliable handling of large technical PDF drawings.
改善点: Although PDF-XChange Pro does not include a dedicated angle measurement tool, angles can still be checked indirectly through available drawing and measurement tools.

タイトル: Not Intuitive for Casual Users
投稿者: Karen アメリカのNA 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Not Intuitive for Casual Users"

When trying to correct this, the application completely deleted all data from all pages. I just need to fill in a form it shouldn't be this complicated.

タイトル: Full featured pdf viewer with measurement tools

投稿者: Pablo Rafael スペインのCEO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "My experience trying to ask Kommo for help in serving a client who wants more than 100 licenses:"

タイトル: Top notch scalable self-service BI tool with cutting-edge visuals
投稿者: Martin 英国のConsultant 金融サービス 使用期間： 6～12か月 ソース：SoftwareAdvice 共有 "Top notch scalable self-service BI tool with cutting-edge visuals"
良い点: Qlik Sense is a self-service analytical tool based on the same in-memory technology as QlikView. It's associative engine allows for snappy selections, filtering and prompt re-calculation of all charts and aggregations on the fly as the user navigates throughout the dashboard, even on datasets of over 100 million rows. Qlik Sense focuses more on the self-service aspects of BI, where users are encouraged to build their own Adhoc visualisations without the use of keyboards simply by drag & dropping various elements, making the technology utmost business friendly. Also, as the whole technology is fully web-based, it embeds the latest visualisation libraries (D3, Raphael etc.) and allows for a seamless integration of customised extended JS charts (so-called extensions). The latter enables for unlimited possibilities when it comes to visualisations (http://d3js.org/) and further integration with web-services (R servers, real-time analytics, Hadoop etc.). Also, the Qlik Sense Server deployment is tailored to facilitate a multi-node deployment, allowing for a very scalable enterprise solution, even cloud-based. The data security technology (Section Access) is the same one as in QlikView and is customisable, secure and robust. All in all, when it comes to deploying a scalable and business-friendly BI solution, which has very presentable dashboards, a fast and robust aggregation engine with extended self-service capabilities, Qlik Sense is currently the best product of its kind on the
改善点: Qlik Sense is still a new product and not very mature yet, as it has only been released a year and a half ago. The review is based on Qlik Sens version 2.1 which is important to emphasise, because QlikTech is constantly updating the software and publishing releases with enhancements and bugfixes. Qlik Sense is not the right tool, if you requirement is: 1. To have a guided analytics dashboard, where the user is constraint in the way he views his data. -> This can be overcome by creating mashup websites, however you will need a web developer to do this. 2. Standardised reporting via Qlik Sense and production of pdf files is not possible (yet). -> An integration with nPrinting, QlikTech's latest acquisition, could change this and it's on Qlik's roadmap for the next year. 3. Your BI solution needs to accommodate flexible data extraction capabilities (e.g. to Excel). General current disadvantages: 1. The story telling functionality is not mature yet - users have more benefit using PowerPoint directly. In my opinion it's missing a live connection of the snapshots used in the story to the underlying chart objects. 2. Security settings (NOT on data level) are governed centrally via the management console and are complicated to comprehend. 3. No guided analytics aspects, even navigation between sheets can't be controlled. 4. No supported data extraction capabilities. It's almost impossible to get comprehensive extract of it's underlying data, something that was possible with QlikView

タイトル: A Powerful Platform for Traffic Intelligence, Market Research, and Competitive Benchmarking
投稿者: Caterina イタリアのFounder and CEO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 市場調査, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A Powerful Platform for Traffic Intelligence, Market Research, and Competitive Benchmarking"
良い点: We rely on Similarweb on a regular basis in our market research work to estimate website traffic, benchmark competitors in specific industries, and gain a clearer understanding of traffic acquisition trends. It is an extremely useful platform for comparing companies operating in the same market and highlighting differences in channel mix, growth trajectories, and overall digital performance. One of the aspects we value most is the level of detail the platform provides. The Industries section is particularly helpful because it enables us to analyze several websites within the same category at once, making it easier to identify leading players, detect up-and-coming competitors, and build a more complete picture of the competitive landscape. The platform also offers many ways to explore the data in depth, and the introduction of AI traffic insights is a very welcome addition that makes the analysis even more relevant in today’s context. From a usability standpoint, the interface is clear and user-friendly, even though there is a bit of a learning curve at the beginning due to the breadth of features available. Because the platform includes so many data points and sections, it takes some time to learn where everything is. Once that familiarity is built, however, it becomes a very efficient and powerful tool. Integration is another major strength. The option to export data into Excel is very practical for everyday work, while the APIs offer significant value for more advanced appl
改善点: On the downside, some areas of Similarweb provide more depth than others. For instance, sections like Industries are extremely helpful for obtaining a high-level view of the market and comparing several players at the same time, but they do not always offer the same level of detail available when analyzing individual websites or conducting direct comparisons between a smaller group of up to five sites. Another point to consider is that the user experience evolves quite often. Although the platform remains highly capable, frequent interface updates can require users to spend time readjusting and locating features or data again, which may temporarily reduce efficiency. Lastly, while many datasets can be exported easily, not every insight is equally accessible in a structured format. In some cases, the most practical way to capture certain information is through screenshots rather than downloadable files, which can be a limitation when that data needs to be reused in reports or integrated into internal tools.

タイトル: Powerful, cost-effective backup — best for technical users
投稿者: Marco 日本のDirector コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Powerful, cost-effective backup — best for technical users"
良い点: Extremely capable for the price. Block-level incremental backups, client-side AES-256 encryption, VSS for open files, flexible scheduling, and long-term GFS retention — all to cheap S3-compatible storage like Backblaze B2, so ongoing cost is a few dollars a year. Restores are granular (single file, any point in time) and there's a full CLI for automation. Once configured it's been rock-solid: runs on schedule with no failures, and block-level keeps each incremental tiny.
改善点: Powerful but not beginner-friendly. Setup has many options, several actions need an elevated/admin CLI, and some behavior (exclusion masks, retention formats) is under-documented — I had to experiment. My first large backup silently hit a Backblaze storage cap and the error could've been clearer. The account/licensing side was also confusing (standalone app vs. the managed-backup web console). Budget some patience and technical comfort for initial config.

良い点: The best thing about MSP360 Managed Backup, for me, was how user-friendly it was. I loved that I could easily set it up with different cloud storage services without any fuss. It made managing my backups a breeze - saved me loads of time and headaches. Plus, the interface was so straightforward that I didn't need to be a tech wizard to figure it out.
改善点: The main drawback I found was that restorations could sometimes be sluggish, particularly when dealing with large amounts of data. It's worth noting that this isn't entirely MSP360's fault, since they don't actually store the data themselves - that's handled by whatever cloud storage provider you're using. Still, it'd be great if they could find a way to optimize the recovery process on their end. Maybe they could streamline how they interface with different cloud services or something. It's not a deal-breaker by any means, but faster restore times would definitely be a welcome improvement.

タイトル: Flexible and Cost-Effective Backup Solution

Granular restore capabilities (individual files, full systems, point-in-time recovery). Encryption support (in-transit and at-rest). Reasonable licensing model compared to many enterprise backup solutions. Support for Windows Server, workstations, and virtual environments (e.g., Hyper-V) Easy deployment and agent-based setup for endpoints.
改善点: The restore process can be slower than expected, particularly for large image-based backups. Error messages and logging are sometimes unclear, making troubleshooting more difficult. Licensing structure can become confusing when mixing backup types, endpoints, and add-ons.

タイトル: Billing practices challenging - beware
投稿者: Lauren アメリカのClinical Psychologist 教育管理, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 ソース：SoftwareAdvice 共有 "Billing practices challenging - beware"
良い点: This software is integrated nicely into PowerPoint and facilitates audience engagement.
改善点: Slido is located in Slovakia. In my case, my bank balked at using a business card for their products. I requested an invoice to see if I could pay that way: the only other solution was an overseas bank transfer, which appeared suspicious and unsafe. However, they unlocked the product anyway and billed me later for it - I had no idea that in requesting an invoice, I'd committed to use of the product and payment by bank transfer. This is the only software product I've ever known to give access to a product without payment first: I believed I was using the free version for that reason. I did not use the full functionality of Slido because I did not know I had it but was billed anyway. They've been relentlessly hounding me about this for weeks since then.

タイトル: Reliable Social Listening Tool for Actionable Insights

Once you get used to it, it becomes a reliable tool for understanding what people are saying about your brand and competitors.
改善点: What I liked least was that it can feel overwhelming at first, especially if you’re new to social listening tools. There’s a learning curve when it comes to setting up queries and getting the most accurate results. Some reports also need manual adjustments

タイトル: Where data turns into real decisions

良い点: It’s a pretty solid tool, especially when it comes to analysis and the volume of data it can handle. The dashboards are really helpful, and support is usually responsive. It also has a strong cost-benefit for us, and the fact that it’s aligned with data protection standards like LGPD brings a lot of security, it’s even helped us move forward and close deals. There are still some usability hiccups and cases where manual adjustments are needed. The system provides complete functionality - from credits to commissions to draws, and then running reports/analytics. It offers a lot of functions and customizations required to design complicated commission plans and calculate commissions. I like the new UI for Incent that the team rolled out a couple of months ago. Plus the new changes that the team brings are really good and make the product more usable & friendly.

While I am writing Rules, I need to create a new Order Type or Credit Type, I cannot create it from the Rules page. Instead, I have to go to the specific page to create these Order or Credit Type and then return to the Rules page to write the Rule.

タイトル: Xactly is the best in the market, but the market deserves better
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 建設, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Xactly is the best in the market, but the market deserves better"
良い点: Commission Calculations - Ability to make changes to plans, quotas, and release documents on the fly. I liked that reps were able to log in and see the breakdown of their payments and see their attainment
改善点: Cost, Implementation Time and Fee, Bugs, cannot self diagnose. Xactly Incent is supposedly the better version and upgrade from Xactly Express. In order to make it work with your organization, you will need to pay an implementation fee. Xactly then flys in trainers to configure your commission plan with their software. Once they leave, if anything breaks, you'll have to contact Xactly support. From our experience, we realize that their software is like a big black box. If anything goes wrong you keep have to run to them. They have just purchased a new software to add to their Xactly suite. This makes self diagnosis an set up super easy, but whats the worst part? Well, even though the software connects to SFDC, someone has to log into their standalone product and click REFRESH in order to sync the days commission. If your company uses daily exchange rates that pipe in from netsuite or other sources into Xactly, make sure that integration is tight, cause Xactly can mess it up.

タイトル: Prime Asia Hotel's Experience with Hotelogix

It has its own channel manager, and can also integrate with the industry leading channel managers. Reports are detailed and comprehensive. Customer support is available 24 hours and they are always there to help. The sales and relationship team are very efficient, they keep periodic communication, and always ask for feedback and ways to improve. All this comes at a fairly decent annual fee compared to other similar PMS.
改善点: Hotelogix could have worked better if it supported multiple languages, especially South East Asian and South Asian Countries, such as Korean, Mandarin and Japanese. This could maximize guest-contact features and make it worth the investment.

タイトル: Efficiency and Ease with Hotelogix
投稿者: Theobs フィリピンのIT Manager - Group ホスピタリティ, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Efficiency and Ease with Hotelogix"
良い点: What I liked most about Hotelogix is its user-friendly system and intuitive interface. From the training phase up to the full implementation, the transition was very smooth. Their support team is also highly reliable—they handle inquiries efficiently, provide step-by-step guidance, and ensure issues are resolved with minimal downtime. I would also like to acknowledge Pravesh Manhas, our Implementation Manager, and Sonu Gupta, our Account Manager, for their superb support and service. Even after more than a year, they remain very accommodating and extremely easy to work with.
改善点: What I liked least about Hotelogix is that some features still have limited customization. There are certain modules where having more flexibility would help streamline the workflow, especially for properties with more specific operational needs. There are also times when the system experiences slight delays during peak usage, which can affect the pace of work. But overall, on the positive side, these concerns are manageable, and their support team remains reliable. Messaging our account manager, Sonu Gupta, has also been very helpful whenever I have urgent concerns, as he responds quickly and ensures issues are addressed with proper guidance and minimal downtime.

I also found the pricing model a bit challenging to justify for smaller teams, as some features felt over-engineered for our actual needs. Additionally, the mobile app could use some improvement; it's functional but doesn't provide the same level of detail and usability as the web interface. タイトル: Buggy, Unreliable Software. Support is Non-existant
投稿者: Mike アメリカのDeveloper Marketing 通信, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Buggy, Unreliable Software. Support is Non-existant"
良い点: I've used Influitive for several years. It can drive results if implemented correctly and with dedicated resources. The platform offers a nice balance for users with challenges, rewards, a messaging center, and a new focus on a forum (although if you already have a forum you cannot turn this off and they will force you to use it).
改善点: The company has changed directions pushing the forum over the challenges (the initial reason Influitive was created). The software is often unreliable, with our team finding bugs and issues almost daily. These issues range from targeting (advocates not receiving challenges), inaccurate counts, data disappearing, and blatant issues in production such as when they broke the rewards page or the challenge forms. We have numerous complaints from our users, and people complaining that it doesn't work. In less than a year we have filed probably over 20 bugs - most of which support ignores. The most common response we get is "it will fix itself eventually." While they have an API, it's very random and not well designed. For example, there is a groups endpoint, but the only way to get the group ID is to go back into the admin, go into reports, dig into the report, pivot and filter, and then eventually you'll find a hidden ID that doesn't match the group ID used throughout the system. The forum likewise is extremely buggy - although they've made vast improvements. Rather than jumping between multiple systems or digging through spreadsheets, everything I need — from vehicle records and maintenance history to inspections and service reminders — is readily accessible in one place. The platform is also remarkably user-friendly, with an intuitive interface that doesn't require extensive training to navigate. Whether I'm pulling up a vehicle's service history or logging a new work order, the experience is straightforward and efficient. Fleetio has genuinely streamlined our day-to-day fleet operations in a meaningful way.
改善点: My biggest frustration with Fleetio has been the telematics integration with our GPS provider, One Step GPS. When we evaluated Fleetio, the seamless syncing of telematics data was presented as a key feature and a major selling point of the integration. Unfortunately, in practice, it has not functioned as advertised. GPS and telematics data from One Step GPS does not reliably update within Fleetio, which undermines one of the core benefits we were expecting from the platform. Having accurate, real-time vehicle data automatically populated in the system was a significant part of our decision to adopt Fleetio, so this has been a notable disappointment and something we hope to see resolved.

投稿者: Chad アメリカのExecutive Director 宗教団体, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Cheap, Not the Best Tool"
良い点: The price was the best part. It was pretty easy to learn as well and teach others the program.
改善点: This needs improvement in many areas. For a small nonprofit that is just starting, it works well. We have grown to a place where we needed more features that it simply does not offer.

タイトル: Great product for smaller non profits
投稿者: Tania カナダのFinance Administrator 非営利団体運営, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Great product for smaller non profits"
良い点: Great product, easy to use. Inexpensive but not "cheap". Great support/help. Fantastic for smaller non profits.
改善点: We only stopped using it because we got very large and needed to interface with Planning Center.

タイトル: User friendly, intuitive software
投稿者: Donna カナダのFinance Manager 非営利団体運営, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "User friendly, intuitive software"
良い点: Donation is a user friendly, intuitive DMS. I have used a variety of DMS and have never wished Donation had a feature I needed. In fact, I enjoy that it is basic without a bunch of complicated stuff I don't need. It has all the reporting features I need and comes with outstanding customer support. I have already recommended Donation to another non-profit, which they ultimately transitioned to.
改善点: Maybe just add some auto formatting in the Postal Code and Phone number fields but not a big deal.

タイトル: Great for starting out with email marketing
投稿者: Tracie アメリカのExecutive Director 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 非営利団体運営, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great for starting out with email marketing"
良い点: Kit has a handful of premade templates that made getting started with email marketing and email list management easy to initiate. Kit made the process less overwhelming.
改善点: The templates provided for paid subscribers are very basic, must be edited on a desk top, and the price increases significantly with subscriber amount but the features do not improve or change.

タイトル: My Go-To ESP Recommendation For Creators
投稿者: Caleb アメリカのLifecycle Marketing Manager コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "My Go-To ESP Recommendation For Creators"
良い点: Kit is an easy to use Email Service Provider that makes automation easy and understandable for any skill level. I also love that their customer support team is active and will reply with solutions quickly.
改善点: Kit has room for improvement in advanced features, but it's prioritization of ease of use easily outweighs that shortcoming.

タイトル: KIT- The Best
投稿者: Muhammad Zohaib アラブ首長国連邦のTalent Acquisition Officer 建設, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "KIT- The Best"
良い点: KIT provides good security for protecting business information and offers solid cost-effectiveness for managing customer-related activities. Its customer assistance helps users resolve issues, while email handling makes it easier to organize and communicate with leads. The software also supports efficient information management, flexible design personalization, and effective lead tracking to help businesses manage potential customers.
改善点: KIT software have some limitations in advanced customization and reporting, which make certain workflows less flexible. Some users may also find the learning curve slightly higher when setting up advanced lead and data management features.

タイトル: Kit's simplicity is both great and also a part of its weakness
投稿者: Faydra D. アメリカのMost-Things-Web Consultant 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Kit's simplicity is both great and also a part of its weakness"
良い点: I've only dealt with the free plan while working with one of my clients. Kit makes it super simple to create email content and send out email broadcasts. You also do not have to duplicate the same user across multiple lists. You can simply use tagging to have one subscriber on more than one list. Customer support is speedy and useful.
改善点: On the free tier, customization options are limited. Also, the entry price to the first paid tier is much more than with other email marketing platforms. Going from $0 to (at the time of this review) $33/mo or $390/yr is not budget-friendly to bootstrapping solopreneurs, and I primarily work with bootstrapping solopreneurs. Also, you are not allowed to use one email for sending and another email as "reply-to" on ANY plan, free or paid.

タイトル: The best email platform for my needs.
投稿者: Javier スペインのOracle DBA - Teacher - Content Creator 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "The best email platform for my needs."
良い点: I moved from MailChimp. I increased the open conversions from 20% to 40% with the same list. I like the automations and sequences, and the segmentation and tagging features. I have Kit integrated with WP, LearnWorlds (previously with Patreon and Teachable) and I could tag all subscribers to drive campaigns to specific audiences.
改善点: It takes a while to really understand how to manage how sequences and visual integrations work.

タイトル: SAP BO - the ultimate Reporting Platform
投稿者: Austin アメリカのGlobal Operations Analyst 認証済みLinkedInユーザー スポーツ用品, 5,001～10,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "SAP BO - the ultimate Reporting Platform"
良い点: SAP BO provides a vast array of capabilities for using data across our companies' systems and provides expansive tools to process and display our data. SAP BO allows us to use large amounts of data across multiple instances (such as EWM, S4, etc.) and consume the data quickly and easily. It also allows for many different reporting designs, formats, and use cases for our reporting needs
改善点: SAP BO is a complex system that sometimes requires knowledge of the schema integration in order to solve issues. This does not allow for everyday users that are not power users to self-service issues and can lead to a developer backlog. Also, our company has run into issues that were only able to be solved by SAP and there was a large lead time in waiting for a solution.

タイトル: Comprehensive SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Solution
投稿者: Noam アメリカのFounder メディア制作, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Comprehensive SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence Solution"
良い点: SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence is an incredibly comprehensive and feature-rich BI solution. It provides users with an array of tools for data analysis, reporting, and visualization, making it easy to identify trends and insights from data. The software also offers customizable dashboards and intuitive user interface, allowing users to quickly and easily access the data they need.
改善点: While SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence is a great tool for data analysis, it can be expensive and difficult to set up. Additionally, it requires a significant amount of technical knowledge in order to get the most out of the software.

タイトル: Amazing with proper training
投稿者: CHANDA アメリカのTeam Lead 機械工業, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Amazing with proper training"
良い点: Honestly, SAP BusinessObjects Business Intelligence could have been a game-changer at my job if two things were done differently. First, we didn’t get the proper training upfront. I’m talking about actually going through the certification on the SAP website—not just a quick overview. I had to take it upon myself to get trained, and once I did, I saw how powerful the software really is. Second, I think we should have invested more in the software itself. Without the right setup and features, it felt like we weren’t getting the full experience. If we had done those two things from the start—proper training and better investment—it would have made a world of difference.
改善点: One thing I really don’t like about SAP BusinessObjects is that if someone accidentally deletes a line, it’s pretty much gone for good. SAP IT services can’t retrieve it—it’s just stuck in the system forever. That’s a huge issue, especially when mistakes happen. I can’t fully blame the software, though, because proper training could have helped prevent situations like that. It just goes to show how important it is to make sure everyone knows how to use the system correctly from the start.

タイトル: SAP BUSINESS OBJECT REVIEW
投稿者: keeza bianca フィリピンのlogistics officer 通信, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "SAP BUSINESS OBJECT REVIEW"

タイトル: Docebo is a great LMS option for the modern learner
投稿者: Craig アメリカのConsultant of Continuous Improvement 保険, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Docebo is a great LMS option for the modern learner"

It’s very mobile friendly and I especially appreciated offline mode and the simple but effective layout (it looked almost like a streaming app). Archiving/managing the courses was also really easy. And last, being able to integrate with Salesforce is always a plus.
改善点: As a frequent collaborator with the L&D team, I have limited administrative powers and found configuration to be quite complex. I also thought some of the extras we paid for should have been free (for example, more advanced analytics).

タイトル: Docebo makes our customers feel special
投稿者: Cindy カナダのProduct Support Specialist 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 自動車, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Docebo makes our customers feel special"
良い点: I like that it does the job of 3 different programs where I work. Now I can do all my work for my customers in the one platform. I can even send emails and notifications straight from Docebo. I also really like to Docebo Community. If I have a question or am just looking for some tips, I just search the community or post a question in the community and I will get a few replies. But if I don't want to ask the community, there is always someone willing to help from Docebo.
改善点: As a super admin, I am still not able to look to see what notifications or emails were sent to someone or if they opened the email or not. I would like to have access to notification/email logs.

タイトル: A digital, interactive social experience
投稿者: Christa アメリカのFreelance Graphic Designer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "A digital, interactive social experience"

The digital ease of it allows me to keep it updated with fresh content that can keep viewers engaged. I enjoy being able to manage it from any computer and the changes take effect instantly. Our customers love seeing their photos/videos displayed on screen and getting to see other people's experiences be showcased. It's a great product, quick customer service, and having this as a feature in our center really adds to the overall social customer experience.
改善点: There will be times when the apps have issues which makes our display have a big "error" screen appear - this is obviously very unsightly, but normally after contacting their support team they get the issue resolved quickly and easily. If not, a quick system reset typically solves most problems. The available app selection has been increasing over the months, which I love, so I would like to continue to see a wider selection of apps to display. This service is not cheap, but if you want to add a social and digital experience to your business then it's a great feature to invest in.

タイトル: Cutting Licensing Costs Without Killing Workflow: My Honest Take on Soda PDF
投稿者: vikram インドのSenior Consultant 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Cutting Licensing Costs Without Killing Workflow: My Honest Take on Soda PDF"
良い点: I used Soda PDF quite a bit during my time at Deloitte because I was fed up with looking for an Adobe alternative that didn't blow the entire project budget. After running it through our internal tests, here’s the straight truth. Learning Curve - It uses the standard Office ribbon UI, so your non-technical teams can start editing without you having to write a "How-To" wiki. Security - The redaction tool actually scrubs the data from the file stream instead of just throwing a black box on top. Value for Money - It’s roughly half the price of Acrobat Pro, which makes it an easy win when you're trying to cut licensing costs. PDF Document Management - Merging, splitting, and reordering pages in a 100MB technical manual is fast and doesn't corrupt the file. Document Editing - The text reflow is the best I’ve seen outside of Adobe; you can actually edit paragraphs like it’s a Word doc. Digital Signatures - The e-sign workflow is a massive upgrade over the old "print-sign-scan" routine for vendor contracts. Time Saving - The batch processing and OCR are reliable enough to digitize hundreds of legacy scans in one afternoon.
改善点: It’s a bit of a memory hog when you have multiple large files open at once. Everything else looks solid given the project's budget constraints.

タイトル: Great Tool For Analytics, Gathering User Feedback, and Customer Outreach
投稿者: Joseph 台湾のLead Program Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great Tool For Analytics, Gathering User Feedback, and Customer Outreach"
良い点: Our organization uses Pendo for a variety of purposes. We use the powerful analytic tools to understand how our users are using our product. This helps our Product Managers make important roadmapping decisions, track feature adoption, and monitor user behavior. The design team gets a lot of benefit from the Funnel and Pathing features, it helps them to study user flows and make design adjustments on the fly. We use guides frequently to announce new features, market events and webinars, collect user feedback, and educate users on how to use our features. I really like the NPS functionality, this allows us to be constantly collecting user feedback that is sampled on a random basis. This has been extremely beneficial for us to track if we are improving our NPS and PMF score quarter by quarter.Nearly ever department in our organization gets some benefit from Pendo, whether its our Product, Customer Success, Marketing, or Sales teams.
改善点: There is a huge learning curve with Pendo. It can take months to learn all the ins and outs, and it needs to be set up correctly or you will lose all the benefits of the tool. The hardest steps are injecting the Pendo snippet into your codebase, setting up data attributes correctly. tagging the pages/features. creating‹ segments. and excluding testing environments and test orgs. In the past we ran into some troubles with Pendo when we had several people using the tool at once who were not properly trained, this lead to a messy Pendo instance and incorrect/unreliable data. It is best to have one Pendo owner in your organization who is completely familiar with the tool and owns all aspects of Pendo from implementation to maintenance. Once it is set up properly. it is an incredibly powerful and beneficial tool for any organization.

タイトル: Very Good Software bad support

Sessions had wrong times and iit would not be available in Expedia for the same reason. The support team used to be very attentive to our demands, but there has been a sudden change in behavior lately. We are a big company with more than 1,000 bookings/month, and Rezdy's lack of support is compromising the entire company. Activities and transfer are booked at a certain time, but the document sent to the passengers states a different time and sometimes a different day! Clients are feeling suspicious about this change in times and dates, even if we explain that it is a system's problem. Pick up times in tours have been changed automatically and clients are getting impatient about that. We have been trying to receive and urgent answer from the support team, even calling them, but no answer. This is completely awkward, considering their previous behavior (answering promptly). Some of our suggestions are to create sessions 1 year long (not 6 months), create a way to make multiple language versions of the same product (not having to clone many times) and create subdivisions for the product description (ITINERARY, INCLUSIONS, EXCLUSIONS, KNOW BEFORE YOU BOOK ETC.)

タイトル: The best Guitar Tab Tool out there
投稿者: Volodymyr ウクライナのMarketing Content Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 音楽, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "The best Guitar Tab Tool out there"
良い点: Most of the notation tools makes notation look and feel very complicated and eerily impenetrable. But Guitar Pro makes it seem easy and completely approachable - which is very important for those making their first steps in music composition. Guitar Pro is probably one of the most accessible notation tabbing tools out there. It is extremely easy to master and very comfortable to use as a lean mean composition tool. It is especially useful if you have limited music education and just want to lay down your ideas. From the user experience perspective - it doesn't get any better. If you know the notation basics - it will take a couple of minutes to get around Guitar Pro's interface. The way the composition process is organised is very streamlined and allows many tweaks without getting tangled. Ever since the 5th version introduced realistically sounding instrument samples, Guitar Pro also became a very interesting tool for sonic experimentation. Sure, it is very limited in comparison with a full-fledged digital workstations - but it offers an interesting experience, especially from a 6th versions which introduced sound effects.
改善点: User interface might seem dense at first and it takes some time to get used to it. From a compositional standpoint - every instrument that is not fretted string one - is limited to the guitar-based tuning. Basically it limits the composition process to laying down the basics while fleshing out will require more specific software. The notation layout itself is somewhat clumsy and got some very irritating traits. Hot keys are messy and you often get confused over which combination does what. It is not critical but might bring you some discomfort. Version 6 and 7 often crash, especially if you try too hard with the RSE.

タイトル: It was one of the first music software I used when I started playing guitar and is still amazing!
投稿者: Victor アルゼンチンのProductor de música 認証済みLinkedInユーザー インターネット, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "It was one of the first music software I used when I started playing guitar and is still amazing!"
良い点: Using the tab/instrument view is really useful to notate the tones of your guitar into a tab/sheet music, and the compatibility with many other strings instruments(Ukulele, Bass, banjo) make it easier to transport your ideas to other players, even if they are really far from you. The printing options are awesome too, if you can't afford a printer, you just export your tab/sheet score into pdf format and then can send it to any place so they can print your parts or chord charts. Also, the playback/loop option is EXTREMELY helpful whenever you encounter a hard to learn, it allows you to go from really slow to the exact tempo you are looking for, so, for practicing your instrument is a really awesome tool.
改善点: There are a few things that can be improved, for example, if you happen to be a producer or an orchestra/band composer, guitar pro will limit you the way you write your music, it does not have a natural flow when it comes to transport instruments(say, many of the brass and woodwind family) so, it might get confusing whenever you have to write something for a trumpet or alto sax player. Also, the playback or RSE (real sound engine, which is basically an emulation of a live instrument) is not that good enough, compared to other software that is around nowadays, most of the time I prefer to use the midi default playback, because it can get too noisy and unproportioned.

I had to edit 1960 listings manually which defeated the purpose of the import feature due to their software not being able to import text out of a legacy template I used on all 1963 listings. I asked for a credit after I spent approx1-2 min per listing totaling 3840 min (64 hours) and about 50 hours on the Ebay side finding out why my listings still had active content after the import to Crazylister. After asking for some type of credit for the issue no credit was issued toward my billing after going through all of the above. I like the software (now that I fixed all of my listings that did not import correctly) but still feel letdown by the staff of their promise. I am not sure I am going to continue my annual service when I dont use it more than at the most 4x month. I might look elsewhere for a template service.
