タイトル: Finish your projects on time.
投稿者: Sarah アメリカのMarketing Project Manager コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 5,001～10,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Finish your projects on time."
良い点: I found it very functional for tracking projects. I was able to develop and present my projects as I wanted until the delivery date.
改善点: The user interface is very complex. Working out is tiring and gives a headache.

タイトル: Absolutely amazing !
投稿者: Stoyan ブルガリアのDigital Marketing Consultant 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Absolutely amazing !"
良い点: Love the simplicity to use and the short and easy learning curve. Every functionality is placed and working kind of intuitively. I am also using the Iphone app, which is absolutely amazing as well, all the functionality of the desktop version is available every time , everywhere in my pocket. Zenkit really means one thing and this is Productivity at it's best. And last but not least is the FREEDOM to use the app without any limitations of the features ABSOLUTELY FOR FREE!!! I am a startup founder who just left his full time corporate job to pursue his dreams and at this time cash is really important for me. Zenkit to plan absolutely everything from the concept to task to be executed. Over the years i found that when brainstorming the most convenient way for me are by using Mind maps. I was using Trello, then Asana before that, but the lack of mind maps made me looking constantly for a other solutions, which will give me the opportunity to easily convert the ideas in tasks and build whole working projects. Well Zenkit does exactly this, from ideas to full projects to be managed with most effective productivity and project management techniques in the easiest possible ways. Brainstorm with Mind maps, create task and execute them in Kanban or List, then easily present or manage them as full blown tables ( i even almost stopped using Excel ). I also like is the constant evolving off the app in only positive way. The team behind it really know their job!

タイトル: As we Germans say - the "egg laying woolmilkhog" :)
投稿者: Mario ドイツのBetriebsdirektor (COO) 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 自動車, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "As we Germans say - the "egg laying woolmilkhog" :)"
良い点: The many ways to enter and use the tool. App. Web. Web Offline. All relevant platforms. The many ways of handling information: list. kanban. mindmap. table. calendar. The design. Awesome. The flexibility. Need a special field to hold information? No problem, just create it. Need automated reminders, etc. No deal, enter their specifics and get reminded. The support. Individual. Quick. Listening. The numerous templates. Save time by just applying prepared configs for your individual topic.
改善点: I dont understand the question... :) Honestly, havent found a downside so far!

タイトル: Excellent Chat App Beats Slack
投稿者: Daniel フィリピンのCEO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Excellent Chat App Beats Slack"
良い点: Chats that don't disappear! Slack-like appearance without the slack price-tag.
改善点: Sometimes small bugs, but nothing really that drives me away from it. It is the best out there for our needs.

タイトル: Reliable chat
投稿者: Tuma ヨルダンのSupervisor 金融サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Reliable chat"
良い点: Customer Support: Quick, friendly replies; clear help docs. Learning Curve: Super easy—new hires onboard in minutes. Security: Solid basics (roles, 2FA, permissions) for SMB needs. Bugs & Issues: Rare; fixes roll out fast when they pop up. File Sharing: Drag-and-drop is smooth; previews fine for common formats. Remote Work: Stable across mixed networks; presence/status helps coordination. Meetings: Built-in calls are perfect for quick huddles and ad-hoc syncs
改善点: Fewer native integrations than bigger competitors Video/voice meetings feel basic compared to Zoom/Teams File previews can be slow with large files Admin controls are good but not very granular Occasional sync hiccups on mobile when switching networks

タイトル: Pumble Review as a new user
投稿者: Richard カナダのStudent デザイン, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Pumble Review as a new user"
良い点: It's similar to Discord and Slack, and it doesn't appear to have the 90-day message history expiry date. It's pretty easy to learn because it's similar, and it holds similar login methods to the previously mentioned apps.
改善点: I don't appreciate getting emails about new users joining, as well as how there was no underline to turn them off in the messages from Pumble (it felt as if it was not clickable). I also don't appreciate the many tabs above the channels; I feel as if it clutters the UI. There doesn't appear to be any voice call channels (at least in my server).

タイトル: Good, but can use a little polish
投稿者: Lee アメリカのOperations Coordinator 物流、サプライチェーン, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Good, but can use a little polish"
良い点: The searching ability of the platform is fantastic and by far the best feature. The ability to schedule/remind about messages, custom notification settings, making user groups, threading, and other customization options are all welcomed. Support has been very prompt with responses and helpful forwarding issues/ feature requests.
改善点: The mobile app is pretty terrible in comparison to the web platform. Calls are my biggest complaint as they just haven't worked properly even once despite multiple tickets to support. I always have to call twice or receive a call twice before it will actually connect. Otherwise, it will show the other party as muted for whoever is making the call and connecting for whoever is receiving it. As far as the other dislikes: not being able to specifically mute a user in chats, lack of custom sorting options for chats beyond just recent/alphabetical, not being able to sort differently from the web/phone version, not having single sign on as default instead of having codes sent to emails and putting it behind a higher price tier.

タイトル: Great alternative to Slack
投稿者: Perry アメリカのOwner マーケティング、広告, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Great alternative to Slack"
良い点: Pumble is a great tool with a lot of good things going for it. It costs way less than Slack but still works almost the same. Sure, it doesn’t connect with as many apps as Slack does, but for the price, it’s still a win. It’s super easy to use—no big learning curve. Everything in the app is clear and simple. I haven’t had any issues or bugs so far, and I really like using it on my phone. Their customer service is quick and helpful too. I even asked them for a new feature, and they actually added it! That’s wild. Now you can pin messages in channels, which helps a lot. Plus, you can make calls and have meetings right in the app. 10/10
改善点: The only downside I’ve found with Pumble is that it doesn’t really connect with other tools easily. So if I wanted it to send me automatic alerts (like when something changes in another app), it wouldn’t be simple to set up. It might be possible, but it seems too complicated to figure out—and I don’t have time or energy for that. Still, if all you need is a clean and simple way to chat with your team, Pumble works great.

タイトル: ManageEngine SDP for your originixation!
投稿者: Jeff アメリカのSystem Administrator 認証済みLinkedInユーザー スーパーマーケット, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "ManageEngine SDP for your originixation!"
良い点: I really like the customization of the product. You can setup different "buckets" and automate tickets to go into the buckets depending on the rules you create. I truly enjoy the life cycle part because we can keep track and go through a process of granting end users access to certain things on our network.
改善点: The only thing I don't care for are ALL the options that can be done to customize the software for your organization. It took us a quick minute to set it up for our company. Once we were done, that was all that was needed.

タイトル: ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus: Delivering Cost-Effective, AI-Driven Enterprise Service Management
投稿者: Rajneesh オーストラリアのIT Consultant 情報技術、情報サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus: Delivering Cost-Effective, AI-Driven Enterprise Service Management"
良い点: ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus is highly regarded by enterprise IT professionals for delivering comprehensive, ITIL-aligned functionality with an exceptional return on investment. The platform significantly enhances operational efficiency through advanced visual automation, native integration within the broader ManageEngine ecosystem, and Enterprise Service Management (ESM) capabilities that extend ticketing frameworks to non-IT business units. Furthermore, the incorporation of the Zia AI assistant optimizes service delivery by automating incident triaging and resolving routine inquiries seamlessly.
改善点: We have been using ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus since past 7 years and adore the fact that their team keeps innovating and keeping us updated with the new features. So, nothing to least liked about ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus

タイトル: Support is terrible
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー プログラム開発, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Support is terrible"
良い点: Nice interface.
改善点: We have been using ServiceDesk Plus for 7 years now. We have contributed a lot into the development of this ticketing software and have around 2K users around the world using it. Software does have occasional hiccups and glitches, but the worst part is their support. It declined so much over the years that it's unbearable now. Every time there is a remote session, it seems that engineers try to waste as much of your time as possible, just connect to you online and literally doing nothing. You have to patch and update SDP manually quite often, sometimes 3 times per month. Every patch is downtime and a risk of an issue, where you have to contact support. Their online instructions are outdated... Just try to renew SSL cert using the posted guides, good luck - another support call to Delhi.

タイトル: Powerful capabilities in the right hands, but requires a lot of front-heavy time and customisation
投稿者: connor 英国のIT Team Lead メディア制作, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Powerful capabilities in the right hands, but requires a lot of front-heavy time and customisation"
良い点: Back-end automation and custom triggers allow for powerful workflows catered to specific and niche requirements
改善点: To fully utilise the automative functions requires some scripting knowledge and skills. The terminology tends to lean away from recognised universal standards, such as in relation to ITIL for the change management features

タイトル: Great ticketing system with customizable import systems
投稿者: Austin アメリカのCTO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 保険, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great ticketing system with customizable import systems"
良い点: Great ticketing system that has a lot of customizable features and ways to import emails into actionable items
改善点: Lack of documentation on the custom formatting of ticket forums can be frustrating if you are trying to setup custom email import rules

タイトル: Criteria making hiring better
投稿者: Robert アメリカのRecruiting Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 運輸、トラック、鉄道, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Criteria making hiring better"
良い点: I highly value the ability to curate assessments specifically tailored to each role. It allows for a much more precise evaluation process. Furthermore, the platform enables us to use performance scores to validate our hiring quality, providing historical data that will be invaluable for making more informed, data-driven hiring decisions in the future.
改善点: One significant drawback is the inability to view or export aggregate test scores for all candidates in one place. This forces us to manually track and compile data in external spreadsheets, which is time-consuming and prevents us from easily leveraging historical data to inform future hiring decisions.

タイトル: A Lot of Potential, But Takes Work to Make It Fit Our Needs
投稿者: Jordan アメリカのTalent Performance Business Partner 金融サービス, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "A Lot of Potential, But Takes Work to Make It Fit Our Needs"
良い点: Criteria has a lot of great tools and capabilities, especially around assessments. Their team has also been willing to work with us through some of the challenges we’ve had. Once we were able to get our process up and running, they helped us make our testing more effective, and we’ve been able to assess a large number of candidates. I also like that there are opportunities to use the platform beyond recruiting, such as for team and leadership development.
改善点: Our biggest challenge was the Workday integration. We were originally sold on the product working with our Workday recruiting process, but because most of our candidates come through Indeed Easy Apply, we quickly ran into integration issues. We spent a lot of time working with Criteria and another team to come up with a workaround, and because of that, we really didn't get the value we expected from the product during the first year of our contract. We have also had some challenges getting more strategic guidance. For example, when we wanted to better understand how to use the personality assessment for team and leadership development, the information we received was often similar to what we could already find and read on the platform. We were hoping for more customized recommendations and insights on how to really make the most of the tool. We've also heard from some leaders who have used other personality assessments that they don't have the same level of trust or confidence in Criteria's assessment.

タイトル: Recruiter Experience and Hiring Team's Value from CCAT
投稿者: Tiffany アメリカのRecruiter 金融サービス, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Recruiter Experience and Hiring Team's Value from CCAT"
良い点: I like the integration between GreenHouse. It is super easy to use and very intuitive for folks that are sending out the CCAT to candidates through our ATS system.
改善点: I don't think it provides a whole lot of information to the Hiring Manager that isn't something we can find from a normal interview process. It's been difficult getting Hiring Teams to read through the results and use the data provided and most of them feel they don't think it provides any additional information that would be necessary to make a hiring decision. I also don't like that you can't send a second criteria corp link through our GH integration and instead we have to go on Criteria Corp's website to find the candidate and send it via the web browser.

タイトル: A Valuable Tool for Identifying Top Talent
投稿者: Junior 南アフリカのTalent Acquisition Partner アウトソーシング、オフショア, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "A Valuable Tool for Identifying Top Talent"
良い点: What I liked most about Criteria was how user-friendly and structured the platform is. It made the assessment process straightforward and provided useful insights to support the overall candidate evaluation.
改善点: Some of the assessments can be quite long, which may make it challenging for candidates to stay fully engaged throughout the process. Shortening certain assessments could make the experience more efficient while still providing valuable insights.

タイトル: TA Supervisor
投稿者: Alexandra アメリカのTA Supervisor 電気・電子機器製造, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "TA Supervisor"
良い点: Criteria was easy to use and gave us a consistent, standardized way to assess candidates beyond what we could gather from a resume or initial screening. I especially liked the ability to use assessments such as the CCAT to better understand a candidate’s aptitude and problem-solving ability. The platform was straightforward for both recruiters and candidates, and results were easy to review and incorporate into the hiring process.
改善点: The biggest limitation was that assessment results did not always tell the full story of a candidate. For some of the highly technical and field-based positions we recruit for, relevant industry experience and hands-on knowledge can be more valuable than performance on a standardized assessment. Because of that, Criteria worked best as one data point in the hiring decision rather than a deciding factor.

タイトル: Clearooms Made Hybrid Office Scheduling Much Easier For Our Team
投稿者: Kaleem インドのSenior SWE 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Clearooms Made Hybrid Office Scheduling Much Easier For Our Team"
良い点: What I liked most with Clearooms is that it made hybrid office scheduling way less confusing compared to the old process of asking around on Slack or checking random spreadsheets to see who was coming in. People can quickly book desks or meeting rooms themselves and the floor plan view honestly helps a lot when teams want to sit together on certain days. The setup is also straightforward for normal users. Most people in our office understood it without needing much training otherwise complicated workspace tools usually get ignored. Outlook calendar sync worked well for us most of the time and automatic booking visibility reduced double quite a bit.
改善点: The platform is simple overall but some settings and configurations can feel a little confusing initially when managing multiple office areas or changing floor layouts later. Also had a few situations where calendar syncing or desk availability updates took slightly longer to refresh. Reporting is decent for basic usage but I still feel analytics and occupancy insights could be more detailed especially for larger hybrid teams trying to track office usage trends properly.

タイトル: Efficient Desk & Meeting Room Management Tool
投稿者: Emilia アメリカのNetwork Support Coordinator ファシリティサービス, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Efficient Desk & Meeting Room Management Tool"
良い点: What I liked most about Clearooms is how easy it is to use and how quickly it can be set up without any complexity. The booking system for rooms and desks is very reliable and works smoothly in day-to-day operations. I also appreciate the clean and clutter-free interface, which makes navigation simple for all users. It fits well in hybrid office environments where flexible space management is needed.
改善点: On the downside, the reporting features feel quite basic and could be more detailed for better insights. The UI also feels slightly dated in certain areas, which affects the overall modern experience. In addition, there is limited customization when it comes to notifications and workflow settings, which may restrict advanced use cases.

タイトル: Established hot desk options for dual places of work
投稿者: Satrio インドネシアのNetwork Engineer 情報技術、情報サービス, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Established hot desk options for dual places of work"
良い点: Through hot desking our workforce has adapted well by having control of where to work at any given time through Clearooms. Every member of the team can access the mobile-friendly application to book a desk depending on their availability and this increases independence.
改善点: The notification system could be enhanced as well as the assessment of the amount of work to be done. In some instances the alerts about upcoming bookings were sometimes omitted or maybe late a thing that created slight inconvenience.

タイトル: Great Solution for Streamlining Hybrid Workplace Management
投稿者: Alya アメリカのProduct Manager 情報技術、情報サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Great Solution for Streamlining Hybrid Workplace Management"
良い点: What impressed me most was how quickly teams could start using the platform with almost no training. The booking process is simple, reliable, and helps eliminate scheduling conflicts. The clean interface keeps the experience straightforward and the platform supports hybrid workplace management without adding unnecessary complexity. It focuses on solving the core problem effectively.
改善点: The reporting capabilities could be more comprehensive, especially for organizations looking to analyze workspace utilization in greater detail. The interface is functional but could benefit from a more modern design, and additional customization options for notifications and workflows would make the platform more adaptable to different business needs.

タイトル: A Simple Solution That Encourages Office Attendance
投稿者: Hannah アメリカのSenior SEO and Content Manager 情報技術、情報サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "A Simple Solution That Encourages Office Attendance"
良い点: I liked how it removed the little inconveniences that come with hybrid work. Before heading into the office, I can confirm that a workspace is available instead of making assumptions or sending messages to colleagues. That simple change has made office days more productive and easier to plan, especially when collaborating on content projects or campaign meetings.
改善点: The product is intentionally simple, but I think it could offer more flexibility for larger organizations. Better occupancy analytics, customizable booking preferences, and smarter reminder options would add more value without making the interface feel complicated.

タイトル: Internal communication platform
投稿者: Siti Saleha マレーシアのSales And Marketing Specialist 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 通信, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Internal communication platform"
良い点: OfficeChat is easy to use because it uses the same corporate email address to log in. You may see a list of your most recent or regularly contacted coworkers and a list of all offline coworkers that are on your contact list. You may also check their status for seeing when they're at their computers or absent from their workstations. You may also use your chat window to transmit pictures, gifs, and other documents.
改善点: When you start a chat thread, the screen skips to the last post rather than continuing where you left off. It's inconvenient to keep scrolling up, attempting to recall and estimate which message the user read last. It would be preferable if the screen/chat queue would open and display the user's most recent news and maybe indicate or identify between reading and unopened messages.

タイトル: Simple chat software
投稿者: Kaitlyn アメリカのPartner and sales associate アパレル、ファッション, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Simple chat software"
良い点: Live chat, real time notifications and alerts, mobile alerts and mobile version, access & control permissions (role based too), file sharing. It's convenient that I can mute conversations that aren't as important or urgent. Quick reply is awesome to have. I like that it includes GIFs and emoticons, some office oriented chat software does not. Price is affordable and consistent. Simple to use and reliable as far as messages getting through. The read receipts are nice when I need to check team accountability!
改善点: Sadly there are several important things we need that aren't in the software, like mentions or tagging with the @ symbol, commenting, event calender or schedule, task lists. It really stinks that there isn't an employee and contact database too. We also really needed a good video conferencing and screen sharing feature. There are some things that are frustrating, for example when I'm catching up on a conversation and someone sends a new message, it sends me back to the bottom of the thread. Also when I'm using another app and a notification pops up for office chat, for some reason it automatically starts typing in the quick reply box instead of what I was doing originally.

タイトル: Decent product unless you use Microsoft Remote Desktop Services
投稿者: Glenn アメリカのIT Manager 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Decent product unless you use Microsoft Remote Desktop Services"
良い点: Ease of setting up users and creating groups; availability of web-based version; option to have server hosted in the cloud; administrative ability to review message activity.
改善点: Very CPU-heavy, often averaging 15% of the CPU depending on each user's activity (not good with multiple users on an RDS server); web-based version very unreliable even with an unclogged 100Mbps Internet feed; was not designed for Microsoft RDS (to be fair they came out with an RDS-friendly installation about a month after we purchased it); product probably sold from somewhere in Asia (not a problem in itself except for adding an extra day to advanced tech support queries).

タイトル: Easy and effective but has some issues!
投稿者: Kira アメリカのFoster Marketing Agent マーケティング、広告, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Easy and effective but has some issues!"
良い点: I love the setup which is similar to text messaging vs other chat formats. Its easy to share an array of files in the chat and you can chat with everyone or one on one. If you need it the delivery confirmation is great and very convenient. Overall it's an easy to use product with great features.
改善点: Unfortunately this product has a few issues that are rather frustrating. There is no option to delete old messages, you can only leave the entire chat and start a new one which requires all other team members to do so as well. It doesn't offer the option to bookmark your place in reading conversations and everything a new message is sent you have to scroll back up. This becomes very time consuming and annoying.

タイトル: Very easy and convenient to use. I use it 90% of the time
投稿者: Annette アメリカのEscrow Accounting Assistant 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 不動産, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Very easy and convenient to use. I use it 90% of the time"
良い点: I work in Escrow and a lot of my co-workers are in another location and its easier to ask a quick question without having to send an email only to have it get lost in the sea of the other emails that we receive on an hourly basis. Using this sends a ping right away to the recipient and allow for my questions to get answer much quicker than sending an email
改善点: The only thing I don't like about it that the chat screen still shows old chats from employees who do not work at the company any longer and for some reason I can not find a way to remove them. All of our old chats are on my dashboard and I would like to remove them. If there is a way to remove them, I have not found it yet.

タイトル: We use Trekksoft daily for all of tour operations.
投稿者: John ブラジルのManager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 小売, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "We use Trekksoft daily for all of tour operations."
良い点: It is a turnkey system with a full back end support staff. The management of the booking process is designed for ease of use and the best user experience.
改善点: Because it is a new more people need to use the software in order to grow the network, this happening as more and more companies trust the system.

タイトル: Surprisingly great solution even for very small businesses
投稿者: Mal ノルウェーのOwner Manager レジャー、旅行、観光, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Surprisingly great solution even for very small businesses"
良い点: Customizable at all levels - and the ability to add differing approaches to offering payment for your products (vouchers etc) and the ability to add shop items too.
改善点: Sometimes the terminology and vocabulary used in the menu and form systems could use more easy and accessible clarification. The help system is great at answering 'how to..?' questions, but not so great at answering 'what is...?' questions.

タイトル: Owes me a lot of money , wont respond, terrible support, many technical issues & designed to bleed money from you
投稿者: Phil CEO 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 ソース：SoftwareAdvice 共有 "Owes me a lot of money , wont respond, terrible support, many technical issues & designed to bleed money from you"
良い点: us off and avoid paying (never resolved). The issues go from top to bottom - CEOs and senior management have been included in email complaints about them not responding (several emails over a month period) to my request for answers regarding the many thousands of USD they owe us but we get no response. Last email informed them of impending legal action and it receive a swift apology and a promise it would be investigate by a support manage , with a follow up response the following day. That what several days ago and nothing so I have no choice but to take legal action against the company now.
改善点: The pre sales people will do everything they can and promise you everything to get you on board - but after that you will not received the same level of response again. - The actual technical setup of the site causes lots of SEO issues and google to penalize you giving you no chance of doing well in rankings. You are very limited on what you can do to make changes to help this. Our sales dropped 60% when we switched. - The tech support is just a system to fob you off with next to no support at all. They have a "helpdesk system" chat type interface right in the admin , you ask a question and it will take min hours but more likely a day or so for someone to reply but that reply will usually not be an answer but just "we will pass this onto the support team" . So basically can take days to just have you request passed to support. From there your lucky if you get a response in less than a week , often taking many weeks for a reply. -The checkout cart is extremely bad and has extremely high abandonment rates. Also the fact that you can only book one product at a time loses lots of sales or puts people off from booking at all - The payment processing fees are very high, and that is on top of an already expensive fee you pay for the system, charges for refunds, placing bookings (even for offline bookings there are fees!). - The checkout cart currency conversion system is a ripoff that just annoys your customers and results in lots of complaints about you over charging them. タイトル: WhatsUp Gold
投稿者: Jim アメリカのNetwork Engineer 人材派遣、人材紹介, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "WhatsUp Gold"
良い点: The ease of adding a device, and getting monitors configured with alerts is what like best. To go from no monitoring to getting a text/email when something goes wrong is relatively easy with this product. The ease of putting specific graph items on a page (dashboard) is also very useful.
改善点: The biggest problem with this product is the performance/capacity of the product to generate graphs. Using java to fetch data from the database to paint pages is slow. I can collect 500,000 data items and generate 100,000 graphs without much horsepower with a tool like CACTI which uses php and flat text rrd files to paint the graph. I can put ten times as many graphs on a page and it still paints 10 times faster. This performance limitation is the biggest week point between your products and the competition. I maintain a CACTI server to do the heavy lifting for graphing high density interface switches in the data centers because WUG is too slow. The thing that I like least about the software is the inability of the administrator to manage other users views. and the lack of an anonymous view. You want to be able to give upper management a link to click on to see pretty graphs and charts. They do not want to have to log in. And you do not want them messing up the view so it constantly has to be fixed. Logging in as admin, changing the users rights, logging out,logging in as the user, changing the dashboard, logging out, logging in as the admin and setting the rights back, is a lousy way to have to manage this.

良い点: PagerDuty is used to send alert notifications to developer, We can use it in a way that when ever failure occurs notify the developer who is scheduled to be on-call, Even a customer escalation to a email can trigger a pagerDuty notification alert, when the receiver email ID is subscribed with PagerDuty, PagerDuty has escalation policies , in which multiple users can be in different level, if level 1 failed to resolve the issue, the level 2 dev gets a alert etc .. and the dev's can be scheduled to rotate there levels in fixed time intervals, like weekly bases, It Dose a good job of maintaining the issue states & the alerted issue has different lifecycle such as triggered, acknowledged , resolved, snoozed, It maintains analytical dashboards on dev's which shows the responsiveness of the developer , like how many issues they have resolved and what is the average resolution time or have they escalated it etc .. it maintains history of alerts, it has good customer support, the resolution note's can also be added against the alert, We can configure the alerts as Low and High Urgency , based on which we can have different type of notifications, types of notifications are phone call, message, email, push notification in pd app etc ... pagerDuty deduplicates the alerts with same message, if a incident is in open state and if same incident occurs again and again , it will not be raised.
改善点: Sometimes when i resolve the alert on web, i still get a call on phone, If the incident was resigned by the developer to a other user who is not in the escalation policy and if he did not answer the alert the escalation chain stops, instead it should be thrown back to older escalation policy from ware it begun

タイトル: Reliable paging, but noisy and hard to work with day to day
投稿者: Koshish アメリカのSoftware Engineer 情報技術、情報サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Reliable paging, but noisy and hard to work with day to day"
良い点: The core alerting is reliable. When something broke, I got paged quickly by push, SMS or phone call, and I never worried that an alert would get lost. On-call scheduling also works well. Rotations, overrides and escalation policies are clear, so it was easy to see who was on call and to swap shifts when I needed to.
改善点: Alert noise was the biggest problem. Without a lot of tuning, we got flooded with low-priority or duplicate alerts, which led to alert fatigue and made the real incidents harder to spot. The learning curve is steep. Services, event rules and integrations are not intuitive, and figuring out why an alert fired, or didn’t, took longer than it should have. The UI feels cluttered, and the mobile app is clunky when you’re trying to acknowledge or triage an incident quickly at night, which is exactly when it needs to be fast and simple.

投稿者: Joseph アメリカのDigital Marketing Consultant 資金調達, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Wufoo Review"
良い点: I like that I can select my own payment processor. Payments through Stripe are easy to setup. Detailed explanation for editing field styles make the forms look professional.
改善点: An extra screen is required for payment, so some users drop off after the initial form submission.

タイトル: True OCR technology. Ease of use and good customer support.
投稿者: Bryan アメリカのFinancial Controller 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 病院、ヘルスケア, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "True OCR technology. Ease of use and good customer support."
良い点: Ease of use. Ease of implementation. Training excellent. Good customer support. Mobile app. Ease of delegations for employees on vacation.
改善点: Dashboard cannot be customized. Limited metric data. No data on comparable companies in size, industry, or spend.

タイトル: Save time use, Yooz.
投稿者: Sarah 英国のAccounts assistant 建設, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Save time use, Yooz."
良い点: The automation of Yooz, makes processing invoices quick and smooth. The warning that are given when there are duplicates, payment amount differ and other issues such as bank details are invaluable as when processing 1000's of invoices this can sometimes be missed. The integration into Sage to allow payments to be made quick and easy also saves time. The accounting records that are produced help to ensure that there are few errors and these are identified easily. The security of the invoices been sent to yooz and the ability to reply to these so you know that you are messaging the correct email account for inquiries for the invoice.
改善点: It is frustration that Yooz does not always learn from invoices and remembers setting that you may have only used once. It would be good if it would learn when you have made the same change several times.

タイトル: Good, but not perfect
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 保険, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Good, but not perfect"
良い点: Easy to use and to upload documents. Good view of what is outstanding and at what payment stage they're at
改善点: Cannot see a history of what has been paid and when. You can see what documents have been uploaded, but cannot access old requests to check what has been paid

タイトル: Makes My Daily Invoice Work So Much Easier
投稿者: Paula ポーランドのHR manager 情報技術、情報サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Makes My Daily Invoice Work So Much Easier"
良い点: Significant time savings by automating invoice capture, routing, and data entry Good integration capabilities with accounting/ERP systems Strong audit trail and visibility into invoice lifecycle Centralized dashboard & analytics for tracking performance Flexible approval workflows
改善点: Steepish initial setup and configuration overhead Occasional issues or manual fixes needed for exceptions or unusual invoice formats Some limitations when dealing with highly customized accounting rules or payment paths For smaller organizations, cost may feel high relative to usage

タイトル: Yooz experience
投稿者: Michaela スロバキアのSenior Manager 金融サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Yooz experience"
良い点: Intelligent OCR, Workflows, Easy navigation, Full text search, Very good value for money, option to connect ERPs via API
改善点: Not flexible set-up as per country legislative requirements, adjustments are done by Yooz team and take very long to implement. Its s bit complicated to onboard on Yooz, its not very easy to make it work, help from Yooz team is needed.

タイトル: A powerful player in the e-learning arena
投稿者: Josh アメリカのSenior Education Manager of Online Learning 認証済みLinkedInユーザー Eラーニング, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "A powerful player in the e-learning arena"
良い点: Having used many products for developing e-learning, Captivate is among the top-tier development programs but has a high cost to entry. The platform is powerful and has a lot of nuances that allow for digging deep into options for developing truly custom courses and user experiences.
改善点: While you can dig deeply into advanced interactions, data reporting, etc, the learning curve is immense to begin to understand elements such as advanced actions, keywords, etc. Variables become buried and are not as easy to manipulate as in Articulate Storyline, but they are buried for very good reason in that you can actually do more in Captivate than with its rival program with such features. If I am to further nitpick, I am not excited by the filmstrip display for slide storyline. This is a feature I love in Articulate's e-learning in that non-linear branching is highly encouraged whereas the linear filmstrip does little to entice users to develop complex learning opportunities, reinforcing the linear death by slides commonly seen in virtual learning.

タイトル: Instructional Designer
投稿者: Jean-Pierre アメリカのInstructional Desing Eラーニング, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Instructional Designer"
良い点: Captivate is a robust software that helps to build interactive materials for your online or hybrid courses. I used the screen recording to create step-by-step instructions to demonstrate how to use different technologies in our school. Question templates are also amazing.
改善点: A little pricy, and it is very difficult to reach customer support. In addition, the new users find it overwhelming to navigate.

タイトル: Expensive but can get results. Articulate is better.
投稿者: Alexander 英国のIT trainer 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Expensive but can get results. Articulate is better."
良い点: Easy to produce very simple e-learning once you overcome the initial learning curve. Good for rework.
改善点: The initial learning curve is extremely steep, even with experience of video editing and other tools.

タイトル: Captivate, once the king, not 2d best
投稿者: Mark アメリカのCEO プロフェッショナル・トレーニング、コーチング, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Captivate, once the king, not 2d best"
良い点: Some features for ease of use, powerful, eLearning software.
改善点: Complicated in some features. Either must have a developer or take a course. On ramping steep at times in the past.

タイトル: Streamline your LMS with an advanced learning tool from Adobe.
投稿者: Shubham インドのManager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 ソース：GetApp 共有 "Streamline your LMS with an advanced learning tool from Adobe."
良い点: We can easily convert our existing webinars & PowerPoint presentations into courses & onboarding walkthroughs thanks to Captivate. Learning Management is the spine of any Organization & Captivate is the tool that ensures that all employees are constantly learning and evolving. Managers at each level can track the progress using 360 degree dashboards.
改善点: Captivate is not an easy tool. Administrators will need a lot of trainings and hands on before they can fully utilize this product to it's real potential.

タイトル: The best and only way to do Simulive Webinars
投稿者: Nick アメリカのSenior Designer- Marketing 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "The best and only way to do Simulive Webinars"
良い点: We use On24 in our marketing department to attract new leads for our sales team. We use On24's Simulive feature. This allows us to pre-record our speaker and slides. Then the day of the live webinar the attendees watch the edited video then our speakers are pushed into a live conversation to take questions that have came in. On24 is maybe the only webinar platform that can do this. All others are more of a screenshare system. Simulive gives us the most flexiblity to have a seamless webinar​ without any sound or speaker problems.
改善点: On24 audience console allows us to put up different resources, surveys and links, but it is limited in its customizability​. I'd like to see more console customization when it comes to menu format and colors. Also being able to upload your branded font would be great too.

タイトル: The platform for a premium webinar experiemce
投稿者: Logan アメリカのowner ファシリティサービス, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "The platform for a premium webinar experiemce"
良い点: On24 makes it easy to quickly get in and spin up an event, no matter how much prior experience you may have had in similar platforms; however, the customization options for events, landing pages, and forms makes it not just professional, but - dare I say - cool. Integrates well with Marketo and HubSpot, i imagine it works well elsewhere.
改善点: On24 licensing tiers can be confusing and pricey, depending on how many seats you are filling. larger events can cost a pretty penny, but that's par for the course with these products.

タイトル: trash
投稿者: Liz アメリカのMarketing Stategist 高等教育, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "trash"
良い点: simu-live and on-demand options allow us to mitigate the risks involved with live presenting on this platform.
改善点: the "best practices" where presenters need a wired internet connection, clear cookies, restart the computer and have no other apps going--are you kidding me? What year is it? The customer service is poor, not for lack of CSM's trying, but because there is no follow through from the product team, and CSM's often don't have access to the latest information, leaving them set up for failure.

タイトル: Great business development platform and branding tool for clients
投稿者: Douglas カナダのBusiness Development Strategies Advisor 保険, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Great business development platform and branding tool for clients"
良い点: I like the analytics feature the most about ON24. With a lot of data collected each show, it is very important to use the data and drive results and inferences from it. You can see how the users interacted with the show, how long they have attended, what buttons they have clicked on, questions they have asked, and quiz answers. There are a lot of widgets interact with and it allows ON24 to process a lot of useful analytics that will be helpful for business development and marketing. I also like the customizability of the software. The audience screen is customizable any way that you want and it allows full control of your own company to do any creative things that you want.
改善点: One thing that I think can be improved is the rigid rules in place for some customization of the software. A lot of the interactive pieces on the console have only 1 or 2 options that may not be right for what your company is trying to do. Also, ON24 is more of a recording software rather that recording and video editing software. If you are doing a recording and you mess up, it is very hard to edit the video, meaning you will need to restart the recording and do it over again. Editing the video is fine, but you will need a 3rd party software, download the video, edit it, and then re-upload the video again.

タイトル: The Best for What is Out Right Now
投稿者: Lauren アメリカのPrograms Coordinator 非営利団体運営, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "The Best for What is Out Right Now"
良い点: One of the only platforms out there that has been established since way before the pandemic. When we purchased it was affordable and catered to what we needed in an events platform. One that allowed individual events and served as a conference platform for multiple events. It allowed to have a conference feel without spending a lot on the virtual world looking platforms.
改善点: The onboarding for the system was horrible. There are several areas on this platform and with each section there is a different ON24 person to lead you through the process. We spent half the time explaining our event over and over again to different people for each section. The team would quickly show us the platform and ask if we had questions, however, since it was our first time we did not know the right questions to ask and missed a lot of good information because of it. We ended up learning the platform ourselves through their library of resource help. By the end of our first event, I knew more about the platform and how it worked better than their "expert help" staff team.

タイトル: A great appraisal tool with all essential features and simply navigation.
投稿者: Vipul インドのDirector 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 金融サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "A great appraisal tool with all essential features and simply navigation."
良い点: Ease of use, prompt customer support, and inclusion of all essential features for performane appraisals.
改善点: Team managers dashboard can be improved.

タイトル: User Friendly
投稿者: Claudia アメリカのDirector of Financial Planning 金融サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "User Friendly"
良い点: I like the ease of being able to quickly assess team members. It allows me to reflect on team member performance quickly and in a meaningful way.
改善点: With the structure of our firm, the format of managers is difficult to use in AssessTeam, because our team is not always a top down manager style.

タイトル: It's ok... not great
投稿者: John アメリカのCaptain 公共安全, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "It's ok... not great"
良い点: It is nice to have reminders of when you want employees to be evaluated. It's a central point to evaluate, send, discuss, and receive signatures from the employee.
改善点: Set up is difficult. With change in the organization and it not being kept up with, I have to delete every evaluator from each employee and re assign every evaluator to an employee. This is HOURS of work. I ought to be able to great groups of employees and assign them that way. If it's possible, I'd like to know how.

タイトル: AssessTeam review
投稿者: clay アメリカのCOO 病院、ヘルスケア, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "AssessTeam review"
良い点: the price is my favorite part. THere are a lot of other options out there but they are very expensive.
改善点: over the years there have been some glitches that have caused some employees to see who reviewed them even when it was supposed to be anonymous

タイトル: Great tool for structured performance appraisals and 360-degree feedback
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 食品製造, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Great tool for structured performance appraisals and 360-degree feedback"
良い点: What I liked most about AssessTEAM is the 360-degree feedback feature. It makes it easy to gather input from managers, peers, and other stakeholders in one place, which gives a much more balanced and holistic view of performance. The performance appraisal process is well-structured, and the platform is intuitive to use without requiring extensive training
改善点: Initial setup can take a little time, especially when configuring appraisal cycles for the first time.

タイトル: They are still providing the best card processing services for websites & online shops!
投稿者: Nipon バングラデシュのExecutive Director 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "They are still providing the best card processing services for websites & online shops!"
良い点: You might not hear a lot about them these days but actually they are the biggest network of merchant account provider processing card payments for almost every type of businesses since the beginning of e-commerce. They offer plan for high risk business sectors too and process cards in a lot of currencies. Plug-ins available for almost every platform out there and clear payments to bank daily.
改善点: I found there interface little tricky and needed expert’s help to integrate with my e-commerce site.

タイトル: Used for over 10 years!
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Used for over 10 years!"
良い点: We were able to intergrade with our software at a cheaper rate. Easy log in and easy to run reports for members and sales.
改善点: We were unable to charge 3% to the customer for online transactions. We did incur a monthly gateway fee plus multiple other fees monthly - we were pci compliment but yet still got charged on the statement

タイトル: Authorize is a handy tool
投稿者: Dana アメリカのFulfillment Manager 出版, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Authorize is a handy tool"
良い点: Authorize helps us securely capture payment from customers on our eCommerce customer facing site that is a partnership with our fulfillment business. It is easier to use than our home grown software for the end user for sure.
改善点: We need separate accounts for US and Canadian payments. This means that we have to log in and out depending on the ship destination. It's also not the most user friendly on the back end.

タイトル: Secure online payments and transfers for export operations.
投稿者: Jason アメリカのOperations Manager 輸出入, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Secure online payments and transfers for export operations."
良い点: Authorize.net gives us strong security for global transactions, plus simple account management and clear fees. The transferring of money to clients and partners is highly reliable; it assists in avoiding fraud issues.
改善点: Account settings and updating staff permissions took some getting used to when dealing with a bigger team. Managing fees and multiple accounts is confusing at first.

タイトル: Good Stripe alternative for Woocommerce
投稿者: Hilary エストニアのHead of Growth マーケティング、広告, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Good Stripe alternative for Woocommerce"
良い点: API access is great and there are paid plugins that make integrating with WooCommerce very easy. The also have low fees
改善点: Their merchant UI is very outdated. It’s hard to find things and it’s small and hard to read sometimes. Looks like it was built in the 90s and never updated.

タイトル: Seismic Review
投稿者: Taylor アメリカのAE 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Seismic Review"
良い点: I like that you can easily assemble a digital sales room to share content for prospects without making threads of content that gets lost.
改善点: I do not like the UI. It's clunky but getting better with enhancements like dropping files in straight from your computer.

タイトル: Great Sales Enablement and CMS Platform
投稿者: Matthew アメリカのPresident & Chief Project Engineer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Great Sales Enablement and CMS Platform"
良い点: We anticipate getting a lot of use out of the "LiveDoc" capabilities for our ABM efforts in the coming years. We also anticipate that Seismic will eventually replace Microsoft OneDrive entirely as our document repository and Sharepoint as our corporate intranet.
改善点: It would be nice if content could be displayed and/or shared externally. Seismic's entire pricing model is predicated on each consumer of content not specifically sent something through the system itself having a license.

タイトル: Great Tool for Organizing Insurance Sales and Marketing Content
投稿者: michael カナダのAccount Manager 保険, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great Tool for Organizing Insurance Sales and Marketing Content"
良い点: Seismic is a useful platform for our insurance brokerage firm, especially for organizing and accessing sales and marketing content. I like that information is centralized and easy to share with clients and colleagues. The search functionality is helpful when looking for specific documents, presentations, or resources, and it saves time compared with searching through multiple folders or systems.
改善点: The learning curve can be a little challenging at first, especially when you're new to the platform and trying to understand where everything is located. Some features could also be more intuitive and easier to navigate. It can take some time to become comfortable with the different tools and content.

タイトル: Useful for content sharing and tracking, but best for larger teams
投稿者: Martina 英国のVP マーケティング、広告, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Useful for content sharing and tracking, but best for larger teams"
良い点: I mainly used Seismic for hosting, sharing and tracking sales and marketing content, and that side of the platform worked well. It was useful to have approved assets in 1 place, share them easily and see how people engaged with the content. The tracking was one of the most useful parts, especially being able to understand which materials were opened and viewed. Seismic also positions this buyer engagement tracking as a core part of its content management platform
改善点: Seismic can feel quite heavy if you’re only using it for content hosting and tracking. It has a lot of functionality, but not all of it is needed for a simpler use case. The platform also depends on good content organisation and admin management. If folders, permissions and versions aren’t maintained well, it can become harder to find what you need quickly.

タイトル: Seismic Review
投稿者: Brendan 南アフリカのAccount Exec 情報技術、情報サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Seismic Review"
良い点: I love Seismic because it has helped me and my team with managing assets and training for new members on our team. It has helped us create and design learning journeys and onboarding courses for all our reps and has given us a central repository for most of our organisational assets. It has also help us collaborate with customers and partners through creating experiences and repositories we need fore collaboration with the parties mentioned. It’s also easier to find information with Seismic as you can easily and quickly search for assets. I also love how easy it is to customise works spaces and assets in Seismic, making it easier for collaboration and differentiation between assets and workspaces
改善点: I haven’t seen any cons yet on Seismic. Everything is exactly how we expected it to be and we have all the functionality we needed when looking for a tool similar to what Seismic does

タイトル: Productivity and agility in my tasks.
投稿者: Milton スペインのFounder 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Productivity and agility in my tasks."
良い点: I love being able to connect all my online services and be able to execute automated tasks between them. It is quite practical and productive.
改善点: At the moment I have no doubts or discomfort with IFTTT, it is really good and has many services to connect.

タイトル: Unlock Automation Possibilities with IFTTT
投稿者: Boyang カナダのJunior Data Integration Developer 情報技術、情報サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Unlock Automation Possibilities with IFTTT"
良い点: IFTTT is an incredibly powerful tool for automating a wide range of tasks. It is incredibly simple to set up and use, and it can make your life easier by taking care of tedious chores. The applets available to users are vast and cater to a variety of needs, and the ability to create your own applets is a great bonus. IFTTT is definitely a great tool for anyone looking to streamline their digital life.
改善点: The main issue with IFTTT is that it can be a bit unreliable. Applet triggers can sometimes fail to execute properly, and there is no way to be sure when this will happen. In addition, the range of services IFTTT can integrate with is limited, which can be a problem for users who require more custom solutions.

タイトル: The Forerunner that got left behind but still packs a mean punch
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 金融サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "The Forerunner that got left behind but still packs a mean punch"
良い点: I first started using IFTTT years ago and found it fascinating because of how much it could do. It is great for managing connections to multiple devices and apps. The ability to have your home lights turn on when you arrive, or have the AC turn on at a specific time every day are all really cool and useful tasks that IFTTT performs perfectly.
改善点: IFTTT lags behind when it comes to multistep workflows the kind that Zapier, Integromat can handle quite easily. But what it does do, it does very well.

タイトル: Automation is now a childs play.
投稿者: Mukul インドのCTO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ、ネットワーク・セキュリティ, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Automation is now a childs play."
良い点: Easiness and straightforward approach make the IFTTT ahead of other available solutions, It took only 2 minutes to sign up and I am pretty sure in total 10 minutes your Alert system/Automation is ready to run. Even in the free account 3 number of automation tasks are free for life and with zero latency.
改善点: In the case of the Google sheet option available options are very limited like a change in single-cell value/Insert a new row where Zapier provides many more options.

タイトル: Simply the best home automation toolset
投稿者: Simon アメリカのCTO 不動産, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Simply the best home automation toolset"
良い点: A wider range of connectors than anywhere else, and the simplest way to create most triggered actions. IFTTT pro now allows multi-step actions which would address most of the issues I had earlier.
改善点: being able to link to multiple accounts for triggers and actions would give me everything I really need from this now.

タイトル: BrainCert - The E-Learning Platform With Global Reach
投稿者: Renjith インドのDesign 認証済みLinkedInユーザー デザイン, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "BrainCert - The E-Learning Platform With Global Reach"
良い点: I liked the ease of use and features included in BrainCert. The platform offers a variety of features, such as drag-and-drop content uploading, interactive tools, scheduling and invoicing, and customizable quizzes to promote engagement with students. Additionally, course designers have access to flexible payment options, enabling them to collect payments quickly from their customers.
改善点: The least liked thing about BrainCert is the limited customization options when building course content. The platform does not allow for much design customization, which can make courses feel a bit generic. Additionally, there have been some reports of technical issues that caused courses to load slowly.

タイトル: Brincert E-Learning : Virtual ClassRoom API Review
投稿者: Rahul インドのDeveloper 情報技術、情報サービス, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Brincert E-Learning : Virtual ClassRoom API Review"
良い点: 1. Authority Structure During Session :- Instructor can allow/disallow Mic, Camera, WhiteBoard access etc of attendant. 2. Recording and storage process of session. 3. Code Editor & Formulas adds more value to session 4. Individual and Common session chat is also very useful. 5. Upload documents to whiteboard feature is very smooth in use. 6. Allow attendant to be an instructor is very awesome.
改善点: 1. API structure has limited access features. 2. Cannot invite someone using api structure to join session. 3. Screen-Share feature in virtual classroom not available. 4. API level should have various session chat log access. 5. Important Notes feature to download by attendee may add more value to session. 6. Missing Rating feature to session which increase overall experience of Instructor in improvement. 7. Embed Session to user website using Iframe will be more friendly. I think you suppose to add embed feature and it will be easier for non-technical users .

タイトル: Some good features, but it needs improvement
投稿者: Daniel ブラジルのTeacher Eラーニング, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Some good features, but it needs improvement"
良い点: My favorite feature is the audio and video streaming service. It works pretty well. The whiteboard is very useful, but typing on it is not not working well. Some students have also reported that my text was not being displayed in the intended place - sometimes it was partially not visible for them. Sometimes text boxes are copied from one slide to another automatically. Changing the size of fonts doesn't work properly, too. Besides, the system doesn't save the font settings from one slide to another. I like the break-out room function, but it's really a pain on the neck to work with it. The voice and video transmissions have apparently improved, but I have had to use some other conferencing apps concomitantly to have a good voice and video transmission.

タイトル: Free time tracking app

良い点: As a freelancer, I rely on solid time-tracking to monitor my performance and give estimates for work, so naturally, I've used more apps than I can count. So far, Timely is my favorite. The UI, features, and glorious reports give it an extra edge over most apps I've used. You can plan out your weeks of work in advance and it displays as nicely colored blocks that you can drag and drop if you need to shuffle tasks around. (You can also choose a custom color for each block!) You can set an hourly rate for tasks or set a budget for a project and it'll tell you how much your hourly fee should be. I love how it integrates with my Google Calendar so I'm not going back and forth to see which calendar has what.
改善点: While I love the custom color feature, it would be great if Timely could automatically assign that color for future blocks with the same name. Another useful addition would be to move a future task to the current week without having to type it out all over again.

We've been using it for about a year, on and off, and are not 100% satisfied. Perhaps a few more options and features would be nice - but the more you build in, the more time it takes to learn it. タイトル: Navigating the World of Backups
投稿者: Kavindu Githsara スリランカのSystem Specialist 認証済みLinkedInユーザー Eラーニング, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Navigating the World of Backups"
良い点: I've been using Acronis Cyber Backup for a while now in our IT services company, and I've got to say, it's a pretty solid backup solution. The best part is its ease of use. I found the interface quite user-friendly, and it didn't take me long to figure out how to create and manage backups. The software also offers a variety of backup options, like full, incremental, and differential backups, which is awesome because it allows me to choose the one that fits my needs the best. Another great feature is the ability to restore data quickly. In the few instances where I've had to restore data, the process was fast and hassle-free.
改善点: While Acronis Cyber Backup is a good software, it does have a few drawbacks. One thing I noticed is that it can be a bit slow when performing a backup, especially if you have a lot of data to back up. This can be a bit annoying when you're in a hurry. Also, the software can be a bit pricey, especially if you're a small business or just getting started in the IT industry. I also wish they provided more detailed tutorials or help articles for some of the more advanced features. Sometimes it takes a bit of trial and error to figure things out.

タイトル: Speed, but with sacrifices.
投稿者: Nathan 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 自動車, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 ソース：GetApp 共有 "Speed, but with sacrifices."
良い点: Very easy to use and deploy, administrative console allows excellent granular controls of client privileges, scope of protection, and endpoint groups. Integrates with Windows server products for deployment (though I use Samba instead, so this was not an option), and provides a centralized point for administrator notification and action when compromised/infected systems are detected. Client seems relatively fast and works on multiple platforms, though see below re. OS X.
改善点: In my experience, Webroot, though the exposed end is fast and well-designed, does not reliably block or detect common threats. This is obviously a Big Deal in a product billed as enterprise-grade antivirus/antimalware. One employee at the affected client's office was able to download three separate third-party software installers containing malware payloads on a Saturday, install them, and work for a full weekend before I arrived back on Monday to complaints that her machine was being "slow and weird". I discovered that Webroot, though fully deployed and set to monitor downloads, warn on browsing, and scan the affected directories, simply had not alerted on anything. At that point, it doesn't matter how beautiful the interface may be: antimalware software which lets common malware through is essentially useless. Also, while there is an OS X client, it's buggy and slow. It causes problems with network browsing and network virtualization with both VirtualBox and VMware Fusion, and it results, for some reason, in systemwide UI slowdowns, which suggest to me that there may be some elemental problems with the codebase: use of deprecated APIs, memory leaks, etc.—not usable.

Most of the fundamental features can be accessed via their free tier; including syncing across devices, complex password generation, autofilling credentials and secure notes. Amongst its crowning features you can find MFA support, passkeys and credential breach/leak monitoring to ensure you keeping on top of any potential security threats - although this feature is usually only for paying customers. it's a versatile tool that can be used for more complex setups, such as balancing personal and professional profiles and 'shared vaults' for credential sharing. A great addition is the support for local hosting for any that worry about the reliability of online platforms, or simply want to have sovereignty over their own data. To this extent however, the software is open source, which is a great plus for transparency and user trust.
改善点: The interface can sometimes feel unpolished or less intuitive to those that are new to the software; comparing against some other paid solutions can feel like you are missing that 'premium' finish found in alternatives. The free tier is a great way to get started and removes barriers to entry, however this also means that some of the nicer 'bells and whistles' require a subscription. The focus on bitwarden seems to lean towards functionality over presentation, which is a great tradeoff - especially from a tech background - however can definitely be a deciding feature for more casual users when deciding on which solution to go with. It can definitely come across as minimalistic when compared to other solutions that offer buckets of additional features, snap-ins and add-ons; such as VPN clients or credential/breach monitoring.

タイトル: Bill4Time got me started, helped me survive Hurricane Maria, and helped me survive covid-19

良い点: It is cloud-based, super user friendly (everyone's learning curve has been quite small), supports electronic billing, and gets the job done effectively and efficiently. If you have to follow billing guidelines that require a separate entry for every discreet task, the "batch" entry feature CANNOT be beat. Being cloud-based, I able to start working on getting my billing up to date within 48 hours of being hit by a CAT-5 hurricane. It has also let our team work remotely during the pandemic while having full access to our billing platform (my billing admin continues to work with us even though she moved out of state!). To put my review into context, after 25 years I opened my own law firm. My clients are mostly multi-national insurance companies that require I submit bills with ABA task and activity codes. I absolutely needed a billing platform, and I did not have the money to pay close to $10k in a server, "traditional software" (I grew up on one of the main legal billing programs out there) and IT setup. This costs me less per year that what such a program would cost, back-ups are taken care of, I can access from anywhere, and I don't have to cough up a pretty penny every five years to upgrade a server or the program. BTW- It has a very decent iOS app to boot (a proper app mind you; not browser based). I have no relation to Bill4Time; I'm just a very happy customer preaching its benefits as the practice of law evolves.
改善点: Even diamonds have flaws (at least most of them). I have only two items I yearn for, which I will share in order of importance: 1. When I look at a case and below I see all the time entries, I can see the activity code but I cannot see the ABA task code unless I click on the entry. It adds a step I would love to see erased when I am correcting our invoices. Not a dealbreaker for sure, but adding this small item would make a difference. 2. Much farther down the list: as far as I know, no Dropbox integration. I want to beg for it and did when I first subscribed to Bill4Time, but at present I am not sure I would even do much with it. Honestly, by now I don't even miss it. Being cloud-based, your session can hiccup (it's rare but it does happen) and its a nuisance. This is not on Bill4Time; any platform you use via the internet is always subject to this. But the benefits of a cloud-based program (which I mentioned in the "Pros") exceedingly outweigh this, at least for me.

タイトル: Reliable Operations Platform with Great Implementation Support
投稿者: Frank カナダのHead of Digital 事務用品、事務機器, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Reliable Operations Platform with Great Implementation Support"
良い点: Brightpearl’s onboarding process is exceptionally thorough. Their team invests real effort into understanding a customer’s operational needs, and the implementation support is strong across the board—from structured training sessions to well‑coordinated customization work involving third‑party partners when needed. The Automations feature is another major advantage. It allows us to build powerful workflows using order data such as SKUs, sales channels, shipping methods, and customer history. This has enabled us to automate tasks like reviewing customer notes before fulfilment, adding promotional items with logic-based limits, and routing orders to the appropriate warehouse. I also appreciate that Brightpearl provides predictable annual software costs. In an industry where surprise renewal price hikes are common, the transparency and year‑to‑year consistency are genuinely refreshing.
改善点: The session timeout is one of the most frustrating aspects of using Brightpearl. It logs users out after a relatively short period of inactivity, which is disruptive for anyone who needs to keep the tab open throughout the day but isn’t working inside it continuously. Compounding this, the interface doesn’t automatically refresh to indicate that the session has expired, so you only discover you’ve been logged out after clicking something—a daily friction point for our entire team. The built‑in search functionality also feels quite limited, especially for users who rely heavily on quick data retrieval. Additionally, permissions could be more granular; for example, offering read‑only access to inventory location data would be extremely useful, but currently it’s an all‑or‑nothing permission.

タイトル: Virtual events that feel like the real thing
投稿者: 💡 Alexander アメリカのFounder, CEO & Lunch Break Enforcer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー イベント企画運営, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Virtual events that feel like the real thing"
良い点: When first finding Remo in August of last year, I knew it was something special but I wasn’t quite sure why. The 2d floorplan seemed to simulate a “space” similar to an actual networking environment, but, as I discovered, the real value and “secret sauce” is the freedom to move about from table to table. Each “table” is essentially a video breakout. The unique format of events and flexibility of the platform has allowed my company to grow significantly. As others are scrambling to provide webinars, my team has been able to provide meaningful, connective experiences that feel like actual in-person networking.
改善点: The registration page had a bit of friction. Similar tools have an option to log on as a guest, but the profile “business card” does add significant value and the team at Remo is very responsive to customer feedback.

タイトル: Like networking in real life, but on the computer and not in real life. 🤷‍♂️
投稿者: Charlie ⚡ アメリカのDesigner/Artist 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 美術、工芸, 自営業 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Like networking in real life, but on the computer and not in real life. 🤷‍♂️"
良い点: The ability to have numerous different conversations throughout a room is a huge step up from sitting in a video conference with 49 other participants, 48 of which are muted while 2 people talk, and waiting for your turn to talk. Being able to bounce around and talk to various groups of people is just phenomenal.
改善点: I think the chat bar could use a little bit of work to make it more functional for the average user. Being able to see the faces or "chat heads" of your other chats, while in a chat with someone else would be extremely useful. So, say I'm talking to [SENSITIVE CONTENT HIDDEN] in a private chat. On the left edge of that chat window you would see a bar that runs the length of the chat window that has a condensed version of the chat overview window (the one that shows General Chat, Table Chat, and Private Chats). Instead of having the full name [SENSITIVE CONTENT HIDDEN], it would just show his tile icon. If any of that makes sense. 🤷‍♂️

タイトル: Beware the Fine Print: Misleading Onboarding and No Refunds
投稿者: Roy 英国のConvener 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 教育管理, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 ソース：GetApp 共有 "Beware the Fine Print: Misleading Onboarding and No Refunds"
良い点: The visual layout of the platform is engaging, and the idea of creating interactive, table-based online spaces for meetings or events is appealing. The interface itself appeared stable and functional during test runs, which initially gave me confidence in the platform’s potential for hosting an academic symposium.
改善点: The biggest issue was being misled during onboarding. I was clearly told that I could manage all aspects of ticketing, including payment and participant registration, within the Remo platform. This turned out not to be true. As a result, I had to urgently set up an external registration process, re-communicate all information to participants, and try to salvage the event. The confusion caused by this last-minute shift contributed directly to a collapse in attendance. Worse still, when I cancelled the event — before anything had been delivered — I was informed that my payment was not for event delivery but for a subscription. This wasn’t how the service was presented at any stage. There was no flexibility, no acknowledgment of the onboarding issue, and no refund or goodwill gesture. The lack of accountability and the rigidity of the response were both disappointing and unprofessional.

タイトル: A Game changer for networking online
投稿者: Alan ドイツのStartup Coach 非営利団体運営, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "A Game changer for networking online"
良い点: Remo provides a fantastic platform for making networking easy online. The ability to have multiple tables in one view, with the ability to see who is chatting with who is a complete gamechanger for networking online. As an admin organizing large networking events there is simply no other tool that provides this kind of value.
改善点: Barrier free entry would be the best new feature for new people joining a remo event for the first time. There are often issues with people accidently selecting "join as speaker" when they are only an attendee. This blocks them from entering and causes a lot of confusion. I would also like to see an easiersystem for entering the timing of the event (during the pre-event setup). The current method of using the clock is not easy to use and after entering the starting time it almost always give me an error that my finishing time is before the starting time. This happens when I clone an event and change the time and date of the start first.

タイトル: Remo allows for autonomy in virtual events
投稿者: Spud アメリカのInnovation Director 認証済みLinkedInユーザー デザイン, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Remo allows for autonomy in virtual events"
良い点: The main reason I use Remo for most of my virtual facilitation is because it allows participants to have autonomy moving around a virtual room and join the small group conversations that matter to them. Most people are 'stuck' in breakout rooms with zoom and other platforms - but Remo allows you flip that dynamic for your participants! I also LOVE being able to upload custom floorplans - many of my clients love that we can match their brand with the event.
改善点: As a new platform for lots of users, there's a learning curve to figure out how to manage the event. Once someone has had familiarity in the platform, I find they love it and want to host a second event - but sometimes that first experience can involve a lot of 'learning the ropes' rather than focused on the specific intent of your event. It can also be challenging not being able to see everyone's video in the main presentation area. I often find myself wanting to have conversations with more people than are allowed in the small groups, but there's no option for that so I sometimes have to refer back to zoom with my group.
