Besides that you can change the layout , also it supports Maven.
改善点: It is not very stable, it crashes so many times. Also, shortcuts do not work properly all the time . For using the shortcuts you have to remember it otherwise you cannot use it. It needs to improve its memory utilization. Running time is very slow. For java users Eclipse is easy but for others, it is not so easy. Also, opening and closing time is more than normal time. Compared with VS Code Eclipse does not have a very clear interface. As it has so many options to change the settings so sometimes it is very difficult to change and also unnecessary some options are given.

タイトル: Free. Powerful. Pretty much essential for PHP development.
投稿者: Luca イタリアのIT Analyst and Developer 包装と容器, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Free. Powerful. Pretty much essential for PHP development."
良い点: For work, I have to develop and maintain a website written in PHP. The site has been developed over the years, so it includes both static and dynamic pages that retrieve data from a PostgreSQL database. As it has grown over time, it has become quite complex, and a basic text editor is sometimes insufficient. That's why I switched to Eclipse for PHP Developers. It's helpful that it offers code completion for functions and variables, and that it's possible to jump directly to the relevant function. With a basic editor, you'd have to scroll through the entire file. I also find the Compare feature very useful, as it allows you to compare the file you're editing with the current version on the server. It does have a few drawbacks, but considering it's free, I'd say it does its job quite well.
改善点: The only downsides I've found are its heavy resource usage (an editor like Notepad++ is much lighter) and a somewhat outdated user interface. Also, the sheer number of options can sometimes be overwhelming and may actually work against productivity.

タイトル: A powerful IDE that feels heavy but gets the job done
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A powerful IDE that feels heavy but gets the job done"
良い点: What stands out most about Eclipse IDE is how powerful it is for development work. It supports a wide range of programming needs, and the features are solid once you get familiar with it. It is very flexible when it comes to customization. The ability to add plugins and adjust the environment to fit different workflows is a big advantage, especially for developers working on different types of projects. In terms of code development, it handles large projects well and provides useful tools like code suggestions, debugging, and navigation between files, which helps speed up the work. The learning curve is there, but after some time it becomes easier to use. Once the basics are understood, daily tasks feel more efficient. Overall, it is a feature rich IDE that works well for serious development, especially when flexibility and extensibility are important.
改善点: What I liked least about Eclipse IDE is that it can feel heavy and slow, especially when working on larger projects. It sometimes takes a while to start up or respond compared to lighter IDEs. The interface also feels a bit outdated and not always very intuitive. Finding certain settings or features can take time, especially for someone new to it. Plugin management can be another pain point. While there are many plugins available, setting them up or dealing with compatibility issues is not always smooth. Occasionally, it also runs into bugs or freezes, which can interrupt workflow and be frustrating during development.

タイトル: Edraw, Extremely flexible program, a great company asset
投稿者: Gustavo カナダのPresident 情報技術、情報サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Edraw, Extremely flexible program, a great company asset"

I also use it largely to create Visio-type layouts which is one of the reason I bought this. It allows me to create great floorplans with ease and great network layouts, including server rack layouts, for my work. Edraw also comes with a huge library of shapes and backgrounds that makes it quite simply and quick to add components to your page. The ribbon menu is easy to read and navigate, it's not overly full of options and it's nicely laid out so you can usually find what you need fairly quick.

With everything being so easy to access and edit, it was surprisingly difficult to manage the data percentages of many charts. There wasn't an easy pop-up icon that you can click to set different percentages. I had to hunt around somewhat to find the area where I can customize that better. Otherwise it's a good program.

タイトル: Delve is a life-changing experience
投稿者: Thao ベトナムのResearcher 認証済みLinkedInユーザー ホスピタリティ, 自営業 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Delve is a life-changing experience"
良い点: 1. The UI/UX is highly friendly for new researchers, but the underlying engines are strong enough for heavy-duty qualitative and quantitative research. 2. The files exported from the post-analysis process are quite clean and easy to navigate. It helps with the process of finding quotes to input into the research-writing process. 3. I feel like it is much cheaper than other research tools, which is a huge plus. 4. The customer support team is amazing, and the best thing is they do not generate AI-like or automated emails, which is very good because they will directly help you with any troubles you have. 5. The transcript feature is amazing because it can help you easily classify Interviewer-Interviewees. This is extremely time-saving from cleaning the transcripts to understanding your transcript.
改善点: Honestly, if I could change the color of the background when I was doing my data analysis, it would be perfect. For example, Arc browser has a feature that allows users to change fonts, positions of the tabs as they like, or the color of the background with extensive options. However, it is technically annoying to code this in the UI, so I understand that it might not be worth it as a feature. I think surveys to understand researchers can be launched to understand them more.

タイトル: The essential dissertation partner
投稿者: Eric アメリカのResearcher 研究, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "The essential dissertation partner"
良い点: Super quick learning curve. Very intuitive and clear interface. Coding process is simple. Extremely dependable app. Fast search functions. Exporting data to Excel or CSV files makes it easy to then triangulate between cases, codes, transcripts and participants.
改善点: I tried using the AI feature and did not find that it gave me a lot of assistance since it only used "some" of the coding and made choices and inferences I did not agree with. I probably could have given it more of a chance but I found that just exporting and doing it myself was more reliable, and that way the AI wasn't interfering with my Delve data directly. Also, some optional way of visualizing codes while looking at transcripts would be great. I had to scroll through the entire list every time I coded a new sentence or paragraph, to see what codes I already had that might be applicable. I did not use the survey feature since I didn't do surveys, but this seems like it would be equally as helpful as the coding feature.

タイトル: A Great and User-Friendly Qualitative Analysis Tool for Beginners and Educators

タイトル: Don't keep searching, just Delve

Ideal for Master's level dissertations, research projects, and any other similar uses. I have experienced no security or ethical issues and received excellent 'real-time' customer service when I became 'stuck'. Without Delve, I worry that my final dissertation would not be submitted by its due date. Thank you to Kate in customer service. What an amazing value-for-money (almost priceless) product. Thank you.
改善点: Nothing to report. My experience of Delve to date leaves me lost for words, way short of the character count!

タイトル: Strong Mission and Responsive Staff, but Glitchy Product
投稿者: Kyler アメリカのSr Associate, Core Model Operations 教育管理, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Strong Mission and Responsive Staff, but Glitchy Product"
良い点: The core features are usually solid and intuitive to new users - adding team members, uploading and commenting on videos. As an education leadership coaching organization with over 50 coaches, we have used Sibme to help our coaches re-watch and improve upon their own practices by letting development conversations be grounded in real examples of their work. Plus, other non-coaching staff now have an easy window into coaching without pestering coaches! In our COVID virtual coaching environment, grounding org learning in video sharing was invaluable. It saves everyone time and the collaboration features to enhance this org learning (commenting, sharing, tagging pre-set categories) are easy to use.
改善点: Though the core service is solid, I encounter tech glitches and question marks at a frustratingly high rate. It's small things - user permission mismatch across pages, confusing naming conventions (the account wide "Admin-User-Viewer" and Huddle-level "Admin-Member-Viewer" have very similar names but different meanings, which is confusing), audio issues for uploads, and several areas of confusion or disconnect in the new Zoom-Sibme "Conference" integration. This latter piece would have been excellent to use in the COVID virtual coaching environment, but was troublesome enough that our team never meaningfully used the integration. More robust and coherent help guides on the Zoom-Sibme integration (with video!) would be a good start. Our customer service manager is very responsive and solutions-oriented and I'm grateful for her! But technical solutions seem slow and often incomplete.

タイトル: Cal U Review
投稿者: Rebecca アメリカのAssociate Professor 高等教育, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Cal U Review"
良い点: Sibme as alot of great features that are useful for my work with teachers candidates. It's particularly impactful in supporting teacher candidate growth through the video-recording and time-stamped feedback. It's also useful for the supervisor to document strengths and needs for the candidates. I particularly like that I can attached my feedback to our clinical practice tool that I entered into the platform. Also, I like the different options it provides for observations (live, scripted notes, video-recording). Moreover, Sibme is always coming out with features that are helpful to my work. For example, I'm excited to learn more about the Goals feature. We require our candidates to develop a professional growth plan based on goals that they have been working on, and the Goals feature is a tool that I believe could support that task.
改善点: I'd like to be able to obtain more data analytics on teacher candidate performance based on my inputs. For example, being able to look at the data for cohorts of teachers rather than just individuals. Overall, I feel like I'm still learning about the software, so I may not be using the data analytics to its full extent.

タイトル: PrinterLogic has been flawless for us and a great value!
投稿者: Chad アメリカのIT Systems Engineer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 建設, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "PrinterLogic has been flawless for us and a great value!"
良い点: We have deployed Printerlogic in our company for over the past 6 years. We were tired of the centralized Windows print server and issues that came along with it. We started with the on prem server and have since moved to the Cloud instance of Printerlogic. This has been such and easy way to manage our printers, printer rollouts and dynamic way of adding printers for when people travel to our other offices. The product has worked flawlessly for us and is really a set and forget service unless we are adding a new printer or updating drivers. When our employees log in for the first time all the printers are added automagically based on their group membership and region they are located. We have no plans to change service or even look for other services due to the great customer support and service. It is a valued product in our environment.
改善点: Honestly we don't have any cons for what we needed to use it for and how we use it.

タイトル: Easy for End-Users, CPA Compatibility with Kyocera Could be Better

No issues with our Konica Minolta copier though. Working with support was great initially, but eventually stalled out and after numerous prompts to continue troubleshooting, was told copiers were no longer supported by Vasion, even though they still appear on the supported list. Again, support was great initially, but over time, became less enthusiastic about helping and started to "ghost" us.

タイトル: Worse each year
投稿者: Dylan アメリカのFounder, Engineer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー インターネット, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Worse each year"

改善点: Cost is extremely high compared to the value of the service being provided. Many of the features can be found on other platforms for free or cheap. The designers and developers are clearly bad or mediocre. Entire platform is wrought with bugs and decisions about UI and configuration that make no sense and do not actually help the users of the product. They have done multiple revamps of the UI, which I am actually totally fine with in general because I am happy to learn new things, but they simply have not been improvements. Just a reshuffling, often with added work required from me for no benefit, plus features that no longer work. Even lowest tier email support apparently requires paying more than $2000 per year. I was legitimately astounded when I discovered this. I already pay through the nose for this software, and when I tried to file a support request they informed me I had to post in the community. Really??? $2000 per year isn't enough to respond to one measly email support request? I give email support for free for all of my customers, even ones who don't pay, because I legitimately want to make my products as good as possible.

タイトル: Small Business Owner's real prespective
投稿者: Tabitha アメリカのOwner-Founder 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 金融サービス, 自営業 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Small Business Owner's real prespective"
良い点: I really like this feature because part of my business focuses on helping clients create and understand budgets. Many small business owners and individuals need assistance seeing where their money is going, planning ahead, and making better financial decisions. As the founder of B & D Bookkeeping LLC and the Financial Literacy Foundation, I believe budgeting is one of the most important steps toward financial confidence. Tools like LivePlan can help entrepreneurs organize their numbers, think through their goals, and build a clearer plan for the future. This feature is valuable because it supports not only business planning, but also financial education, which is a major part of the work I do with clients and the community.
改善点: Cons would be the price for each entity. I have clients that could use this. However, as a bookkeeper it can be costly to add all my clients. I think this is something that as an accountant, annalist or bookkeeper should have one package subscription to include with the bookkeeping needs of all of our clients instead of the firm paying or passing on to the clients. The way it is now I can only pass this through to my clients that are larger in size. It is not feasible for the small service, trade, or small business owner just starting out.

タイトル: Terrible Cancelation system and customer service
投稿者: Majid カナダのCEO 情報技術、情報サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Terrible Cancelation system and customer service"
良い点: Part of the business model is making money from unauthorized transactions.
改善点: I canceled my account a month ago, but my credit card was charged again. I requested a refund, which was denied. Relying on unauthorized charges is a poor business practice. If you cannot handle cancellations online and promptly, then avoid issuing credit cards and stop auto-renewals. When you see there is tons of negative review here and there, you should fix your system. I expect a full refund, as my account shows that I haven’t accessed it in the past 30 days; I'm not using your service. I only tried it for a few days before canceling my account.

タイトル: What You Need Now & What You Will Need Tomorrow
投稿者: Robert アメリカのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー マーケティング、広告, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "What You Need Now & What You Will Need Tomorrow"
良い点: The software is one of the easiest to use in my opinion. It's very intuitive and I've already recommended it to some of our clients who have tried it and that's the same comment I get back..."It's so easy". When you're running a company and want to offer courses as one of your main goods, having to spend months creating content (especially if you do videos with editing) is already time consuming. Gurucan makes it easy to take all your pieces and make the final course you want to sell.
改善点: I wish there were more design aspects we could control and a more robust GUI. I'd love to see something similar to what GetResponse or Mailchimp offers. What would be the most amazing is to get a WordPress style editor like Elementor or Divi or anything similar so we could make amazing emails, completely customized landing pages and so much more.

タイトル: THE online platform for all of my courses and teaching resources
投稿者: Yann フィンランドのConsultant 認証済みLinkedInユーザー オンラインメディア, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "THE online platform for all of my courses and teaching resources"
良い点: There are a few things I really like about Gurucan. Firstly, the fact that it enables you to create and sell a wide variety of products, such as courses, challenges and membership sites, as well as host webinars. I had been using different platforms to offer each of them, so it was great to be able to gather everything "under the same roof". Another thing that, in my opinion, make Gurucan stand out is its smartphone app. How cool does it feel to be able to offer access to a course, membership site, etc. through an actual app?? And you don't need to be a coding wizard in order to be able to use the app – or the Gurucan platform overall, for that matter! Speaking of hosting everything on one platform, many learning management systems and platforms give you the option to send emails to students...but set up actual automation that are triggered once certain parameters are met? Very useful! And since most people, nowadays, have a smartphone, Gurucan's chat feature will make sure that each message we want to send to students is seen and open (since you can send push notifications too).
改善点: Gurucan is a growing platform so I'm sure that these two points will be addressed soon. First, the fact that you need to create various elements – for example a course, an offer, a chat for the specific course and a landing page – separately. It would be great if Gurucan would enable you to just create an element, let's say a course, and choose to automatically create everything else (offer, chat, etc.) for it. The second point that I'm sure will be worked on quite soon is the limited course and landing page builder. I think that certain features, like the ability to add columns to a section, should be included.

タイトル: Asthetic appeal and functionality missing especially when reviewing content.
投稿者: Joypreet Singh インドのPartner Eラーニング, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Asthetic appeal and functionality missing especially when reviewing content."
良い点: A good thought through design for an e-learning app/website. Things like payment, feedback, user database with customizable and user-action triggered emails have been incorporated.
改善点: 1. The content at times goes missing and with little support available, it's very disheartening to work on everything all over again - they seriously need to ask people to have a word back-up simultaneously. 2. The online school page is a great idea but there are very limited options to the look of that page. In the age where websites like wix.com give you fantastic options, we have font type, font size and variety limitations in rich text. 3. Even after providing the API keys for Open Bank which was the reason I got to know about Gurucan - nothing happens, it doesn't say "you're all set". So, a preview doesn't show you anything. again, very disappointing if you've gone the whole nine yards to link it to a payment gateway. 4. There is no provision for a timed and typed-out test. The 'workout' section gives you the functionality but wants you to upload a video. Do I seriously want to record a video of a single PPT slide with a question for 10 mins while the student attempts the test - this is what we call a 'jugaad' in India but it isn't very practical. 5. The course cover page and the transitioning between lessons isn't very smooth as compared to other video-hosting e-learning sites like futurelearn, canvas, etc. I mean the whole look and feel needs to be a lot better. 6. There's lack of a customizable user registration form - like a google form integration and many more things. There's no one on one customer interaction....and I'm not allowed to write any more....wow!!!

タイトル: One of the best softwares for mobile and desktop!
投稿者: Andres パナマのEntrepreneur 認証済みLinkedInユーザー Eラーニング, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "One of the best softwares for mobile and desktop!"

Also the integration with stripe needs work, it creates a payment every time people click the button, needs work. Also the "trial" for courses (when you offer them part of the course for free) should be improved, the purpose of the trial is for them to get to know the content, but they can't see what's not included in the "paid course" so they won't be motivated to buy. Needs marketing work.

It's got some great features that allow you flexibility in what you're displaying and how it is being displayed. Their Customer Support is awesome and they continue to roll out new features. While that app itself is already great, I'm very encouraged by the idea that they seem to continually be improving it. Some of the features they roll out are very useful but things I didn't even know I wanted.
改善点: I think anyone could find a few features that they would like to have but with the continual improvements, I'm sure they'll be coming. I'm not sure when they launched but it feels like the product is fairly new. However, they are very receptive to feedback so I have shared things with them on improvements I would want. The one minor issue I keep getting feedback on from my team is when viewing the Leaderboards directly from the tab in Salesforce, there is a date that indicates date of last update. It causes confusion because it's the date the criteria for the leaderboard was last updated, NOT the date that the leaderboard last updated with accurate data (it's real time). This can cause a bit of confusion when the users don't understand that.

タイトル: Smooth Editor with Great TM/MT Features
投稿者: Hirotaka 日本のVounteer Translator 翻訳、ローカライゼーション, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Smooth Editor with Great TM/MT Features"

改善点: The automated QA checks are sometimes relevant for English, but not for Japanese. Because standard rules flag false positives for Japanese syntax and punctuation, dismissing the warnings adds unnecessary noise to the proofreading process.

タイトル: Intuitive localization platform that truly supports open-source projects

良い点: One of the best things about Crowdin is their genuine support for the open-source community by offering free plans. The interface is clean and very easy to get used to. Features like translation suggestions (translation memory) and the ability to upload reference screenshots make a huge difference—seeing the actual context in an image prevents mistranslations and noticeably speeds up the work.
改善点: There is no simple option for standard users or contributors to upload translations in bulk. Also, while the free tier is definitely enough to get started with small projects, once you scale up, you inevitably have to upgrade. That jump to paid plans can feel a bit pricey for early-stage or bootstrapped startups.

タイトル: A thousand words in one place
投稿者: Tomasz ポーランドのProgrammer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ゲーム, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A thousand words in one place"
良い点: Workflow, Features. Convenient and seamless translation capabilities + community interactivity. From the very beginning, I have valued the quick preview of translations in other languages, as it provides insight into the semantic direction to choose. Auto-translation—the intelligent translation of similar phrases—effectively speeds up the translation process. It often saves money.
改善点: Security. Sometimes it's too much of a hassle. I understand that it's protection against bots. For some time now, the system has been overly aggressive in flagging words as not matching the dictionary. In this regard, the system lacks intelligence; it is too Anglocentric (English-centric).

タイトル: Solid crowd-translation site
投稿者: Toni ドイツのHead of Customer Experience 電気・電子機器製造, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Solid crowd-translation site"
良い点: I like the most the automatic mail notifications when new translations are available. This way I never miss any new translations.

You can configure it to let people override this or not, as an extra bonus. The management tools are sufficient for our needs, and it comes with various forms of machine translations. importantly along with a global translation memory out of the box, which we find to be especially high-value for our use case (translating software user interface). There are also good tools for removing people's contributions if necessary (to address errors or malice). Since we started using it, Crowdin has also introduced the "Developer" permission which now completes the lot for us. We don't need anything beyond these defaults. I can say that despite our free-for-all contribution model, we have never had a single instance of spam after 9 years and 3000+ members. Crowdin supports many formats and while there is a plethora of these in software, there is enough support that software developers can easily align a translation format to something Crowdin will accept. Or just standard reminders "Don't forget your course expires in X months." We could also use a better view of course learner progress in a course, in % completion. For now we use the course activity matrix, but need to check row by row. Ideal with a % along the right, for instance. 検討した類似製品： Teachable TalentLMS Thinkific LearnWorldsに決めた理由： It was too expensive, and exclusively served to host online courses. タイトル: Powerful platform, but unresolved audio reliability issues
投稿者: Rafael チリのCEO 公共施設, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Powerful platform, but unresolved audio reliability issues"
良い点: Telnyx offers competitive pricing, flexible APIs, detailed configuration options, and support for WebRTC, SIP trunking, call control, recordings, and diagnostics in one platform. The portal provides substantial control over call routing and media settings.
改善点: Audio reliability was the main problem. I experienced one-way audio, calls that remained stuck before dialing, and robotic or severely degraded outbound audio. The same problem appeared with two independent sources—Chrome WebRTC and an ElevenLabs SIP trunk—when calls reached the mobile network. Troubleshooting required significant time and many configuration changes. Some support responses did not match the actual integration; for example, I received advice about bidirectional WebSocket media streaming even though my setup used a direct SIP trunk. I needed a clear analysis of the negotiated codecs, transcoding, packet loss, jitter, and PSTN termination route, but did not receive a timely root-cause resolution.

良い点: The basic product is excellent. Automations work well, campaigns are easy to create, schedule and send. We had some initial problems with deliverability (often an issue with providers using shared ip pools) but they had a helpful contact who helped us warm up the list and move IPs which seemed to resolve the issue.Baseline support was usually fairly quick (although see one of the caveats below).
改善点: We extensively pre-tested Moosend including booking a call with their sales team where we shared very detailed technical requirements, and then watched what seemed like them able to implement those requirements. We also reviewed their tech documentation to confirm that specific functionality existed (which existed with specific code examples on how to implement).We invested significantly, and then spend over $1000 on developers to try and implement that functionality, which proved impossible. We contacted front-line support who assured us that the functionality existed, and pointed us to the same documentation on their website which we had reviewed. We continued to persist with implementation. After eventually finding ourselves at a stand-still, we kept escalating until we eventually reached a level where we were told:1) The functionality did not exist2) That the documentation on their website was "out of date" (despite support pointing it to us)3) That their sales team "didn't know what they were talking about."We went back and forth and eventually got a refund (to their credit). However, we obviously weren't able to get compensation for our time, or expenditure on developers. It left a bad taste in our mouth as we had done all the right due diligence.

タイトル: Reliable multi-hypervisor backup that punches above its price tag
投稿者: Kawan Henrique ブラジルのBackup and Infrastructure Engineer 情報技術、情報サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Reliable multi-hypervisor backup that punches above its price tag"
良い点: What sold us was the hypervisor coverage. We're a service provider with a mixed estate (VMware vSphere, Hyper-V, XCP-ng and Sangfor HCI) and Vinchin backs all of them up agentlessly from one console. Very few products do that without a second license or agents inside every guest. Value for money is excellent: per-socket licensing is transparent and costs a fraction of Veeam or Commvault for the same host count. The learning curve is short — clean web console, self-explanatory job wizards, first jobs running the same day. Instant VM recovery has genuinely saved us, bringing a failed VM back online straight from the backup repository in minutes. Support is responsive and technically competent.
改善点: Logging is the weak point. When a job fails the log rarely tells you why, so you open a ticket for something you should be able to diagnose yourself. Documentation for advanced scenarios is thin. The dashboard and reporting are functional but basic, limited alert customization and no polished reports to hand a client, so we still build our own. For an MSP, multi-tenancy could go further: separating clients and delegating access is more manual than it should be. Cloud/object storage is noticeably slower than local repositories, and Microsoft 365 coverage is incomplete. The backup server is also resource-hungry, give it real CPU and RAM.

タイトル: The best and weak of Vichin

良い点: Vinchin Backup & Recovery provides a reliable and cost-effective data protection solution for virtualized and cloud environments. The platform offers a user-friendly dashboard, flexible licensing options, and comprehensive backup and recovery capabilities. The learning curve is relatively low, and the product delivers strong value for money compared to competing enterprise backup solutions. Customer support is responsive and knowledgeable, while cloud storage integration helps organizations meet disaster recovery and business continuity requirements. Although occasional performance issues and some interface limitations exist, the overall experience has been positive and dependable.
改善点: While the product is generally stable, certain advanced configuration options can be complex for new users and may require additional documentation. The reporting and monitoring features could be more detailed, and the user interface could benefit from modernization and improved navigation in some sections. During large backup operations, occasional performance slowdowns may occur, and some advanced integrations available in larger competitors' solutions are still limited. However, these issues do not significantly impact the overall effectiveness of the platform.

タイトル: Great Project Software for Teams

良い点: OpenProject is a pleasure to use for projects from proposal/concept to closing. Creating a WBS and timeline with generic resources is a great way to generate documentation needed for proposals. Copying that proposal project to an active project is then a great way to jumpstart project planning with team awareness of timelines and requirements. Teams can interact with the project plan, adding their own features and tasks to complete deliverables. Creating custom WBS queries assists in focusing team members on items they are required to complete. And creating custom queries to the master Work Package list provides a way for executive members to view the active phases and status of milestones. Meetings can be logged in their own section, and wiki notes can be captured for reference. Very pleased with the community version of OpenProject.
改善点: Scheduling and resource management is a bit burdensome with OpenProject. There is so much value in scheduling with blocked-out weekends, holidays, and resource calendars. Resource loading reports have to be manually created in other tools (spreadsheets) to show whether resources are available or overbooked. The planned project overview page and executive/portfolio views can't come soon enough. Value is often communicated upwards, and there isn't much for executive management to view; these views and reports are still custom creations in other tools. Printing wiki pages, meetings, etc. are awkward. Budgeting is OK, but again awkward as the plugin appears to apply to all projects when within a single project. There is no baseline feature and no way to compare performance verses the baseline. For these reasons, users are still required to use more advanced resource management, project management and budgeting, and scheduling tools alongside OpenProject. It is great software, just not a complete replacement for other project management toolsets. At times, it would be good to have more condensed views, but reducing the screen rendering/size to less than 100% suffices for now.

タイトル: One of the Best in the Business
投稿者: Patrick アメリカのGeneral Manager 人材派遣、人材紹介, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 ソース：SoftwareAdvice 共有 "One of the Best in the Business"
良い点: When we started our search for a new ATS/CRM system, we developed a 120 point checklist to find a product that met our needs as a recruiting agency. Overall, I had reviewed over 70+ products and had done 35+ demos of various ATS/CRM systems. Tracker came out on top and met every point we needed. Where Tracker excels is its customization features, ease of use, and fantastic customer service. We had an extremely smooth transition from our previous system, thanks to the support of Tracker.After reviewing so many systems, we found a few things that made them the differentiator. First, they are a US/UK based company who have been established for years. Their support services are robust, and their product is very intuitive to pick up and use. This has allowed for easy ramp up time for new employees. They have developed a fantastic customizable organization system on both their ATS and CRM platforms. All aspects of the system work harmoniously together. In the past few years, it is easy to see a huge change in their development, and they have provided a steady streams of updates to differentiate itself as one of the top software programs for recruiting. They provide fantastic automations and sequencing, as well as full mass-email campaign support. Additional perks include video interview integration, detailed reporting, and capability to support all types of recruiting (exec, direct, staffing, etc.). I highly recommend this product to any recruiting firm!
改善点: The problems associated with Tracker are mainly due to growth. They are growing quickly, and sometimes their servers slow down slightly, as they grow and continue to invest in their servers, the better this will become. The one major request would be autosaving! Tracker provides alerts when needed to save, but it would be incredibly beneficial to allow autosaving both on record pages, as well as email drafts. Overall, the product is fantastic.

タイトル: First-time ATS admin, Experienced CRM User
投稿者: Kristin アメリカのExecutive Administrator, Sales and Marketing 人材派遣、人材紹介, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 ソース：SoftwareAdvice 共有 "First-time ATS admin, Experienced CRM User"
良い点: I appreciate how TrackerRMS offers many ways to accomplish the same result. It doesn't force me to do any activity using a singular approach. I have experience with CRMs; however, this is my first encounter with an Applicant Tracking System, so coming into this organization, I reset my expectations. What worked on other platforms wasn't going to apply to this one and, more often than not, not being realistic with ANY software can create negative experiences. The FAQs, orientation videos, and support via the account management and success teams make learning the functionality easier than most systems. The trick is actually to focus on the material, though. If you do, you'll be interacting with everything the platform has to offer and more in no time. If you don't, I guarantee it'll be a source of frustration because it is the same with learning anything new or unfamiliar. Having the ability to store communications, documentation, comments, company, and candidate details all in one place is more of a strength than most realize. It reduces the time you have to search for things in your e-mail, cloud storage, desktop, etc. The workflow is logical, and the customizations allow for a company or department to generate specific reporting applicable to their team. The LinkedIn integration, ability to forward e-mails to a record, change dashboards, and streamline processes as you see fit is a tremendous asset.
改善点: The "con" section of any review never seems fair to the company, from my perspective. What I see as unfavorable from my view may be a positive for someone else. The platform does what it promises. It allows you to track leads, add details to records, manage candidates, automate marketing campaigns, integrate with applicable apps such as LinkedIn, track time, manage payroll, store documents, and produce detailed reports. The only con I have with the system is the information being put into it by the other fallible human beings (nothing and no one is perfect). What goes in is what comes out. Not having everyone be as conscientious of their data entry is the source of my frustration as an admin. Some may say "inflexibility" and a lack of customization are cons. However, from a development standpoint, the more flexibility and custom options you build for clients, the higher the risk for issues. So even if some of my ideas are great ones, that doesn't mean they belong in a system with thousands of others that it'd negatively impact in the end.

タイトル: If You Intend to Run Viral Contests, InviteReferrals Will Deliver.

良い点: About usability, the interface is neatly designed and quite convenient to use. About functionality, you have the basic features that you would expect in such a software package. You have enough options to customize how you want your campaigns to appear. You can choose the tasks you want your referrers to take to perform, set the type of rewards for each task they perform, add custom tasks, set notifications up, set integrations up. etc. Using tools like this is a good way to get the benefits of expanding your reach and building your list at the same time. You can always access the leads you've acquired and even export the lists or automatically feed them into your email marketing software of choice. There are tools for fraud prevention, referral testing, blocking participants, adding your team members, setting up a custom domain, etc. For integration, InviteReferrals supports some of the most popular email marketing systems and CRMs out there, and it also integrates with Zapier, so you're in luck if that is important to you. InviteReferrals is quite robust and I only pointed out a few of the things you can do with it. Although InviteReferrals has all these numerous features, it is still relatively easy to use. You don't have to spend minutes just to get one thing set up, although how easy you find it also depends on how tech-savvy you are as a person. With that being said, I hope this helps someone.
改善点: The only issue I experienced is when I signed up as a referrer myself and clicked on my direct referral link and I was stuck in a loop in which the link didn't redirect to the landing page. The tab just kept refreshing itself; otherwise, no other problem that I noticed.

タイトル: VideoPad Breakdown

There are tools to export the files into different platforms as well. The interface is really clean and intuitive.
改善点: Not the easiest software out there. The learning curve might be a little hard. Effects like chroma key (green screen) looks kind of amateurish. It's overpriced.

タイトル: Endless possibilities in a simple tool
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 非営利団体運営, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Endless possibilities in a simple tool"
良い点: There is a lot good to say about VideoPad. I cannot count how many times I have recommended it for various reasons. It is simple, intuitive, easy to instal and not PC resource hungry. I could write endlessly about its UI, Effects, integration with NCH suite softwares such as WavePad, MixPad and so on. However, my most used feature has been SUBTITLES. VideoPad makes importing, editing and exporting subtitles very easy. It supports the SSA, SRT and VVT files. I have always been able to create new subtitles for translation purposes very easily. The subtitles can be adjusted for specific durations, background and text fonts. Each subtitle can be edited and one can playback and check how they appear till happy with the result.
改善点: The subtitles auto generate is wanting. It often generates a lot of errors which are not worth spending time to correct and it is better to just create a new file from scratch. I think the problem is the Microsoft speech recognizer. May be if VideoPad would allow another speech engine like google things would be better.

タイトル: Clarizen a great Project Management Tool
投稿者: Brian Web Time Implementation Team Lead 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 人材, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 ソース：GetApp 共有 "Clarizen a great Project Management Tool"
良い点: Customization. I cannot say enough on how exceptional the Clarizen technical team is with taking our needs and making them happen in the system. One specific example is I formulated a scoring system for incoming clients that based upon how they were going to use our system would be given a "complexity" score so that I could assign higher level clients to my best employees and lower level clients to my lesser experienced employees. Clarizen took my request that I submitted and within a month had the entire scoring system automated and up and running giving me a fantastic tool to use daily.
改善点: Pricing. Clarizen needs to be able to add options on as fixed costs instead of raising the overall monthly rate. My team doesn't use every aspect of the program so when I need more of just one option in the system I shouldn't have to pay for a higher level across the board with more of all their options when I need just one. I am hoping that can change in the future to meet individual client needs.

タイトル: 13 Days Down. $100K+ Gone. 6,500 Customers Lost. Freshchat's Answer? $1,000
投稿者: Mohd アラブ首長国連邦のFounder 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 小売, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "13 Days Down. $100K+ Gone. 6,500 Customers Lost. Freshchat's Answer? $1,000"
良い点: Before the incident, the multi-channel dashboard was practical. Managing WhatsApp, website chat, and social media from one place saved our team time. The interface was straightforward and onboarding agents was quick. Setup was relatively painless. Credit where it's due, when it worked, it worked fine.
改善点: In March 2026, Freshchat went completely dead for our account. Not slow, not buggy. Completely gone. 13 consecutive days with zero access to any channel. No WhatsApp, no live chat, no social messaging. Nothing. During those 13 days Freshworks gave us no recovery timeline, no backup plan, no interim solution. Near total silence for two weeks. We lost approximately 6,500 customer conversations permanently. Customers publicly called us scammers because we went silent on them for almost two weeks. Negative reviews flooded every platform we operate on across 6 GCC countries. After restoration, we spent two months asking for compensation. Their response was always "under internal discussion" and "awaiting management approval." The final offer after two months? $1,000. One thousand dollars for $100K+ in documented damages. A formal legal compensation demand has been sent to their headquarters.

タイトル: Just simple SMTP2GO
投稿者: Troy アメリカのFounder and Lead Technologist コンピュータ、ネットワーク・セキュリティ, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Just simple SMTP2GO"
良い点: I have been using SMTP2GO for over 7 years now and it is the top tier vendor in the industry. Their system just works — no weird quirks, no random delays, no headaches. The network is solid and consistent, which is the biggest thing I look for with any outbound email provider, and they nail it. Their dashboard/portal is probably one of the cleanest and easiest I’ve used. You don’t have to dig through ten layers of menus just to find what you need. Everything is laid out in a way that makes sense, and you can tell they actually thought about the user experience instead of just throwing features at you. Support is top-notch. Every time I’ve reached out, they’ve responded fast and with actual helpful info — not canned replies or copy/paste answers. You can tell their team knows what they’re doing and takes pride in it. As for security, they have that locked down. It is well worth the money. Overall, SMTP2GO has been a rock-solid addition to my stack. Reliable delivery, great tools, and a support team that actually cares. Hard to beat that mix.
改善点: I really do not have any issues with SMTP2go. They have a simple thing to do and they do it well. No down sides.

タイトル: Outstanding Email Delivery and Reliability
投稿者: Sean アメリカのOwner 小売, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Outstanding Email Delivery and Reliability"
良い点: Email deliverability is excellent, and emails arrive in inboxes in seconds. SMTP2Go is much more affordable than many of their competitors, and the price per thousand emails gets better as you go, no "success tax" here. Integrating with WordPress / WooCommerce is extremely easy, both through their official plugin, or through third party email plugins. Easy to setup your account, manage your emails, and check delivery status statistics.
改善点: Be aware that SMTP2Go focuses on sending emails. Although a few (expensive) services offer both sending and receiving/inboxes, usually they focus on sending only. I recommend using SMTP2Go and then pairing with a dedicated inbox service, or you can even run Thunderbird or other open source programs for your inboxes.

タイトル: Just try it, you will love it!

You can use the intuitive GUI to quickly build out your pipelines and then bring it under source control with a couple of clicks. The GUI still works for read only making it easily accessible to less pipeline technical folks while also giving those maintaining the pipeline all the benefits of "as code".

タイトル: Streamlined CI/CD with powerful workflow automation

Being able to visually build and adjust workflows saves a lot of time and makes it easy to automate even more complex deployments. This lets us release faster and with more confidence, without the team having to manually perform each step.
改善点: So far, I haven't explored the security features within Buddy itself, so I don't have a strong opinion on that aspect yet. This isn't necessarily a downside of the product — more a reflection of where our usage has focused so far. Once we start using those features, I'll have a better sense of how well they work.

タイトル: Kayako Classic (On-Premise) is a solution that covers all areas of support and more.
投稿者: Christian ドイツのDirector Technical Support 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Kayako Classic (On-Premise) is a solution that covers all areas of support and more."
良い点: It covers many areas of daily conversation handling activities: Ticket, Incident, Problem, and Complaint handling situations. If the basics do not suffice, custom fields and tracking options help iron out missing pieces. It contains a Knowledgebase that allows you to record Articles and information. Survey system (very handy for Event-Driven Surveys); Reporting options and quick access to tickets. One of the KEY FEATURES is that the tool is FAST and keeps a focus on the work area for staff, rather cluttering everything with detail fields. Finally, the web-interface is fully customizable and very useful in granting options to access the conversation handling tool. Did I mention Kayako Services being great in helping to resolve questions and issues when contacted? They do this very well!
改善点: It lacks a few items that I wish would be included (software is always under constant development, and Kayako customer service is very responsive and friendly): proper comprehensive auditing when tickets are handled (like automatically submitted communications recorded with date and time); Complaint Handling structures based on tickets; improved linkages between tickets (though possible it is not done in a single click); KBA link to tickets; Reporting is nice though it lacks options to customize charts, colors and the way detail can be presented (formatting through configuration rather customization). Another drawback in a recent release is that a lot of browser cell padding has been introduced causing the display of elements unnecessarily spread out across a regular HD monitor. Luckily this can be customized using CSS injection or system-wide CSS manipulation.

タイトル: A KB that is actually helpful
投稿者: David イスラエルのAdmin 通信, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "A KB that is actually helpful"
良い点: The piece I didn't expect to love is the knowledge base that Kay (the AI agent built into Kayako) generates on its own. Any time a ticket gets kicked over to a human because Kay couldn't resolve it, Kay watches how the human handled it and drafts a KB article from that interaction. You approve or tweak the draft, publish it, and Kay handles that ticket type unassisted from then on. Nobody on my team sat down to write articles. Six weeks in we had around 30 new ones in our help centre that the system had effectively written for us, and our resolution rate kept inching up because every gap in Kay's knowledge was getting patched automatically.
改善点: Analytics is the weak spot. Two of my agents hit a wall trying to pull a fairly standard report and I ended up opening a support ticket just to get the steps. The data is all there, it's just buried under menus that aren't laid out intuitively. The reporting side of the product needs the same thoughtful UX work that the rest of it has had.

改善点: The complexities of building usable reports made the reporting part of the system unusable. Although the system was overall a decent system, we found that the costs and lack of support from the company were the biggest reasons we stopped working with Kayako.

タイトル: Kayako AI agent was a game-changer. Better than our human agents
投稿者: Uba アメリカのVP of Growth マーケティング、広告, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Kayako AI agent was a game-changer. Better than our human agents"
良い点: What made Kayako click for our team was the way the AI agent Kay gets introduced. Kay doesn't get switched on as an autonomous agent on day one. It drafts replies and puts them in front of your agents first. They read, adjust if needed, send. For about two weeks that's all it is, a drafting assistant. Then you start noticing the drafts need less and less adjustment. At some point your agents are just clicking send. That's when we started turning on autonomous handling, category by category. Billing questions first, account management second, the standard FAQ questions last. Three weeks or so before the team stopped hovering.
改善点: They don't really have any great options for voice. It wasn't a deal breaker, but it would have been nice. I had to use a workaround.

タイトル: It's a good start, but there are a lot of opportunities for improvement.
投稿者: Ewen アメリカのProduct Development Engineer 自動車, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "It's a good start, but there are a lot of opportunities for improvement."
良い点: With the proper and appropriate hardware, you can obtain a solution significantly faster than conventional solution methods by leveraging the power of GPUs, even older ones. For simple problems (i.e. single parts and/or basic external vehicle aerodynamics), it is very easy to set up.
改善点: I'll give what I think are opportunities for improvements based on domain. Static structural - does not handle multiple parts/complex assemblies very well. Does not/cannot model non-linear contacts. Does not/cannot simulate non-linear materials. Defining and applying custom materials is sometimes quite cumbersome. Fluids - Cannot extract important engineering values from the fluid simulation, e.g. coefficient of drag/coefficient of lift from the external aerodynamics example. Cannot select other turbulence models. (Last I inquired, you can ONLY use the LES turbulence model, which is invalid for certain types/classes of analyses.) Cannot model air as an ideal gas (compressible flow solver). Cannot define point heat sources. Direct modelling/manipulation - if you have a part with defined dimensions (part from print), it is quite cumbersome to reproduce the part using the direct manipulation method. Direct manipulation method is great when you are trying to experiment with new designs and you are trying to figure out which design will work best, but if you are trying to test/verify an existing design and you don't have the original/source CAD part, which requires you to re-model it in Ansys Discovery Live/SpaceClaim, it's ridiculously complicated to create, for example, a dimension that is symmetrical/mirrored. Topology optimisation - Sometimes the result from the topology optimisation does not pass the FEA analysis.

タイトル: Simplicity is key
投稿者: Brett アメリカのRegional Operations Educator 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 不動産, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Simplicity is key"

改善点: Custom reporting and additional competitors that match our industry. However, they are constantly rolling out new reporting and engaging the customer on what WE want to increase company-specific benchmarks. Also, they haven't yet overpromised and underdelivered.

タイトル: A good simple & basic product for people looking for easy reputation management
投稿者: Maria アメリカのDirector, Marketing 病院、ヘルスケア, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "A good simple & basic product for people looking for easy reputation management"
良い点: This product is very user friendly. It was everything that you need for tracking your brands reputation online, but presents it in a simple and user friendly way. You are able to select the different sites that you want to monitor reviews, set up alerts based on certain specifications and respond to all reviews in a log format. For someone that owns multiple different brands/businesses, this is a quality & scalable solution to monitoring reviews.
改善点: The customer service could be better and the analytics platform could be a bit more sophisticated. But overall, I think the bag for your buck is good with this product.

タイトル: Basic review management
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 病院、ヘルスケア, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Basic review management"
良い点: ReviewTrackers did what the name implies: tracked and reported on review volume, so that we could see what our customers were saying about us. The out-of-the-box product was very easy to implement, simple to learn, and easy to use.
改善点: Unfortunately, the reporting and monitoring interfaces were somewhat bleak at the time, and were not as visual or supportive as we would have expected. In addition the product was not as dynamic as we'd hoped. It simply curated and shared reviews as we received them, with little opportunity for customized or segmented reporting. Also, there was a very low level of customer service intervention. Our hospitals want to be able to respond to reviews with a local voice, with local perspectives. We were basically told this wasn't supported.

タイトル: Super Helpful!
投稿者: Cameron アメリカのMarketing Manager ホスピタリティ, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Super Helpful!"
良い点: Makes it easy for all of our managers across all of our properties to access and respond to reviews. The dashboard is also great for monitoring all the reviews we get across all platforms. The alert system is super helpful when wanted to respond immediately to those negative reviews! Finally exporting reviews for weekly reports has never been easier
改善点: Not being able to directly respond to some sources without leaving ReviewTrackers (TripAdvisor) Not all review status change automatically when responded outside of ReviewTrackers.

タイトル: Keeping current with Google Reviews
投稿者: Doug アメリカのMarketing Manager 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Keeping current with Google Reviews"
良い点: It gives us fairly quick updates on Google reviews. This is needed in our industry to fix issues with our customers immediately.
改善点: I wish there was an easier way to create a campaign to entice our customers to post positive reviews when they've had a great experience.

タイトル: Met our needs at beginning, as needs grew Katana team listened and added features
投稿者: Lisa アメリカのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 小売, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Met our needs at beginning, as needs grew Katana team listened and added features"
良い点: The ability to use Resources as a way to assign a specific person to each task so I can see who is working on what step of the manufacturing process and the allotted time they are provided for the task. This year we went from contract labor/paid-per-piece to employees/hourly-wage and Katana has made this a much smoother transition then it could have been. Having both "cost-per-piece" for assembly of items as well as "cost-per-minute" has given us the ability to compare former payment procedures with what to expect per hour from employees.
改善点: There are a variety of tasks that were unable to be done when we began using Katana in January 2019 but I am thrilled to say that most of them have been developed. The developers listen and are very attentive to requests, bug reports, and ideas and so despite the fact that some of the features were not available (exporting reports, importing recipes, bulk print MOs/pick lists, etc.) they have added these and the software continues to grow. The next feature I'd love to see is the ability to have a product photo attached to each product that prints out an image with the MO. Also, we have some items "on hold" (not sent to distribution center yet) and we use Resources to specify ONHOLD-BIN221 etc. to know the status of any particular SKU completed. We'd prefer not to use different locations, but rather have the ability to add a couple more "status" options. Either a misc or a custom. For now, everything on hold gets marked BLOCKED status and then the Resource is used to say it's on hold in whatever bin.

タイトル: First Impression KATANA - perfect fit for smaller companies which do not need a complex ERP-system
投稿者: Klaus ドイツのManagement 機械工業, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "First Impression KATANA - perfect fit for smaller companies which do not need a complex ERP-system"
良い点: Handling of inventory, items, products, ingredients, sales orders - all this is handled in a very efficient, clear and easy to use way. Makes the difference compared to many alternative MRP-/ERP-systems. Connector to QuickBooks with automatic trigger for invoices in QB once the products are marked as shipped in KATANA. Connector to Shopify for on-line sale of spare parts. 100% helpful and open minded customer service - very helpful in helping to understand all features and finding the best workflow for specific situations.
改善点: There are some functions/features which need improvement, e.g. the customization of documents such as Quotations so every company can generate a set of individual template to serve different areas (machines, spare parts, service,..). 3-5 custom fields for Quotes/Sales Orders/Products would be helpful. Althoug KATANA is intended to be a MRP-system it would be helpful to integrate SERVICE-articles (not only MAKE or BUY articles). This would allow to add a possible service portion to a spare parts quote. Dedicated Delivery Notes (with partial shipments) would be a great feature.

タイトル: Scrappy startup quality at enterprise rates
投稿者: Chris 英国のCEO 電気・電子機器製造, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Scrappy startup quality at enterprise rates"
良い点: The user interface is pretty and nice to use, mostly The concepts of scheduling and general "idea" behind the katana system are good
改善点: The endless bugs and now pricing issues. No backup, no undo, and again, lots of bugs. We regularly have to contact support with issues in their system. Most of the time the response is "oh we'll put it on our voting system, if it gets votes we'll fix it", which really is not what I expect from a system that costs several hundred dollars a month, before addons and users. To be perfectly honest, we were making do - the pros of not having to build this kind of system ourselves outweighed the cons. That has now changed. What triggered this review is that they doubled the price of our plan, turned off a number of features we were using to run our business operations, and charged us for "add-ons" all without warning. We did get sent an email, warning us of an upcoming change in billing (note this email was sent 28 days before the change...). That email said someone would reach out to us to discuss transitioning. That did not happen, and instead they just turned things off and billed our card for add-ons we never agreed to. Forced onboarding (billable of course) with an "expert" is a bit of a joke

タイトル: Most affordable MRP system for small manufacturers
投稿者: Chris アメリカのManufacturing Manager 再生可能エネルギー、環境, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Most affordable MRP system for small manufacturers"

One example is not being able to shift/ctrl click multiple items and drag them around as a group when reorganizing priority rank of manufacturing orders. Since we have multilevel subassemblies I spend more time dragging around manufacturing orders to organize the order I want them completed in and I could save some time if I could drag items around as a group.

タイトル: It's a hidden gem - stumbled upon Lodgix + learned how awesome it is
投稿者: Andy Director of Operations and Sales, Managing Partner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 不動産, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 ソース：GetApp 共有 "It's a hidden gem - stumbled upon Lodgix + learned how awesome it is"

I became acquainted with (and set up) this software just by using their online guide/manuals and some googling + some late nights when customers weren't calling.

タイトル: Ticks ALL the boxes!
投稿者: Helen オーストラリアのBusiness Owner レジャー、旅行、観光, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Ticks ALL the boxes!"
良い点: Ease of use. We very quickly could load up our multiple properties and get the business up and running and fully operational very quickly, when we changed over from our last PMS. The software works equally well for Australian businesses, even though the company is US based My staff find it easy to navigate and training has been no problem with the Tutorial Manual that is provided. I love that the guys are constantly improving things, and nothing is static. There is always great changes that are taking place. We opened up second business and automatically went to Lodgix for our PMS. There was no need to shop around, I couldnt be happier with the product we have. Totally love that the guys always respond to any questions we have. Even though we have a time delay of 12 hours difference, I have often had replies out of business hours from them. I sincerely thank them for their customer support. It is always clear, concise and helpful.
改善点: I would dearly love it if a guest could do a property search, enter date parameters, and all available holiday homes with a total price could be visible. I do believe however that is something that the guys are working on. So that is fantastic. Not having this function has in no way impeded our bookings, with almost 70% of our bookings coming directly through Lodgix!!

タイトル: Choose another property management software

タイトル: So glad we found Lodgix

タイトル: Great product for doing website updates - reporting is limited resulting in a lot of manual efforts
投稿者: Alexandra アメリカのOwner ホスピタリティ, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Great product for doing website updates - reporting is limited resulting in a lot of manual efforts"

改善点: The reporting basically sucks for my needs. I tried using the reports with some edits but editing also is a limitation. I have two business models in place: For example. The model that was in place when I signed up involves sharing a 60/30 or 70/30 split on the lodging figure and corresponding tax is also split accordingly. Lodgix can't deal with that so I have to track sales, by client, in separate worksheets. The reporting is not useful for my needs because I am not able to tell the system to use my business model elements.

タイトル: Skepal, a great tool!
投稿者: Félix カナダのCoordonnateur aux projets d'investissement 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 政府機関, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Skepal, a great tool!"
良い点: I appreciate Skedpal because it offers automatic scheduling for my tasks and events. Its AI considers deadlines, task duration, context, and more. This tool is adaptable for different types of workers and highly configurable. Even without utilizing all its features, it boosts my productivity. I no longer need to manually plan my days; Skedpal takes care of it for me.
改善点: I find Skedpal's mobile app less intuitive than the desktop version. Furthermore, there are opportunities for user interface enhancements to improve the overall experience.

タイトル: Superb tool
投稿者: Andre ブラジルのNo Title 情報サービス, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Superb tool"
良い点: Skedpal is a tool like no other. I have used several to-do apps over the years and most of them lacked features that would allow me to organize my personal and working life as I wished. Skedpal is a game changer. You can organize your projects/tasks/subtasks hierarchically (outline layout), add as many child tasks as you want to your tree, define time maps and preferred times to execute tasks, define budgets so as to not over-concentrate on a single subject, and much more. The main feature is the ability to click an "Update Schedule" button and let Skedpal do all the math behind the scenes to deliver a plan to your day. No more giving poor estimates to upcoming projects! With Skedpal you can see how busy you are and how feasible your deadlines are.
改善点: Skedpal has many features, so the most common con is its learning curve. I love learning about new tools that can boost my performance, so it doesn't bother me much.

タイトル: Poor customer service. Not recommended.
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 経理, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Poor customer service. Not recommended."
良い点: The application Helps organizing tasks and has a refresh feature, which is a cool thing to use daily
改善点: Very poor customer service. They are trying to blame their suppliers whenever they don’t want to help you.

タイトル: Skedpal is an effective solution to the chaos of modern work-life
投稿者: Nick アメリカのDirector 小売, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Skedpal is an effective solution to the chaos of modern work-life"
良い点: Skedpal is a really, really helpful app for organizing your to-do list in a realistic way to actually get things done. Most of the time we don't have a sense of if we actually have the time to complete all the things we would like to. Skedpal fixes this by plotting out your tasks onto a calendar according to the criteria you provide (time needed to complete, priority, what time of day it can be done, etc.). What doesn't fit gets put on a separate list called "suggestions" where you have the opportunity to reschedule things. It honestly relieves a lot of stress for me knowing how my to-do's fit or don't fit into my schedule and makes it easier to focus on what's most important in the moment.
改善点: It has a learning curve and takes a fair amount of time to set up all your tasks in a way that is really useful. The time is well worth the effort and it saves a lot of time in the long run, but for those who are looking for a quick-fix sort of tool this isn't it.

タイトル: Amazing product and concept but still has to work out some kinks

It's also not great at handling tasks that repeat at an exact time, rather than being flexible. I also don't like that you have to sync your tasks to a calendar to get notifications. I would rather get them directly from the app. I would also like a way to have custom colours for my different categories of tasks. I have my own palette that I always use.

タイトル: CardBoard

What I wanted was a way to capture the full board visually to put into a document or communication, to show the overall Story Map (which I could not get in screen shots) I realize I could provide a link to the board for people to access and see the actual Map, but sometimes you just want a picture of it to support a communication.

タイトル: Cardboardit for developing roadmaps and communicating with stakeholders
投稿者: Sean アメリカのProduct Owner / Business Analyst 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 小売, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Cardboardit for developing roadmaps and communicating with stakeholders"

タイトル: A great product if it's the only thing you were using.
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "A great product if it's the only thing you were using."
良い点: I liked that it was very easy to use. Almost everything was very click and drag, which made it really easy to onboard new users who were new to story mapping. I also really appreciated that it let me share a story map across multiple locations. I work with teams in SF and Seattle. A physical board is a nice idea but just not possible with the way that we are distributed.
改善点: I had some challenges with user management. I work in a large enterprise so adding users individually was a bit of a pain and it was challenge to move users from regular viewer to user or admin roles on multiple boards. I also found that bulk moves of cards was difficult. If I wanted to pick up several cards and put them between two existing rows that wasn't really possible without spending 8 or 10 minutes rearranging the other cards around it to keep the map coherent. Also our org runs on-prem JIRA and I had no way to connect JIRA and confluence together, which made it nearly impossible to keep the two in sync. This is ultimately why I stopped using the product.

タイトル: Good but with some hiccups
投稿者: Mark アメリカのProduct Owner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Good but with some hiccups"
良い点: I quite liked the intuitive interface and ease of storyboarding things.
改善点: The JIRA integration left something to be desired. The software did not do a good job of informing me of what it would do when I synced the two. It was also not clear to me that this was not a constant sync. Changes in one product were not automatically migrated over to the other. This was especially problematic because later syncs of the stories and epics caused duplicates of the previously synchronized items to appear because the system did not identify previously sync'd stories.

タイトル: The easy way to Story Mapping
投稿者: Veselin ブルガリアのCo-founder and business analyst at VM & Co 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "The easy way to Story Mapping"
良い点: While working with paper and stickies is the most quick tool to adopt, sometimes a digital one is required, as it provides certain benefits (quick editing; sharing; remote collaboration). I liked that it required zero learning for the basics. I just did the storymaps without a hitch, no wondering how I can do this or that. Of course, it provides some advanced functionality, but for the pure, basic, stickies-on-the-wall, experience, you there isn't a learning curve. Just plug and do.
改善点: The free version is said to work like the GitHub model - all boards are public. Everyone can see them and browse them. So far so good. However, unlike GitHub where you can use one of several ways to get your repository to other people (sharing a link, inviting them, telling them the name of the repo...) I didn't find any of it here. I could not share the free board to my colleagues (even for viewing). There is a workaround with exporting, which can get the job done. I understand this is their business model, but then the site should not describe it working as GitHub's public repos, as it, in practice, differs as an end result.

タイトル: Simple Scheduling Tool That Saves Time but Feels Limited Compared to Dedicated Solutions
投稿者: Josh 英国のIT Support Engineer 情報技術、情報サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Simple Scheduling Tool That Saves Time but Feels Limited Compared to Dedicated Solutions"
良い点: Microsoft Bookings is a handy and straightforward scheduling tool that works well within the Microsoft 365 ecosystem. It makes appointment booking easy with a clean interface for both admins and end users, and it syncs well with Outlook calendars to avoid double bookings. Setting up services and availability is fairly quick, and automated reminders via email help reduce no‑shows. For basic scheduling needs, it does the job efficiently and removes a lot of back-and-forth when arranging meetings or appointments. It also benefits from Microsoft’s security and compliance framework, which is useful in business environments.
改善点: Customer Support can be limited unless you have a higher-tier Microsoft support plan. There’s a bit of a learning curve when configuring services, staff availability, and policies properly, especially for more complex setups. The feature set is fairly basic compared to dedicated booking platforms, with limited customisation and reporting options. Bugs and quirks can pop up at times, such as syncing delays or booking pages not behaving as expected. Scheduling works well for simple use cases, but struggles with more advanced scenarios like complex resource allocation. Reminder functionality is useful but basic, with limited flexibility or custom workflows.

タイトル: JD Edwards EnterpriseOne - Works fine but with some limited options
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー マーケティング、広告, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "JD Edwards EnterpriseOne - Works fine but with some limited options"
良い点: I mainly like the easy of use as all the options are really logic and simple to choose from. The menus show in a basic use for almost anybody to be able to understand them (even non accountants in order to use for Financial Use). It is quite flexible and you can configure the system to gain a maximum benefit out of it. The software itself is very stable and reliable which gives you peace in this sense as you want to have a software in your company that you can always rely on. I believe the software is also constantly being developed and new tools and new technologies are often included. I must admit I never usually have major problems with the system but just the odd small little issues which are the limited options I mention on my title.

タイトル: JD Edwards EnterpriseOne user review

JD Edwards requires too much development work (issue development) to include even the most basic error-proofing features to ensure data integrity & accuracy.

タイトル: A simple CRM that allowed us to hit the ground running
投稿者: Robert オーストラリアのCEO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 教育管理, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "A simple CRM that allowed us to hit the ground running"
良い点: I like the simplicity of the system. It was very quick and easy both to setup (and make changes to) and then to use the system. It has been very easy to train new employees on. The system has some good power around workflows - which have helped us lock down our processes and helped new staff to follow them. It has a good integration with Xero which has saved us a lot of time and has just released an integration into a mail campaign tool (Transpond) which looks to be a nice added bonus.
改善点: The system doesn't have a document generation tool (so you need to generate invoices and quotes in a separate system). It also is comparatively underpowered in the reports you can generate (even when you upgrade to the higher tiers that have additional reporting functionality). You can export full data sets to CSV - so we have built what we needed in Excel, but it would be nice to have it saved as reports and visualisations in the system. There also isn't the flexibility around notifications that I am previously used to (and so we have had to adjust the workflows a little).
