良い点: We have used this software for over five years. We used to use act and were reluctant to move to another provider. We moved because we could use the software on all forms of devices, anywhere in the world. The other great feature is that it is so simple to use, you hardly need any training at all
改善点: Actually we love it, so we dont really have anything negative to say

タイトル: Great marketing automation tool
投稿者: Noga アメリカのVP, Marketing 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 金融サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Great marketing automation tool"
良い点: Holistic marketing automation. Is a great solution for brands that have both a website and an app and want smart flows that send push notifications, in-apps, and emails to the applicable people. Very easy to use.
改善点: Overall the initial package price is reasonable and you only pay for MAUs and not for all users in the account, but adding more emails is pricey.

タイトル: Flexible CRM Platform that Scales with Growth
投稿者: Katelyn 英国のCRM Lead 情報技術、情報サービス, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Flexible CRM Platform that Scales with Growth"
良い点: Braze provides excellent value for money given its depth of features. It centralizes multi-channel orchestration across email, push, in-app messaging, and more, making it easy to build sophisticated journeys. The learning curve is manageable thanks to clear documentation, and once workflows are set up, campaign specialists can execute quickly. Its security and data privacy compliance also give confidence when managing tens of millions of users.
改善点: The platform can be overwhelming at first, especially for newer team members who face a steep learning curve when navigating the product with various features. Email management and template handling are powerful but sometimes clunky, requiring extra QA to ensure translations or localized versions work correctly. Bugs are rare, but when they occur, they can slow down analysis and require support tickets.

タイトル: Works for Complex Subscription Programs
投稿者: Angela アメリカのLifecycle Marketing 食品、飲料, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Works for Complex Subscription Programs"
良い点: Canvas journeys are able to support our complex subscription flows, creating and augmenting the SMS campaigns is also simple.
改善点: I wish segmentation was more intuitive - I find competitor products much simpler to use and/or statements when creating audiences

タイトル: A great messaging platform for maturing companies!
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 食品、飲料, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "A great messaging platform for maturing companies!"
良い点: I love how much automated functionality and personalization is available through out the different messaging capabilities. There is a significant time commitment when setting up new automation but in the long run it saves time. They also have very flexible in platform permission settings which avoids any accidental messaging from testers and dev.
改善点: Due to all the functionality there is a bit of a learning curve that can feel overwhelming if you have a lean team. The other double edge sword is the support process. You can enter a ticket like most systems but the level of detail they require from the team can feel like overkill when you are trying to solve an issue quickly. I call this a double edge sword because they are incredibly helpful it can just take a lot time to duplicate the issue to send all the info required.

タイトル: Keep it up Braze! Excited to see what the future holds
投稿者: Arman 英国のSenior Marketing Automation Executive 小売, 5,001～10,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Keep it up Braze! Excited to see what the future holds"
良い点: I love how intuitive and user-friendly Braze is—it makes it easy to build and launch campaigns quickly without needing heavy dev input. Braze’s real-time event triggering is super valuable. Being able to act instantly on user behavior (like cart abandonment or a milestone hit) is key for performance
改善点: You often need to supplement Braze analytics with Looker, Tableau, or something else if you want real strategic insight.

タイトル: Mattermost, open-source but not that great
投稿者: Edgar フランスのFrontend Developper 情報技術、情報サービス, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Mattermost, open-source but not that great"
良い点: Open-source, easily installable. Quite fast.
改善点: Not so great working with threads, chats are messed up. Some competitors do much better in this regard (zulip)

タイトル: An excellent messaging alternative
投稿者: Mateusz ポーランドのBusiness Analyst スポーツ用品, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "An excellent messaging alternative"
良い点: Convenience of installation, practically free for most users, quick and easy implementation, very similar in appearance and functionality to top messengers, so it is very easy to move even a large group of users. Works fast and does not consume a lot of memory. Lots of add-ons and plug-ins being developed.
改善点: A few UX issues, but not significantly affecting the user experience. For example: No ability to search for users directly from the search bar, no preview of more than 1 image file, no internal media player, linking to YouTube instead of playing right away.

タイトル: Mattermost: Self-Hosted Superior Alternative To Slack
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Mattermost: Self-Hosted Superior Alternative To Slack"
良い点: This software is very easy to install and supports a simple Docker install, which makes it easy to keep up to date and secure. There are multiple examples on installing and running Mattermost in different cloud hosting environments, and the user community is also very helpful. Running the software locally means you can keep a much better eye on its security and usage. Its user management and directory integration is superior to Slack's. The desktop and mobile clients are fast and easy to install/configure/maintain.
改善点: There's not much that I dislike about Mattermost. Its open source nature may put some people off, but paid support and enterprise licensing solve that issue immediately.

As well the prices are super nice and often is possible to get offers

タイトル: Weeks without a resolution
投稿者: Mark アメリカのFounder and CEO Eラーニング, 自営業 使用期間： 6～12か月 ソース：SoftwareAdvice 共有 "Weeks without a resolution"
良い点: I like that (in theory) it will expose my online courses to a broader audience since they have students sign-up and able to search for the type of courses they want to invest in.
改善点: The customer service is really poor and there's a lack of respect shown to those that invest a lot of their time and money in creating the courses that Udemy profit from.

タイトル: A broad and practical learning library for professional skills
投稿者: Furkan トルコのFounder 認証済みLinkedInユーザー デザイン, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "A broad and practical learning library for professional skills"
良い点: What I like most about Udemy Business is the breadth of its course library and the amount of practical, hands-on content available. I can usually find training that matches a very specific need, whether it is related to UX/UI design, development, analytics, project management, productivity, or business skills. Many courses include real examples, exercises, and complete workflows, which makes it easier to apply what I learn directly to ongoing projects. The flexibility to move between different subjects and learning levels is also a major advantage.
改善点: Because the content library is so large, the quality and teaching style can differ between courses. Ratings and previews help, but I sometimes need to compare several courses before deciding which one is the best fit. Some longer courses could also be structured more concisely, especially when I am looking for a quick answer to a specific problem rather than a complete introduction to the subject.

タイトル: A platform to Upskill and Learn Affordably
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 消費財, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "A platform to Upskill and Learn Affordably"
良い点: Udemy Business offers a wide range of courses across various fields, including specific tools and software applications. Most courses are well-structured and delivered by experienced instructors. The cost of learning and upskilling is relatively affordable, making it accessible for both individuals and organizations. The ability to track employee learning progress is also a valuable feature for management.
改善点: The certifications are not widely recoganized and is relatively easy to achieve . some of the courses are outdated and the quality of the content is not consistent.

タイトル: Simple and easy end points management

良い点: Relatively simple to use. It is very simple to deploy and cost-effective.
改善点: More filter capabilities are needed, and the options to display more information on grids (lists) need to be improved.

タイトル: Great Simple MDM Software
投稿者: Sebastian アメリカのIT Operations Technician Eラーニング, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Great Simple MDM Software"

タイトル: Tried the Free Trial, But It Wasn't For Me
投稿者: Parker アメリカのTeacher 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 教育管理, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Tried the Free Trial, But It Wasn't For Me"
良い点: I decided to try the LogMeIn free trial to see how it compared to some of the other remote access tools I've used. The setup process was pretty straightforward, and I was able to connect to a remote device without too much trouble. It has a decent set of features and the interface looks professional enough for business use.
改善点: After using it for a little while, I just didn't find it as smooth or intuitive as some competing products. Certain tasks seemed to take more clicks then necessary, and the overall experience felt a bit clunky at times. The pricing also seemed hard to justify based on what it offered, especially when there are other options that felt easier to use and worked just as well.

タイトル: Powerful MDM Solution for Trucking and Transportation Companies
投稿者: Bradley アメリカのOperations Manager 運輸、トラック、鉄道, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Powerful MDM Solution for Trucking and Transportation Companies"
良い点: The seamless integration for our end users make this a perfect solution to manage our fleet of tablets. My Customer Success Manager could be contacted directly and made sure I was headed in the right direction and the customer service response was on point for the questions I had. We use this on a daily basis. It is easy to use and after understanding the nature and terminology of the MDM universe, the implementation was virtually pain free. The features included give us the tools we needed to manage our devices.
改善点: There is a learning curve to MDM software. It is not a shortcoming of Miradore. It is simply the nature of the technology. 検討した類似製品： Hexnode UEM TinyMDM LogMeIn Miradoreに切りかえた理由： Cost and features were a major factor choosing Miradore over other options. The GoTo is also a familiar business that has a good track record.

タイトル: An affordable & efficient MDM
投稿者: Brandon アメリカのTechnology Director 非営利団体運営, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "An affordable & efficient MDM"
良い点: I really liked the simplicity of rolling it out and getting my iPads enrolled in Miradore. The business policies are really nice, it helped me separate about 50 iPads from the rest of the fleet because they are lab based.
改善点: I wished that there was a Miradore self service app for my end users to utilize. I have to download apps from ASM and push them out, which isn't necessarily bad, I just wish it was a bit more cleaner by being available in a self service app.

タイトル: Answer to Prayer
投稿者: Charlene アメリカのAdministrator 認証済みLinkedInユーザー ファシリティサービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Answer to Prayer"
良い点: The ease of learning the system and having all of the information that I need on the dashboard. Using the customized email is the most appreciated features. Everyone reaches back and thanks me for the beautiful email.
改善点: Would like to add people to the email who are not members, but first time visitors. This would keep all of the outgoing emails within this system - instead of from my personal email representing the church. I also understand that the system was created to support members, not visitors.

タイトル: Excellent features, excellent pricing structure, easy to learn
投稿者: Christian アメリカのOperations Manager 宗教団体, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Excellent features, excellent pricing structure, easy to learn"

改善点: I would like to see more flexibility in reporting. ChMeetings aggregates a lot of data, but I've found that I wasn't quite able to get the exact reports that I needed. I have an analytics background and I would just love a build-your-own report.

タイトル: Bang for your buck
投稿者: Jocelyn アメリカのExecutive administrator to Senior Pastor 宗教団体, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Bang for your buck"

改善点: Only con would be the limited file upload for push notifications, so some of the images we try to upload with push notifications we can’t do then we have to send the message in the group chats instead.

タイトル: Needs to be more User Friendly
投稿者: Khursten アメリカのAdmin Assistant 宗教団体, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Needs to be more User Friendly"
良い点: The low cost for being able to do what we need it to do. It's a little clumsy and takes extra time to figure things out, but since we can't really afford a more expensive app, it's working for now.
改善点: It took time for me to figure out how to navigate the app and often I have to demonstrate to church members how to use it because it's not very intuitive. I would like a message board or chat feature. It would also be nice if members/users could choose upcoming events they would like to be reminded about with a notification or email. I wish there were more inexpensive label printer options compatible with the app. I wish there was a list view that showed both the date and volunteers' names for planning. Being able to print that list/calendar would also be very helpful.

タイトル: A Comprehensive Church Management Solution That Leaves Us Speechless

The platform offers strong security features that give confidence when managing member information. The value for money is exceptional, especially with the integrated communication tools — messaging, text messaging, and email — which make staying connected with our congregation simple and efficient. The system is thoughtfully designed for real ministry operations and has greatly improved our administrative workflow. LOVE IT!
改善点: We don’t have any cons to report. Every feature we’ve used has performed well, and the platform continues to meet our needs, and the support response is amazing!!

タイトル: Classe 365 gives you value for your money.

良い点: Data management, as a school administrator, it makes it easier for me to track students's data. Easy registration forms and link to our website. The Alumni module is fantastic.
改善点: None at the moment, I'm fine with the current offerings and innovation. They keep making timely improvement with new additions, so I'm fine.

タイトル: German School Geneva - Classe365 Experience - EXCEPTIONAL!

改善点: It takes a while to understand how the modules function and interlink. Once understood, it's a smooth ride. There are lots of options and solutions - it's just a question of getting your head around everything. Perhaps a bit more "colours" to make the user journey more "friendly" but all in all, nothing to complain about. 検討した類似製品： Teach n Go Classe365に切りかえた理由： Comprehensiveness of the tool. Established company vs. start-up.

タイトル: Classe365 Review
投稿者: Sanél バーレーンのHead of Juniors 教育管理, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Classe365 Review"
良い点: Classe365 offers a wide range of useful features in one system, but what stands out most is their excellent customer service. The team is responsive, approachable and always willing to go above and beyond to help. I also appreciate that they listen to feedback and continue to improve the platform. The addition of Microsoft Teams to the live lectures feature is a great example of them responding to users’ needs.
改善点: Some of the initial setup and technical configuration can be challenging for someone without an IT background. In my experience, having a dedicated IT person oversee these aspects would make the process much easier. More straightforward setup instructions and guidance for non-technical users would be helpful. However, the support team is always available and willing to assist.

タイトル: Leadsquared- One CRM to rule them all

改善点: There are two functions I would like to see added or adjusted. One is that there is no way to post a link individually or in a group, e.g. to share relevant articles with board members, or to link to a shared Google doc or drive. Links must be added to a document and then posted. The second is that for ease of management, ability to write notes on, etc., all uploaded/posted documents including Excel files are converted to pdf format. Also the "live" feature is not available in quotes, requiring you to look up pricing with the supplier to make sure it is accurate. With all the changes with covid and pricing, this should be addressed sooner than later. The ability to link a catalog item to a production event would also make a big improvement in order entry. 改善点: I wish basic text formatting was built into the note taking (especially bullet points). I understand with not going crazy with a WYSIWYG, but some simple formatting options would help for quicker note taking.

タイトル: Perfect Platform for Small Batch Mailing
投稿者: Ian カナダのProducer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー エンタテインメント, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Perfect Platform for Small Batch Mailing"
良い点: I use this program for lists which have small and specifically targeted audiences. This mainly includes press lists for producing events, and for teaching large classes or workshops. It allows me to create simple mailings where I do not want a lot of noise or fuss, more like direct mail as opposed to broadcasting a message. It's the perfect scale and I love the ease of understanding the reporting, which becomes of direct benefit for following up and moving between lists. It functions for me like the perfect basic database for supporting the ways I need to communicate.
改善点: At this point I don't have a lot of complaints, as I've been using it for probably a decade. The cloud synchronization has been greatly improved more recently. I often send things which are just this side of plain text for ease of reading and sharing the content with the audiences I send to, and I do find that it's best to bring in any text unformatted and do the formatting within Direct Mail as the styles can get funky when one copies and pastes.

タイトル: Easy, Professional, Reliable Email Marketing System
投稿者: Jason カナダのREALTOR 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 不動産, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Easy, Professional, Reliable Email Marketing System"
良い点: - Easy to use - Clean, intuitive interface - Detailed reporting with nice features like heatmaps to show where subscribers clicked - Easy contact management - Syncs with things like Google Sheets and my built in Mac Contacts - Good help documents - Native Mac app
改善点: - A bit of a learning curve if you're new to email marketing, like me. But that seems to be the case with any email marketing system. - Limited templates, though nearly unlimited customization.

タイトル: Customer Service Just Stopped Communicating with Me 2 1/2 Months Ago!
投稿者: Jeni アメリカのDirector of Marketing and Communications 高等教育, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Customer Service Just Stopped Communicating with Me 2 1/2 Months Ago!"
良い点: My predecessor used it and it was easy to continue to use.
改善点: Customer Service when you have a problem.

タイトル: First Class Product.
投稿者: Gregory 英国のDirector 自動車, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "First Class Product."
良い点: Simple and easy to use. Easy to colaborate with other members of the team. Creating a email is very easy and easy to share with your team and work on the same document. I believe the reports on open rates are more accurate than mailchimp. No proof just a suspicion.
改善点: No cons for me. This is the perfect solution for where we are. Long term it may miss some functionality that you would get from more complex systems. But for most businesses this is perfect.

タイトル: Semi-experienced user writes...
投稿者: Michael 英国のCEO エンタテインメント, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Semi-experienced user writes..."
良い点: Comprehensive coverage of all our needs, with easy layout. Excellent customer services, on the few occasions I've needed them.
改善点: It's a bit pricey. Tricky for smaller operators like ourselves, so do look out for better offers elsewhere. Would appreciate more lower-end pricing options which don't disadvantage smaller businesses.

タイトル: Delivering insightful feedback with Culture Amp.
投稿者: Frankline ケニアのAdministrative Supervisor 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 農業, 5,001～10,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Delivering insightful feedback with Culture Amp."
良い点: This is one of the most user friendly software that integrates top quality analytics to gain insights onto the employee performances while ensuring that the user interface is easy to use and is available to employees at all levels in the organization.
改善点: I feel the 1-on-1s feature should be upgraded in that, it should be able to send an email of responses whenever a direct report or manager updates the conversation or shares a reply. Other than that, Culture Amp is the best.

タイトル: Great platform for employee surveys
投稿者: Zach アメリカのSenior Systems Analyst 情報技術、情報サービス, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Great platform for employee surveys"
良い点: Lovely UI, easy to manage employee data, configure surveys, and track results through the tool.
改善点: There is very little to speak negatively about Culture Amp. The application is great and support has met expectations.

タイトル: Flexible but not the most structured / streamlined feedback / performance mgmt. tool
投稿者: Christoph ドイツのCOO ホスピタリティ, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Flexible but not the most structured / streamlined feedback / performance mgmt. tool"
良い点: Provides 360° feedback options (upward, direct, peer) and can be nominated and assigned individually / according to need of the organization
改善点: The usability with surveys, cycles and dependencies was sometimes overwhelming (although the organization size was not too large). Also, the number of separate tasks / reminders creates more confusion that focusing on simple deadlines and open to dos.

タイトル: Worth the money!
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 農業, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Worth the money!"
良い点: I love that Culture Amp just makes things so simple for the People team now. They have survey templates readily available so we don't even have to design the surveys anymore. It's very user friendly for employees to take the survey and the reporting is the best part. It really protects anonymity while allowing you to take targeted action.
改善点: While the Performance features have many of the things you would expect in an OKR software, it's not as strong as their survey module yet. For example, there are opportunities to improve in the features for adding and tracking OKR progress. This is a newer feature for them though so I am hopeful to see where they will be at in a few years from now.

タイトル: Best tool to measure employee engagement & performance management
投稿者: Yitzhak Vini インドのPeople Success Generalist インターネット, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Best tool to measure employee engagement & performance management"

タイトル: LogMeIn Is a wonderful option for remote repairs
投稿者: Carman アメリカのMajor Incident Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "LogMeIn Is a wonderful option for remote repairs"
良い点: I like that it allows me to take over an end user's computer with almost complete access. There does not appear to be any feature on the user's computer that I cannot access (outside of administrator access needed on site). This is very handy and allows me to do my job easier.
改善点: Certain optional screen sharing features would be nice, like being able to choose a specific window or screen. And easier sign in and access granting would be nice. It takes a few steps to get into a user's computer.

タイトル: Good Product for Remote Support
投稿者: Mihai ドイツのProject Manager 航空会社/航空産業, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Good Product for Remote Support"

改善点: I have used LogMeIn for years now, and I have great experience with it. What I like the least right now is the pricing for the enterprise solution. The value for money is not quite there, especially compared to other products on the market.

タイトル: A Reliable Tool for Remotely Connecting to Another Computer or Device
投稿者: Andrea アメリカのVice President, Instructional Design Services Eラーニング, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "A Reliable Tool for Remotely Connecting to Another Computer or Device"
良い点: I was really happy with how quickly and easily LogMeIn Rescue allowed my Help Desk technicians to gain access to our client's computers when they were having issues.
改善点: There wasn't much not to like about LogMeIn Rescue. If there was anything, it was that the price was just a bit higher than I would have liked as we operated a very small Help Desk.

タイトル: LogMeIn Rescue - Essential Support Software
投稿者: Bryan カナダのIT Manager 経理, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "LogMeIn Rescue - Essential Support Software"
良い点: In my industry, I tend to the needs of users inside the office and outside. LogMeIn Rescue seamlessly allows me to take over my users computer and address their needs wherever I happen to be. Quite frankly, it is the most important software I use. Not only can I control the user's computer remotely, but the Rescue console also allows me to peak inside the file directory. This allows me to move and transfer files directly between our two computers.
改善点: It's not cheap! There are alternatives that are significantly less expense, however, you get what you pay for. Rescue is robust and the extra money spent is certainly worth it. Additionally, in order to acquire full control over the user's computer, there are a couple of steps that need to be explained to the user. While most find these steps intuitive, some of my older clients find it difficult. Sometimes patience and familiarity with the Rescue commands are required to get your client on board with you.

タイトル: An Efficient Tool That Keeps Our Remote Operations Running Smoothly
投稿者: Sebastian メキシコのCEO at MyBikeMx 物流、サプライチェーン, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "An Efficient Tool That Keeps Our Remote Operations Running Smoothly"
良い点: At MyBikeDrop, we manage logistics and delivery teams spread across different locations, so having a reliable system to monitor remote work was a must. Monitask has truly made that process effortless. The time tracking and task management features help us stay organized, while the screenshot and activity monitoring tools give clear visibility into daily progress without feeling intrusive. I also appreciate how secure the platform feels data protection is critical in our industry, and Monitask gives us that confidence. The collaboration tools make it easier for our dispatchers and drivers to stay in sync, even when they’re miles apart. Their customer support is another highlight they’re always friendly, responsive, and genuinely care about helping us get the most out of the software.
改善点: Honestly, I haven’t found anything to dislike so far. Everything works smoothly, and the setup process was straightforward even for our non technical team members.

タイトル: Missing features
投稿者: Saurabh インドのManager 情報技術、情報サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Missing features"
良い点: User friendly interface, Required reporting features. Main thing I liked about this is ability to select currency for each individual separately.
改善点: It do not have some of the features like 1) We can not provide access to client for reviewing project and where time is consumed 2) It do not have a way to put non billable hours. For example, if I have worked 5 hours on a project and want to bill my client only 2 hours. I can not do that. I have to delete 3 hours in order to do it but I need those 3 hours information for future reference. 3) It do not Integrate with task management software like Office 365, Jira 4) Good to have video recording feature apart from screenshot 検討した類似製品： Time Doctor Hubstaff DeskTime Monitaskに切りかえた理由： As of now I am mostly using Hubstaff because of missing features I mentioned.

タイトル: Managing remote project teams across sites is now seamless

タイトル: Efficient Productivity Tracking with Minor Drawbacks

タイトル: A Complete, All‑In‑One Solution for Effortless Referral Management
投稿者: Julie フィンランドのHead of Company 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 教育管理, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "A Complete, All‑In‑One Solution for Effortless Referral Management"
良い点: What I like most about Referral Factory is how seamlessly it consolidates the entire referral workflow. It allows businesses to build campaigns, track referrals, manage rewards, send communications, and monitor performance all within one streamlined dashboard. It removes the need for spreadsheets or multiple disconnected tools, making the whole process far more efficient and organized.
改善点: One thing I’ve noticed is that some of the more advanced settings could benefit from clearer guidance. The platform is intuitive overall, but adding short tooltips or practical examples would make it easier for new users to understand certain options without trial and error.

タイトル: I found Referral Factory useful and exciting for promoting Eric's Voice Over Uk
投稿者: Eric 英国のVoice Over 認証済みLinkedInユーザー メディア制作, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "I found Referral Factory useful and exciting for promoting Eric's Voice Over Uk"
良い点: What I liked best was seeing how a modern referral platform is put together. It gave me a better understanding of how businesses can automate what would otherwise be a fairly manual process. I also liked that it provides a structured framework for running a referral programme, rather than having to manage referrals in a more time consuming way through emails and spreadsheets. Being able to see the entire referral journey from the customer's perspective, from invitation through to reward, was useful.
改善点: Setting up the Online Pop-Up was a headache. The process was poorly described on the platform. Now I have worked it out, I could do it in minutes. The pain point was doing a process backend to simulate a user and getting a code. Also needed some work with what is displayed on the button for a website.

タイトル: Easy to Use with Useful Referral Features
投稿者: Richard 英国のPlanning 食品製造, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Easy to Use with Useful Referral Features"
良い点: What I liked most was the overall concept behind Referral Factory. It gives businesses a simple way to manage and track referrals from start to finish. My favorite feature is the analytics because it gives brands a clear view of how their referral program is performing. Being able to see referral numbers, conversion data, and who is generating successful referrals can help businesses understand what's working and recognize the people bringing in results.
改善点: What I liked least was the rewards setup. Compared to the rest of the platform, it took a bit longer to understand and felt slightly more technical. Once I spent some time exploring it, it made sense, but I think first-time users may need a little more guidance. A few clearer explanations or tooltips would make this part of the platform easier to use.

良い点: - Offers competitive pricing while still delivering solid performance and scalability - The support team is responsive and knowledgeable, especially for complex setups or troubleshooting scenarios - The WebRTC-based streaming provides very low latency and works well for real-time use cases like live events or conferencing - Offers APIs, integration capabilities, and customization options that make it suitable for engineering teams building tailored solutions - Supports cloud, on-premise, and clustered deployments, making it adaptable for different architectures
改善点: - The Admin interface can feel unintuitive, especially for new users or when managing complex workflows. - Difficult debugging and troubleshooting – When issues occur, it can be hard to identify root causes due to limited diagnostics and observability tools. - Monitoring is limited and not insightful – Metrics are mostly raw numbers (CPU, bitrate, etc.) without clear indication of how they affect streaming quality or user experience. - Complex setup for advanced use cases – Advanced configurations (e.g., clustering, scaling, GPU usage) require strong technical expertise and are not beginner-friendly. - Documentation could be deeper for edge cases – While basic docs exist, more detailed guidance is needed for complex scenarios. - Support quality can vary in effectiveness – Although responsive, some solutions provided are not always practical or fully resolve the issue.

Firstly, it is easy to use and learn, given that it has a simplified interface, which is more approachable for beginners. In addition, it allows its users to progress from basic to more advanced techniques without being overwhelmed. Another positive aspect is that you can use it through a one-time purchase, which is a perfect approach for starters. In fact, it can be more cost-effective for people who don't need a lot of updates. Furthermore, it has strong and easy photo editing tools, which allow you to crop, resize images and adjust brightness and contrast.
改善点: I am also aware that Photoshop Elements has some faults and disadvantages. Firstly, its editing tools are quite limited. For example, it doesn't include advanced retouching, compositing, and precision editing features. In addition, its layer capabilities are reduced. This software presents selection tools which are less precise for complex tasks. I also discovered that it has limited support for professional workflows. In fact, it lacks advanced colour management, CMYK editing, and other tools. Lastly, it doesn't have a lot of AI and automation features.

タイトル: Lots of features as open-source & enterprise group chat software
投稿者: Hendy インドネシアのCTO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 個人および家族向けサービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Lots of features as open-source & enterprise group chat software"
良い点: The core software is open-source, so the cost is low to get started. You have the option, but not forced to, to purchase business/enterprise support and upgrade for additional features, and Rocket.Chat company also provides hosting services. In case you want to modify the code (likely you won't need it), but you can, so it's a big plus for feeling in control. Rocket.Chat supports OpenID Connect for SSO authentication out-of-the-box, which we integrate with FusionAuth and it works as expected. So really happy about this. We also did submit some patches and enhancements to Rocket.Chat GitHub, and while response time varies, we were welcomed, some of our contributions were accepted, some were not accepted but with clear explanation. So we're very happy that we can collaborate directly with Rocket.Chat developers and hopefully having good relationship in the long term.
改善点: I still see stability issues, sometimes chats not refreshing, and random minor issues. It's quite hard to debug/diagnose the issue, and on GitHub some issues have been waiting for weeks or months. I understand this is complex code without various platforms connected together, and to be fair Rocket.Chat tried to provide several debugging options inside it, so they do put effort in this. Configuring to use own Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) push notification is tricky, and requires deploying customized Android and iOS app... but this is to be expected and I'm not sure how it can be made easier. It still feels that they're pushing for new features more than to fix bugs. Which can be both a good thing or bad thing, depending on which side you're getting.

タイトル: Overall, it's been just OK. It gets the job done but not always a great experience

改善点: It's buggy and there are weird nuances to get used to within environments. Have to clear cache FREQUENTLY or issues occur. No nesting folders for content available, so our list of emails and assets is LONG and not well organized. Can't upload a photo into the contact area- which is big issue for us in sending personalized emails on behalf of our HUGE sales staff with unique and varied information. タイトル: It does everything and more

改善点: Because it can do so much, setup can be a little complicated. However, the support documentation and their online chat support are fantastic. So even if you are a beginner, you'll be able to get it all set up.

I love how easy to talk are the customer support people, they react and give simple solutions (with step by step instructions) to solve all the hick-ups I've encountered. Also, they are always very patient answering a pile of questions that sometimes require a bit of a discussion too.
改善点: There are some limitations (one order bump option) and there is always room for UX improvement, but other than that - all is goo!

改善点: This company is more about selling and their software is a sideline to that. I only made use of the recurring payment side and found it to be very long winded in setting up, by far the longest setup than any other similar I have evaluated (and there have been lots). Once installed the whole look and feel is very cheep and requires way to many clicks to get where you need to be. You can add custom fields but dont expect to be able to edit them after. The data it stores is also not consistant despite all transactions using the same form and gateway. Support is pleasant but all they will do is send you a page of the manual. They make no effort to understand your issue or go the extra mile.

タイトル: Very price competitive, with a ton of features over a very intuitive UI
投稿者: Garrett アメリカのTeaching Associate 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 高等教育, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Very price competitive, with a ton of features over a very intuitive UI"
良い点: The first thing that drove me to looking into Hubilo was their reasonable pricing model. Especially since they offer a flexible model. From an administrative standpoint, the Dashboard couldn’t be more intuitive. It is very easy to get around and setup the event, add attendees, add sessions, etc. In both cases (attendees and sessions), Excel files can be uploaded to allow bulk adding to make the process even easier, and they were all sent an invite email to join in an instant. Adding Exhibitors/sponsors was just as easy – with the added bonus of giving them permission to edit their own virtual booths should you wish to open that portal. There is so many nuances in the settings, you can turn things on or off with a switch – allowing you to totally customize the event to your liking. For example, we turned off polling for some of the sessions, but left it on for others, including the event feed. We turned off open chats for the event feed, allowing us to moderate the chat and have “Sponsored” posts in that area. Overall, Hubilo is very price competitive, with a ton of features over a very intuitive user interface, that make your event flow smoothly for the planners, speakers, and attendees, alike.
改善点: The user interface overall is easily navigable as seen above, but there are some quirks. As great as it is, there’s some quirks. If more than 3 sessions are happening concurrently, they can become “hidden” behind an arrow you must click to scroll through. We mitigated that issue for our event by having subsequent sessions start 1 or 5 minutes later. If the event is happening over multiple days, looking forward/backward isn’t as obvious. Would like to see those buttons larger, a different color, or something else to make them pop a bit and be more noticeable. One of our biggest issues was trying to play an “on-demand” video while having the speakers available for live Q&A after. Through the Hubilo Broadcaster, this is possible, as it is with Zoom, but in both cases, the video must be played from someone’s’ computer. It would be nice if the video played from Hubilos’ servers (as a typical On-Demand video does), with a ‘Zoom’ call added to the end of it for live Q&A. To be fair, I don’t think any other platform can do this right now, so it’s not an easy problem to solve. Another quirk we ran into is that the Q&A and chat responses have a limited character count. Understandably so, but we would like to see it raised a bit for the Q&A at least. Our speakers couldn’t easily answer some questions with the limitations in place. And something we didn’t think about before hand.

タイトル: OpenCart is the easy option for e-commerce solutions
投稿者: Aris ギリシャのWeb Developer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 消費者サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "OpenCart is the easy option for e-commerce solutions"
良い点: As a developer, I like the Model-View-Controller design pattern, it's easy to seperate things and understand the code, as well as reuse different controllers or models through the development of new extensions, as a result it's easy to make what it looks like native extensions, without breaking the software functionality if you follow the coding standards already used by the OpenCart developers. I think that the OCMOD system is the most intelligent way to extend OpenCart's functionality and I admire the developer who invented it. As for the UI, it's easy to use because all sections are seperated and grouped on the left column menu. Moving from other platforms to Opencart or moving from older OpenCart versions to newers is very easy especially from v2 to v3. From a user's point of view, OpenCart is like using an app, it's that easy. Labels and hints make it easier for new users to adapt as well as new customers to buy.
改善点: Even though OpenCart is stable since the beginning, I think we need more functionality that other platforms are having and would be nice if we could move them to OpenCart too. Not major functionality, but different minor things that will improve the workflow of an e-commerce owner, such as a summary page that will show products missing images, products with broken images, categories with no products, products with no descriptions or products missing translations etc. I think in the era of Javascript it would be nice if we could convert some pages that the administrator spends a lot of time to AJAX functionality or even Single Page Application so that we can make more and massively in less time. Although, that would break some 3rd party extensions obviously.

タイトル: Great CRM running over a nice business process tool

良い点: Main advantages for BPMOnline: 1) Marketing, Sales and Services is fully integrated and normally don't require external or additional tools to work. 2) No hidden costs. The cost model and licenses are quite simple. Your contract normally provides all (and more) of what you need. It's really weird to find unexpected restrictions in the licenses you buy. 3) Learning curve for users, administrators and technicians is very short. With good guidance during implementation, you can take control very fast.
改善点: Some areas that requires improvements: 1) Integration to third party tools. There are certain integrations that come with the tool like email and phone systems. But others like legacy system or very particular solutions, requires development that can be difficult (not impossible). The lack of existing solutions in the market (free or paid) force you to develop those integrations. 2) Changes are easy to do, but they normally requires compilation. This can take some time, and if it's executed incorrectly, you can affect your instance. 3) The security is very detailed and can be aligned to every model. But, some changes applies just to new records, not to historical information. This can require customizations to work properly. 4) Analytics tool is simple to use and powerful, but it still require some additional features, like calculated variables and export.

Students have access to their results all semester long versus waiting for midterm and final reports. This enables students to access their learning outcomes and goals while gaining a better understanding of course weighting. As an educator, you can send a broadcast out to students and their parents to update them on upcoming field trips, projects and learning goals. A daily journal keeps students focused on what needs to be submitted as well as insight for students who may miss a day of classes. Edsby interconnects every aspect of learning in the classroom into one multifaceted online program to support the entire educational journey for both the student and the teacher.

タイトル: Excellent LMS that organizes learning in one place

良い点: Edsby is a one-stop shop for educators. It combines all the basic everyday functions, like taking attendance, updating daybooks/lesson plans (journal), and assessing learning, into one convenient place. The journal feature is especially useful as it allows students to follow along with a course if they are absent, saving teachers from needing a "what you missed" folder. In the journal entry, teachers can type up the class agenda, include links to resources, and attach any necessary documents. For evaluation, the Edsby Gradebook allows teachers to set up course breakdowns at the beginning of the year (easily copy from one section to another) and then create a wide variety of assessments that directly get entered into the Gradebook or formative assessments that allow educators and students to track learning over time without impacting a grade. Edsby also allows users to select various methods of assessing learning, such as letter grades, percentages, learning skills, creating rubrics, or simply entering a "mark out of". Then a variety of reporting formats are available, including generating a report of incomplete assignments or filling in report card comments. Edsby also allows for creating whole courses that can be shared between teachers, a feature I am still exploring. Outside of courses, Edsby's groups allow for collaboration between teachers and students. Professional Learning Communities are especially useful and allow teachers to share resources.
改善点: Though Edsby's messaging feature is convenient for communicating with students and parents, the interface is not as well organized or sophisticated as other messaging platforms. Not being able to sort chats, rename a group message, or thread messages makes it difficult to organize messages. The Edsby phone app is also difficult to use. The interface is clunky, making it difficult to navigate to the pages one is looking for.

As with any other tool, it's a learning curve but the Crisp team has made this so easy to go from old school tree-branch methods and a bunch of if statements to bring in AI and handle these scenarios seemlessly. It's value for money already bringing us a 40% reduction in queries (and increasing) due to their AI handling mundane queries obo our agents.
改善点: Cons we faced: 1. The search function can't identify exact matches yet, so if you're looking to search for an order ID or a specific string of text, it either won't find it, or it will bring back what it might be. *Search doesn't work perfectly yet but we know the team is working on this. 2. There is no way to see what an Agent was up to exactly during their day, log on / idle / log out + unique conversations handled vs resolved, etc. How many queries are inbound (that comes in from a client) VS outbound (that we created). 3. Unable to extract raw data when doing an export via analytics - only topline numbers come through (almost like Power BI where you decide what underlying information the users are allowed to see when they export their report) This caused some headaches when our QC teams needed the session ID's to review the Agents and their ratings. For this, we had to build a custom data warehouse to host all our crisp conversations which allowed our data team to build the reporting our business requires. The downside to this is that we don't match the Crisp analytics because the underlying goals are different. Example, we would want to see if Agent X reached their daily target "today" and even if they did, it won't show in case Agent X resolved a query that was received last night - it will only reflect on the previous day's data for Agent X which leaves a gap.

タイトル: Complete platform for managing entire software development lifecycle
投稿者: Edwin カナダのDev Manager 金融サービス, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Complete platform for managing entire software development lifecycle"
良い点: What I like most about Azure DevOps is that it provides a complete platform for managing the entire software development lifecycle in one place. The integration between Boards, Repos, Pipelines, and Test Plans makes it easier for teams to plan, develop, and release software without needing many disconnected tools. Building POC's sometimes we need all the tools. The CI/CD pipeline experience is one of the strongest features because it allows us to automate builds, testing, and deployments with flexibility. I also like how Azure DevOps works well with modern AI development workflows. It can be integrated with AI services, automated testing tools, and code quality tools to help developers improve productivity. The search capabilities across work items, repositories, and files are useful when working on large projects. Code management through Git repositories is reliable, and the permission controls make collaboration safer for enterprise teams. Overall, it saves time by bringing development, deployment, and project tracking into a single environment.
改善点: The biggest challenge with Azure DevOps is that the platform can feel complex when setting it up for the first time. New users may need time to understand the relationship between organizations, projects, repositories, pipelines, agents, and permissions. Some configuration areas require technical knowledge, especially when creating advanced YAML pipelines or managing deployment environments. The learning curve is higher compared to simpler project management tools. The search experience is helpful but could be improved when looking across large amounts of code, documentation, and work items. File management and artifact handling can sometimes feel less intuitive compared to dedicated storage solutions. Although Azure DevOps supports automation and integrates well with AI-powered development tools, some newer AI-assisted experiences require additional setup and configuration. More built-in AI assistance for troubleshooting pipeline failures, suggesting improvements, and explaining errors would make the platform easier for developers.

Customer want to view the items they purchased, but not with the cost price... would really appreciate is we can select by dates see the items and have no other specific information, many times customer feel the need to see all the items but this way it will show cost price the only way is selecting transaction per transaction which you may understand becames tedious. Transaction with Swipping EMV and manual imput, can really pinpoint what's the incongruency but each of our iPads 3 run differently some don't swipe other just EMV so far we just deal with it but it's annoying, last mindful thing... the printer for over a year we were promised all iPads can print receipts after installing a new 300 printer and new modem,,. タイトル: Great System with some Bad Updates with No Time Frame to be Resolved
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー アパレル、ファッション, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great System with some Bad Updates with No Time Frame to be Resolved"
良い点: The layout for processing sales and invoices is great and easy. We do not have a very tech-savvy staff and they were able to quickly learn the software, even with its various updates and changes. The receipt layout is great with the barcode at the top, it makes it easy to pull up sales quickly. The software has really helped to better manage our inventory. I love the ability to affiliate specific customers to inventory items so we can track trends. The integration with Mail chimp is awesome as we are able to send mass emails to our customers to let them know about various events in the store. The matrix feature for the inventory is great as well. I love the all of the reports and the inventory management. The customer service team is very efficient if there is an issue and are always friendly and readily available.
改善点: I researched several POS systems before we chose Bindo, I thought Bindo had all of the features we needed for our small business and more. After several years of using Bindo a couple of updates were launched some were great and others were not beneficial to us. The updates often times took away features that we had liked. When I had called to investigate if this was something that was going to be corrected, there was never a time frame for when it was going to get resolved. The customer service team is always very helpful, nice and assured me that the developers were working on it. I know that no system will be perfect for everyone and with technology there are always issues but certain features just got worse and the software has gotten harder for my sales staff to use. My sales staff are not the most tech-savvy and prior to the updates they were excited and embraced the software and after a couple of bad updates they are not eager to use it. I am getting a lot of complaints by them about certain issues that I have to keep assuring them that the developers are working on. Simple features like the ability to print a quote on the receipt printer or changing the associate on a sale after it is paid or showing the balance owed by the customer on a partially paid invoice are not possible. Our lease is ending in November and I am sad to say that we will probably be leaving the Bindo Family. I still love Bindo and hope that some things change before we need to make a decision.

タイトル: Do not get in business with Bindo
投稿者: Matthew アメリカのBar Manager 食品、飲料, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 ソース：SoftwareAdvice 共有 "Do not get in business with Bindo"
良い点: Bindo, when it works is very easy to use. They have really improved the interface and any prominent issue probably has a work-around.
改善点: Where to start? Bindo's customer service is quite possibly the worst I have ever experienced in the tech industry. Since Covid started they have not answered their customer service line when I called. Not a single time. I have constant issues is different aspects of the app and they are not willing to even contact me back. On top of that, the question mark button that leads to customer service has said "Something went wrong" for 5 months now. I have gotten responses from their team like "You are not a big enough account for us to help" or when asking about bad reviews: "Haters gonna Hate" We have used Bindo for over 5 years and it has kept terrible track of our inventory. The quantities are all over the place, things that were sold 4 years ago show up as in stock, things that came in this week are listed as negative numbers. There is a big issue with credit card processing. Recently, at least once a day the software crashes while processing a credit card and it charges the card but reports in the POS app as unpaid. I also have tons of issues where transactions come up as partial payments for no reason at all. We have experienced the app crashing from so many little things. Whether its deleting a number when manually entering a credit card, charging our menu setup, just swiping a card, Bindo crashes all the time. Luckily they updated the software to save open tabs but before that was implemented we would lose 15-30 tabs every time Bindo crashed.

タイトル: Best tool for analytics and Event tracking

Guesty and Tokeet were so glitchy they cost me money to try to setup. Guesty wanted $1000 just to set me up AND a PERCENTAGE OF MY COMPANY ( % of gross sales ) STAY AWAY from any company like that! Wheelhouse automated my prices, for a PERCENTAGE OF MY COMPANY - meh. Guesty promised to scale my ads and failed miserably. Tokeet's chat feature was garbage, but import/export listing feature was awesome. In the end, you can only hook up one channel manager to your airbnb account, so if your like me, you have got to decide on one at a time. I have tried 8 and reviewed 50-60... and Im done looking. SmartBNB delivered in almost every way I could have wanted. - Dirt cheap for what you get - Perfect communications channel w guests ( I am super picky ) - Seamless automated messages WITH THE ABILITY TO REVIEW THEM BEFORE THEY GO OUT - Bad Review strategies and are automated, rational, and effective - Almost instant, and intelligent customer service - Killer Documentation that actually trains you and almost never confuses you - Phenomenal - like off the charts phenomenal customer service tools.
改善点: - The calendar viewing is weak. Its fine because you can just use Airbnbs... but to improve it guys: clicking to go to the next month? Really? You cant scroll to Jan 15th to feb 15th? Fix that. Make it scroll like airbnbs please immediately. I don't touch that, but again, its not really a point against the company because you don't actually need to use it, I can get everything from the airbnb cal with info imported via Ical from the other sites.

タイトル: Comprehensive, versatile CRM and project management tool with outstanding customer support

We've implemented Solve360 in three companies and recommended it to dozens of others and never been disappointed. Of course we always consider other products on the market. Many of them promise to deliver great things, but when you get into the detail, they lack key features that are essential, or are prohibitively expensive.

Being really picky, perhaps some lesser used functions are not immediately obvious, but there are plenty of guides and the customer support is outstanding. The inclusion of a Gantt chart function would be great for project work, but there are work arounds for this.

タイトル: Wonderful tool for any business with contacts
投稿者: Dorea アメリカのDirector of Health Relations 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Wonderful tool for any business with contacts"
良い点: I have used Solve for over 4 years, and introduced it to my latest start-up business project. I vetted several CRM's before going with Solve and have been very happy with this decision. At first glance I was intimidated by how to begin and organize, but with guidance from their team with one on one training and reading their guides, I have been very pleased with the results. I use the desktop version which I like better than the app for the phone, but I still appreciate the app when on the road to make notes and reminders. I can easily make templates for emails and reminder tasks/queues/calendar dates. It has been a wonderful CRM to work with. I recommend it to anyone that needs to keep track of contacts and their interactions.
改善点: It would be nice if the mobile app could link with the desktop templates I have created to insert those on the fly. I think I was given a tutorial of how to do this, but it must have been too many steps, because I never completed it. We cannot connect our Quickbooks with Solve. I have used Xero with success with my prior business. I prefer Xero over Freshbooks. No number to call for support, but when you email support they can setup a time and they do respond quickly.

タイトル: Ovatu is the reason my company functions so easily in a paperless system! I absolutely love Ovatu!
投稿者: Serina アメリカのOwner and Nutritional Therapist 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Ovatu is the reason my company functions so easily in a paperless system! I absolutely love Ovatu!"
良い点: I absolutely love how all of my most used items are contained in one place! Extremely flexible schedule, invoicing, appointment reminders, client reviews, online scheduling - it's fantastic. I spent so much less time going back-and-forth for scheduling with most of my clients because they can very easily add themselves to my schedule through my website. I can open up the Ovatu app on my smart phone and easily check my schedule for updates. Fantastic! I recommend Ovatu to everyone and couldn't be happier with customer service as they are always polite and prompt returning my questions.
改善点: There are only 2 areas in which I think Ovatu could be tweaked: 1) adding in some way to track a few more types of expenses to reflect on the bottom line for revenue (items such as rent, insurance, payroll cost, etc. which is a little bit more of a job for accounting software) to give a more accurate overall picture in the Reports section. 2) An improved note-taking system to allow for a little bit more flexibility. I'd love to have a way to store private SOAP notes after each consultation that can include PDF attachments or diagrams, and, at the same time, another section of semi-public notes (between me and that particular client only - through their log-in) that clients can log-in and see through the mini-site which would contain recommendations for them to complete between appointments.

タイトル: If you're looking for support, look elsewhere

良い点: A very customizeable salon software system. Ability to change timing for different services and providers, and color coding options were nice but not overwhelming. Extensive reports. Great email marketing which included premade templates and easy way to select the custoemrs to receive the email campaign and tracking.
改善点: Reports all pulled and displayed data differently. Some would add odd things into names like "new request" which made compiling data a pain as you had to clean up each report to match another to compare information. Customer support was close to nonexistant, and every problem you had was essentially "your fault, not the software" and more often than not resulted in a work around to do a basic task. Outdated appearance. Confusing menus for settings. Software was regularly nonresponsive or completely down for random amounts of time in the middle of the day. Terrible when your whole software is cloud based. Inventory was always a mess - not a perpetual system and if there was ever a time where your inventory dipped into the negatives due to an error, it would disregard that when receiving more inventory in the future through an order.

タイトル: Switching from Shortcuts to Rosy was the BEST DECISION EVER!
投稿者: Joe アメリカのConsultant 小売, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Switching from Shortcuts to Rosy was the BEST DECISION EVER!"

It has CRM, Reports and all the major and minor features necessary to run a successful salon and not have to focus on the software. It seamlessly integrates into the daily workflow.
改善点: The Email Builder for the CRM needs to mature a bit more, but overall it works great for someone with knowledge of how to build emails. It's just not a job for someone with little or no CRM experience. I can see that it will get better, and you could always use MailChimp or other CRM service for sending Campaign style emails if that is what your salon does. Rosy handles all the automated emails quite well once they have been setup. Mobile functionality is important so be prepared to test your messages on a mobile device. It all works great, it just takes some know-how or you have to call support and let them help. Or you can have a consultant like me help you.

タイトル: Why Rhino Users Teamwork Desk
投稿者: Ramin アメリカのCEO 情報技術、情報サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Why Rhino Users Teamwork Desk"
良い点: I have used Teamwork products on and off for over 7 years now. Everytime I come back (frankly because everything else out there is not as good), I am impressed by all the work that has gone into it while I was gone. This time, I came back because we have some large projects and I was migrating away from Saleforce.com. The product simple to set up, it does what we need it to do and it integrates with many of the services we use every day to support our client base. The other thing that I love about Teamwork, in general, is the support. I am in the US on the Pacific coast and Teamwork are in Ireland. Regardless, I am always replied to in a timely manner and the responses I get are not canned (something I hate about other organizations and their attempt to shove support into a dark closet).
改善点: Missing features would be such things as: * Integration with Ring Central or 8X8 or Mitel hosted VoIP platforms. * Integration with remote access software like, SplashTop (splashtop.com) or LogMeIn. *Two way integration with Teamwork Projects and Teamwork CRM and Teamwork Chat. This little gem would be a game changer as I imagine being able to do data entry about a client in the CRM and have all of their company contacts, and information propagate across all the products so my team does not have to go hunting for information. * Integration with IT Glue (itglue.com). This is quickly becoming an industry standard platform for MSP documentation and it would be great to pull up all the machine data for a client who sends us a ticket from inside the ticket. There are more but this is a good start ;-).

We also love that Teamwork Project is customizable to our company so we can easily customize things to fit our needs. And lastly we love the time tracking and billing. Everything we need to run our company smoothly is included so we don't have to split our resources.
改善点: Integration took some time but overall the learning curve was easy. We would love to see better time tracking for employees so we can see time logged over the course a day, week or month and comparison of tasks so we can see averages of how much time the same task takes across projects and where it might have taken longer or less time on certain projects for accountability and task efficiency. The phone apps also need improvement. Desk tickets can not be sent from within the app and functionality is severely limited. Downtime has also been a little bit if a pain, but we are ok with these for the most part because customer service usually fixes them pretty quickly.

Here, I am able to provide everyone in the company with a login to the ERP system and have access to not just ERP features, but also Project Management, a Wiki and a Learning Managment System.
改善点: The HR and Payroll Module can improve quite a bit. The way incentive payments are handled require external programming to design an automated performance based pay. Leaves are also not mutable if a mistake was made during the Leave Policy Assignment which was realised only half-way through the year. This is quite important considering the constant switching of employees between Work From Home, Hybrid and Remote, each of which will have a different leave policy within the company.

The system’s intuitive layout allows our agents to navigate customer interactions quickly and confidently, reducing friction and improving productivity. The conversation-based structure—rather than a traditional ticketing model—has been a standout advantage. This approach provides a more natural, customer‑centric workflow, enabling our team to follow interactions seamlessly across channels and maintain full context in a single thread. As a result, we’re able to deliver faster, more personalized support while ensuring nothing gets lost in transition.
改善点: The reporting structure feels too segmented, requiring users to pull information from multiple areas rather than having access to a holistic, consolidated data view. Because most organizations in our industry rely on the same core metrics, having a pre‑built, unified dashboard that brings collective information together would be extremely valuable. A centralized reporting experience would reduce manual work, improve efficiency, and provide a clearer picture for decision‑making.

Now, every type of communication with a client is consolidated in one place, which has streamlined our workflow. We are able to run reports based on Topics and other factors, giving us valuable insights. The platform also allows us to scale our remote team and helps us identify when we need to schedule more coverage during peak call and text times. Before Gladly, we had nothing comparable, so this has been a major improvement for us. All of this still holds true!
改善点: There are a few challenges with the reports that I wish were addressed to make them easier to read. For instance, the Task Export report does not provide a straightforward way to filter the data. I often find myself copying and pasting this report into an Excel sheet just to extract the information I need. Ideally, I would prefer to have all the necessary details included in a single report, with the option to have it automatically emailed to me on a regular basis. We've also encountered some technical issues with the rules, which haven't worked out for us so far. However, I want to emphasize that the support team is PHENOMENAL. Despite these difficulties, they are always very responsive and do their best to assist us.

タイトル: Well thought-out solution for internal brainstorming and idea collection
投稿者: Mai 英国のFounder 情報技術、情報サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Well thought-out solution for internal brainstorming and idea collection"
良い点: IdeaNote is an excellent example of a simple idea well executed. We use IdeaNote almost daily internally for our brainstorming exercises. With IdeaNote: 1. Ideas are centralised in a single place. Hence they are easily tracked, prioritised and measured. 2. Ideas recorded promptly and adequately on IdeaNote means we can take immediate actions about them. 3. Because many of their ideas result in actions, our team members now feel much more encouraged to contribute their thoughts. They think outside of the box and are more talkative on IdeaNote about solving our business challenges. On top of this, IdeaNote has an excellent UI/UX and a very well thought out design. Not to mention the solution can be made entirely white-labelled too with CNAME!
改善点: These cons are accurate as of our usage currently Jan-2020: 1. Currently there is no granular settings for notification options 2. Currently we cannot "Make Featured" or "Force Rank" some chosen ideas 3. There is no progress indication or "decision" status for each Mission. It will be useful to be able to see some measurements of progress on each mission, as well as an ability to mark the "resolution" or "chosen ideas" for each mission. The team is very responsive to users, though. I have communicated some issues with them and have always received almost instant responses. I am sure they have taken many user feedback to implement on the roadmap, so hopefully, these cons are in their radar and will be released as future features.

タイトル: Great software for CFD simulation and workflow
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 建設, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Great software for CFD simulation and workflow"
良い点: The fact that SimScale is completely web-based CFD software that is capable of providing tangible outputs in a short period of time with the help of real-time simulation with no reduction in resources of the system, is the best aspect of this software. This is better than other CFD software that typically takes weeks to simulate a 24 hour period with basic boundary conditions. SimScale allows us to simulate the built environment with respect to thermal simulation, wind analysis, heat island etc. with the help of CAD models within the browser, you don't need any expensive hardware upgrades or parallel computing either. The software is also capable of providing thermal comfort parameter outputs such as PMV and PPD, which can help designers to consider these when designing pedestrian/occupant friendly spaces.
改善点: Customer care can be a bit more proactive in solving issues. Secondly, there is currently no option to calculate PET, SET and UTCI which are outdoor thermal comfort parameters and can be added in a future upgrade.

タイトル: Pet Sitter Plus is Top Notch for us!

Scheduling is a breeze and it allows me to have peace of mind. I am able to review schedules by the Day, the Week or the Month, and to catch any potential mistakes ahead of time. My Independent Contractors and office assistants are delighted and very impressed with all of the software's capabilities. The contractors are very pleased to see their future jobs clearly scheduled in the system. They also like being able to view their commissions for each and every service that they're scheduled for. Calculating their commissions due for each pay period is so easy now. It literally takes seconds to view all the commissions at once. No more tedious, manual calculations. What a boom! Another critical feature, that helps me a great deal, is the staff's ability to check off their unavailable dates on the system's "Request Holiday." With the click of a button, I can easily view who is available at any given date. My Pet Sitter Plus trainer, Becky Eberly, is extremely knowledgeable in the software and she has also been a pet business owner herself. She is personable, courteous, and entirely professional! I appreciate her quick replies to my many inquiries, as well as her help whenever I reach out to her. From my perspective, it seems to me like she drop everything else, to tend to my requests. She is an angel!
改善点: There is nothing that I do not like about Pet Sitter Plus. I have had nothing but positive experiences with it. I haven't yet implemented all of its features, so I'm not fully versed in all of its capabilities, though. This has nothing to do with anything lacking from Pet Sitter Plus or my trainer. I have just been taking my time to implement features at my own timing, which is something that I also appreciate. Nobody is pushing me to use all of the available features, but they're always there to work with me at my own pace. I really appreciate that!

良い点: Qualio has a great user interface for anyone needing to create, edit, review, find and extract documents from a reliable document control system. This experience also spills over to their events module allowing me to personalise an audit and risk functionality that fit the mould of my companies quality journey. The Customer Service both supporting the induction of the platform and the every day query customer service is outstanding and could not compliment them more. The Help features of the platform make it easy for me to find quick assistance on what I need to do and the regular webinars are a blessing for me to understand what is in production to improve my experience with Qualio. Sandbox environment is great and much welcomes to play around before doing something you will regret in the live environment.
改善点: Qualio still have some sticking points with the document creation journey and while they are improving every day, they are still sorely lacking ease with the creation, reviewer and approval experience. Supplier event is also brand new and not quite the finished product yet. But its heading in the right direction.

タイトル: Qualio is a great flexible QMS tool for small companies

良い点: Qualio has great customer service and and the onboarding team was incredibly helpful in setting up the system quickly. The system has great flexibility in setting up customized processes using their Events feature and I'm excited to implement their new analytics features. The process for change control is simple and intuitive.
改善点: As compared to other eQMS systems, there seems to be some basic functionality that is missing. For example, change control must be applied to one document at a time where most eQMS can revise multiple documents at a time. The system does unfortunately have bugs throughout all of their modules and the editing tool and tracking changes tool is quite tedious and burdensome. Lastly, their design control module is really a requirements management tool and does not actually assist with design control.

タイトル: We told them our requirement before signing. They signed us anyway, then held us to the contract.

タイトル: Good value for money and customer support
投稿者: Bart ポーランドのBusiness Owner ホスピタリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Good value for money and customer support"
良い点: STRONG POINTS 1. Rentals United is mostly a solid CHANNEL MANAGER with the broadest spectrum of OTAs available on the market. I've connected to most of them, but 5 top performers generate almost all bookings in London. Still, there were hardly any connection issues after nearly 2 years, and I avoided the nuisance and stress of double bookings and iCals failing, improving my OTA mix and revenue. 2. PRICE The more properties you have better the price. After our research and having circa 40 units to manage, it was the best value for money as the price is fixed and you know exactly how much you will pay. You can integrate some external software which I describe below and that costs extra. 3. INTEGRATION WITH OTHER SERVICES We found external DYNAMIC PRICING integration (Pricelabs, Beyond Pricing or Wheelhouse) and OPERATIONAL APPS (Wishbox, Chekinn, Doinn, HelloHere, SuperHog) great. For payments for direct bookings, you can integrate STRIPE (a flat fee per charge if generated from RU, free if you take payment manually). These apps are optional, and you pay extra for them, but we are glad we found them!
改善点: Free FEATURES could improve 1. BOOK DIRECT Free website generator creates one page per listing, but guest cannot search for availability between all your listings, which makes it not very useful. We mostly get bookings from the OTAs, and direct bookings are from returning guests, so it is not a deal-breaker, but it would be great to have this function. 2. GUEST PLANNER is a place where you can see a snapshot of what is happening at your properties: your current reservations, check-in / check-out; You can also communicate with guests there. It's a bit difficult to use when you have many properties - in our case, we used the multicalendar available in the software and integrated external communication service available on RU. 3. GUEST COMMUNICATION - you will receive messages from all platforms on your email, and you can message guests on most platforms (I believe not all, but I'm not sure) from Rentals United directly. Instead we use one of the integrated software providers for that as it allows us to upsell, take pre-check-in data, security deposit, etc. and communicate via WhatsApp, text message, online chat, so that guests cannot miss our messages - not everyone can access their email at all times, so the text message backup is great.

タイトル: Lots of Great Features but Most Miss the Mark

改善点: - Misses the mark in full, elegant and flawless execution of most features. - The integration with google calendar took a couple of weeks to get going. It was working but not fully. Once we got it going, it was working very well. - Stripe payments worked well but there were no other methods to accept payments at the time of this writing. - The setting of the meeting parameters felt clunky and unnatural. - The integration with Zoom requires a paid plan with Zoom. - The "schedule with me" page has a set design that I felt was ok but not that great. It's probably just a personal design preference, however. - On the plan I had, their own link was a part of the emails sent to my clients.
