タイトル: Excellent Collaboration & Feature Velocity, Some Platform Bias
投稿者: Frank カナダのHead of Digital 事務用品、事務機器, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Excellent Collaboration & Feature Velocity, Some Platform Bias"
良い点: The pricing model fits a collaborative business environment, because charging per ticket instead of per user allowed nearly everyone in our company to use it freely without worrying about seat limits, which massively streamlined cross‑team communication. Its ecosystem of integrations has also been excellent for us, with ChannelReply filling the marketplace‑support gap perfectly, our reviews and Q&A platform integrating cleanly into the interface, and the native ecommerce sidebar giving us quick access to customer orders and refunds. The Help Center and forms features, while not the most advanced, have been solid and reliable, and Gorgias continues to improve at an unusually fast pace — new updates seem to arrive every couple of weeks. Features like sentiment‑based auto‑tagging, customizable ticket fields, AI‑generated ticket summaries, phone transcription, and the much‑improved multi‑level IVR with natural‑sounding text‑to‑speech have all had real practical value. What I also appreciate is that the subscription price hasn’t increased despite all these additions, which makes the platform feel like it keeps getting better without becoming more expensive.
改善点: Their marketing and product announcements are overwhelmingly Shopify‑focused, which becomes frustrating when many promoted features turn out to be Shopify‑only despite Gorgias supporting multiple platforms. The AI Agent follows the same pattern, offering full functionality only for Shopify and requiring an awkward email‑per‑store setup that doesn’t fit every business. Ticket management could also be smoother, since merged tickets cannot be unmerged and sometimes the merge option doesn’t appear when needed. Another recurring issue we’ve experienced is how Gorgias handles email suppression: if an internal email address happens to bounce somewhere along the chain, the system may start treating that address as invalid, and the affected employee cannot be tagged in tickets until support removes the suppression manually. This has happened a handful of times over the years, and while support usually fixes it within a day, a recent incident took almost three weeks to resolve, creating real inconvenience for us. Phone‑number porting during setup was also stressful, though that seemed more related to carriers than Gorgias. Finally, some features bundled into the AI Agent module feel uneven in usefulness; Flows is genuinely helpful for automating things like order tracking or returns, while Article Recommendations only works well for very short help center articles.

We use it to manage emails, phone calls, and other customer service channels, so it keeps everything organised and makes it easy to see a customer's full conversation history. The Shopify integration is excellent and saves our team a lot of time, as we can access order details without leaving the ticket. Macros, automation rules, tags, and AI suggestions also help streamline repetitive tasks, allowing us to respond to customers faster while maintaining consistency across the team. Overall, it's an intuitive platform that has made our customer support workflow much more efficient.
改善点: The biggest downside I've experienced is that the platform can occasionally be slow when loading tickets or switching between conversations, especially during busy periods. While the AI features are helpful, the suggested responses often need editing before they're ready to send. Some automation rules and ticket routing can also be a little difficult to troubleshoot when they don't behave as expected. Improving performance and making automation management more intuitive would make an already strong platform even better.

タイトル: My first POS
投稿者: Karen アメリカのowner 小売, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "My first POS"
良い点: I purchased this POS machine and software in order to streamline our monthly sales and inventory. For the most part, it has met those needs satisfactorily. I like that I can look up sales info for specific days and track inventory during both the busy season and the shoulder season. Being able to spot trends is paramount to achieving success in any business, and that's one of the main reasons I wanted to use this software. Tracking expenses and profit/loss is also something I'm looking forward to doing with ease once I figure it out. Also, having an machine that links up to our online store and keeps inventory current is a major plus.
改善点: Oooh, this is gonna be a long list. It is not exactly user friendly or intuitive. Entering inventory is a pain in the neck. You must go through two separate screens in order to complete all the information on each item! I would much rather have a long list of things to complete on one screen than have to close out Style Matrix, go into Inventory Maintenance, find the item, fill in the missing details (part number, description for the price tags, web description, etc.) then print out the price tags (which is on yet another screen!) Also, there have been updates to the software that make some interesting changes, including having items go missing from the database and when I'm trying to ring up a customer and the machine insists that the item is NOT in inventory and would I like to add it now (even though I JUST scanned a barcode printed out by my machine) is super frustrating. Sometimes I just need to scan it for a third time before it recognizes the code and the purchase can continue. Also, the TS lookup is a hassle, as there is no way to tell if you're choosing the correct color or size in a style matrix situation. Also, when you get your online store together, the categories and departments are the opposite of what they are in the POS, which is horribly confusing, and you cannot easily change categories or departments. Don't even think about deleting one of them, because that is one button click from disaster. It gets ugly.

I couldn't possibly manage selling on all these channels at once without a service like ecomdash. I've sold on eBay for 18 years, Etsy for 8 years, Shopify for 1+ year, and on Amazon for 2 months. 改善点: There have been numerous challenges with integrating my Etsy listings and there have been multiple times over the last year when I have sold an item on another channel and it was not deleted from my Etsy channel. This rarely happens with the other channels but Etsy has had repeated problems. I'm not sure if the difficulties come from Etsy or what, but ecomdash tech support always comes through with a fix in the end. I understand that these platforms are always changing so a service like ecomdash has to play catch up when these issues occur. They're also dependent on their users pointing out the problems as they arrive and they do their best to fix them prompty.

タイトル: Poorly designed user interface, non-intuitive, frustrating to use
投稿者: William シンガポールのVP 銀行, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Poorly designed user interface, non-intuitive, frustrating to use"

So strange that it supports PPTX but not PPT. And also it has a strange requirement that files uploaded must be of minimun 5KB in size. Why? Changing the position of agenda items can use drag-and-drop but it is buggy and clumsy to use. Must remember to click "Save" as it doesn't automatically save the repositioning for you. For the meeting organiser, there is no easy way to determine whether an agenda item has been updated with the correct file version because you cannot see the filename of the uploaded file. Need to open the file to manually see the content to verify. So frustrating to use. There is no single click publishing of the meeting. Need to click the 'tick' mark for each uploaded file to 'confirm' before the file is visible to users. Imagine if you have lots of files, really too troublesome to use. Good idea to have side-by-side version comaprison but the way it is implemented makes it hard to identify which annotations are for which page to be transferred. Annotations on iPad app is unfriendly to use. There is no text tool for typing text on the page. Sharing annotations is not real time sync and buggy. Unreliable and unusable.

タイトル: Good for the price
投稿者: Megan アメリカのOwner 印刷業, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Good for the price"
良い点: Shift4Shop (previously 3dcart) is a FREE website ecommerce platform. Unlike some of their competitors that charge you for every transaction, Shift4shop does not take a commission and they do not charge a monthly fee. It really is free, which is amazing. You do need to use their credit card processor, and the fee is 3%. But you will pay a CC processor no matter what, so ultimately the ecommerce website is still free. They have templates that are ready to go and are pretty decent. Updates are done automatically, so you don't need to be a techy to keep up (this was a concern when we previously self hosted and did Woocommerce). Ultimately we are happy and would recommend Shift4shop.
改善点: You have no control over some things. One time the entire website went down. Customer service told me I didn't even have a domain with them - even though it had been working and taking orders until the day before. And their customer service is not good. They are out of the country and have no control. Every issue needs to go to a different department. Which is not a big deal for small things, but when your entire website won't work and you have customers emailing and calling (and ultimately ordering elsewhere) losing an entire day because of poor service is huge. Once their error was fixed, there was no apology or explanation. Before we launch any advertising campaigns or send emails to our customer database I always check the site, to make sure it's working. So the free price does with a tradeoff. I calculated what places like Shopify would take per transaction, vs what I lost in one of being down and I am still way, way ahead.

良い点: I liked the ease of use getting Travis setup, the caching, and the build matrix.

Sometimes this takes 20 minutes for all branches to finish building before a push can happen. Also, I'm very unhappy with the pricing changes roll out. I have been paying for Travis for a couple years now. All of a sudden, my iOS team said they didn't think our builds were working any longer. There were a bunch of builds that didn't go through, saying we didn't have enough credits. Digging in, I realized your pricing model changed. So our builds have not been going through for close to a couple months now. I never received an email that you would be changing the pricing which would then break our builds. This to me is a botched roll out. You should have specifically told me that my iOS builds would stop working. In our dashboard, it just shows that our last build was successful 2 months ago. Not that no more builds were happening. This is unacceptable. So much so, that I am actually now reading the Travis CI to Circle CI migration document. Circle CI seems like a cheaper option for us now.

タイトル: Travis CI: Great overall for over 8 years. Not anymore after travis-ci.COM migration & OSS credits
投稿者: James アメリカのDevOps Engineer コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Travis CI: Great overall for over 8 years. Not anymore after travis-ci.COM migration & OSS credits"
良い点: As a long-time user of TravisCI for 8 years, I loved the ease of setting up CI testing pipelines and testing matrices with a single .travis.yml file. It made testing DevOps Chef cookbooks easy and was a great solution that integrated well with test-kitchen.
改善点: When getting a remote VM testing pipeline set up, there are some barriers to ease of debugging. This was primarily due to the lack of live SSH terminal access to poke around at the testing environment to debug job failures. After they added Debug Mode, this became a bit easier. The main problem with Travis-CI was recently introduced with the travis-ci.COM migration. Users were encouraged to migrate projects over to the new website with no way of going back. A new paid credits system was forcibly implemented, with some promise of Open Source credits. All of my projects on TravisCI were free and OSS licensed, so I asked for OSS credits. After a few back and forth emails, I was promised 25k credits. However, after checking in the OSS credits section I still see zero credits listed. It seems that just like that, Travis CI was taken away from OSS users who chose to migrate with no warning about the implications. Travis CI news blog posts explain that this change was made due to some nefarious bitcoin miners abusing their free build systems to mine cryptocurrency. So just like in school where the bad apple ruins it for the rest of the class, now Travis CI has been taken away from small Open Source developers. Please improve your customer support and reinstate OSS credits for independent Open Source developers! Any kind of response or clarity around the application process would be much appreciated!

It will cost you in licenses: Many key assembly features are locked behind special licenses, not to mention the more-or-less required 3rd party customer support subscriptions you need to even get started using the software. 2. It will cost you months to onboard engineers with its terrible user interface. 3. It will cost you hundreds of hours of friction to simply use the software and click through the needlessly-convoluted menus 4. It will cost you entire days of lost work from the program crashing without warning and without explanation. Creo is a pain to use. The user interface is the worst of any software I have ever used, and that's not hyperbole. It has the clunkiest, most inconsistent set of UI paradigms imaginable. If a task (for example, dimensioning or text entry) is done X way in one context, it's done Y way in the next context, and Z way in the next. Creo is hard to learn. The software doesn't tell you what it expects from you, it does not tell you what you're doing wrong, and the information center at the bottom of the screen often prints vague, unhelpful messages if it prints any messages at all. Help articles are often locked behind PTC's web portal, and once accessed, are usually so sparse they are not helpful. Forget about submitting support tickets directly to PTC. Your ticket either gets submitted to the community forums, or to a 3rd party support company, who can submit tickets on your behalf and may take several months to do so. Creo

I can produce an assessment in ProProfs in relatively little time (10 to 20 minutes), and that assignment can be ready to be linked to students immediately.When students take an exam or quiz on ProProfs, I can 'randomize' the questions, so every student sees the questions in a slightly different order. This helps stop cheating in the classroom! I can set the test so students cannot switch tabs on their browser while taking the test. I can produce 'banks' of questions with the Tags option and give each student a slightly different set of questions, so they are assessed on the same material without being able to share answers. Quizzes can be password protected or set so they become active or expire at a certain time. These options are excellent!ProProfs keeps updating their software and making it better each year. Up until recently, there were only two options for sharing scores with students - immediately sending them a score report upon taking the test, or not sending them a report at all. They recently changed this, so that I can click on a student's report (or a group of students) and send them a detailed score report at any time I wish. This improves test security and makes this software even better.I have used ProProfs since 2009, and I use it on a daily basis.
改善点: A few years ago, ProProfs implemented a 'Users' function. Some of the more common K-12 accounts limit teachers to 75 users, which is not nearly enough in a high school. I hope ProProfs increases teacher accounts to 150 users, which honestly is the minimum number of users that would be practical for a high school teacher like myself.

良い点: As a not-for-profit community radio station with a changing team of volunteers, we need a CRM that is simple, reliable and easy the team to use. OnePageCRM has been ideal for us. It allows volunteers to quickly add prospects, record conversations and set follow-ups without creating unnecessary admin. That ease of use has meant very little resistance to adoption, which is often the hardest part of introducing a CRM. For the management team, it gives us excellent visibility of activity, conversations and opportunities. Because actions, notes, and follow-ups are tracked naturally within the system, we need very little additional reporting from volunteers. Having used many CRMs over the years, OnePageCRM is now my go-to. It is quick, practical and focused on what matters: making sure relationships are followed up properly and nothing gets lost.
改善点: There are, of course, CRMs with more advanced reporting, more complex automation and deeper customisation options. OnePageCRM is not necessarily the right choice if you want a heavily bespoke enterprise system. But for us, its strength is that it keeps the focus on the most important thing - recording relationships, tracking activity and making sure the next follow-up happens.

タイトル: OnePage, the CRM That Gets Out of Its Own Way

良い点: Everything is intelligently laid out and easily referenced. Customer management isn't buried in useless bloat — and unlike many other CRM programs, that bloat isn't optional, it's just there. OnePageCRM is simple on the surface but robust underneath. For me in sales, it handles everything efficiently: updating contacts, complete interaction history, scheduling calls and emails, and managing quotes and deals through a pipeline. It does everything the big CRM platforms do, but in a more refined, straightforward way — without requiring a two-day class just to find the tools you need. I went through about five other CRM programs before landing on OnePageCRM. The others could do the same things, but navigating them felt like having a cigarette lighter in a new car when you don't smoke — a feature nobody asked for, taking up space. OnePageCRM strips all of that away. The recent addition of Claude AI integration has been remarkable. And having your data stored on their servers? Priceless. I recently lost my SSD and didn't panic for a second. The mobile app is a nice touch as well.
改善点: My only original hesitation was that it didn't integrate with Claude, my AI assistant of choice. Last week I discovered that had recently changed — Claude and ChatGPT are now both supported, and that was a genuinely exciting moment. There are a couple of key features I'd still like to see Claude handle within OnePageCRM that aren't yet possible, but I've already communicated those to customer service. Larry responded quickly — and not with a template reply. His response made it clear the email was actually read, he agreed the suggestions had merit, and he passed them along to the development team. That kind of responsiveness means a lot. Honestly, it has me excited about where this is going. I've only just begun using Claude alongside OnePageCRM and I don't think I've scratched the surface of what these two will do together. Done right, it could make client management not just easier — but genuinely enjoyable.

You can add your own CSS or JavaScript to fill in any gaps from the out of the box theming engine. A recent overhaul of the search experience brings the experience to what you would expect from enterprise search with the addition of best bets, predictive search, etc. The people directory is beautifully crafted and thanks to the Employee Directory Connector you can bring your users and their active directory properties (such as department, job title, phone, email) in just a few clicks. For authentication, SAML SSO is an option. The admin area is intuitive and very powerful as many options are configurable in the UI.
改善点: There are only 2 security roles, admin and user, so roles like help desk or others might get exposed to settings one might not want them to have. From an integration point of view, would like to see more integration with Office 365 as we use it for more day-to-day collaboration. A SharePoint integration is possible, but not sure if it will also work with SharePoint Online.

タイトル: Check ThoughtFarmer out for your next intranet!

良い点: Although some dislikes are mentioned below, overall we LOVE our new ThoughtFarmer intranet!!! The experience was wonderful, we got a great intranet, and saved money in the process! The base rate for ThoughtFarmer was cheaper than our current intranet by a substantial amount (including adding a significant amount of new users). There are additional add-on features that can be purchased. These are not necessary for a functional/organized intranet, but there are some cool options for reasonable prices. I love that every resource has a home and the robust navigation options. I also really like that editing/admin functions all live within the same site, as opposed to going to a different site. They have SO MANY features that are very flexible and customizable. It takes some work to get set up, optimize settings, and migrate content, but it's worth it! One of our major organizational goals with the new intranet was cutting down on mass emails (emails to all staff announcing X), and this intranet will definitely help with that. The news feature is very customizable and there are options to make information front and center on the homepage.
改善点: There are some specific features that are to be desired our new intranet, but we are still ahead of where we were with our previous platform. Some of the features desired (these may be included in future updates): *Major limitation* External links are not searchable, and there's no 'broken link report' to see which external links may not work. As a credit union, we have a good amount of external links. I also want to mention that all of these points have been relayed with ThoughtFarmer, and may be part of future feature updates. They've been very good about working in our feedback where possible. Forms - To get a notification for a comment on the form, the commenter has to tag you. In theory that's a small step, however it's not something our staff has gotten the hang of yet. Also it would be helpful to add comments to forms. Content editing - If a page is in 'draft mode' it doesn't exist at all. Ideally, there would be a live/published version along with the draft version. Additionally, there could be a permissions setting where a user can update content, but it needs to be routed for approval by someone else before publishing. There is a way to manually set a collaborator, but there's a very real possibility this can be bypassed.

タイトル: Didn't honor agreement; tried to increase fees more than 300%
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 資本市場, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 ソース：GetApp 共有 "Didn't honor agreement; tried to increase fees more than 300%"
良い点: There are a lot of data room providers and Caplinked was getting off the ground and offered our not-for-profit regional association a long-term program to switch from our incumbent provider and join their platform for the same fees we were paying our incumbent provider. After a reasonable transition period, we adopted the program at Caplinked. We transferred a number of users and conveyed the dynamics of how our association interacts with our incumbent provider and were told there were no issues coming over. The association members used 50-75 data rooms at any given time.
改善点: After using the platform for a few years, the company came back and claimed we were getting too good of a deal and they wouldn't honor it. We used the service consistent with how we outlined the service in our contract when we negotiated our agreement. They threatened to shut down the service to the members and then said to stay, we would need to pay fees that were more than 300% higher than our current rates. When you're in the middle of transactions, you don't want a data room supplier threatening to shut down your rooms or holding you hostage to higher fees than you bargained for. We contacted our previous data room vendor, V-Rooms and transitioned back to them for the same rates we had with Caplinked. Obviously, they weren't problematic and we got excellent support from V-rooms transitioning over. The tactics and interactions with Caplinked were terrible. They knew they had you over a barrel and it felt like our not for profit association and its members were being bullied or blackmailed. We will never do business with these guys, no matter what the capabilities of their rooms. We interacted with the Company CEO and VP Sales. We paid annually through September and expected a reasonable transition off their platform for existing rooms in service. They noted they applied our fees to their new proposed rates and we couldn't transition off in a reasonable time-frame.

タイトル: Citrix: Best Virtual workstation

The experience is so great that it feels like we are accessing our own physical device as it supports almost all shortcuts. The support for multiple displays helps to be more productive which is one of the deal-breaking feature for me. It is highly secure as we have to enable 2 FA to be able to login into our remote desktop.
改善点: Currently, I am using Citrix workspace for development, so I would like to see Citrix optimized for the Linux system as well. I have to change the configuration in the system when installing the Citrix workspace app in Linux (Currently using Ubuntu 20.04). タイトル: User friendly and 'No-headache' LMS
投稿者: Gautam CEO & Principal Consultant 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 教育管理, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 ソース：GetApp 共有 "User friendly and 'No-headache' LMS"
良い点: My use of Online Academy facility is solely for the purpose of launching my own programs in the market and it should appear as my course on my platform. The process is quick and simple structure is helpful. Even though one would like to have more features, what WizIQ has now is good enough. I think the overall concept and model is very good and useful for online teaching and virtual classes. The assessment and feedback tool is very good. Chat and Virtual Class service is also quite good but people keep comparing with Skype.
改善点: However, I want my identity and not to be seen as a piggy back on WizIQ, that somehow undermines my efforts in front of my clients. The course launch facility must be supported from remote/guided, if required by the client or users like us. Our faculty is widespread and hence they have to access my online academy for use and teach in collaboration with me on my online academy. I think, the online academy licencee/user is a notch above the online teacher who is solo on the site/service. I would like to have better pricing than the present $83/month for online academy with 25 learners. That is a big price to pay /charge learners in India which works out to about INR 2500.00 per month per learner approximately. This means independent course providers must charge 2 or 3 times more plus taxes to make reasonable income. Now if we are Online Academy service providers, we share courses with other partners and need margins to operate and share, this is a challenge for now, unless we have large numbers of learners to sign on instantly. I am sure WizIQ will price the service at a more friendly level and earn on volumes acquired by us. There are some design restrictions that prevent flexible curriculum design and easy usage by Math and Science function users. The flash based interface is also a little challenge which should be working n HTML or anything better. Corruption of flash players now and then is a recurring problem and Indian users / learners in rural settings are not very comfo

タイトル: Used to be good
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー Eラーニング, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Used to be good"
良い点: 1- The quality of the recorded videos is excellent. 2- Easy integration with WordPress, and update plugins are frequently available. 3- 99%+ up-time, which guaranteed a reliable service. 4- Live sessions are automatically recorded, with an unlimited space.
改善点: 1- Not a complete LMS (Lacks essential features such as exams, certificates, learning paths, evaluations, etc.) 2- VERY poor customer service (Would reply after weeks and won't provide a resolution) 3- The price is really high compared to complete LMS solutions such as Moodle. 4- The web-conference service provided lacks essential features such as multiple whiteboards, collaboration, etc. 5- The size of recorded videos published for the live videos are HUGE, 300 MBs to 1 GBs! Which made it difficult to migrate/download the records later.

タイトル: Don't get trapped by fake reviews posted by WizIQ employees or hired reviewers
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 ソース：GetApp 共有 "Don't get trapped by fake reviews posted by WizIQ employees or hired reviewers"
良い点: I hope that more people who were victims of this company could join forces to oblige WizIQ to act responsibly. It's very odd that such a scammer has lived so long and they are continuing to mislead and trap customers. I strongly suggest everyone read reviews of real users who have used the product and learn from stories. The pattern is rather the same. They are extremely aggressive when it comes to sales. They would manipulate you with excessive contacts, offers, time-bound promotions, etc. After getting your money, they disappear for a long time and fail to fulfill their commitments and even avoid refunding your money when they cannot deliver what they had promised.
改善点: Nothing honestly! They are scammers. Who may love scammers? They recruit people to write them fake reviews, try to manipulate search engines to stand at the top. I wish there were a community that could help victims like us sue this company in an affordable way. They pollute the digital service ecosystem.

タイトル: WizIQ is My Choice
投稿者: Dr. Nellie 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 使用期間： 1年以上 ソース：GetApp 共有 "WizIQ is My Choice"
良い点: The CEO, developers, support, and sales team at WizIQ listen. There is no hierarchy when it comes to catering to educators and students. The team at WizIQ are always ready to listen and implement suggestions. The VC is easy to use and very engaging.
改善点: WizIQ has been listening to my suggestions and improving its features since 2007. It takes time to implant new features. I would like the process to be faster even if these features are in the planning stages. I urgently need the following. I would like to see a mobile App that is compatible for both uses and presenters that allows users to have the same experience that is currently available on the VC desktop. I would like to be able to send the recording directly from my account to Youtube and Vimeo. I would like to be able to edit the recording before I share it.

タイトル: Been working with them for over 13 years. 100% satisfaction entire time. Great team and products
投稿者: Chander アメリカのCEO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Been working with them for over 13 years. 100% satisfaction entire time. Great team and products"

Students are able to attend live sessions from phones, WizIQ mobile app is highly customizable which we didn't find with other LMSes. We have conducted over 2 million hours over the years with great results. 3. Tons of customization to the themes, colors, logo, notifications. 4. The overall LMS is well integrated and has almost everything anyone would need for online education. 5. Customer support is very proactive. The limited use we have needed has been very helpful.
改善点: Not much to say. However, Switching LMS applications is difficult for any business, therefore as a satisfied user I hope they keep up with the product roadmap and deliver more features and improve the existing ones.

タイトル: Digital signage ease of use

What really sets Novisign apart is its robust feature set – from scheduling content and remote device management to the integration of multimedia formats. We’ve used it for everything from promotional displays to information-sharing in our lobby, and the results have been outstanding. The display quality is sharp, and content updates are seamless.

タイトル: Easy and Convenient Digital Signage Management

The ability to schedule content in advance is also helpful for keeping information current and organized.

Some of the customization options aren't as intuitive as I would like, and it can take a little extra effort to get everything formatted exactly how I want it. I also think the design tools could be a little more flexible and user-friendly.

タイトル: Fancy looking feedback surveys to engage, give and receive! Love it!!

改善点: - For some clients, the playful look and feel of the surveys are phenomenal, for others they may be a bit too fancy. I would like to have different templates with cleaner and more professional versions. - It would be great to have the ability to disable unnecessary extra information like "last question" and "you're the fastest respondent". - Furthermore, I like to display the ratings and the answers to the feedback surveys on my website in a comprehensive but clean way. At the moment it is only possible to display the overall rating. I've heard that they are working on each of this cons. After implementation this software will be perfect for my needs!!

タイトル: Excellent Leading Edge Platform for Getting Feedback
投稿者: Ed アメリカのCoach, Trainer, Facilitator, Course Designer, Organization Development 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 消費者サービス, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Excellent Leading Edge Platform for Getting Feedback"
良い点: I think it's important that you get feedback from new products that people have paid for. This feedback gives you an immediate reality check on whether you've hit the mark or not. Of course that assumes you are measuring what matters most to the customer. Feedier makes it easy to set up any questions you want.
改善点: Im wanting more integration with my other platforms. For example, I want to be able to have a WordPress widget that will rotate my testimonials on a page. I want to be able to tag those testimonials and have the widget only display testimonials with a certain tag so they are pertinent to the topic. That said, I also want to direct the person to write testimonials that appeal to a theme. Right now I cant do that. For example I want to be able to have a question that says "What is different in your life now that you are using X product-service?" and I might want a question like "What would you tell someone who is on the fence about X product-service?" the answer to these are unique and would be used in only in the appropriate page on my website depending on the "proof" Im trying to convey.

タイトル: Unrealiable and Really Buggy Feedback Tool
投稿者: Veronika スペインのOnline Marketing Specialist 教育管理, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Unrealiable and Really Buggy Feedback Tool"
良い点: The idea behind this tool is great - asking for reviews in an interactive, gamified way, and also offering a reward for submitting a survey. We loved that idea and that's why we decided to use Feedier. I also liked the design and many possibilities of sharing the survey.
改善点: We've been struggling with it for months now and it cost us completely immoderate amount of effort and time to make it work. Overall problem is mainly that there were problems with the settings - some of them were missing, in a plenty of cases there was a problem with settings loss, we were also experiencing problems regarding the integration to our WordPress website. At the end, there was a continuos problem with data extraction and that's when we decided to stop using it for good. Also, the support didn't help us much, then they stopped responding at all. What is it good for when you can't access the gathered data???

タイトル: A solid contender in the customer feedback space!
投稿者: Nefer アメリカのMarketing Consultant and Front-End Web Developer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "A solid contender in the customer feedback space!"
良い点: I love that you can connect a sub-domain to your survey (aka carrier) so you're left with a professional looking domain like survey.acme.com. You have the option of white-labeling the survey to make it look like a custom solution (great for agencies). Feedier integrates into Zapier which opens up many possibilities for alerting team members and stakeholders and recording data. It's incredibly easy to ask happy customers to post a review on a review site like TripAdvisor, Amazon, Google, Facebook, and the list goes on. This one is the best...Feedier gives you the ability to reward your customer AFTER they submit their feedback (so you're not bribing your customers to leave a review) in the form of a voucher, downloadable asset, a coupon, etc.
改善点: There are some parts of the survey I would like to customize but currently don't have the option of altering. The language to describe what certain features do is sometimes hard to understand because they are not written clearly, therefore, it makes it hard to see the value of a feature.

タイトル: Best platform to create your website

タイトル: Great product that simplifies web design for the average user.

It allows me the flexibility to create in a program that I am familiar with and reduce the amount of coding / back end knowledge that you would otherwise need to create a website.

I wish there were more templates to choose from. A huge roadblock I have encountered is transferring your desktop version to the mobile version when it comes the sizing of some objects. That has been a frustrating process for me. As well as the lack of being able to have a background video automatically play for phone browsers.

タイトル: Stands up to the Competition, and then some ...
投稿者: Jesslyn アメリカのPhotographer 写真, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Stands up to the Competition, and then some ..."
良い点: I've been with PageCloud almost from the beginning, and the strides they've made with improving their product to be more competitive with other options is truly noticeable. I can NOT say enough about their support team. Truly a few notches about the rest. Always so kind, extremely responsive, and they take care of you when you're needing help with something. I've never had a bad interaction with them and have always gotten a straight answer/resolution. Likewise, the development team actually listens to their customer feedback. I know that implementing new features takes a lot of dedicated time and work, but they've never failed to continually progress in getting much needed features from beta into live-use. Just to name a few of my favorite and most-used features: - Desktop view vs Mobile view, and being able to tweak each one separately - Being able to access the code and work with that - Drag and drop ease (obviously!) - Sections and how easy it is to copy, remove, adjust, and rearrange them - Etc. etc. ... I could go on and on :)
改善点: The blog feature still leaves much to be desired, though I know that this is one of the next big updates, so I'm very much looking forward to that. I love that it is easy to organize and search, using keywords, etc., but the lack of customization on how it looks (formatting, typeface, etc.) is so far askew from the rest of PageCloud's immense customizability that I haven't used it other than quick tests on the backend. Once I'm able to dial that in, though, I very much look forward to using it to its full potential.

良い点: The software was intuitive and the user support was prompt and friendly. タイトル: Efficient, AI-powered business planning with investor-ready outputs

良い点: What I liked most about Upmetrics was its ease of use and the significant time savings it provided when building a startup business plan. The platform offers well-structured templates that help create a coherent and professional business plan from the outset, making the overall process much more efficient than working with separate Word and Excel files. I also found the financial planning tools very useful, as they are integrated directly into the business planning workflow and help maintain consistency between the narrative and financial sections. The AI features are another strong advantage, helping to draft, improve, and rephrase content in a way that is better suited for investors and external stakeholders. Overall, Upmetrics enabled me to produce a more polished document, with a clearer structure and a better presentation, while considerably reducing the time required to complete the business plan.
改善点: The financial modeling features could be improved in terms of flexibility and depth, especially for more advanced or complex scenarios. That said, this limitation was not blocking in my case, as the tool still provides a solid and efficient framework for building a startup business plan. Overall, it remains a very usable solution despite this area for improvement.

改善点: XMind is not flexible when it comes to arrangement of the elements of any diagram. Also, you will face some issues in performance (i.e. significant lag), if the size of your mind map/diagram increases beyond a certain limit. Though XMind is a fairly simple tool to learn but it still needs some time to get used to the menu icons and its features.

But just email their team and they will raise a bill for Disney if someone told them so. Staff (account manager and billing team) changes every few months. The new person doesn't know anything that happened with previous team. They say 24x7 support but it is not. Only call center employees with limited understanding of their own product are available at night or on weekends. They cannot solve any bugs, just raise tickets and wait.

タイトル: Convenient subscription billing tool

改善点: The initial setup can take some time, especially for businesses with complex billing requirements or unique subscription workflows. Some features may also require a learning curve, and the pricing can feel high for smaller businesses that are still building their customer base.

タイトル: Good Subscription Platform but Flexibility and Reporting could be improved
投稿者: Janice カナダのOperations Manager コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Good Subscription Platform but Flexibility and Reporting could be improved"
良い点: Subscription management is generally easy to work with and provides the functionality we need to manage recurring billing. The customer portal has improved significantly over the years, and the HubSpot integration has been particularly useful for our team.
改善点: Reporting is one of the weaker areas for us. Reporting is primarily subscription-based rather than customer-based, which has created challenges for the way we need to analyze our business. We have also had difficulty getting the QBO integration configured in a way that works well for our specific accounting processes. There can also be some limitations around subscription changes. For example, when we need to credit or remove a specific line item, the system doesn't always behave as expected. The email functionality could also be more flexible. Certain subscription changes, such as updating a PO name or changing a start date, can trigger customer emails without clearly showing what was actually changed, which can create confusion. It would be helpful to have more control over which types of subscription changes trigger emails.

タイトル: Easy to use tool for quick edits

良い点: A very good tool is the background removal tool. While it's not 100% perfect, it mostly does the job done admirably and you have unlimited usage. About 70% of the time there is no tweaking needed, while sometimes I do need to tweak things. It all depends on the photo you're providing. I love the simplicity of either choosing the advanced tool - Pixlr E or the simple edit tool - Pixlr X. Because sometimes I just need to add a photo, remove a background, add a different background and put some text in, which all can be done in the simple version, and also has some nice ready-made text style templates available if you want to make it fancy and quick. So obviously, the other ready-made templates are also a great asset if you're either out of ideas or just want to use something premade, change the colors a bit, add your text and you're good to go. The advanced tool has almost everything you would need in an Photo editor tool. Very close to Photoshop. A huge benefit that saved me countless pains is the autosave feature. It doesn't matter what small detail you changed, it's already saved. Probably because it's all "in the cloud" - which takes me to my next point. I can open and use it on any computer, without needing to install anything. I have a laptop that's on Windows 10 S, which doesn't allow installation of other software that can't be found in Windows Store, and I use Pixlr on it heavily. I don't want to exit the S mode just to install Photoshop.
改善点: While other tools cost a similar amount, this one is one of the cheaper ones. However, the templates available aren't that many, they could add more in this regard. I see the team is mostly focused on adding new feature instead of expanding their library, which is fine, but the library is very useful. Another thing that's very annoying for me personally is that it doesn't work so good in Firefox versus Chrome. I understand that Chrome now is dominating, but I'm still a avid Firefox user, and I hate opening Chrome just because I encounter a bug or a tool isn't working properly.

In other systems, I have seen a more practical solution where each data point has a default status of “SDV not performed”, which can then be changed to “SDV performed” or “SDV not OK”. If “SDV performed” is selected and the site subsequently changes the entered data, the status automatically changes to “Data changed after SDV”. In my opinion, this functionality greatly facilitates monitoring and the tracking of all data changes. Another problematic aspect is the lack of possibility to raise queries in empty visits. In such cases, I have to contact the site separately by email and provide screenshots from the eCRF to indicate the missing data. It would also be very helpful if the query status were clearly visible, i.e. whether a query has already been addressed and closed or whether it still requires action. Currently, it is only visible that a query has been raised for a given parameter, but the actual status is not clear. In addition, in the query list, it would be very useful to see the specific queries linked to specific parameters, rather than only the sections in which the queries were raised. If there are many parameters and several queries, it is easy to overlook one of them.

タイトル: For someone who is not an accountant, the learning curve was steep. But in time, it became great.

良い点: It's a true ERP/accounting software suite that covers all aspects of a business. There's no cheating when posting transactions. It forces you to get to know actual accounting principles and follow them. I also like that it is platform agnostic. I prefer Linux to Windows, and the software runs on both. This versatility also runs to the database back end; I'm using PostgreSQL on Linux, which is quick and clean for my needs. My accountant loves it, since it does what an accounting package is supposed to do, and not let me delete things if I screw up. The entry-level offering, PostBooks, is free. You can request a free license key for up to four (4) users, running concurrently, which for small businesses or startups is fantastic! The database engine runs on a small server (Windows or linux), and users run the self-contained user interfaces from their desktops - no real installation needed there. If you wish to increase your footprint, additional licensing is available. Forms and reports are fully customizable. With a little bit of time and motivation, you can create any form you wish and configure the environment exactly to your tastes.
改善点: It takes time to master the application if you are not familiar with accounting practices and principles. Being a small businessman who specializes in IT, I'm not accustomed to think in the ways of balancing buckets. It's not Quickbooks (whatever that means). Office managers and financial people continually ask me why I should use something that's off the beaten path with respect to small businesses. Of course, I give them the reasons above. Needless to say, the argument inevitably comes back, "Quickbooks is still easier to use." It's not easy to back out stupid mistakes. Again, this is an "operator issue". A non-accountant really needs to be trained properly to fully utilize the power of this application.

Several bugs that we deal with have been fixed in newer versions but are not available as patches to our version. タイトル: Solid endpoint protection with an easy-to-run console but alert tuning takes some work
投稿者: Philip アメリカのNetwork Administrator 政府機関, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Solid endpoint protection with an easy-to-run console but alert tuning takes some work"
良い点: The management console is genuinely easy to work in day to day. Deploying, checking agent health across our environment, and pulling up an endpoint's history when something looks off is all pretty intuitive and it's great because I'm not digging through nested menus to find what I need. Policy management across device groups is straightforward, and it plays well alongside the rest of our security stack. For a small IT team supporting a tribal government organization, that ease of management matters a lot since we don't have the headcount to babysit a complicated tool.
改善点: Alert noise is the main thing. We get a fair number of false positives, especially around legitimate admin tooling and scripts we run internally, which means time spent triaging and building exclusions rather than actually responding to threats. It's manageable once you've tuned policies for your environment, but that tuning process takes longer than I'd like, and new false positives crop up as we roll out new tools.

タイトル: Quick to start, good support, but it can also take some time to figure out all the details
投稿者: Nicholas ドイツのAssociate and Project Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Quick to start, good support, but it can also take some time to figure out all the details"
良い点: I've been using SmartSurvey for social science research for about 6 weeks now, and agreed to write a brief review and first impressions of the product and my experience using it in return for a not-for-profit discount on the product. I'm using the service to conduct open-ended social scientific questionnaires about how online communities help people care for those with chronic health conditions, and have so far found SmartSurvey to be quite a nice way for doing so. It allows me to post links to surveys within online communities and efficiently each a globally distributed population. I was originally attracted to the product because I needed a service provider that adhere to EU data privacy laws but offer a product that is in English (since this my native language and the common language of my respondents). A lot of the US providers could not meet the requirements, especially regarding data deletion. SmartSurvey quickly responded to a question I had on this account and told me they could guarantee that upon request, survey data would be deleted from active servers within a week and from backups within 30 days. Most US providers could not come close to guaranteeing this. While you can get a basic survey going quickly, there is a lot of customizability on the back end, and this can take some time to learn. My experience is that documentation is good and support tickets I have submitted have always been answered promptly and helpfully.
改善点: One example of the tool's behavior that takes some getting used to so this is not so much a con as a part of the tool that is a bit more complex and takes more time to learn is the anonymous response function. This function hides respondent IP and geographic information from responses when activated. However, if it is off, and then someone responds, and you then turn it on, the system seems to continue to log the information, although it hides. You can then turn the setting back off and reveal all this information. This means a survey is not a truly anonymous UNLESS you design it so from the get go. Similarly, it is possible to activate both the complete it later function, which lets respondents save incomplete surveys by entering a name and email (identifying information that allows them to receive a unique link). But this identifying information will only be permanently hidden if you set the anonymous response feature to on before your first response. Otherwise, the complete it later function undoes the anonymous response setting. So make sure you peruse the full set of privacy features before opening up your survey to respondents so that the settings are correct before you begin. (Also, if you are testing features, be sure to start with a fresh, unopened survey, rather than just changing features on a survey that for which you have already gathered test responses.)

タイトル: A reliable, secure, and cross-platform VoIP/SIP solution for daily call management
投稿者: Guillermo エクアドルのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "A reliable, secure, and cross-platform VoIP/SIP solution for daily call management"
良い点: Zoiper stands out primarily for its versatility and technical performance on a daily basis. The most valuable aspects of the app are: Mobile Access & Stability: The mobile application works flawlessly on both iOS and Android. Push notifications allow you to receive incoming calls without keeping the app running in the background, which saves a significant amount of battery life. Solid Security: It supports advanced encryption protocols such as TLS, SRTP, and ZRTP, ensuring total privacy for corporate communications. Efficient Call Management: It allows you to easily manage multiple SIP accounts, perform call transfers (both attended and blind), mute, hold, and organize contacts without any operational hassle. Ease of Use for daily tasks: Once the SIP account is properly configured, making and receiving day-to-day calls is fast and intuitive for any user.
改善点: Although it is a very comprehensive tool, there are a few areas where the application could improve: Initial Learning Curve: For non-technical users, the initial setup of SIP or network parameters (codecs, ports, STUN/TURN) can be somewhat complex and intimidating. Additionally, the desktop user interface feels a bit austere and outdated. Limited Call Recording: The native call recording feature is generally locked behind the paid versions (PRO). This can be a drawback if you need to record interactions right out of the box without upgrading. Lacking Phone Support: Direct phone support is very limited for standard users. In most cases, you have to rely entirely on their online documentation or email ticketing system, which doesn't always provide immediate responses.

タイトル: No support and developers don't know or care what they are doing.
投稿者: Bob アメリカのPresident/CEO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 通信, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 ソース：GetApp 共有 "No support and developers don't know or care what they are doing."
良い点: It registers to the PBX and I can assign different ringtones to each registration. That's about it. Sadly, this app is a prefect example of inexperienced amateurs or a company that simply couldn't care less about what they put out.
改善点: 1. Zoiper will not ring priority callers when the phone is in Do Not Disturb mode. This is an expected behavior - one which every native dialer properly does. 2. Huge waste of screen real-estate that could be used to provide easily touchable function buttons instead of the tiny ones at the top of the screen. 3. No floating icon for active calls!! Seriously!! Do you know how next to impossible it is to get back to a call once I've moved on to the home screen or worse - the phone decides to sleep?? 4. The tiny hold button on the top of the screen changes to an add call button after it is pressed!! There is a HUGE EXPANSE OF UNUSED SCREEN during a call and just little tiny function buttons at the top THAT MOVE AROUND?!?!? 5. Does not automatically put a Zoiper call on hold when answering another call on the native dialer. 6. Bluetooth volume and integration is just terrible. 7. Zoiper cannot deal with a VPN connection on the phone!! If I activate a VPN connection to my office I cannot make or receive any Zoiper calls. Well actually it seems I can place calls - just that nobody can hear me and I cannot hear them so obviously they're getting the media path all wrong!!

タイトル: Zoiper - One of the best sip clients ever seen!
投稿者: Paul ルーマニアのSenior ICT Specialist 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Zoiper - One of the best sip clients ever seen!"

タイトル: A 'good' product when operational, with Cirrus nuisance self-promotion built in for free
投稿者: Bob アメリカのVP Innovation 消費財, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A 'good' product when operational, with Cirrus nuisance self-promotion built in for free"
良い点: I like the ability that Cirrus links to SalesForce and Gmail and locates recipients in the SalesForce database and links emails to the Account/Contact activity log
改善点: Cirrus is not reliable in locating related SalesForce contacts and particularly not reliable locating contacts when using the 'Add to SalesForce', 'Custom' option that allows linking an email to a standard related lists such as linking an email to Opportunity or Case- there are many examples of these issues that often I've thought to cut-and-paste and email into a SalesForce activity would be faster. Another daily pain is when selecting another tab (instance) of Gmail, cirrus presents a sidebar that says, "Let's put this app to work!" When you're ready to go to work, you're required to click the "Continue" button, only to be greeted with another sidebar that says "Get More Done" that 'promotes/sells' cirrus features Book Meeting, Follow-Up Reminders, Sales Email Campaigns, Email Templates. If you do not select the "Get To Work!" button cirrus is not functional. Why is a productivity application like cirrus requiring me to tell cirrus separately to "Continue" and "Get To Work" when in fact these are redundant requests causing extra keystrokes? Why does not cirrus just start working for me without having to tell the application to start syncing my email (activities) to Gmail? Cirrus is counter-productive for a productivity application.

タイトル: CQ : our QMS best friend
投稿者: Andrea コスタリカのQuality Manger 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 医療機器, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "CQ : our QMS best friend"
良い点: I have been using CQ for +2 years. Since the first time that I started using it, I loved how easily you can understand performing all your transactions. In addition, it allows you to migrate different physical documents or records into the platform without losing any traceability. A highlight for us was electronic signatures 21 CFR compliant.Through this software, we accomplish on of our goals of having a 100% electronic QMS, Can't wait for the latest revision to include as part of this effort, the digital SOPs as a way to release or revise new docs.
改善点: Probably the way the permissions sets works. The software in general is very user friendly. Nevertheless, this aspect can be improved regarding the details associated with the permissions sets to understand the impact on your transactions.

タイトル: CQ Document Control, CAPA, and Audits
投稿者: Elizabeth アメリカのQuality Director バイオテクノロジー, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "CQ Document Control, CAPA, and Audits"
良い点: 21 CFR Part 11 compliance built-in is extremely useful, especially for document approvals and training. Workflows can be customized, and we have integrated our existing objects with CQ.
改善点: Audit trails are sometimes difficult to discern, as the user, time, and field are available, but not always the original and changed content.

タイトル: Great Features, not Great Support or Cost
投稿者: Audra アメリカのManager, Corporate Certifications 家電製品, 5,001～10,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Great Features, not Great Support or Cost"
良い点: We utilize ComplianceQuest for the Document Management component of our ISO Certifications. The system has all of the controls (and then some) necessary within a document management system. We liked the fact that beyond document management, CQ has the ability to send out and record trainings linked at a document level, which other SW platforms do not have.
改善点: Whenever we encounter a critical bug, it takes a year or longer to resolve with CQ. The support and escalation are just not there when it is needed most. There is a substantial fee associated with the cost of this platform which is yearly.

タイトル: Great Overall Quality system
投稿者: Laura アメリカのStaff Business Analyst, Quality Systems 医療機器, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Great Overall Quality system"
良い点: The CQ quality system is a full suite of products used for tracking all quality objects. I use Training, Complaints, NCs, CAPAs and Equipment module. With CQ being built on Salesforce, from the beginning we had much better visibility to our data for users and managers alike, creating dozens of dashboards utilizing SF power, from every module, literally at the click of some buttons and drag and drop functionality. This is light years ahead of our last eQMS, and one of the major selling points for us to move to CQ. Our users are able to easily train in CQ and managers can see their employee's metrics for training easily. The equipment module is simple and clean to use and we have taken advantage of the calibration and equipment event schedules to track those tasks. Our NC users have a CAPA request type to easily recommend what needs to become a CAPA, and when escalated a workflow creates that CAPA record for us, bringing over data already entered on the NC. We also did the same with SF Cases, bringing over relevant data to Complaints at the click of a button. This has reduced creation of these types of records so users have more time to investigate the issue, then they have to spend documenting it. CAPA/SCAR records are easy to create, investigate and recommend plans and actions, and follow up with VOE at the appropriate time.
改善点: As with all systems, CQ has some things to improve, as far as giving the users direction on the next action to take, making the workflow easier to track and understand from a coordinators view. Version 13 that just came out, will address some of those issues our users and coordinators still find a little frustrating.

タイトル: Integrated and flexible QMS solution
投稿者: Nicole アメリカのSr. Manager Quality Systems 医療機器, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Integrated and flexible QMS solution"
良い点: Out of all the systems we looked into, only ComplianceQuest was able to meet all the requirements put in place. We worked with the CQ teams to configure and test the system to fit our business needs. Through this process, they offered a lot of guidance on system options to meet needs with reduced configuration. Overall, good controls in place, layout is modern, reporting and data analytics is great and easy for users to manage. Love the dashboard capabilities, configurability and integration capability. System provides users with easy to follow layout and next steps.
改善点: CQ has a really complex backend. We had to make a shift moving into this system from being Quality managed to IT managed. Understood that this allows us a lot of the flexibility we need and it is working out fine. Majority of the issues we run into are permissions-related – which has been somewhat challenging to sort out, but we are getting there.

タイトル: Mailrelay experience
投稿者: Ballet Flamenco De Madrid スペインのProducer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 美術、工芸, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Mailrelay experience"
良い点: What I liked most about Mailrelay was the excellent and fast customer support. They quickly identified an issue with the shared sending IP, explained the situation clearly, and moved our account to a high-reputation IP at no additional cost. Their technical assistance was professional, efficient, and very helpful.
改善点: The main issue we experienced was related to the reputation of the shared sending IP, which caused some emails to be rejected by recipient servers and generated a significant number of soft bounces. However, the support team responded quickly and took effective action to resolve the problem.

タイトル: The best email platform I have ever used
投稿者: Xavier スペインのMarketing 認証済みLinkedInユーザー エンタテインメント, 自営業 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "The best email platform I have ever used"
良い点: Great technology, user interface, features (they keep adding new ones every week!), amazing balance between quality/price, with proper options for free users but great incentives to move to a paid/prepaid plans. I have been using other email platforms for many years and this is by far the best one.
改善点: The only cons is not being aware of their existence before. With so much noise in social media and websites it was difficult to discover them. But I'm glad I finally made it.

タイトル: There are better alternatives, but the free tier makes it a good choice
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "There are better alternatives, but the free tier makes it a good choice"
良い点: Mailrelay's free tier is so high, that it's likely that you won't paid for the service until you really grow up - and even then, its pricing is really cheap. Also, it has a ton of learning material and their support service is helpful. Watch out for their blog and their onboarding emails, they deliver a lot of useful tips and tricks. What I like the most about their blog, is that they don't only focus on giving advice on email marketing topics, they also cover digital marketing in general. Speaking more about the app, I think it's important to remark an interesting technology that they have: some time ago, they implemented "Smart Delivery", a feature that sends the emails first to the most active customers, making sure that your IP reputation is the highest possible.
改善点: Features and design-wise, their competitors are far more advanced. It's UI/UX is really old, and makes navigation a bit hard. And the automation features are quite limited compared on other big players on the market. But I have heard that they are working on this, so we probably will have more advanced marketing features soon.

タイトル: Mailrelay is the best option for freelances and small companies

タイトル: A Professional, Reliable, and Powerful Email Marketing Platform
投稿者: Christos ギリシャのCEO コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "A Professional, Reliable, and Powerful Email Marketing Platform"
良い点: Mailrelay is simple, professional, and surprisingly powerful. The interface is easy to understand, yet it includes all the features I need for email marketing. Setup was quick, performance is reliable, and it offers excellent value for both beginners and experienced users.
改善点: Honestly, I haven’t found any significant drawbacks so far. It covers everything I need, works reliably, and the interface is clean and intuitive. If I had to mention something, I would only like to see even more advanced automation templates in future updates.

タイトル: Teamtailor is the tool that has it all. A perfect balance of functionality and flexibility.
投稿者: John スウェーデンのHR- och Rekryteringsansvarig 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Teamtailor is the tool that has it all. A perfect balance of functionality and flexibility."
良い点: The candidate storage is great, easy to maneuver when you need to find that candidate from six months ago what-was-his-name, incredible to make sure no candidate is left unanswered and completely in regulation with GDPR. One less thing to worry about. The drag-and-drop bars connected to various triggers and the ease with which to combine this with other services to automise processes is brilliant. Lastly the career-site has it all while still being easy to design even for the complete novice. The chat-bubble connecting you directly to eventual candidates browsing your site is great - employees deserve as much service as customers. If not more. Aligning with business goals and justifying and measuring different approaches is essential and with the statistics tools built in it's easy to get a overview and from them creating more accurate performance reviews. Lastly the fact that Teamtailor is directly linked to most job advert-pages is truly a time-saver.
改善点: Right now my only problem is the calendar, for which I have no particular use. However I've been invited to participate in the beta-testing of a calendar in which the candidate can book his own interview - effectively rendering youcanbook.me or other third party services needless. So I'm hopeful to say the least!

タイトル: Easy to use and seamless

タイトル: The best recruitment system I have ever used!

良い点: I love that the system is modern, easy to use and have tons of smart functions that makes me and my colleagues save a lot of time when recruiting.
改善点: To be honest - nothing. I love everything about it.

タイトル: My Teamtailor Experience
投稿者: Stephanie フランスのTalent Scout Eラーニング, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "My Teamtailor Experience"
良い点: The customer service is excellent. Not only from our account manager [SENSITIVE CONTENT] but also the direct messaging via the platform. The responses are always quick and very helpful. It allows for a great overview of our open positions, where the candidates are in the pipeline, and triggers for aspects such as NPS are great. Being able to merge duplicate applications is also a great benefit.
改善点: I can't track which candidates specifically the NPS was sent to. The analytics page is sometimes confusing to understand the number of candidates that have tracked through my pipeline. When publishing new positions, we don't want the email to be sent out to candidates who are connected as oftentimes it's candidates that we wouldn't consider for another position or its noise for them and they ask for their profile to be deleted. However, there is no option to opt-out from this automatic emailer that is sent out from our side. Time in the state is also limited to days, whereas I would prefer it was limited to weekdays in terms of a tracking time.

タイトル: Excellent customization abilities within Scheduling and Reporting functions

良い点: The programming is intuitive and each section of a patient's account, such as patient data and claim data, communicates together (which improves ease of use and decreases labor costs).
改善点: It needs to have bidirectional communication with our EHR, Practice Fusion. Claims are sent from PF to CMD, but patient data is not communicated from CMD to PF, which costs us labor to input the schedule and patient data twice, once in each program.

タイトル: Training is taking too long and inadequate

良い点: Ability to enter claims quickly without having to go from platform to platform. Other than that I find it confusing to use.

タイトル: Very good and simple
投稿者: Sherlynn アメリカのClinic Manager 医療業務, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Very good and simple"
良い点: I like the simplicity of CMD and that if I ever have questions, there is a knowledge center available. If I have more complex questions, I can always reach out to the support chat. I really enjoy the chat feature.

タイトル: Cybersecurity Manager

良い点: Effortless segregation of duties: The granular, role-based delegation makes it incredibly easy to assign specific AD tasks (like password resets, user provisioning, or group modifications) to non-administrative operators and helpdesk staff without granting elevated Active Directory permissions. Simplified AD administration: Complex, time-consuming tasks like bulk user onboarding/offboarding, group updates, and template-based object creation are streamlined into a few clicks or fully automated workflows. Granular operator audit trails for investigations: It maintains an exact history of every action taken by delegated operators, making it straightforward to trace who performed a specific administrative change during internal investigations or audits. Rich, pre-built reporting: Comprehensive reports covering inactive accounts, locked-out users, group memberships, and NTFS permissions provide immediate visibility without needing complex PowerShell scripts.
改善点: Initial delegation setup: Defining custom technician roles and configuring multi-stage approval workflows requires careful upfront planning to align correctly with internal security policies. Interface density: Because the tool packs in so many administrative options, management tasks, and report categories, navigating the sub-menus can occasionally feel crowded. Automation rule learning curve: Fine-tuning complex, conditional automation workflows (such as multi-department offboarding procedures) takes time and testing to get completely right.

良い点: Zabbix is amazing. It's free open source software for monitoring IT infrastructure. I use it to track the health of my office laptops, router, network switches, everything. The web UI dashboard is easy to read and you can configure email notifications, which I have turned into helpdesk tickets for me to review by sending to my Helpdesk's email address.
改善点: It's definately a learning experience if you haven't used something like this before (which I hadn't). You have to learn about SNMP, managing the templates for the devices you want to monitor, setting up the hosts one-by-one for monitoring or using the scanner option and then tweaking what it finds. It's a lot to do at first but the reward is now I typically know about an issue in the office before anyone else even notices it, much less sends me a ticket about it. If you are multi-office it may be more than you want to undertake. Yes you can setup Proxies and connect them, but if you manage lots of locations you may want to look at something cloud hosted at that point? I feel the strength is managing on-prem with this solution.
