Their IT team programs the app, with all the logic and code that they know, then release it expecting normal people to proceed with equal logic. They may test it with their employees. Perhaps a "brake it" session. But when they have a difficulty, the IT guy looking over their shoulder explains their error. I GUARANTEE they never bring in a normal parent or administrator and say "go", and watch them setup and operate this app successfully without assistance.

タイトル: great app so far
投稿者: tracey アメリカのcoach スポーツ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "great app so far"
良い点: great free app to communicate with our team
改善点: would love to be able to set multiple reminders for the same event

タイトル: Stack Team App Review
投稿者: Robert アメリカのSports Director スポーツ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Stack Team App Review"
良い点: I like that this app works with Sports connect. The integration sends parents an invite to the app and they can see the game schedules on the app. This makes it so parent wont have to constantly ask when the game is or ask for a physical copy.
改善点: There are no cons about this app. I like using this app for my flag football league.

タイトル: Great cloud based PIMs
投稿者: Becca アメリカのVeterinarian 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 獣医, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Great cloud based PIMs"
良い点: I really like the team responsiveness to issues via the chat function and their willingness to make changes to their program based on the desires of the users. The flexibility with how to set up your own system and templates. Scheduling appointments is a breeze even if you have to register a new client they updated the system to accommodate that in a recent update.
改善点: I dislike how much the system changes sometimes. I personally like the updates, but communicating that to my staff (especially the parttime staff) sometimes is difficult or frustrating due to the changes from week to week. I do not care much for the 2 factor log-in feature since we have multiple technicians and doctors moving throughout the clinic. We use a shared technician log-in for the clinic.

タイトル: Recommend Digitail
投稿者: Karen アメリカのOperations Manager 獣医, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Recommend Digitail"
良い点: For a cloud base program, the initial product that would get the hospital up and running is very user friendly. If there is an issue the team via support tickets will work on fixing the issue. If it is a big concern that requires technical support they work on giving a resolution within a reasonable time frame.
改善点: As a new product, there are a lot of small items that are not efficient for a general practice. Lots of tickets are created to make the workflow easier for the hospital.

タイトル: Admin Manager
投稿者: Nancy 米領ヴァージン諸島のAdmin Mgr 獣医, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Admin Manager"
良い点: The beginning when I had hope that it was going to be a great new system for our organization, with plenty of support.
改善点: Customer service has been absolutely dreadful. It is sometimes days before we hear back on an issue and some of them we are still waiting to be resolved for weeks. We have several serious issues i.e., cannot add or change client addresses, none of our client's open balances transferred over from our old HIPPO software which means $1000's of lost revenue. System is overall clunky and some tasks require multiple clicks before you get to what you need. This is a Romanian-based company that rolled out into the US market way too soon without the proper tech support.

タイトル: Digitail is the way of the future for Vet Clinics
投稿者: Lynn カナダのPractice Manager 獣医, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Digitail is the way of the future for Vet Clinics"
良い点: We like the reminder system, the client chat, the client app, the appointment scheduling, the support, the value for the cost, the AI, and patient managment.
改善点: The learning curve is very steep, it takes a while to learn Digitail. I see they've come out with personalized training now, haven't checked that out yet, but they usually fix what we don't like.

タイトル: Digitail after 4 months
投稿者: sebastian アメリカのManaging Partner 獣医, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Digitail after 4 months"
良い点: Digitail gave us the foundation to modernize our hospital. We transitioned from paper records to a fully digital workflow, implemented online forms, client communication tools, AI-assisted medical records, and a client app, all within a single platform. The system is intuitive enough for new team members to learn quickly while still offering the flexibility needed for a busy veterinary practice. Their team has also been highly responsive to feedback and genuinely interested in improving the product based on real-world hospital needs.
改善点: One area that still needs improvement is the accuracy and consistency of the AI Scribe feature. We've found that dictation performs noticeably better on laptops and desktop computers than on iPads, where transcription accuracy can be less reliable. As a practice that relies heavily on medical documentation, this occasionally creates extra editing work for clinicians. Beyond that, there are still some workflow and reporting features that could benefit from greater customization as practices become more advanced in their use of the platform. That said, Digitail's team has been highly receptive to feedback and continues to release meaningful improvements based on user input.

タイトル: Reliable Infrastructure Automation for AWS
投稿者: Twinkle インドのBusiness Development Executive 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Reliable Infrastructure Automation for AWS"
良い点: nstead of manually creating resources one by one, you define everything in a template (YAML or JSON), and CloudFormation handles the setup automatically. That means fewer human errors and consistent environments every time you deploy. Another strong point is its “infrastructure as code” approach—once your template is ready, you can version it, reuse it, and even roll back changes if something goes wrong. This makes managing complex cloud setups much easier.
改善点: What I liked least about AWS CloudFormation is that it has a steep learning curve, especially for beginners. Writing and managing templates can feel complex and time-consuming compared to some newer infrastructure-as-code tools. Debugging stack failures can also be challenging at times due to less intuitive error messages.

タイトル: Cloudformation : Best tool to automate aws cloud infrastructure creation.
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 小売, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Cloudformation : Best tool to automate aws cloud infrastructure creation."
良い点: aws cloud formation can creates cloud infrastructure using declarative method without manual intervention.This helps creating cloud infra irrespective of AWS UI updates .It enable resource creation with simple commands and templates, enable complex cloud infrastructure creations and troubleshooting guide. There is large aws support to solve issue related to cloudformation template.
改善点: Template creation can be excausting due to interconnecting components when multiple resources are used and they are interlinked to transfer data within the resource. Managing and viewing budget and cost of resources utilized would not be available at ease and would need to login to console to view billing details. Creating resources can take time as compared to creating resources in UI as it becomes more interactive experience for developer to exactly view what cloud resources are created and there interlinked components.

タイトル: Potential for greatness
投稿者: Philipp 英国のLead Engineer コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Potential for greatness"
良い点: Cloudformation natively supports everything in AWS so it is already solidly ahead of third party providers. It is an easy to understand tool.
改善点: The documentation on AWS has always been subpar for cloudformation. For new products, they are more willing to release examples, but usually, one needs to visit a blog or similar. Cloudformation stacks are very vulnerable to drift. If this ever happens, this is irrecoverable.

タイトル: AWS CloudFormation enables reliable automated infrastructure management as code
投稿者: Estrella スペインのSoftware Engineer コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "AWS CloudFormation enables reliable automated infrastructure management as code"
良い点: Declarative templates streamline workflow automation across environments. Security stack sets manage access well, deployment setup is reliable, and developer tools simplify infra updates without extra cost.
改善点: Stack drift detection is slow, debugging nested template errors has a steep learning curve, setup for complex setups takes time, and customer support relies heavily on general AWS documentation.

タイトル: Reliable IAC service for AWS native workflows
投稿者: connor 英国のIT Team Lead メディア制作, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Reliable IAC service for AWS native workflows"
良い点: Incredibly powerful for repetitive infrastructure provisioning; templates let you define resources and deploy consistently across environments. It handles life cycle management very well, including updates and deleting, so related resources can be managed as a single operational resource or unit rather than individual components. More advanced features help this stand out as a powerful tool, such as change sets, drift detection, and automatic dependency management make it very useful for administrators to interface with - regardless or single account, multi account, and single/multi region.
改善点: It can feel very verbose and AWS specific; which can feel less flexible than some newer IAC tools and may be slightly more complex when dealing with multi cloud environments. Complexity can scale up quickly leaving administrators struggling to read and maintain infrastructure when managing nested stacks and dependencies. It is advisable to run workflows in Cloudformation entirely in the AWS ecosystem as this, like most AWS services, finds its home best when interfacing with other AWS services and tools.

タイトル: The best ELT tool on the market
投稿者: James アメリカのSenior Analyst 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 消費者サービス, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "The best ELT tool on the market"
良い点: -Extremely easy deployment with cloud formation template. -Excellent pre-authored integrations that are easily extensible/customizable. -Easy to use UI to build complex transformations. -Extremely flexible logic with static and grid variables to intelligently execute jobs and branch as needed.
改善点: -No automated scheduling based on dependent table updates. (This is possible to set up, but not out of the box.) -Support SLAs have gotten worse over time.

タイトル: As an ETL it is robust
投稿者: Dan 英国のIT Manager 再生可能エネルギー、環境, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "As an ETL it is robust"
良い点: There is a vast number of options and data connectors on offer.
改善点: When communicating with the support and billing teams, they are never around to answer. Phone support is useless as no one answers, and it takes a few days to get an answer via email. Took for ever to switch billing from credit card to invoicing.

タイトル: Matillion Usability
投稿者: Marcus Vinícius ブラジルのBack End Developer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 金融サービス, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Matillion Usability"
良い点: The ease to use, Matillion has a great set of tools that make complex and difficult process more simple and fast to develop.
改善点: There are many tools in Matillion that doesn't have enough attention and because of that these tools are fragile, while some of them do not work.

タイトル: Matillion - ELT process made easy , perfect integration tool for snowflake users !
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 通信, 5,001～10,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Matillion - ELT process made easy , perfect integration tool for snowflake users !"
良い点: Matillion is a cloud based ELT tool and it is very easy to use . The data transfer rates are incredibly good since the product locates in cloud infrastructure and the infrastructure can be scaled up when required.
改善点: The connectors to other data sources are limited when compare to what other rival product are offering . The job monitoring functionality is limited , the scheduling and job log features could have been improved. The GitHub integration could have been straight forward.

タイトル: Easy to use solution, allowing rapid delivery of ELT processes
投稿者: Graham 英国のSolution Architect マーケティング、広告, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Easy to use solution, allowing rapid delivery of ELT processes"
良い点: - Very intuitive design environment - super quick to learn. - Components map closely to SQL capabilities in Redshift. - Easy to view the SQL generated. - Sample, row count, and data lineage make it easy to unit test as you build. - Powerful management options via REST API (orchestration, Github integration, etc.). - Native AWS integration. - Aggressive release cycle, constantly adding new features. - Easy to document in-workflow. - Lots of third party integrations.
改善点: - User concurrency/licencing model (simple, but can't be customised to fit your need). - Exception handling could be improved. - A single Task View would be helpful for multi-environment/project support.

タイトル: Astonishing Look and Feel
投稿者: Mihai ルーマニアのFreelancer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 自営業 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Astonishing Look and Feel"
良い点: I have liked the way that the performance of the freelancers is nicely and graphically represented concerning the time that they have spent on their work. The Graphical User Information of this Tracking Desktop App is quite impressive.
改善点: I am coming from a background of using Tracking Desktop Apps such as the ones maintained by "Freelancer", "Guru", and even "Upwork". They are more related to the direct relationship between an individual freelancer and the freelancing portal. I have seen the "Traqq" App on a "Mac O.S. X" machine. It has a great design. It is nicely integrated into the System-Tray. Functionally, it is better suited for a Project Manager who is watching their whole Team at once. What has impressed me is the way that the time is nicely and graphically represented following the performance of the freelancers. Still, for an individual freelancer, it is a little bit too much that somebody lower than the Project Management level would require.

タイトル: Traqq-An innovative way to track remote hours
投稿者: Elizabeth アメリカのHuman Resource Consultant 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 人材, 自営業 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Traqq-An innovative way to track remote hours"
良い点: Traqq's application is set up with ease in just minutes. Inexpensive when compared to other time tracking software. An ethical and simplified approach to monitoring remote employee activity, with the ability for employees to monitor themselves. Understanding how their activity level affects their performance and task completion success, enables the employee to improve their work flow output. The app conducts frequent screenshots, which are blurred, protecting any confidential information, with only the website being visible.
改善点: Allowing the employee to delete their time, is a red flag for me. Seeing that would raise questions in my mind, as to why they were deleting a block of time. The drawback is not necessarily the deletion but that when the "Deleted Time" report is ran, the screenshots are missing. The report only includes the amount of time that was deleted. It would be better if those screenshots were still available somehow.

タイトル: Good Work
投稿者: Lawunn フィンランドのManager 経理, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Good Work"
良い点: The team management feature is excellent. It's easy to manage the entire team and see performance levels of each employee.
改善点: While Traqq is great for time tracking, it doesn't fully replace project management tools. Having more project management features would be nice​.

タイトル: Fantastic for managing remote workers
投稿者: Trent 日本のHR Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 人材, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Fantastic for managing remote workers"
良い点: As a HR manager who looks after remote workers. I can say this is simply the best. Everything you need to see is intuitive and accessible with a simple click. You can literally see the time spent on each app and with the inbuilt pay rate calculations, payroll for work reported on vs work done is a breeze. Reporting is no different, reports are easily generated for your team and can be accessed by other HR personnel who may need to access it at a later date.
改善点: A phone app would be a great addition to the software. But besides that I don't see anything I dislike.

タイトル: Most User-Friendly Time Tracking App
投稿者: Samia アラブ首長国連邦のAssistant Manager HR 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 人材派遣、人材紹介, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Most User-Friendly Time Tracking App"
良い点: The apps best feature, with accordance to my job requirement, would be being able to track our employees' time spent searching for potential talent for the positions assigned to them daily while also generating a report weekly for my Manager to review. It was so easy for me to get a grasp of all the features in this app. My job requires me to ensure our company's remote employees and in-house employees are all working towards reaching our quarterly target, and by using this app I was successfully able to monitor the time they spent in actually finding a solid candidate pool. The screenshots of their screens gave me an understanding of whether they were making candidate calls or if they were just slacking off at low activity points on their timeline. Traqq is a highly effective time tracking tool and I would recommend the app to any small enterprise or moderate sized organizations too.
改善点: Traqq has been a fantastic tool for me as an Assistant Manager incharge of observing employee productivity. A very minor con would be that the screenshots need to be blurred out 10% more as, at times, I could make out some of the employees personal information such as e-mails or messages done in their off time when they have forgotten to pause their tracking or delete such screenshots.

タイトル: ActiTIME - Tracking and Billing Made Easy
投稿者: Joseph アメリカのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "ActiTIME - Tracking and Billing Made Easy"
良い点: The pros for this software are easily the ability to host the software yourself; I currently have the software self-hosted and have a one user license at the moment. Really nice features that provide everything I need on a daily basis to track, invoice and get paid.
改善点: The software does have some features and nice to haves missing, but overall I feel it’s a pretty descent package for the price they charge. One feature I would love to see is when a time is started for tracking, it also timestamps WHEN it was started and WHEN it was stopped instead of just providing the total time.

タイトル: Excellent visibility into time, cost, and team performance
投稿者: Shah インドのManaging director コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Excellent visibility into time, cost, and team performance"
良い点: actiTIME gives me complete control and visibility over how time and resources are being used in the company. The reporting tools are the strongest feature, they make it simple to analyze productivity, monitor budgets, and evaluate project profitability without complicated spreadsheets.
改善点: I would love to see more visualization options within reports, such as interactive dashboards that update automatically.

タイトル: User friendly and able to provide basic Timesheet records
投稿者: Lye Yoong マレーシアのManager, Human Resource & Administration 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 石油、エネルギー, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 ソース：GetApp 共有 "User friendly and able to provide basic Timesheet records"
良い点: User friendly and easy to master its setting and features. Reporting are quite flexible and has a few choices to choose from. Recommended to company which is looking for a tool for monitoring of project costing by man hour as a start
改善点: User setting by different level of authority shall be established User deletion or archive shall be enable for better housekeeping of the user database

タイトル: actiTIME has been great for time-tracking projects in our business
投稿者: Jason アメリカのCo-Owner 情報技術、情報サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "actiTIME has been great for time-tracking projects in our business"
良い点: Offers quite a bit of functionality for free. Time tracking and the ability to carry that information over into invoices are critical features we need to complement the other SaaS products that we use (wave, clickup, etc). Project setup and time-tracking work very well for us and does everything we currently need.
改善点: The reports/invoices are still a little clunky compared to the features offered by Wave and other competitors. As far as I know there is no way to have the invoices remember recurring billing items that are not related to expenses or time-tracking. We would like a fixed monthly billing item on each of our invoices, currently we add those by hand.

タイトル: Review of actiTIME after 1 year of use
投稿者: Eric アメリカのDirector, Global Engineering Services 自動車, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Review of actiTIME after 1 year of use"
良い点: 1. Easy to Administrate 2. Easy to use 3. Good Training features 4. Thorough selection of report types
改善点: Would like to be able to customize reports and then make the report set-up available to other users.

タイトル: Catering with Ease!
投稿者: Mai アメリカのManaging Director 認証済みLinkedInユーザー ホスピタリティ, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Catering with Ease!"
良い点: Caterease is wildly affordable platform for our small boutique catering firm. Our chef loves the updating and managing his new and seasonal recipes within the software.
改善点: It did seem to feel outdated overtime. With so much competition in the market, I did find It hard for Caterease to keep up!

タイトル: The name says it all! Caterease has put the Ease into our Catering Operations
投稿者: Melissa アメリカのOffice Manager 食品、飲料, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "The name says it all! Caterease has put the Ease into our Catering Operations"
良い点: The customization of EVERY ASPECT of Caterease is one of the reasons why we love it so much. Everything can be made to suit your individual businesses needs. You can use their basic templates for prints such as contracts, receipts, billing statements and more or create your own with whatever information you would like. Every single bit of information can be displayed or removed from prints. Anything!! You can even customize your screen views. We have 6 different users linked to our Caterease and each users desktop/window views are customized down to the theme color. We have 2 divisions to our catering company, one is rather simple and the other is very complex. We have one user set up for the simple division and have cut out 80% of the features Caterease offers from that users display because we do not use them with that division so now, those features that we use for the complex catering side don't clutter up or confuse our simple home meal delivery user. The reports and query features are amazing. You can pull a report or query for literally any piece of information the you want. Want a query of all events that had more than 20 peoples worth of rice pilaf in the month of June 2 years ago, its one click away with Caterease. I've been in the catering business for 10+ years and Caterease is hands down the best Catering Software out there if you want to make things your own and customized to your business. I could go on for days about why I love Caterease!
改善点: Because it is so big and customizable, it does take a while to set up. You can come into it new and work off templates and be just fine but if you want to really take advantage of all the great features Caterease has, be ready to spend some time setting it up. Although it may take some time to setup, once you do, you are all set! With the endless video tutorials and help center articles, you have everything you will need to set things up your way.

タイトル: Would Not Purchase Again
投稿者: Emelie アメリカのGeneral Manager 飲食店, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Would Not Purchase Again"
良い点: I liked how it was seamless when bringing outside orders in. It kept our team organized and on the same page.
改善点: I did not like the user interface of Caterease. The learning curve was extremely long, especially for the less tech savvy of the team. It was very difficult to operate in, and the ease of use was certainly lacking.

タイトル: Very Powerful, can do a lot, but too much for my needs
投稿者: Todd アメリカのOwner ホスピタリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Very Powerful, can do a lot, but too much for my needs"
良い点: Caterease has a ton of options and easy to get information out of it as long as you are a subscriber. The Subscription is pretty steep but if you are doing 6 and 7 figures in sales it is worth it. I am a small shop it was too much for what i needed.
改善点: The Price is too steep for my shop. I have found other software providers but there are some short comings i have to deal with.

タイトル: The Detailed Catering Engine That Keeps Our Complex Operations Organized
投稿者: Maxwell アメリカのGeneral Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー レジャー、旅行、観光, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "The Detailed Catering Engine That Keeps Our Complex Operations Organized"
良い点: The sheer depth of functionality for catering operations is unmatched. I rely heavily on the customizable event prints and screen displays to ensure my team only sees the information relevant to their specific roles. It completely eliminates the risk of double booking rooms or equipment, which used to be a major headache for us. The ability to generate detailed kitchen prep lists, pack lists, and financial reports from a single data entry point is a massive time saver.
改善点: The software interface looks quite dated and feels clunky compared to modern web applications. The learning curve is notoriously steep, and it requires significant training for new staff members to feel confident using it. It can also run a bit slow when navigating between different screens or pulling large queries. Furthermore, to access the best features you really need the expensive professional tier, and any custom web form integration usually requires calling customer service rather than doing it yourself.

タイトル: Gagelist is a game changer!
投稿者: Casey アメリカのSupply Chain Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 石油、エネルギー, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Gagelist is a game changer!"
良い点: Calibration shouldn't be difficult to track and maintain. Gagelist is cost-effective, easy to use, and makes calibration less of a hassle; it's calibration software designed for the modern world.
改善点: The language is a bit different than what I am used to (i.e. control no. as opposed to serial no.), but not to the point that it deterred me from switching.

タイトル: Small Machine & Manufacturing Shop Review
投稿者: Hailey アメリカのQuality 機械工業, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Small Machine & Manufacturing Shop Review"
良い点: Easy, clean and simple lay out makes it very quick to find or search for what you need, and to print reports for audits or reviews. The app makes this a game changer as far as ease of use and utility. Being able to look up a gage on the factory floor, and being able to ensure it's calibration status gives us very quick assurance.
改善点: I wish I could remove the options in the gage descriptions we do not as a company want to use, such as specific manufactures, Aquisition dates, cost, ect. It would be nice to able to customize and make the information screen smaller and quicker, and it would help prevent issues of people putting incorrect information into different tabs.

タイトル: Review from a french user
投稿者: Didier フランスのCustomer Support Representative 医療機器, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Review from a french user"
良い点: Our company is based in France but has an office in US. It is easy to share and update information. My US co-worker uses it and never reported problem or had question about its use. The same test and measure equipment can be assigned to a different person after a calibration, traceability is then easier to achieve because information is directly updated. I never suffered from disconnections and the site is always accessible. I regularly discover new features in the Web version. And I can always ask for a new feature if I think it is missing. タイトル: Superb cloud-based software tool with powerful text analytics with social media integration.
投稿者: Wasim 英国のTeaching Assistant & Demonstrator 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 高等教育 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Superb cloud-based software tool with powerful text analytics with social media integration."
良い点: The ability for those from the social sciences to be able to import and/or retrieve social media data, including historical data from Twitter, and analyse the data in order to answer research questions. This is because other tools may require a computer science background. Consequently, DiscoverText has been used in answering important social science questions leading to peer reviewed outputs. Over the years I have seen many tools appear and slowly wither away, however, DiscoverText has stood the test of time and has been growing in popularity. DiscoverText is not limited to academic uses and has a number of neat uses in the commercial world. A useful feature applicable to the commercial domain is the ability to retrieve and/or import data from Twitter and identify influential Twitter users, with the additional ability to use machine learning to sift influential users into different groups. For example, a football club may be interested to find out whether influential users are fans of the club or whether it is opposition fans causing a storm. To the best of my knowledge, no other tool is capable of doing this with this level of accuracy.
改善点: To be fair this is not a limitation of DiscoverText per se, as this is a restriction from Twitter, but there is a limit to how many units of tweets can be exported per day. This is not a major issue because there are enough features in DiscoverText that you may not necessarily need to export the data. This is particularly true with a recent integration with NodeXL which provides the ability to export directly to a format supported by NodeXL.

タイトル: A much better way to scrape data than learning how to code an API
投稿者: Christine アメリカのWater Treatment Consultant 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 環境サービス, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "A much better way to scrape data than learning how to code an API"
良い点: My review of DiscoverText is a bit limited because I'm really only using it for Twitter. That said, the features are incredible. I know a bit about coding, but the prospect of learning JSON to use Twitter's API was doable but daunting. When I came across DiscoverText I was so pleased to find a way to search, use, and categorize Twitter data that made sense and would save me A LOT of time. I didn't anticipate getting access to so much useful metadata that was easy to navigate and use, so I was pleasantly surprised. The built-in bucket and dataset features are great ways to organize the massive amount of Twitter data that can be collected. The ability to code the data with peers within DiscoverText is also super useful. I really can't exaggerate how many features DiscoverText has that I didn't think I would need but have used to improve the quality of my scholarship.
改善点: The software has many features that I didn't find on my own, so the UI could be improved a bit. That said, the one-on-one tutorial that the founder provides helps mitigate this issue. The tutorial videos are helpful too! You'll just have to be prepared to set aside a few hours to really learn the program.

Another con, in my point of view, is the obscurity of metadata meanings and algorithms. I cannot understand what some of the means and how they are calculated. "I thought the process was pretty revealing actually. As the viewer it was interesting to see how they handled the format-their comfort level with answering the questions within the time limit, and if they looked in the camera (or not)." "I found that Spark Hire was very convenient to use and gave me a way to do an initial interview of a large number of candidates in an efficient manner. Since I tend to have large candidate pools, the videos were able to give me an initial assessment to determine who I wanted to do in person interviews with. Particularly effective when dealing with out of area applicants." "Excellent tool that allowed us to consider more candidates. Previously we had to select 7 or less and coordinate a group schedule to interview face to face. Spark hire allowed us to consider 28 candidates remotely and at each interview panel members pace." "I really liked using the Spark Hire Video system as it allowed me to review the candidates on my own schedule. I could also review the videos a second or third time while I was reviewing the resumes and applications. "
改善点: Again, I'd like to share feedback I have received from hiring managers. Keep in mind some of these may just be viewer/reviewer error. "A good candidate might get screened out if they are not as tech savvy as other candidates. That might be fine for a tech job but not a relevant for others." "What I didn’t like was the review options within Spark. It was essentially a STAR ranking system with comments. Once submitted, you cannot go back and make edits." タイトル: Spark Hire Makes Hiring More Efficient

良い点: Spark Hire is the "new normal" for hiring, helping to make the hiring process more efficient while still maintaining a personal touch. It allows you to set up either one-way or two way interviews with potential candidates, allowing great screening prior to final in-person interviews. It is ideal for all sizes of companies and for most (if not all) positions. I like that the questions can be customized, you can create different custom question sets, create video intros and outros, and the entire service is branded for your company. There is the ability (with some accounts, depends on price) to have multiple jobs open and have multiple users (i.e. the entire hiring team) who review submissions. The program is incredibly user-friendly from both the company perspective as well as the candidate perspective. There is a great knowledge base as well as video tutorials, and for the company there is a terrific onboarding service. I like that there are a variety of pricing levels with various features to best fit a user's needs. For me, I appreciate that my clients who use Spark Hire can go month-to-month on use when they are not on a complete hiring rampage. We can essentially turn the program on and off on an as-needed basis which makes it incredibly cost effective for our needs. For power users there are annual payment plans to help drive costs lower.
改善点: Up to this point, I have not found any "cons" that would prevent me from using or recommending the product. I guess one "con" would be getting potential candidates to actually get over their reticence about doing a video interview, but honestly if they refuse then they are generally not the type of candidates that my clients would be looking for.

Helium 10 offers a lot of the same functionality of jungle scout and their overlay chrome extension is top notch. That piece of Helium 10 is what truly brought me to Helium 10, I couldn't say which is better between Helium 10's extension and Junglescout's, they do a lot of the same functions, but what I can say is that you won't find any better than those two. If you're currently deciding which ecommerce research tool to use, I would say Helium 10 definitely deserves to be in the number 1 or number 2 position, and when it comes right down to it, when you have a platform as nice as Helium 10's that rivals jungle scout's as much as it does, all that is left is preference. That being said, I am more of a Jungle scout man, but you can't go wrong with Helium 10.
改善点: I would say the thing I didn't like about Helium 10 (and again, this is only because i have to choose something I don't like, the platform is all-around great). Is the "success score", it feels a little under developed, I am no programmer and could be completely wrong about that. It is completely possible that I feel this way simply because I have seen Jungle Scout's niche score system, and it is fantastic, but I would say that would be one of the only cons I have had with Helium 10. But don't let that discourage you, if Helium 10 is the platform you are gunning for, both are great, and I would say choosing between the Jungle Scout's niche score system and Helium 10's success score system is a little bit more than just preference, I think Jungle scout's is inherently better, at least by a little, but that small of a difference, over one functionality should most definitely not be the deciding factor.

良い点: Tradogram has made our processes run smooth and straight-forward. Everyone - from the Site Supervisors, trades to the office staff, have been able to use and navigate without any issues. Some of the site supervisors have never really used a computer in their job, and they were able to create PO's and understand the system within 30 mins of using it. I am very pleased with how easy it is to create a PO, how easy the approval process is for all parties & how the program communicates through email (with just a click of a button you can view a PO or approve/reject). Everything is customizable and we were able to tailor the program to work exactly how we envisioned. We were even able to add a link to a SharePoint folder right on the PO itself, so trades could access the project files. Another huge positive, is that this program is cloud-based, so anyone can access it from anywhere. It has made working remotely infinitely easier. Also, budgets are easy to import and track by accessing the "Spend Report". This is a huge deal for us, so we can see the original budget vs. what we've spent to show what is remining for each line-item.
改善点: Initially with the integration setup, there was an issue with getting the vendors to push over from QuickBooks Online and a lot of the GL accounts were not communicating. But with the help of the support team, we were able to get to the bottom of all the issues quickly and effectively. They were super helpful in getting it working and integrated properly. Also, not really a con because we got around it, but we were told there was an iPhone app coming out for this software before Christmas, and it still hasn't been released. We rely heavily on apps for communicating/working remotely, since our whole crew is working from different cities & provinces. So instead, we decided to get our site supervisors iPads and we saved the web login page to the home screen of the iPad, so it works just like an app. It seems to work better anyway because the screen is bigger and easier to navigate on.

タイトル: ASTERIA Warpを約2年使用した感想
投稿者: 表示する詳細を増やす 匿名レビュアー 情報技術、情報サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "ASTERIA Warpを約2年使用した感想"

改善点: 価格にも影響するため、なかなか難しいとは思うがどのバージョンでもサブフロー機能が使えると管理も楽になるため助かる。

タイトル: UIが分かりやすく使いやすいため、大活躍しています
投稿者: 表示する詳細を増やす 匿名レビュアー 情報技術、情報サービス, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "UIが分かりやすく使いやすいため、大活躍しています"
良い点: この手のツールはUIの分かりやすさ・使いやすさが第一だと考えており、ASTERIA Warpの最も優れている点は正にそのUIの分かりやすさ・使いやすさだと思います。
改善点: ASTERIA Warpに限らずですが、GUIでの開発ツールではいくら簡単に処理が作れると言っても、ある程度の規模・複雑さを超えると、作成の難易度が急に高くなると感じています。 やりたいことがどうすると実現できるか、どう作るとよいかをアドバイスしてくれるような機能があると助かります。

タイトル: 自動化の可能性と学習のハードル
投稿者: 表示する詳細を増やす MAKI 日本の主任 コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "自動化の可能性と学習のハードル"
良い点: XMLベースの定義を手打ちで行う必要がなく、特にフローデザイナーを用いて視覚的にフローを構築できる点が大変魅力的です。これは、以前手動作業でXMLを扱っていた身としては大きな利点で、エラーの減少や作業の効率化がにつながっています。また、ツール自体がJavaエンジン上で動作するため、特定の基盤に依存せずに柔軟に環境を構築できる点も評価できます。
改善点: 一方で、ツール固有の制約が存在し、すべての要件に対応できるわけではないのがデメリットと感じています。また、初心者にとっては、フローデザイナーの起動や使用方法の学びのコストが高く、作業が億劫に感じられることもあります。これらの点は、慣れるまでの時間と多少の努力が必要でした。

タイトル: Great Tool for Zoho Users, Solid Team Collaboration Platform
投稿者: Chinna Siva Krishna インドのMERN STACK Developer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 教育管理, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Great Tool for Zoho Users, Solid Team Collaboration Platform"
良い点: Zoho Cliq is simple to use, integrates seamlessly with other Zoho applications, and provides real-time messaging with customizable channels.
改善点: Some of the features, such as voice/video calling, are not as refined or stable as those of rivals like Slack or Microsoft Teams.

タイトル: Use Communication and Employee/Network Management Tool
投稿者: Mallory アメリカのClinical Operations Manager 病院、ヘルスケア, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Use Communication and Employee/Network Management Tool"
良い点: I love the variety of features and permission sets. It is very helpful with a larger group of employees as a manager. The features I use most include calls, channel creation, pinning messages for organization, monitoring the network communication.
改善点: I think that it can be quite buggy at times with profile pics glitching or not loading messages. Its also sometimes difficult to scroll back through past chats as you can only go back to a date not a time.

タイトル: Solid team chat/collaboration app with an extensive development backend for customizations
投稿者: Rick メキシコのDirector 認証済みLinkedInユーザー デザイン, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Solid team chat/collaboration app with an extensive development backend for customizations"
良い点: Cliq integrates well with other Zoho apps, particularly helpful in Contact. All the basic chat and collaboration features are there in a familiar user interface. It's possible for advanced users to create extensions, custom integrations, bots, and commands with a powerful development backend and make these customizations available throughout your organization and team.
改善点: Unless you're already using a bunch of Zoho apps there's no reason to switch from Slack, Flock, or Asana, which area already mature platforms. Compared to these other apps, particularly Flock, the UI is a bit obtuse and hard to get a clear overview of. I particularly disliked the double panes within a chat window (opening the settings for a bot, for example).

タイトル: An efficient Team Communication tool.
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 経営コンサルティング, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "An efficient Team Communication tool."
良い点: Zoho Cliq is a very special communication tool. The best thing about it is that it has many excellent features that make team communication smooth. With its help, teams can easily stay connected with each other. It is a very powerful tool that brings teams together in one place with its modern features. Whether it's through chatting, audio, or video calling, it is an excellent tool for everything. This platform helps in completing any task easily because its interface feels very user-friendly, which also saves time. It is considered useful for both small and large companies because while working, it truly helps in increasing productivity along with making your communications faster.
改善点: The thing I felt least liked about this platform is that sometimes the customization options and notification management feel a bit complicated, due to which the user has to face some difficulties. But I would also say that if you have to handle large-scale work in minutes, then its a very good platform either. These are my personal experiences.

タイトル: Slack alternative to those of us with limited software budgets
投稿者: Leland アメリカのPresident マーケティング、広告, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Slack alternative to those of us with limited software budgets"
良い点: Clean interface, easy to update settings, like how easy it is to invite new people to the platform. Easy to create channels and direct messages for different topcis.
改善点: Wish I didn't have to use MarkDown for some formatting, it's not how I think about formatting vs. some sort of easy to use tool bar to make the text more easily formatted.

タイトル: Very good value for your money!

改善点: the library is missing some deep-dive learning, courses tend to be level 200 at the most the structure might be boring, the introduction part into each chapter is long and unnecessary the course management page is needlessly complex

タイトル: Good not great
投稿者: Mitch 英国のHR Business Partner 小売, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Good not great"

タイトル: One of the best platform for learning new things

タイトル: Half baked product
投稿者: Nicole アメリカのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 消費者サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Half baked product"

改善点: Automatic charges integrated with Square failed the first month we had this set-up. There was another error I received when refunding someone through Zoho Billing saying it failed but when I logged into square it had been pushed through and just didn't show in the Zoho Portal.

タイトル: Setting up recurring invoices for maintenance contracts actually makes sense.
投稿者: Keith アメリカのField Operations Manager ファシリティサービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Setting up recurring invoices for maintenance contracts actually makes sense."
良い点: Managing monthly billing for our facility maintenance contracts used to eat up half a day every week. Now, Zoho Billing handles all the subscription stuff so I don't have to babysit it. It auto-generates invoices, sends out client reminders, and keeps track of who’s paid and who’s falling behind.
改善点: The mobile app feels like an afterthought when I'm out at job sites and need to pull up billing details in a hurry. I really wish the reporting export options gave me more control over date ranges, especially for those quarterly reviews I have to do with our finance person.

タイトル: Great for automating payments from clients
投稿者: Matthew アメリカのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー マーケティング、広告, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great for automating payments from clients"
良い点: Really easy to set up, and integrated with the merchant processing of my choice. When we first switched over Zoho subscriptions were the only tool that could email multiple reminders to the clients prior to the billing renewal which I feel is great for subscription services. The customer portal on the backend allows for customers to change their credit card information without me or one of my team members to have to do it manually. Super time saver. It also notifies my team when a payment doesn't go through for whatever reason and can automatically retry the card again. When we first started, it gave up to $50k worth of transactions as a free trial. Meaning you don't have to pay for a subscription until you reach 50k worth of transactions or a certain number of clients. Really cool.
改善点: The only thing I didn't like was that I couldn't do a one time payment easily. Sometimes we have one time jobs such as web development or consulting, and it makes it kind of hard to use just this one system. We had to also get Zoho invoice to complement what we were doing. So unless you are doing just recurring subscriptions you'll need to get an invoicing tool as well. Als ran into problems with the customer portal, but most of my clients didn't wnat to log in so it wasn't that big of a deal.

タイトル: Easy to use to improve business strategies and communication
投稿者: Christiane ブラジルのEntrepreneur 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 人材, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Easy to use to improve business strategies and communication"
良い点: Go Brunch has a very friendly and warm design, this helps to build proximity with colleagues and with leads and prospects. It helps us build our own branding with is to offer customized solutions. the second thing I like most is the no need to install any software to use. This is very helpful when you work with a team and clientes in different geographic locations and with limited resources.
改善点: Sometimes due to technical difficulties there is a delay in delivering the recorded section. I use the free version, so I understand completely. And it is valid to point that I've always got the file it was never lost or erased. Congratulations for that!

The UI is amazing and looks very interesting by giving a classroom experience or as if we would sit in a conference room during office meetings. GoBrunch allows us to use various file formats which makes it easy for uploading and downloading it, also if you miss downloading it in a Real-time session we can go back and download it at ease
改善点: I am loving all the new features being added however I would love it if we are able to use everybody's camera at the same time. The mobile phone browser experience is a little difficult as the screen is small and since it is convenient for people to login on phone they also prefer to use it and I wish GoBrunch made this experience easier too

タイトル: Do Meetings with GoBranch

タイトル: The Serbian GoBrunch Pioneer
投稿者: Caslav セルビアのManager 教育管理, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "The Serbian GoBrunch Pioneer"

Possibility for the participants of my sessions to participate them – only through a browser, without any obligation to install anything special...
改善点: Relatively confusing sign in procedure – little less optimal for the less experienced users... Lack of possibility to set typical equipment (e.g. mic or camera) in advance, but rather depending on the OS defaults... Lack of "MIRROR-option" on the video-preview window... Lack of chroma-key background setting in the video-broadcasting.

タイトル: Low effort, full featured mobile app solution for Shopify stores
投稿者: Damien オーストラリアのCTO 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 食品、飲料, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Low effort, full featured mobile app solution for Shopify stores"

We don't have to run a separate dev pipeline for our mobile app and everything we deploy to our Shopify store is instantly available in the app as well. A fraction of the cost of a custom native app and far more features than drag & drop Shopify app builders.
改善点: Not quite a snappy as a native app, but this is to be expected for a wrapper app solution. Also need to log in more often than a typical native app.

タイトル: Mobiloud App is great
投稿者: Jamie カナダのPresident 化粧品, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Mobiloud App is great"

タイトル: Exceptonal Customer Service

良い点: We needed something fast - without the hassle of a dev team to support it and with MobiLoud we got all of that on short timeframes.

タイトル: Mobiloud is a great fit for small companies who want to have an app to go with their wordpress site
投稿者: Gabriel アメリカのCo-Founder 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Mobiloud is a great fit for small companies who want to have an app to go with their wordpress site"
良い点: What I like most about the software is that it pulls content from my site... this means I don't have to load content in 2 places. It creates a hyrbrid app. Not native and not a shell. Some of the code is custom and that is created by the Mobiloud team. The second thing I like is the communication with the team there is very professional.

Also, there are some limitations of what the Mobiloud platform can do. I wanted a specific feature however they could not do it at that time... in the future it might be a possibility.

タイトル: Reliable push notifications without building everything from scratch
投稿者: Furkan トルコのFounder 認証済みLinkedInユーザー デザイン, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Reliable push notifications without building everything from scratch"
良い点: What I like most about OneSignal is how quickly we can add push notifications to a new product without having to build the whole notification infrastructure ourselves. We use it in SaaS and mobile/web projects, both for client work and some of our own products. The SDKs and documentation are generally good, and once the initial integration is completed, sending and managing notifications is very straightforward. I also like having segmentation, scheduling and basic analytics in the same place. For smaller products or early-stage projects, the free and entry-level options make it especially easy to get started.
改善点: The main limitation for me is that some of the more useful features become restricted as the product grows, so you eventually need to look more carefully at the paid plans and usage limits. The dashboard is generally easy to use, but some settings around segmentation, users and platform configuration can take a little time to understand at first. Advanced customization may also require additional development work, so it is not completely no-code once your notification flows become more complex.

タイトル: Push notification central
投稿者: Tomás カナダのSenior Software Developer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 自営業 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Push notification central"
良い点: I found One Signal to be the best option for getting started with push notifications. They provide an excellent, documented SDK for almost any programming language and platform where your project is running. New features were always in place to provide more functionality, and any adjustments needed during the setup process were both easy and valuable.
改善点: For Latin American markets, using WhatsApp is necessary when communicating with your clients. It is a very competitive channel, and the users are often more oriented to be notified and contacted regarding sales and promotions through this channel. This integration is not easy to use in One Singal, even thought they are working to keep up with the competition.

タイトル: Onesignal - The Popular Among All
投稿者: Sonu インドのAdmin マーケティング、広告, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Onesignal - The Popular Among All"
良い点: Onesignal has wide support to almost all kind of platforms, So if you want to use Onesignal for App/Website at the same time this is the best option because they have SDK for every platform and the detailed documentation will help you to implement is quick, They have a WordPress plugin to make your task easy if you are a blogger
改善点: They promised that it will be free for lifetime when I started using OneSignal. It was I think 2016 and since then I gained 70K subscribers then they set the limit of 3)K and then 10K so it just they offered fake promise I guess, If I move to any other platform I lose 70K users otherwise pay for it.

タイトル: Easy cross-platform push from a single API, watch the pricing
投稿者: Kaynan カナダのSoftware Engineer コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Easy cross-platform push from a single API, watch the pricing"
良い点: OneSignal gives us one API to send push notifications to web, iOS and Android users of our apps. The Node SDK is straightforward to call from our backend, segments and tags let us target users by app and behavior, and delivery stats in the dashboard make it easy to see what actually reached people. Getting started was fast and the free tier let us validate it before scaling up.
改善点: At high volume the pricing climbs quickly, and some useful features (advanced analytics, more granular segmentation) sit behind higher plans. Debugging why a specific device did not get a notification can be slow, and keeping our own user IDs in sync with OneSignal subscriptions needed extra work on our side.

タイトル: Using One Signal to increase user retention
投稿者: Victor パナマのHead of Digital Intelligece 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 新聞, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Using One Signal to increase user retention"
良い点: I like the user friendly admin panel for non tech-savvy users and the integration with many services/platforms.
改善点: I tThe pricing model has a big jump between the free version to the next tier. I will think in a mid-cost plan for small and medium size business.

タイトル: Secure, Reliable File Management with a Familiar Desktop Experience
投稿者: Lukas アメリカのSenior SEM Manager マーケティング、広告, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Secure, Reliable File Management with a Familiar Desktop Experience"
良い点: What I like most about Egnyte is how naturally it fits into our existing file management workflow. The mapped drive lets us access cloud files directly through File Explorer / Finder, so users can continue working within a familiar desktop environment. This keeps the learning curve relatively low and avoids the constant downloading and re-uploading required by some other cloud platforms. Egnyte also handles large files reliably, which is especially valuable when working with complex project documents. Sharing files with clients and external partners is straightforward, with useful controls for passwords, expiration dates, and permissions. The version history provides a strong safety net, making it easy to recover an earlier copy if something is accidentally changed or deleted. I also appreciate that files can be accessed remotely without taking up large amounts of local storage. Overall, Egnyte combines secure cloud storage with the familiarity and convenience of a traditional shared drive.
改善点: What I like least about Egnyte is that the desktop application can occasionally experience sync delays or become unstable when handling heavy file activity. It can sometimes report that a sync has completed even when files are still pending, which creates uncertainty about whether everyone is working from the latest version. File locking is useful for preventing conflicts, but it can also hold up work when someone leaves a file open and is unavailable to release the lock. Some advanced settings, such as version history and sharing permissions, require switching from the desktop drive to the web portal. In rare cases, customer support has been slow to react at the initial stage, with complex issues often requiring escalation before reaching someone who can resolve them. The pricing feels high for general file storage, especially for companies already paying for Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace. Unexpected bandwidth limits and paid add-ons for external sharing can further reduce the overall value.

タイトル: Perfection for a virtual company
投稿者: Brandon アメリカのFounder 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Perfection for a virtual company"
良い点: Globonics is a virtual company with employees working from home in many different locations. We needed a way to monitor these employees' performance. With Teramind we are able to: 1. Monitor emails both incoming/outgoing and we are able to search for key words across our entire enterprise's email flow 2. We monitor clock in / out performances. There is a tendency for people to clock in when working from home and simply not work for the first 30 to 60 minutes. 3. When we spot a productivity opportunity we can go back to the exact time and employee and watch their recorded video. We have used these videos during performance reviews. 4. The recorded videos can also be used to provide training on what we call EIO's (efficiency improvement opportunities). For example, a user spends 4 hours working on 100 items. The user was not using a series of hot keys programmed into our software. We took the video and showed a before and after. After user worked 130 items in 4 hours. 5. Teramind has an automated alert system that can be customized for many things but is robust even out of the box. It monitors for key website usage (monster.com/indeed/etc) and will let you know if your personnel are looking for other jobs. It monitors for file uploads, unauthorized printing, and more. 6. We are successfully using Teramind to satisfy SOC2 DLP (data loss prevention) audit requirements. Needless to say we LOVE it!
改善点: When we were using the hosted version: The only suggestion I have is to tweak how your licensing assignment works. When using the hosted version every time a "user" logs onto a computer it creates a new "employee" in Teramind and eats up a license automatically. There are times when our trainers travel to employee homes or when we have an onsite computer at a client that has multiple employees logon to it where we do not want this behavior. Instead, my suggestion is it creates a profile for each employee and track's their usage across ALL devices they log on to. Now that we use our own internal server: Teramind tracks by actual device and not by user so the licensing application issue no longer exists however, we still have many duplicate employees as it still creates a duplicate each time they logon to a different device.

タイトル: Auvik Transformed How We Manage Client Networks
投稿者: Afendi マレーシアのSales Director コンピュータ・ネットワーク, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Auvik Transformed How We Manage Client Networks"
良い点: Auvik's automated network discovery and real-time topology mapping is genuinely impressive — it saves our team hours of manual documentation every time we onboard a new client. The moment the collector is deployed, we get a live, accurate map of the entire network including switches, routers, firewalls, and even unmanaged devices. The multi-tenant dashboard is a huge win for MSP operations, letting us monitor all customer networks from a single pane of glass without constantly switching contexts. Traffic analysis (TrafficInsights) has been invaluable for troubleshooting bandwidth complaints, and the automated config backups for network devices give us peace of mind and audit-ready documentation. Alert quality is also better than most competitors — fewer false positives means our technicians actually pay attention when something fires.
改善点: Pricing is the biggest pain point — it is billed per managed device, which can add up quickly when managing large or dense networks, making it harder to maintain healthy margins for smaller SMB clients in Malaysia where customers are more price-sensitive. The onboarding learning curve is steeper than expected for junior technicians; the UI looks clean but the underlying concepts around collectors, sites, and device tiers take time to grasp. Reporting is functional but lacks the polish and flexibility we need for professional customer-facing reports — exporting and customising report templates feels limited compared to the rest of the platform. Integration options, while growing, could be deeper particularly around PSA ticketing workflows with tools more commonly used in the Asian market.

投稿者: Drew アメリカのSR SYS Admin 消費財, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Want to Discover Devices? Let's Go!"
良い点: The automated network discovery and live topology mapping are easily the best features. As soon as you deploy a collector, it maps out the whole network, which saves huge amounts of manual documentation time. Automatic configuration backups for switches, firewalls, and routers give you great peace of mind. The alerting system is fast, making it easy for team members to jump in and pinpoint hardware bottlenecks or offline access points right away. There is a slight learning curve - but it's absolutely worth it in terms of network security. Patching and bug fixes are released regularly
改善点: Pricing is based on billable devices, so the subscription cost can stack up fast as your infrastructure grows. The default notification settings can also be pretty noisy right out of the box. You definitely have to spend a bit of time early on tweaking the thresholds so your inbox does not get flooded with low priority alerts.

タイトル: Auvik rocks!
投稿者: Thanya アメリカのTechnology Support Associate III 情報技術、情報サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Auvik rocks!"
良い点: I like how easy it's to set up, there's a training portal and Knowledge Base for any doubts or concerns that I have. Easy to deploy and easy to manage, support is very responsive, alerts can be customized or leave as default, how granular permission works and all the integrations it has.
改善点: There's no way to keep historic data of network devices, if a device goes offline there's no way to track where it was connected to and makes it harder to troubleshoot.

タイトル: Comprehensive control over AWS resources from one interface
投稿者: Adam 英国のSenior Technical Writer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 5,001～10,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Comprehensive control over AWS resources from one interface"
良い点: The breadth of services available through one interface is its greatest strength. Resources, permissions, monitoring information, service health and billing data can all be accessed using the same account. Search, favourites and recently visited services make commonly used areas easier to reach. The console also provides helpful visual guidance when configuring unfamiliar services or reviewing existing resources
改善点: The sheer number of AWS services and configuration options can make the console overwhelming until you are used to it. Interfaces are not always consistent between services, and important settings may be located within several layers of navigation. It can also be easy to overlook which account or Region is currently selected. Clearer and more prominent context indicators would help reduce the risk of viewing or changing the wrong resources.

タイトル: So easy to use

良い点: The AWS Management Console was updated a while back with new UI and it has been so much easier to use since. There are updates daily on the UI almost I can tell that a LOT of effort went into this. The simple and clean design makes it so easy to provision and manage most AWS resources.
改善点: I dislike how naming can sometimes be a little weird. For example, if you set up an AWS EC2 instance on the console, it will name the VPC using weird names which aren't bad but it can be confusing because the VPC then has an internal name and a display name.

タイトル: AWS console centralizes cloud infrastructure management and Lambda monitoring

良い点: CloudWatch logs simplify serverless Lambda monitoring and help debug execution bugs. Tweak S3 bucket features manually handles rapid deployment configurations well during incidents.
改善点: The dense navigation structure causes a steep learning curve, and confusing IAM permission error messages often lead to silent bugs and issues.

タイトル: A steep learning curve, yet powerful for navigating the AWS Service Library
投稿者: Connor 英国のIT Team Lead メディア制作, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A steep learning curve, yet powerful for navigating the AWS Service Library"
良い点: It provides direct access to a plethora of enterprise services and solutions in a centralised console that would have traditionally required enormous investment of time, resources and expertise to be able to investigate and/or utilise. The management console has what seems to be an extremely deep learning curve, but if you are somewhat familiar with the way the services are delivered (i.e interactions and distinctions between IAM users; roles; groups; manager vs in-line policies etc) then it can begin to grow into a powerful tool. Once familiarised enough there are plenty of options and third party solutions that can be integrated and architected to automate and standardise on processes for service delivery which I think is where AWS really begins to excel.
改善点: It is a gargantuan task to undertake with little or no experience, unless coming from another cloud provider potentially such as Azure or GCP. To that end you could spend a hundred hours on the platform and still find new services and errors that are completely new to you; when paired with frequent updates and changes to services, architecture and command formatting this can make managing in small or medium businesses a very daunting task. The use of third party tools such as Intruder (automatically scans your env for security concerns) feels like a baseline requirement for security and risk management.

タイトル: Are You Ready To Manage?
投稿者: Drew アメリカのSR SYS Admin 消費財, 201～500人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Are You Ready To Manage?"
良い点: When our team managed cloud resources manually, the AWS Management Console was our primary gateway for daily operations. It bundled an impressive set of features into one browser interface, giving us direct control over everything from storage buckets to computing instances. We especially appreciated how easy it was to grant temporary remote access through CloudShell and SSM without configuring separate bastions. Finding core tools for patch management and server visibility was straightforward once we customized the console home screen widgets. For quick administrative tasks or occasional troubleshooting, having all services accessible in one location provided great flexibility.
改善点: There was definitely a steep learning curve for new team members because of the sheer number of services packed into the platform. Ease of use suffered whenever AWS redesigned sub service layouts, which forced us to relearn navigation paths every now and then. Built in ticket management and operational incident tracking through OpsCenter felt somewhat limited for our workflow, so we quickly linked those tasks to external ticketing tools instead. Additionally, reaching technical customer support required higher tier support plans, which meant basic account inquiries often took longer to resolve than we liked.

良い点: Process.science is a powerful automation tool that has the ability to automate virtually any business process. The platform is incredibly versatile, with features such as process modeling and design, process control, and forms automation. The visual representation of processes helps identify inefficiencies and bottlenecks, making it easy to improve processes and enhance productivity. The real-time monitoring feature ensures that issues are detected and resolved quickly, leading to increased compliance and efficiency. The forms automation capability is particularly impressive, with the ability to collect, process, and store data from forms, leading to significant time savings and improved customer service.
改善点: One potential drawback of using process.science is that it may have limited capabilities when it comes to handling more complex or nuanced tasks that require human judgment or decision-making. Another potential negative is that the platform is dependent on existing systems and software, which may limit its integration capabilities if a company's systems are outdated or not properly configured.

タイトル: Reliable File Transfers
投稿者: Sarbagya アメリカのData Analyst 病院、ヘルスケア, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Reliable File Transfers"
良い点: What I like most about SFTP To Go is how intuitive and clean the interface is. The site layout is simple and uncluttered, so I can find exactly what I need without digging through menus or settings. After spending all day looking at data, that simplicity makes a real difference. I don't have to think hard about where to upload a file, how to check a folder, or where to manage access; it's all right where I'd expect it to be. Tasks that could feel tedious on other platforms take just a few clicks here. It's the kind of tool that stays out of the way and lets me get my work done quickly, which is exactly what I want from a file transfer service.
改善点: What I like least about SFTP To Go is how it handles session timeouts. When the site times out, there's no warning or message letting you know your session has expired. Instead, it leaves you on the same page you were working on, so everything looks normal. The problem shows up when you try to click something: the buttons stop responding, and you end up stuck in a loop where nothing you click takes you anywhere. The only way out is to manually refresh the page, which isn't obvious the first time it happens. A simple timeout notice or an automatic redirect to the login page would fix this and save some confusion.

タイトル: Simple to use and reliable ERP
投稿者: John カナダのDirector, Information Technology 食品製造, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Simple to use and reliable ERP"
良い点: Right out of the box Syspro implements many best practise recommendations and for most businesses that's a great start. You can get up and running very quickly without having to customize Syspro. A key feature though is the extensibility of the software. We all have that internal process that no one could call best practise. It's unique to us, it's ugly and painful but we just can't live without it. Fortunately, Syspro gives you a very robust business object framework to deal with these situations. You can easily create customized features and external applications using your own programming tools like Visual Studio but that integrate seamlessly with Syspro. Business objects allow you to enforce strict data schemas so you can be confident that inbound data meets the Syspro standards - you only want good data going in! We have been able to develop numerous add ons and custom applications that add real value to our Syspro implementation. Like any major ERP software, Syspro cannot be everything to everyone. While the core functionality is extensive and varied the ability to quickly build new features that tie directly into Syspro is a sure way to improve your ROI.
改善点: Patching is always a challenge. Syspro allows you to heavily customize the core product with custom scripts, screens and add ons. As a result, a solid testing strategy is needed to make sure that all customizations are properly tested in your dev environment before deploying to production. Things can occasionally go wrong with a specific port (patch) and core functionality can be impacted. Syspro are quick to respond to these issues though. Syspro doesn't publish hotfix availability for every known issue so be sure to ask your VAR when patching if there are any that are relevant to you.

AMP HTML: The native support for AMP allows us to make our emails interactive rather than static, which is a rare feature to find implemented this well. Efficiency: The "Modules" system is brilliant. We can build reusable headers, footers, and content blocks that ensure brand consistency without re-coding every time. Support: This deserves its own mention. It is hands down the best customer service I have dealt with in a long time. They are responsive, technically literate, and incredibly helpful.

The plugin accepted overlapping paid appointments for the same staff/resource multiple times on a live production website. This created serious operational problems for our client, because the same private spa room was booked by two customers at overlapping times. The support experience was also very poor. We opened an urgent ticket and provided appointment IDs, WooCommerce order IDs, screenshots, calendar screenshots, Google Drive documentation and even WordPress admin access. Despite this, the replies were slow, often generic, and the ticket remained unread for several days at times. We were also asked for information that had already been provided or was no longer fully available because the client had to operationally move/cancel bookings in the live business due to the delayed support response.

タイトル: Flow is moving to a wrong direction
投稿者: Anton 英国のFounder 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Flow is moving to a wrong direction"

タイトル: Not the cheapest, but...

良い点: I was invited to a team that uses Flow. Compared to Asana, the user experience is better, which makes it a tool worth exploring for your next project.
改善点: The trial was too short, so I could not convince another team to try it...

タイトル: Game changer project management tool
投稿者: Büra トルコのIT Project Manager 認証済みLinkedInユーザー コンピュータ・ソフトウェア, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Game changer project management tool"
良い点: Flow is an incredibly intelligent tool. Its capacity to organize numerous tasks across various teams is fantastic, especially in a business with numerous clients where keeping things categorized is crucial. The feature that allows for recurring tasks is a real lifesaver! What I appreciate the most is the flexibility it offers for setting up recurring tasks on specific dates, whether daily, weekly or monthly.
改善点: When dealing with a large number of cards, the absence of color-coding or the ability to establish visual priorities can make certain projects feel rather daunting. Having the option to apply visual tags would be a valuable addition. I'm looking forward to the upcoming mobile app update with the new UI.

タイトル: Perfect Booking Software for Aerial, Dance, or Fitness Studio
投稿者: Lauren アメリカのExecutive Editor, Work Truck Magazine 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 出版, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Perfect Booking Software for Aerial, Dance, or Fitness Studio"
良い点: I manage an aerial silks studio and we needed a system that would allow us to book classes, private lessons, and events. The Bookeo System is inexpensive, connects to PayPal, super easy to set up, and allows for multiple instructors to access the system. Creating new one-off classes is easy as well as canceling classes. We can create memberships, punchcards, discounts, promo codes, and more. I tested several other systems before settling on Bookeo and haven't turned back. They are also very prompt with responses and continually update the system for improved functionality. The system can allow for bookings paid in advance or for cash payment on arrival.
改善点: It's not the prettiest system on either the back end or the end users side, but it gets the job done. I do wish it would let people book more than one student at a time with a punch card at once (you can use a punchcard for other students but have to book each one separately). I also wish there was a way to bill or invoice students for missed classes so we could accept more bookings without payment required in advance. You can allow cash payments but if someone doesn't show there isn't an easy way to bill for missed classes.

タイトル: Best software until, Vest value, Best Support
投稿者: Cédric スイスのDirector 代替医療, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Best software until, Vest value, Best Support"
良い点: Bookeo, really guys I love you, best product, best support ! They are always quick to reply and help you find a solution.

タイトル: Not worth the money

良い点: It is easy to sign up but I don't particularly enjoy the app
