タイトル: Not created for National business (NOT timezone friendly)
投稿者: Vanessa アメリカのOnboarding manager コンピュータ、ネットワーク・セキュリティ, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "Not created for National business (NOT timezone friendly)"
良い点: It makes setting up group classes very easy and you can have custom questions for each customer and/or specific classes.
改善点: No way to auto-populate timezones which caused much confusion for customers and missed classes. Integration with Google calendar but not customizable, doesn't allow for Google calendar notifications. Custom fields errored so I couldn't make necessary fields required, fields disappeared over a weekend, booking fields didn't show for the customer. Doesn't feel like a reliable fit. No custom developement available. If it doesn't fit everything you want right now, this is not the product for you.

タイトル: Great product!
投稿者: Billy アメリカのOwner/Operatior 認証済みLinkedInユーザー レクリエーション施設・サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Great product!"
良い点: After years of using Bookeo, I should have wrote this review sooner. I run a kayak touring biz, we wear a lot of hats here, and the last thing we need is a booking system that has problems. We have turned down all the salespeople for other systems. Bookeo does what we need it to do.
改善点: This may be possible with Bookeo, but it doesn't appear to save data older than 2 years. Older data is useful for planning purposes. Right now, we are downloading the date in XLS format and saving it to an independent folder. Last thing, some customers can't figure out how to use the "previous days - following days" buttons on the tour descriptions/dates opening page. They think that the only tours being offered are just on that page. We haven't kept data on this, but I don't think it's very much.

タイトル: A one Hub solution that could work a bit faster
投稿者: Corstiaan オランダのUnity 3D Developer 認証済みLinkedInユーザー インターネット, 501～1,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A one Hub solution that could work a bit faster"
良い点: It's a one-hub solution. Everything I need is within reach. Task management and planning in the card-wall of tickets are indispensable.
改善点: Slow: Opening a page or a ticket can sometimes take seconds of looking at a blank page. When used in meeting this is really annoying. Clutter: It lacks options to clean-up. Since I work with it for 10 years I have 150 projects in my view and no way to hide old projects. New projects appear at the bottom of that list, so scrolling galore! Yes, I could go to the project-owner and ask him to archive, but you know how that goes in large companies and I don't have rights to archive so I'm stuck with over 10 years of old projects. GIT: It could use some more optimizations, specially Merge-request handling / canceling, retaining comments etc.

タイトル: Strive to be best toolset for development organization
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Strive to be best toolset for development organization"
良い点: It is a cloud based solution and can be accessed from anywhere. Support for protocols like git. It has embedded document management workflow.
改善点: Lack of support for document search. Lack of support for wide adoption among developers. No easy way of project management, bug tracking etc. At the least the versions that we used in the past. No management reports. It serves the basic purpose of source code management with git. No clear support for command line tools and scripting for ci/cd pipelines.

タイトル: Slow and inconvenient

The way the tickets keep track of the dates and hours of every change in the ticket is really good. And the relationships you can build between tickets is good too.
改善点: A don't like many things about this software, the main thing is that Is too hard to plan long-term using it. Also is hard to have access to quantitative reports. To keep all my information accurate and easy to access I use Airtable to organize the information I have on Assembla. Because Assembla is too slow and too hard to get reports from it. Everyone at my office does the same thing of using another tool to interpret and organize the info we have on Assembla. I think a Gantt view would help and a view more likely to excel in which you could add and edit tickets faster. It would be great if you could build features for the admins to build their own statistics and reports. And features to automate some actions on tickets.

タイトル: Very user friendly, some bugs though.
投稿者: Claire アメリカのSalon owner. 使用期間： 1年以上 共有 "Very user friendly, some bugs though."
良い点: I like that I can add a new client from my phones contacts. I love that is also send reminder texts for me so I don't have to.
改善点: I don't like that the phone number isn't auto drafted over from my contacts when adding a new person. So if I need to text then from the app, I have to copy and paste the number into MyCuts. I have had a few wrong numbers in my records within my cuts because of this. And there seems to be a problem with the function that puts the time and date on the appointment. I have had clients text me many times to make sure I had the date correct rather than the one that that was sent to them in the reminder. And lastly, I think that if you change an appointment time the same day, it should ask you before sending the client another reminder. They usually understand what is happening as far as the time change because I have contacted them to move them up or down. I have had clients find it very irritating that the app send that many more reminders the same day.

タイトル: MyCuts
投稿者: Trisha カナダのHairstylist 消費者サービス, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "MyCuts"

I can also track which products I have on hand, which I'm running low on and which need to be reordered.
改善点: Works great but seems to get a bit glitchy with multiple clients and stylists. Best to be used for one stylist who has lower about of clients. Would be nice if there was a way to have clients book in their own appointments.

投稿者: Andrés J アメリカのDirector 認証済みLinkedInユーザー Eラーニング, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "Great alternative, but still in an early stage"
良い点: The price is great. It has many options, so in the ratio of money/value, it's one of the best solutions available today. If you're tech savvy or don't mind reading instructions and/or testing until things works, Videolinq is a great solution for multi broadcasting to YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn and many other online platforms.
改善点: A few months ago, they started adding messages to the control panel, where they constantly ask for your feedback. This messages popup at the worst times, e.g., when you are on the middle of a live streaming, and you don't need any distractions. Plus, they are not configured on a smart way, so that if you have already seen it or answer it, it won't show up again.

タイトル: A great alternative for multi-streaming with Closed Captions
投稿者: Andres J コロンビアのDirector オンラインメディア, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A great alternative for multi-streaming with Closed Captions"
良い点: It's easy to use and configure to multiple social media and video sites. In a few minutes, you configure a multi-stream event to YouTube, Twitch, Facebook and more. Plus, you can easily use the same setting if you have a schedule. They also have the option to add in real time captions in multiple languages and with the ability to automatically translate them.
改善点: The interface is simple, yet, not the best UX. However, it does the job and works!

タイトル: Highly Recommend
投稿者: Heather アメリカのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー エンタテインメント, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Highly Recommend"
良い点: Setup was super easy and most of the work was automatically done inside of Videolinq, which is way better than others that I have tried that require a manual setup. It was important for me to be able to use this easily with Zoom and OBS Studio. Both are seamless and easy to use setups while directly streaming from Zoom was an unexpected bonus. A major reason I tried this software was because of the CDN ability. I am beyond thrilled with the ability to upload pre-recorded videos and have them scheduled in advance. Not only that but to do it at this price point, is incredible. Another "bonus" for me was that I am able to host a video on VideoLinq and people can view it from my website, which essentially removes the need to embed YouTube or vimeo videos that include lots of host branding and links. I had been looking for a solution for many months, and to have this in the same place as my scheduled live streams is awesome.
改善点: The UI on the backend isn't the most user-friendly. There are some updates in the pipeline that i'm waiting for.

タイトル: One Stop Solution for Organizing your Sales Process

As a user of the tool, I feel immensely happy as it allowed me to automate my regular work. Highly recommend this tool for any of the organization.

タイトル: After trying EVERY CRM I could find on Google THIS IS IT!
投稿者: Steve アメリカのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー マーケティング、広告, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 無料トライアル 共有 "After trying EVERY CRM I could find on Google THIS IS IT!"
良い点: I tried literally every CRM I could find on Google and nothing worked until I found Salesmate. I'm honestly struggling to write this review only because I keep rambling on about features I love that it gets way too long. Bottom line for me is this just works! It's so easy to use, easy to set up, every feature works (which may sound weird but I have had at least 10 other CRM's that features didn't work right or I had to do some kind of workaround to have a basic email workflow), the layout is fantastic, the mobile app works great, the price is good - I can't fault this! And when I say I tried every other CRM I could find, I mean it. I didn't try Salesmate sooner because I couldn't find it sooner. I can't recommend Salesmate enough and again - I have tried SO MANY other CRM's including Hubspot, Zendesk Sell, Nutshell, Pipedrive, Keep, Salesforce, Monday.com, ClickUp, Airtable, the list goes on and on and on. This is honestly the best. Just sign up for Salesmate. If you are still reading, just do it!
改善点: The only thing I can say is within the deals page when you click on a deal I wish that was laid out a little better. But I am truly nitpicking here. You can work everything just fine, I have had no issues, it's so easy to keep track of everything, I just wish this one page was a little easier but in my opinion that is not a reason to avoid this platform. Again, just sign up. I love everything about this platform. I will say, I haven't experienced the customer service yet but there is a chat icon right at the top of the screen and already that is better than a lot of other CRM's I've tried.

タイトル: Salesmate Review - Michael
投稿者: Michael オーストラリアのRegional Account Manager VIC TAS and NZ 食品製造, 51～200人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Salesmate Review - Michael"

The business representatives have been consistently professional, responsive, and genuinely invested in our success. Salesmate has significantly benefited our sales team by streamlining our processes and providing valuable insights that have boosted our productivity and sales performance. The tools and features available have empowered our team to work more effectively, manage leads better, and close deals faster. The automation and analytics provided by Salesmate have allowed our sales team to focus on selling, while reducing administrative tasks. Every interaction with their support team has been positive, and their expertise and dedication have played a crucial role in our smooth experience. I highly recommend Salesmate to any business looking for top-notch service, support, and a positive impact on their sales operations.
改善点: Nothing So Far. Great Platform For Any Sales Team.

タイトル: The only way a startup can manage a global workforce

タイトル: Fastest Video template editor Online!

良い点: Tyle has a very simplistic interface that is very easy to use. Videos can be created on the basis of slides and there are slide credits (limited) each month. Each slide has numerous functions of customizing, Tyle has around 12 readymade and instantly accessible design layouts to choose from and many color themes for changing the looks of each slide. Each slide has a button to display all the layers in that particular slide - in an isometric view, and you can select individual layers easily from this isometric view. Besides the color themes, there is a section for adding Tyle heading tile and sub-heading contents, and a box overlay shape behind the title content. Each of these elements can be instantly tweaked to your advantage, which saves huge amount of time. Also, the best feature I liked is the access to premium quality stock videos and photos from the library of Pexel and Storyblock. The slides can also be resized instantly into the standard resolutions and sizes suitable for social media like stories, square size, standard 16:9 video etc. When I resize the slides, the contents therein are quickly re-positioned and adjusted to the new size dimensions of the slide - which is a huge time-saver!
改善点: Tyle has a fixed number of Video design layouts and templates, and you have to create all videos only according to the readymade templates. You can't manually play around with the position and sizes of each template element. The readily available Stock library must be used in conjunction with titles and contents generated by Tyle - and this poses a serious problem occasionally, because if the titles, text and Tyle contents obstruct the videos or images, you can't do anything to improve the composition, because you are limited to the readymade design layouts provided by Tyle. Tyle also applies automatic transitions between slides that has occasional glitches that must be re-edited in an external program. Tyle is also not good for making title intro slides or end credits/outro slides, and that has to be done in another video editor. The synchronization of the videos and music (provided by Tyle) cannot be controlled, nor is there a timeline editor to polish the timings and durations of each cut and split in the video editing.

タイトル: A smart tool that looks slick but has some frustrating limitations
投稿者: Paul 日本のHuman Resource Development 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 情報技術、情報サービス, 10,000+人規模の会社 使用期間： 6～12か月 共有 "A smart tool that looks slick but has some frustrating limitations"
良い点: Mentimeter allows you to easily (very easily) create and launch live, interactive polls, surveys and quizzes and create cool things like wordclouds in real time. It has a really smooth mobile integration through the use of QR codes which is a killer feature in the modern age. We have frequently had "wow moments" in meetings, workshops and training sessions using Mentimeter as people see animated quiz standing come in in real time and the like. Zero learning curve from the users point of view and almost frictionless.
改善点: It has a few limitations that make it less slick from the point of view of the person using it compared to the people answering the questions. It does not integrate well with Powerpoint. There is an outdated and never updated plug in which crashes all the time and thus unusable. The other option is to import your slides into Mentimeter and do the whole thing from there. This is not always advisable because animations are not preserved and the general look of the slides suffers. Without PPT integration, if you are running a remote session using Zoom or similar you are forcing people to navigate away from your window to use Mentimeter and then relying on them coming back to see the results come in in real time. It damages the experience tremendously. You get around this by showing QR codes and having them do it on their phones, but still, not ideal. Another issue is that moving or otherwise adjusting slide shows inside Mentimeter is a huge pain. Drag and drop to change the order of slides is basically broken, so me and my team always make sure everything is in order before importing (if we even use importing, see above). Even a no-integrated session with more than a few Mentimeter slides is a huge pain to adjust. Finally, although they claim that switching between say PPT and Mentimeter on the fly is easy, it inhibits you from easily and smoothly moving to the next question. Not ideal.

Other users in my organization have been able to use it as well, without any help from me. A few of our teams are pretty old-school, so the fact that our people were able to use it without needing my guidance is a testament to Sakari's simple and logical menus, buttons, and overall structure. The built-in help docs are a blessing as well.
改善点: We had a specific use case that wasn't really supported by Sakari, but then again it's not supported in any SMS tool I tried. The good news is that the Sakari support team did some magic to help me create a manual workaround that allowed us to send our campaigns exactly as intended. Super helpful! Guess that wasn't really a dislike--sorry :(

タイトル: Great SMS software that integrates with Hubspot and has its own web interface
投稿者: William 英国のProduct Lead 非営利団体運営, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Great SMS software that integrates with Hubspot and has its own web interface"
良い点: I like three things about Sakari a lot. First, the way it integrated seamlessly with Hubspot to show all my Hubspot contacts in Sakari, let me see proper SMS coversation history in Hubspot, and allow me to include SMS messages in Hubspot workflows. It's added SMS to Hubspot in about 30 seconds with almost no config. Secondly, the way it has a web interface for sending and receiving text messages. Before this we had individual team members on their own phones. Now we have one interface the whole team uses. It just makes it so easy to handle conversations with our users. Finally, we've set it up to alert us by email whenever there is a new message - and even better, we can reply to the text message direct from our email without having to open the web interface. Oh and the customer support is amazingly responsive. They use Intercom so it's easy and rapid. And they are helpful and nice :)
改善点: The design and usability of the web interface is still a bit clunky. It doesn't seem to remember the sort order or column selections which is a pain. The mobile app keeps logging itself out and is therefore not very useful. I'm a little anxious that there is no two factor authentication on login. Everything else we use has 2FA.

It lacks integration with other essential systems and safety compliance databases. 3) Bioraft - SciShield has poorly designed menus and unintuitive controls and is outdated and clunky. 4) Bioraft - Scishield has no link to safety data sheets other than a link to Google search, no SDS library management, and offers a simple downloaded CSV of what each lab manually entered. 5) Bioraft - Scishield provides no information in database format to download a list of your chemicals, with corresponding hazard classes, GSH codes, pictograms, proper cabinet container storage, or sortable queries based on any criteria. 6) Bioraft- Scishield, has bugs, fails to save data, often can not add chemicals due some type of error, and it is very clear the developers care very little about delivering a functional product offering insufficient customer support. タイトル: A powerful product at a reasonable price from a responsive developer
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 健康、ウェルネス、フィットネス, 1,001～5,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "A powerful product at a reasonable price from a responsive developer"
良い点: This product is very easy to use and easy to teach. I recently needed to take some medical leave and was able to train two others to do some of the more exotic things I do on the program within an hour. Others who might only need to check the status of documents, download them, or possibly upload them, will find that this is exceptionally simple and easy to do. Storage is a great bargain, and the more data we tag, the better our reports get. Finally, support has been great. We've had big projects that involved sending hundreds of documents for signature through CW on a short timeline, and support was very responsive for us during that time.
改善点: The AI is fairly limited in its usefulness for us, although some companies might need little more than party names and start dates. Some features are not immediately obvious--like searching in-text in uploaded documents--in where to find them. The UI does not translate very well to an iPad and touch screen, to the frustration of some of my colleagues.
